local BadgeService = game:GetService("BadgeService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local BadgeConfig = require(Shared.Config.BadgeConfig)
local Formulas = require(Shared.Modules.Formulas)
local Notifier = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.Notifier)

local AwardService = { Priority = 55 }

local checking = {}

local function statValue(data, stat)
	if stat == "ZonesUnlocked" then
		return Formulas.ZonesUnlocked(data)
	end
	return tonumber(data[stat]) or 0
end

function AwardService:Init(services)
	self.Services = services
	self.Data = services.DataService

	local function check(player)
		self:Check(player)
	end
	self.Data:OnProfileLoaded(check)
	if services.DestructionService then
		services.DestructionService.Wrecked:Connect(function(_, credits)
			for _, credit in ipairs(credits) do
				if credit.Counted then
					check(credit.Player)
				end
			end
		end)
	end
	if services.RebirthService then
		services.RebirthService.Reborn:Connect(check)
	end
	if services.ZoneService then
		services.ZoneService.ZoneUnlocked:Connect(check)
	end
	if services.EventService and services.EventService.ChaosCompleted then
		services.EventService.ChaosCompleted:Connect(function(participants)
			for _, player in ipairs(participants) do
				check(player)
			end
		end)
	end
end

function AwardService:Check(player)
	local data = self.Data:GetData(player)
	if not data or checking[player] then
		return
	end
	checking[player] = true
	for _, badge in ipairs(BadgeConfig.List) do
		if badge.Id > 0 and not data.Badges[badge.Key] and statValue(data, badge.Condition.Stat) >= badge.Condition.Value then
			local hasOk, alreadyOwned = pcall(BadgeService.UserHasBadgeAsync, BadgeService, player.UserId, badge.Id)
			if hasOk and alreadyOwned then
				data.Badges[badge.Key] = true
			else
				local ok, awarded = pcall(BadgeService.AwardBadge, BadgeService, player.UserId, badge.Id)
				if ok and awarded then
					data.Badges[badge.Key] = true
					Notifier.Send(player, { Kind = "Badge", Text = "BADGE UNLOCKED", Subtext = badge.Name, Icon = badge.Icon })
				end
			end
		end
	end
	checking[player] = nil
end

return AwardService

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local AssetConfig = require(Shared.Config.AssetConfig)

local rgb = Color3.fromRGB

local TEXTURES = {
	Spark = AssetConfig.Image("Spark") or "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds",
	Smoke = "rbxasset://textures/particles/explosion01_smoke_main.dds",
	Core = "rbxasset://textures/particles/explosion01_core_main.dds",
	Ring = AssetConfig.Image("Ring") or "rbxasset://textures/particles/explosion01_shockwave_main.dds",
	Shard = AssetConfig.Image("Shard") or "rbxasset://textures/particles/SquareParticle.png",
	Glow = AssetConfig.Image("Glow") or "rbxasset://textures/particles/forcefield_glow_main.dds",
}

local STYLES = {
	Small = { Scale = 1, Debris = 6, Fire = rgb(255, 150, 40), Smoke = rgb(90, 88, 86) },
	Medium = { Scale = 1.5, Debris = 10, Fire = rgb(255, 130, 30), Smoke = rgb(80, 78, 76) },
	Large = { Scale = 2.2, Debris = 14, Fire = rgb(255, 110, 20), Smoke = rgb(70, 68, 66) },
	Huge = { Scale = 3.2, Debris = 20, Fire = rgb(255, 100, 20), Smoke = rgb(60, 58, 56) },
	Electric = { Scale = 1.5, Debris = 8, Fire = rgb(34, 225, 255), Smoke = rgb(60, 70, 90) },
	Fuel = { Scale = 2.6, Debris = 12, Fire = rgb(255, 80, 20), Smoke = rgb(40, 38, 36) },
	Crystal = { Scale = 1.8, Debris = 14, Fire = rgb(200, 110, 255), Smoke = rgb(90, 60, 120) },
	Void = { Scale = 2.6, Debris = 14, Fire = rgb(150, 60, 255), Smoke = rgb(40, 20, 60) },
	Gold = { Scale = 2.2, Debris = 16, Fire = rgb(255, 210, 60), Smoke = rgb(120, 100, 60) },
	Plasma = { Scale = 2, Debris = 12, Fire = rgb(60, 230, 255), Smoke = rgb(50, 70, 100) },
}

local MATERIALS = {
	Metal = Enum.Material.Metal,
	Wood = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks,
	Rubber = Enum.Material.Rubber,
	Glass = Enum.Material.Glass,
	Concrete = Enum.Material.Concrete,
	Tech = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
	Crystal = Enum.Material.Neon,
	Gold = Enum.Material.Foil,
	Rock = Enum.Material.Basalt,
}

local ANCHOR_COUNT = 14
local MAX_DEBRIS = 110
local DEBRIS_LIFETIME = 1.9
local FADE = TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
local FLASH = TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

local Fx = {}

local folder = nil
local anchors = {}
local anchorIndex = 0
local freeDebris = {}
local activeDebris = 0
local lowEffects = false

local function sequence(points, scale)
	local keypoints = {}
	for _, point in ipairs(points) do
		table.insert(keypoints, NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(point[1], point[2] * (scale or 1)))
	end
	return NumberSequence.new(keypoints)
end

local function emitter(name, attachment, props)
	local particles = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	particles.Name = name
	particles.Enabled = false
	particles.Rate = 0
	for key, value in pairs(props) do
		particles[key] = value
	end
	particles.Parent = attachment
	return particles
end

local function buildAnchor(index)
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = "FxAnchor" .. index
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.Transparency = 1
	part.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
	part.Parent = folder
	local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment.Name = "Emitters"
	attachment.Parent = part
	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
	light.Name = "Flash"
	light.Brightness = 0
	light.Range = 16
	light.Parent = attachment
	return {
		Part = part,
		Light = light,
		Sparks = emitter("Sparks", attachment, {
			Texture = TEXTURES.Spark,
			LightEmission = 1,
			Speed = NumberRange.new(18, 42),
			Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.2, 0.55),
			SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180),
			Drag = 5,
			Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -35, 0),
			Size = sequence({ { 0, 0.6 }, { 1, 0 } }),
		}),
		Fire = emitter("Fire", attachment, {
			Texture = TEXTURES.Core,
			LightEmission = 1,
			Speed = NumberRange.new(4, 14),
			Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.25, 0.55),
			SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180),
			RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-120, 120),
			Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360),
			Drag = 3,
		}),
		Smoke = emitter("Smoke", attachment, {
			Texture = TEXTURES.Smoke,
			Speed = NumberRange.new(2, 7),
			Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.65, 1.25),
			SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180),
			RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-40, 40),
			Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360),
			Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 4, 0),
			Drag = 2,
			Transparency = sequence({ { 0, 0.55 }, { 1, 1 } }),
		}),
		Ring = emitter("Ring", attachment, {
			Texture = TEXTURES.Ring,
			LightEmission = 1,
			Speed = NumberRange.new(0, 0),
			Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.35, 0.35),
			Transparency = sequence({ { 0, 0.15 }, { 1, 1 } }),
		}),
		Glow = emitter("Glow", attachment, {
			Texture = TEXTURES.Glow,
			LightEmission = 1,
			Speed = NumberRange.new(0, 0),
			Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.18, 0.26),
			Transparency = sequence({ { 0, 0.35 }, { 1, 1 } }),
		}),
		Chunks = emitter("Chunks", attachment, {
			Texture = TEXTURES.Shard,
			Speed = NumberRange.new(22, 50),
			Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 0.9),
			SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(70, 70),
			EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top,
			Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -70, 0),
			RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-300, 300),
			Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360),
			Size = sequence({ { 0, 0.45 }, { 1, 0.25 } }),
		}),
	}
end

local function nextAnchor(position)
	anchorIndex = anchorIndex % #anchors + 1
	local anchor = anchors[anchorIndex]
	anchor.Part.Position = position
	return anchor
end

local function flash(anchor, color, brightness, range)
	anchor.Light.Color = color
	anchor.Light.Range = range
	anchor.Light.Brightness = lowEffects and 0 or math.min(brightness*.4,2.5)
	TweenService:Create(anchor.Light, FLASH, { Brightness = 0 }):Play()
end

function Fx.Setup()
	folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("ClientEffects") or Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "ClientEffects"
	folder.Parent = workspace
	for index = 1, ANCHOR_COUNT do
		anchors[index] = buildAnchor(index)
	end
end

function Fx.Folder()
	return folder
end

function Fx.SetLowEffects(value)
	lowEffects = value
end

function Fx.Spark(position, color, scale)
	scale = scale or 1
	local anchor = nextAnchor(position)
	anchor.Sparks.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	anchor.Sparks:Emit(math.floor((lowEffects and 4 or 9) * scale))
	anchor.Chunks.Color = ColorSequence.new(rgb(200, 200, 205))
	anchor.Chunks:Emit(lowEffects and 1 or math.floor(3 * scale))
	flash(anchor, color, 2 * scale, 8)
end

function Fx.Impact(position, color, scale)
	scale = scale or 1
	local anchor = nextAnchor(position)
	anchor.Fire.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	anchor.Fire.Size = sequence({ { 0, 2.5 }, { 1, 6 } }, scale)
	anchor.Fire:Emit(lowEffects and 4 or 8)
	anchor.Glow.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	anchor.Glow.Size = sequence({ { 0, 6 }, { 1, 10 } }, scale)
	anchor.Glow:Emit(1)
	anchor.Sparks.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	anchor.Sparks:Emit(lowEffects and 6 or 14)
	anchor.Ring.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	anchor.Ring.Size = sequence({ { 0, 1 }, { 1, 12 } }, scale)
	anchor.Ring:Emit(1)
	flash(anchor, color, 5, 18 * scale)
end

function Fx.Debris(origin, extent, color, material)
	if activeDebris >= MAX_DEBRIS then
		return
	end
	activeDebris += 1
	local part = table.remove(freeDebris)
	if not part then
		part = Instance.new("Part")
		part.Name = "Debris"
		part.CastShadow = false
		part.CanQuery = false
		part.CanTouch = false
		part.CollisionGroup = "Debris"
		part.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
		part.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	end
	local base = math.clamp(extent.Magnitude / 11, 0.35, 2.4) * (0.45 + math.random() * 0.8)
	part.Size = Vector3.new(base, base * (0.35 + math.random() * 0.6), base * (0.5 + math.random() * 0.7))
	part.Color = color
	part.Material = material
	part.Transparency = 0
	part.Anchored = false
	part.CanCollide = true
	local spread = extent * 0.35
	local offset = Vector3.new((math.random() - 0.5) * spread.X, (math.random() - 0.3) * spread.Y, (math.random() - 0.5) * spread.Z)
	part.CFrame = CFrame.new(origin + offset) * CFrame.Angles(math.random() * 6, math.random() * 6, math.random() * 6)
	part.Parent = folder
	local horizontal = Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, 0, math.random() - 0.5)
	if horizontal.Magnitude < 0.05 then
		horizontal = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
	end
	local speed = 18 + math.random() * 26
	part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = horizontal.Unit * speed + Vector3.new(0, 22 + math.random() * 30, 0)
	part.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, math.random() - 0.5, math.random() - 0.5) * 24
	task.delay(DEBRIS_LIFETIME, function()
		local tween = TweenService:Create(part, FADE, { Transparency = 1 })
		tween:Play()
		tween.Completed:Wait()
		part.Anchored = true
		part.Parent = nil
		table.insert(freeDebris, part)
		activeDebris -= 1
	end)
end

function Fx.Explosion(payload)
	local style = STYLES[payload.Explosion] or STYLES.Medium
	local size = payload.Size or Vector3.new(6, 6, 6)
	local scale = math.clamp(style.Scale * 0.45 + size.Magnitude / 16, 0.8, 5)
	local anchor = nextAnchor(payload.Position)
	local cut = lowEffects and 0.5 or 1

	anchor.Fire.Color = ColorSequence.new(style.Fire, rgb(255, 230, 160))
	anchor.Fire.Size = sequence({ { 0, 2.5 }, { 0.4, 5 }, { 1, 7 } }, scale * 0.6)
	anchor.Fire:Emit(math.floor(14 * cut))
	anchor.Glow.Color = ColorSequence.new(rgb(255, 240, 200), style.Fire)
	anchor.Glow.Size = sequence({ { 0, 8 }, { 1, 16 } }, scale * 0.8)
	anchor.Glow:Emit(1)
	anchor.Smoke.Color = ColorSequence.new(style.Smoke)
	anchor.Smoke.Size = sequence({ { 0, 3 }, { 1, 9 } }, scale * 0.6)
	anchor.Smoke:Emit(math.floor(7 * cut))
	anchor.Sparks.Color = ColorSequence.new(style.Fire)
	anchor.Sparks:Emit(math.floor(26 * cut))
	anchor.Ring.Color = ColorSequence.new(style.Fire)
	anchor.Ring.Size = sequence({ { 0, 2 }, { 1, 16 } }, scale * 0.7)
	anchor.Ring:Emit(1)
	anchor.Chunks.Color = ColorSequence.new(payload.Primary or style.Smoke, payload.Secondary or style.Smoke)
	anchor.Chunks:Emit(math.floor(18 * cut))
	flash(anchor, style.Fire, 7, 14 * scale)

	local material = MATERIALS[payload.MaterialType] or Enum.Material.Metal
	local count = math.floor(style.Debris * cut * math.clamp(size.Magnitude / 14, 0.6, 1.6))
	for index = 1, count do
		local color = (index % 3 == 0 and payload.Secondary) or payload.Primary or style.Smoke
		Fx.Debris(payload.Position, size, color, material)
	end
end

function Fx.Respawn(position, size)
	local anchor = nextAnchor(position)
	anchor.Sparks.Color = ColorSequence.new(rgb(255, 210, 31))
	anchor.Sparks:Emit(lowEffects and 6 or 14)
	anchor.Ring.Color = ColorSequence.new(rgb(255, 255, 255))
	anchor.Ring.Size = sequence({ { 0, 1 }, { 1, 8 } }, math.clamp((size and size.Magnitude or 8) / 10, 0.6, 3))
	anchor.Ring:Emit(1)
end

function Fx.CoinBurst(from, to)
	if not to or lowEffects then
		return
	end
	for index = 1, 4 do
		local coin = Instance.new("Part")
		coin.Name = "Coin"
		coin.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
		coin.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.9, 0.9)
		coin.Color = rgb(255, 210, 31)
		coin.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		coin.Anchored = true
		coin.CanCollide = false
		coin.CanQuery = false
		coin.CanTouch = false
		coin.CastShadow = false
		coin.Position = from
		coin.Parent = folder
		local peak = from + Vector3.new(math.random(-6, 6), 7 + math.random() * 4, math.random(-6, 6))
		local rise = TweenService:Create(coin, TweenInfo.new(0.22 + index * 0.03, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Position = peak })
		rise:Play()
		rise.Completed:Once(function()
			local fall = TweenService:Create(coin, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), { Position = to, Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.4, 0.4) })
			fall:Play()
			fall.Completed:Once(function()
				coin:Destroy()
			end)
		end)
	end
end

return Fx

 })
end

-- Short job chains: each stage starts after the previous reward is claimed.
QuestConfig.Chapters = {
 {Id="YardRecovery",Name="YARD RECOVERY",Zone="ScrapYard",Material="Wood",Cash=120,Scrap=20,
  Brief="Recover a working yard: clear wood, catalogue scrap, then tackle the heavier wrecks."},
 {Id="CityRenewal",Name="CITY RENEWAL",Zone="Downtown",Material="Glass",Cash=300,Scrap=35,
  Brief="Open the streets: remove glass, survey the district, then demolish bulky obstacles."},
 {Id="FactoryReset",Name="FACTORY RESET",Zone="Industrial",Material="Metal",Cash=800,Scrap=60,
  Brief="Restart the factory: clear metal, identify machinery, then remove heavy equipment."},
 {Id="BaseRecovery",Name="BASE RECOVERY",Zone="Military",Material="Wood",Cash=1500,Scrap=80,FinalCores=1,
  Brief="Restore the perimeter: recover ammo crates, survey the base, then clear armored wrecks."},
 {Id="FutureReboot",Name="FUTURE REBOOT",Zone="FutureDistrict",Material="Tech",Cash=3000,Scrap=100,FinalCores=2,
  Brief="Reboot the district: dismantle tech, catalogue machines, then take down its heavy units."},
 {Id="CoreContainment",Name="CORE CONTAINMENT",Zone="ChaosCore",Material="Crystal",Cash=6000,Scrap=120,FinalCores=3,
  Brief="Contain the core: clear crystals, identify alien machinery, then finish the final cleanup."},
}
for chapterIndex,chapter in ipairs(QuestConfig.Chapters) do
 local objects={}
 for _,object in ipairs(Objects.List) do
  if object.Zone==chapter.Zone and not object.TierZone then objects[object.Id]=true end
 end
 local stages={
  {Type="DestroyMaterial",Target=4,Text="CLEAR %s "..string.upper(chapter.Material).." OBJECTS",Description="Clear the work area. Only wrecks in this chapter's zone count."},
  {Type="CollectTypes",Target=3,Text="SURVEY %s OBJECT TYPES",Description="Break three different object types in this district. Repeats do not count."},
  {Type="DestroyHeavy",Target=2,Text="REMOVE %s HEAVY TARGETS",Description="Medium, Large and Huge targets count. Share a wreck with another player if it is tough."},
  {Type="DestroyZone",Target=10,Text="FINISH %s DISTRICT WRECKS",Description="Finish the cleanup. Claim this stage to complete the chapter."},
 }
 for step,stage in ipairs(stages)do
  stage.Id=chapter.Id..step
  stage.Category="Campaign"
  stage.Chapter=chapter.Id stage.Step=step stage.Order=chapterIndex*10+step
  stage.Zone=chapter.Zone stage.Material=chapter.Material stage.ObjectIds=objects
  stage.Prerequisite=step>1 and (chapter.Id..(step-1))or nil
  stage.FixedRewards=true stage.Rewards={Cash=chapter.Cash*step,Scrap=chapter.Scrap*step}
  if step==4 and chapter.FinalCores then stage.Rewards.ChaosCores=chapter.FinalCores end
  stage.Icon=Zones.ById[chapter.Zone].Icon
  table.insert(QuestConfig.List,stage)
 end
end

function QuestConfig.IsStageUnlocked(quest,data)
 if not quest or not data then return false end
 if quest.Prerequisite then
  local previous=data.QuestProgress and data.QuestProgress[quest.Prerequisite]
  if not previous or previous.Completed~=true then return false end
 end
 return true
end
function QuestConfig.IsAvailable(quest,data)
 return QuestConfig.IsStageUnlocked(quest,data)and
  (not quest.Zone or quest.Zone=="ScrapYard"or (data.Zones and data.Zones[quest.Zone]==true))
end

QuestConfig.ById = {}
for _, quest in ipairs(QuestConfig.List) do
	QuestConfig.ById[quest.Id] = quest
end

return QuestConfig

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local ThemeConfig = require(Shared.Config.ThemeConfig)
local Format = require(Shared.Modules.Format)

local POOL_SIZE = 36
local RISE = TweenInfo.new(0.9, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
local POP = TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
local FADE = TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)

local Floaters = {}

local pool = {}
local cursor = 0

local function build(index)
	local anchor = Instance.new("Attachment")
	anchor.Name = "FloaterAnchor" .. index
	anchor.Parent = workspace.Terrain
	local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	gui.Name = "Floater"
	gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
	gui.LightInfluence = 0
	gui.MaxDistance = 200
	gui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(240, 64)
	gui.Enabled = false
	gui.Parent = anchor
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Name = "Value"
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	label.FontFace = ThemeConfig.Fonts.Number
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
	label.Parent = gui
	local outline = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	outline.Name = "Outline"
	outline.Thickness = 3
	outline.Color = ThemeConfig.Colors.Black
	outline.Parent = label
	local shine = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	shine.Name = "Shine"
	shine.Rotation = 90
	shine.Parent = label
	local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
	scale.Name = "Pop"
	scale.Parent = label
	return { Anchor = anchor, Gui = gui, Label = label, Outline = outline, Shine = shine, Scale = scale, Token = 0 }
end

function Floaters.Setup()
	for index = 1, POOL_SIZE do
		pool[index] = build(index)
	end
end

function Floaters.Text(position, text, color, size)
	size = size or 1
	cursor = cursor % POOL_SIZE + 1
	local item = pool[cursor]
	item.Token += 1
	local token = item.Token
	item.Anchor.WorldPosition = position + Vector3.new((math.random() - 0.5) * 2.4, (math.random() - 0.5) * 1, (math.random() - 0.5) * 2.4)
	item.Gui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(240 * size, 64 * size)
	item.Gui.StudsOffset = Vector3.zero
	item.Label.Text = text
	item.Label.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	item.Shine.Color = ColorSequence.new(color:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.35), color)
	item.Label.TextTransparency = 0
	item.Outline.Transparency = 0
	item.Outline.Thickness = 2 + size
	item.Scale.Scale = 0.35
	item.Gui.Enabled = true
	TweenService:Create(item.Scale, POP, { Scale = 1 }):Play()
	TweenService:Create(item.Gui, RISE, { StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3.2 * size, 0) }):Play()
	task.delay(0.55, function()
		if item.Token ~= token then
			return
		end
		local fade = TweenService:Create(item.Label, FADE, { TextTransparency = 1 })
		fade:Play()
		TweenService:Create(item.Outline, FADE, { Transparency = 1 }):Play()
		fade.Completed:Once(function()
			if item.Token == token then
				item.Gui.Enabled = false
			end
		end)
	end)
end

function Floaters.Damage(position, damage, crit)
	if crit then
		Floaters.Text(position, "CRIT!\n" .. Format.Smart(damage) .. " DAMAGE", ThemeConfig.Colors.Yellow, 1.5)
	else
		Floaters.Text(position, Format.Smart(damage), Color3.fromRGB(235, 238, 245), 0.85)
	end
end

return Floaters

local MINIMUM_TIME = 2.6

trackStroke.Thickness = 2

fillShade.Parent = fill

local running = true

	local index = 1
	while running do
		task.wait(0.9)
		index = index % #PHRASES + 1
		phrase.Text = PHRASES[index]
	end
end)

local function fetched(content)
	local success = false
	pcall(ContentProvider.PreloadAsync, ContentProvider, { content }, function(_, fetchStatus)
		success = fetchStatus == Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Success
	end)
	return success
end

task.spawn(function()
	if not game:IsLoaded() then
		game.Loaded:Wait()
	end
	done.World = true
end)

task.spawn(function()
	while not player:GetAttribute("DataReady") do
		player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("DataReady"):Wait()
	end
	done.Save = true
end)

task.spawn(function()
	local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
	character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 20)
	done.Hero = true
end)

task.spawn(function()
	local shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared", 15)
	local config = shared and shared:WaitForChild("Config", 10)
	local assets = config and config:WaitForChild("AssetConfig", 10)
	local ok, assetConfig = false, nil
	if assets then
		ok, assetConfig = pcall(require, assets)
	end
	if ok and assetConfig then
		local background = assetConfig.Image("LoadingBackground")
		if background and fetched(background) then
			art.Image = background
		end
		local logoImage = assetConfig.Image("Logo")
		if logoImage and fetched(logoImage) then
			logo.Image = logoImage
			logo.Visible = true
			wordmark.Visible = false
		end
		local images = {}
		for _, key in ipairs(KEY_IMAGES) do
			local id = assetConfig.Image(key)
			if id then
				table.insert(images, id)
			end
		end
		pcall(ContentProvider.PreloadAsync, ContentProvider, images)
	end
	done.Art = true
end)

while true do
	local count, pending = 0, nil
	for _, step in ipairs(STEPS) do
		if done[step.Id] then
			count += 1
		elseif not pending then
			pending = step
		end
	end
	local elapsed = os.clock() - started
	local finished = count == #STEPS or elapsed >= MAXIMUM_TIME
	local goal = if finished then 1 else 0.08 + 0.84 * count / #STEPS
	local target = math.min(elapsed / MINIMUM_TIME, goal)
	progress = math.max(progress, progress + (target - progress) * 0.2)
	fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(progress, 1)
	status.Text = if pending and not finished then pending.Text else "READY!"
	if finished and progress >= 0.995 then
		break
	end
	task.wait(0.03)
end
fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)

running = false
local fade = TweenInfo.new(0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
for _, descendant in ipairs(backdrop:GetDescendants()) do
	if descendant:IsA("TextLabel") then
		TweenService:Create(descendant, fade, { TextTransparency = 1 }):Play()
	elseif descendant:IsA("UIStroke") then
		TweenService:Create(descendant, fade, { Transparency = 1 }):Play()
	elseif descendant:IsA("ImageLabel") then
		TweenService:Create(descendant, fade, { ImageTransparency = 1 }):Play()
	elseif descendant:IsA("Frame") then
		TweenService:Create(descendant, fade, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play()
	end
end
local closing = TweenService:Create(backdrop, fade, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
closing:Play()
closing.Completed:Wait()
gui:Destroy()

ServerScriptService.Services.EventServic.source:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local EventConfig = require(Shared.Config.EventConfig)
local ZoneConfig = require(Shared.Config.ZoneConfig)
local Formulas = require(Shared.Modules.Formulas)
local Signal = require(Shared.Modules.Signal)
local Net = require(Shared.Modules.Net)
local Notifier = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.Notifier)
local Spawning = require(script.Spawning)
local RandomEvents = require(script.RandomEvents)

local CHAOS_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(166, 77, 255)
local CASH_RAIN_SCALE = 1000

local EventService = { Priority = 60 }
EventService.ChaosStarted = Signal.new()
EventService.ChaosCompleted = Signal.new()
EventService.RandomEventStarted = Signal.new()
EventService.RandomEventEnded = Signal.new()

local state = nil
local remotes = {}
local participants = {}
local chaosEndsAt = 0
local isMega = false
local queuedMega = false
local bankedPoints = 0

local function serverNow()
	return workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
end

local function chaosGoal()
	return EventConfig.Chaos.BaseGoal + EventConfig.Chaos.GoalPerPlayer * math.max(#Players:GetPlayers(), 1)
end

local function chaosBuffs(mega)
	local scale = mega and EventConfig.Chaos.Mega.BuffScale or 1
	local buffs = {}
	for stat, value in pairs(EventConfig.Chaos.Buffs) do
		buffs[stat] = value * scale
	end
	return buffs
end

function EventService:Init(services)
	self.Services = services
	self.Data = services.DataService
	for _, name in ipairs({ "EventAnnounce", "WorldFx" }) do
		remotes[name] = Net.Remote(name)
	end
	state = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("GameState") or Instance.new("Configuration")
	state.Name = "GameState"
	state.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

	local destruction = services.DestructionService
	destruction.Wrecked:Connect(function(entry)
		if not entry.IsEvent then
			self:AddChaosPoints(entry.ChaosPoints)
		end
		RandomEvents.OnWrecked(self, entry)
	end)
	destruction.Damaged:Connect(function(player)
		if state:GetAttribute("ChaosState") == "ChaosEvent" then
			participants[player] = true
		end
	end)
end

function EventService:Start()
	state:SetAttribute("ChaosPoints", 0)
	state:SetAttribute("ChaosGoal", chaosGoal())
	state:SetAttribute("ChaosState", "Building")
	state:SetAttribute("StateEndsAt", 0)
	state:SetAttribute("MegaChaos", false)
	state:SetAttribute("ActiveEvent", "")
	state:SetAttribute("ActiveEventEndsAt", 0)
	state:SetAttribute("ActiveEventZone", "")

	local function refreshGoal()
		if state:GetAttribute("ChaosState") == "Building" then
			state:SetAttribute("ChaosGoal", chaosGoal())
		end
	end
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(refreshGoal)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		participants[player] = nil
		task.defer(refreshGoal)
	end)

	task.spawn(RandomEvents.Scheduler, self)
end

function EventService:GetState()
	return state
end

function EventService:Announce(payload)
	remotes.EventAnnounce:FireAllClients(payload)
end

function EventService:WorldFx(kind, data)
	remotes.WorldFx:FireAllClients(kind, data)
end

function EventService:IsChaosActive()
	return state:GetAttribute("ChaosState") ~= "Building"
end

function EventService:AddChaosPoints(points)
	points = math.max(0, tonumber(points) or 0)
	if state:GetAttribute("ChaosState") ~= "Building" then
		bankedPoints += points
		return
	end
	local goal = state:GetAttribute("ChaosGoal")
	local total = state:GetAttribute("ChaosPoints") + points
	state:SetAttribute("ChaosPoints", math.min(total, goal))
	if total >= goal then
		self:StartChaos({})
	end
end

function EventService:AddChaosFraction(fraction)
	self:AddChaosPoints(math.ceil(state:GetAttribute("ChaosGoal") * fraction))
end

function EventService:StartChaos(options)
	options = options or {}
	local current = state:GetAttribute("ChaosState")
	if current == "ChaosEvent" then
		if options.Mega then
			isMega = true
			chaosEndsAt += EventConfig.Chaos.Mega.Duration
			state:SetAttribute("StateEndsAt", chaosEndsAt)
			state:SetAttribute("MegaChaos", true)
			self.Services.EconomyService:SetGlobalBuffs(chaosBuffs(true))
			self:Announce({ Id = "Chaos", Name = "MEGA CHAOS!", Description = "The Chaos Event got upgraded and extended!", Phase = "Start", Duration = chaosEndsAt - serverNow(), Color = CHAOS_COLOR, Icon = "EventChaos" })
		end
		return
	elseif current == "TotalWreck" then
		queuedMega = queuedMega or options.Mega == true
		return
	end

	RandomEvents.Stop(self)
	isMega = options.Mega == true
	local duration = isMega and EventConfig.Chaos.Mega.Duration or EventConfig.Chaos.Duration
	chaosEndsAt = serverNow() + duration
	table.clear(participants)
	state:SetAttribute("ChaosPoints", state:GetAttribute("ChaosGoal"))
	state:SetAttribute("ChaosState", "ChaosEvent")
	state:SetAttribute("StateEndsAt", chaosEndsAt)
	state:SetAttribute("MegaChaos", isMega)

	local services = self.Services
	services.EconomyService:SetGlobalBuffs(chaosBuffs(isMega))
	services.DestructionService:SetRespawnScale(EventConfig.Chaos.RespawnScale)

	local crowd = Spawning.PlayersByZone()
	crowd.ScrapYard = crowd.ScrapYard or 1
	for zoneId, count in pairs(crowd) do
		for _, spawnInfo in ipairs(EventConfig.Chaos.Spawns) do
			for _ = 1, spawnInfo.PerZone do
				-- TotalWreck owns cleanup; Mega can extend the active event.
				Spawning.SpawnObject(services.DestructionService, spawnInfo.Object, zoneId, count, "Chaos")
			end
		end
	end

	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local data = self.Data:GetData(player)
		local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if data and root then
			local orb = EventConfig.Chaos.MultiplierOrbBoost
			services.DropService:Spawn(player, "Boost", 0, root.Position, EventConfig.Chaos.MultiplierOrbs, { Boost = orb.Boost, Seconds = orb.Seconds, Spread = 20, Lifetime = duration })
			services.DropService:Spawn(player, "Cash", Formulas.ProgressScale(data) * CASH_RAIN_SCALE, root.Position, EventConfig.Chaos.CashRainPerPlayer, { Spread = 24, Lifetime = duration })
		end
	end

	self:Announce({
		Id = "Chaos",
		Name = isMega and "MEGA CHAOS EVENT" or "CHAOS EVENT",
		Description = "City Chaos hit 100%! Bonus Cash, Scrap and Damage for everyone. Smash the golden targets!",
		Phase = "Start",
		Duration = duration,
		Color = CHAOS_COLOR,
		Icon = "EventChaos",
	})
	self:WorldFx("ChaosStart", { Mega = isMega })
	self.ChaosStarted:Fire(isMega)

	task.spawn(function()
		while serverNow() < chaosEndsAt do
			task.wait(0.5)
		end
		self:TotalWreck()
	end)
end

function EventService:TotalWreck()
	local services = self.Services
	local duration = EventConfig.Chaos.TotalWreckDuration
	state:SetAttribute("ChaosState", "TotalWreck")
	state:SetAttribute("StateEndsAt", serverNow() + duration)
	self:WorldFx("TotalWreck", { Duration = duration })
	self:Announce({ Id = "TotalWreck", Name = "TOTAL WRECK!", Description = "The whole city resets. Get ready to smash it again!", Phase = "Start", Duration = duration, Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 59, 59), Icon = "EventTotalWreck" })

	task.wait(2)
	services.DestructionService:WreckAllEvents()
	services.DestructionService:ResetAll()
	services.EconomyService:SetGlobalBuffs(nil)
	services.DestructionService:SetRespawnScale(1)

	local completed = {}
	for player in pairs(participants) do
		if player.Parent and self.Data:IsLoaded(player) then
			table.insert(completed, player)
			self.Data:Increment(player, "ChaosEventsCompleted", 1)
			services.EconomyService:GrantRewards(player, EventConfig.Chaos.ParticipantRewards, "Event", "CHAOS EVENT COMPLETE")
		end
	end
	table.clear(participants)
	self.ChaosCompleted:Fire(completed)

	task.wait(math.max(duration - 2, 0))
	isMega = false
	state:SetAttribute("MegaChaos", false)
	state:SetAttribute("ChaosGoal", chaosGoal())
	state:SetAttribute("ChaosState", "Building")
	state:SetAttribute("StateEndsAt", 0)
	local banked = bankedPoints
	bankedPoints = 0
	state:SetAttribute("ChaosPoints", 0)
	if queuedMega then
		queuedMega = false
		self:StartChaos({ Mega = true })
	elseif banked > 0 then
		self:AddChaosPoints(banked)
	end
end

function EventService:NuclearWreck(player)
	local services = self.Services
	local data = self.Data:GetData(player)
	local zoneId = services.ZoneService:GetZone(player)
	local zone = zoneId and ZoneConfig.ById[zoneId]
	if not zone or not zone.Order or not services.ZoneService:IsUnlocked(player, zoneId) then
		zone = Formulas.HighestZone(data)
		zoneId = zone.Id
	end
	local center = ZoneConfig.Center(zoneId)
	local nuclear = EventConfig.Nuclear
	self:Announce({ Id = "Nuclear", Name = "NUCLEAR WRECK", Description = player.DisplayName .. " nuked " .. zone.Name .. "! Everyone gets 2x Cash for 5 minutes.", Phase = "Start", Duration = nuclear.Countdown, Color = nuclear.Color, Icon = "ProductNuclear", Zone = zoneId })
	self:WorldFx("Nuclear", { Zone = zoneId, Position = center, Countdown = nuclear.Countdown })
	Notifier.Broadcast({ Kind = "Big", Text = "NUCLEAR WRECK!", Subtext = "BY " .. string.upper(player.DisplayName), Color = nuclear.Color })
	task.wait(nuclear.Countdown)
	if not player.Parent or self.Data:GetData(player) ~= data then
		return false
	end
	-- Finish the buyer's reward before ProcessReceipt can acknowledge the purchase.
	services.DestructionService:WreckZone(zoneId, player, nuclear.BuyerRewardMultiplier)
	for _, other in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		services.EconomyService:AddBoost(other, nuclear.ServerBoost.Boost, nuclear.ServerBoost.Seconds)
	end
	return true
end

return EventService

local AnalyticsService = game:GetService("AnalyticsService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local AnalyticsConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config.AnalyticsConfig)

local MetricsService = { Priority = 80 }

local sessions = {}

local function forward(callback)
	if not game:GetService("RunService"):IsStudio()and AnalyticsConfig.Enabled and AnalyticsConfig.ForwardToRobloxAnalytics then
		pcall(callback)
	end
end

function MetricsService:Init(services)
	self.Services = services
	self.Data = services.DataService

	local function listen(serviceName, signalName, callback)
		local service = services[serviceName]
		if service and service[signalName] then
			service[signalName]:Connect(callback)
		end
	end

	listen("DataService", "ProfileLoaded", function(player)
		sessions[player] = { Started = os.clock(), ObjectsDestroyed = 0, DamageDealt = 0, RandomEventsStarted = 0, ChaosEventsStarted = 0, ChaosEventsCompleted = 0, EventObjectsDestroyed = 0, EventDamageDealt = 0, MilestoneSeconds = {} }
		if self.Data:GetSession(player, "IsNew") then
			self:Milestone(player, "FirstJoin")
		end
	end)
	listen("DataService", "ProfileReleasing", function(player)
		self:Flush(player)
	end)
	listen("DestructionService", "Wrecked", function(entry, credits)
		for _, credit in ipairs(credits) do
			if credit.Counted then
				self:Milestone(credit.Player, "FirstWreck")
				local session = sessions[credit.Player]
				if session then
					session.ObjectsDestroyed += 1
					if entry.IsEvent then
						session.EventObjectsDestroyed += 1
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)
	listen("EventService", "RandomEventStarted", function()
		for player in pairs(sessions) do
			sessions[player].RandomEventsStarted += 1
		end
	end)
	listen("EventService", "ChaosStarted", function()
		for player in pairs(sessions) do
			sessions[player].ChaosEventsStarted += 1
		end
	end)
	listen("EventService", "ChaosCompleted", function(completed)
		for _, player in ipairs(completed) do
			local session = sessions[player]
			if session then
				session.ChaosEventsCompleted += 1
			end
		end
	end)
	listen("DestructionService", "Damaged", function(player, entry, amount)
		local session = sessions[player]
		if session then
			session.DamageDealt += amount
			if entry.IsEvent then
				session.EventDamageDealt += amount
				self:Milestone(player, "FirstEventParticipation")
			end
		end
	end)
	listen("UpgradeService", "Upgraded", function(player)
		self:Milestone(player, "FirstUpgrade")
	end)
	listen("ZoneService", "ZoneUnlocked", function(player)
		self:Milestone(player, "FirstZone")
	end)
	listen("MonetizationService", "PromptShown", function(player)
		self:Milestone(player, "FirstPurchasePrompt")
	end)
	listen("MonetizationService", "ProductPurchased", function(player)
		self:Milestone(player, "FirstPurchase")
	end)
	listen("MonetizationService", "PassOwned", function(player, _, isLivePurchase)
		if isLivePurchase then
			self:Milestone(player, "FirstPurchase")
		end
	end)
	listen("RebirthService", "Reborn", function(player)
		self:Milestone(player, "FirstRebirth")
	end)
end

function MetricsService:Start()
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		task.defer(function()
			sessions[player] = nil
		end)
	end)
end

function MetricsService:Milestone(player, name)
	local data = self.Data:GetData(player)
	if not data then
		return false
	end
	local session = sessions[player]
	if session and session.MilestoneSeconds[name] == nil then
		session.MilestoneSeconds[name] = math.max(0, os.clock() - session.Started)
	end
	if data.Metrics[name] or name == "FirstEventParticipation" then
		return false
	end
	data.Metrics[name] = os.time()
	local step = table.find(AnalyticsConfig.Funnel, name)
	if step then
		forward(function()
			AnalyticsService:LogOnboardingFunnelStepEvent(player, step, name)
		end)
	end
	forward(function()
		AnalyticsService:LogCustomEvent(player, name, 1)
	end)
	return true
end

function MetricsService:Track(player, name, value)
	forward(function()
		AnalyticsService:LogCustomEvent(player, name, value or 1)
	end)
end

function MetricsService:GetSessionSnapshot(player)
	local session = sessions[player]
	if not session then
		return nil
	end
	local snapshot = table.clone(session)
	snapshot.MilestoneSeconds = table.clone(session.MilestoneSeconds)
	snapshot.ElapsedSeconds = math.max(0, os.clock() - session.Started)
	return snapshot
end

function MetricsService:Flush(player)
	local session = sessions[player]
	if not session then
		return
	end
	self:Track(player, "SessionTime", math.floor(os.clock() - session.Started))
	self:Track(player, "ObjectsDestroyed", session.ObjectsDestroyed)
	self:Track(player, "DamageDealt", math.floor(session.DamageDealt))
	self:Track(player, "RandomEventsStarted", session.RandomEventsStarted)
	self:Track(player, "ChaosEventsStarted", session.ChaosEventsStarted)
	self:Track(player, "ChaosEventsCompleted", session.ChaosEventsCompleted)
	self:Track(player, "EventObjectsDestroyed", session.EventObjectsDestroyed)
	self:Track(player, "EventDamageDealt", math.floor(session.EventDamageDealt))
	for name, seconds in pairs(session.MilestoneSeconds) do
		self:Track(player, "TimeTo" .. name, math.floor(seconds))
	end
end

return MetricsService

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local rgb = Color3.fromRGB

local STYLES = {
	Scrap = { Color = rgb(34, 225, 255), Material = Enum.Material.Neon, Size = Vector3.new(0.8, 0.8, 0.8), Shape = Enum.PartType.Block, Sound = "Scrap" },
	Cash = { Color = rgb(255, 210, 31), Material = Enum.Material.Neon, Size = Vector3.new(0.25, 1.3, 1.3), Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Sound = "Coin" },
	Boost = { Color = rgb(255, 122, 26), Material = Enum.Material.Neon, Size = Vector3.new(1.6, 1.6, 1.6), Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball, Sound = "Purchase" },
}

local LAUNCH_TIME = 0.4
local COLLECT_TIME = 0.22

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local Drops = {}

local orbs = {}
local folder = nil
local controllers = nil
local lowEffects=false
function Drops.SetLowEffects(value)
 lowEffects=value==true
 for _,orb in pairs(orbs)do
  orb.Part.Material=lowEffects and Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic or (STYLES[orb.Kind]or STYLES.Scrap).Material
  local glow=orb.Part:FindFirstChild("Glow")if glow then glow.Enabled=not lowEffects end
  if lowEffects and orb.State=="Launch"then orb.State="Idle"orb.Part.CFrame=CFrame.new(orb.Base)end
 end
end

local function rootPosition()
	local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	return root and root.Position
end

local function build(kind)
	local style = STYLES[kind] or STYLES.Scrap
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = kind .. "Orb"
	part.Shape = style.Shape
	part.Size = style.Size
	part.Color = style.Color
	part.Material = lowEffects and Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic or style.Material
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.CastShadow = false
	if kind == "Boost" and not lowEffects then
		local sparkle = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		sparkle.Name = "Glow"
		sparkle.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
		sparkle.LightEmission = 1
		sparkle.Color = ColorSequence.new(style.Color)
		sparkle.Rate = 8
		sparkle.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.6, 1)
		sparkle.Speed = NumberRange.new(1, 2)
		sparkle.Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.5), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) })
		sparkle.Parent = part
	end
	part.Parent = folder
	return part
end

local function finish(id)
	local orb = orbs[id]
	if orb then
		orbs[id] = nil
		orb.Part:Destroy()
	end
end

function Drops.Setup(registry)
	controllers = registry
	folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "Drops"
	folder.Parent = workspace:WaitForChild("ClientEffects")

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local now = os.clock()
		local target = rootPosition()
		for id, orb in pairs(orbs) do
			if lowEffects and orb.State=="Idle"then
    orb.Part.CFrame=CFrame.new(orb.Base)
   elseif orb.State == "Launch" then
				local alpha = math.min((now - orb.Started) / LAUNCH_TIME, 1)
				local position = orb.From:Lerp(orb.Base, alpha) + Vector3.new(0, math.sin(alpha * math.pi) * 5, 0)
				orb.Part.CFrame = CFrame.new(position) * CFrame.Angles(0, now * 4, 0)
				if alpha >= 1 then
					orb.State = "Idle"
				end
			elseif orb.State == "Idle" then
				local bob = math.sin(now * 3 + orb.Phase) * 0.35
				orb.Part.CFrame = CFrame.new(orb.Base + Vector3.new(0, bob, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, now * 2.4 + orb.Phase, 0)
			elseif orb.State == "Collect" then
				local alpha = math.min((now - orb.Started) / COLLECT_TIME, 1)
				local goal = target or orb.Base
				orb.Part.Position = orb.Part.Position:Lerp(goal, alpha)
				if alpha >= 1 then
					finish(id)
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

function Drops.Handle(action, list)
	if type(list) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	if action == "Spawn" then
		for _, drop in ipairs(list) do
			if not orbs[drop.Id] then
				local part = build(drop.Kind)
				local from = drop.Origin or drop.Position
				part.Position = lowEffects and drop.Position or from
				orbs[drop.Id] = { Part = part, Kind = drop.Kind, Base = drop.Position, From = from, State = lowEffects and "Idle"or "Launch", Started = os.clock(), Phase = math.random() * 6 }
			end
		end
	elseif action == "Collect" then
		local played = {}
		for _, id in ipairs(list) do
			local orb = orbs[id]
			if orb then
				orb.State = "Collect"
				orb.Started = os.clock()
				local style = STYLES[orb.Kind]
				if style and not played[style.Sound] then
					played[style.Sound] = true
					controllers.SoundController:Play(style.Sound)
				end
			end
		end
	elseif action == "Expire" then
		for _, id in ipairs(list) do
			local orb = orbs[id]
			if orb then
				orb.State = "Fading"
				local tween = TweenService:Create(orb.Part, TweenInfo.new(0.4), { Transparency = 1, Size = orb.Part.Size * 0.2 })
				tween:Play()
				tween.Completed:Once(function()
					finish(id)
				end)
			end
		end
	end
end

return Drops

local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local services = {}
local ordered = {}

local function report(name, stage)
	return function(err)
		warn(string.format("[%s] %s failed: %s\n%s", name, stage, tostring(err), debug.traceback()))
	end
end

for _, module in ipairs(ServerScriptService.Services:GetChildren()) do
	if module:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		local ok, service = xpcall(require, report(module.Name, "require"), module)
		if ok and type(service) == "table" then
			services[module.Name] = service
			table.insert(ordered, { Name = module.Name, Service = service })
		end
	end
end

table.sort(ordered, function(a, b)
	local left, right = a.Service.Priority or 100, b.Service.Priority or 100
	if left == right then
		return a.Name < b.Name
	end
	return left < right
end)

for _, entry in ipairs(ordered) do
	if type(entry.Service.Init) == "function" then
		xpcall(entry.Service.Init, report(entry.Name, "Init"), entry.Service, services)
	end
end

for _, entry in ipairs(ordered) do
	if type(entry.Service.Start) == "function" then
		task.spawn(xpcall, entry.Service.Start, report(entry.Name, "Start"), entry.Service)
	end
end

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local GameConfig = require(Shared.Config.GameConfig)
local Formulas = require(Shared.Modules.Formulas)
local Geometry = require(script.Parent.Geometry)

local Combat = {}

local lastAttack = {}

function Combat.ConsumeCooldown(player, toolId, stats)
	local now = os.clock()
	local cooldown = Formulas.AttackCooldown(toolId, stats) * GameConfig.Combat.CooldownTolerance
	local last = lastAttack[player]
	if last and now - last < cooldown then
		return false
	end
	lastAttack[player] = now
	return true
end

function Combat.Forget(player)
	lastAttack[player] = nil
end

local function nearest(entries, origin, reach, filter)
	local best, bestDistance = nil, nil
	for _, entry in pairs(entries) do
		if entry.Alive then
			local distance = Geometry.Distance(entry, origin)
			if distance <= reach and (not bestDistance or distance < bestDistance) and filter(entry) then
				best, bestDistance = entry, distance
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

local function collectAround(entries, center, radius, exclude, filter, scale, targets)
	local found = {}
	for _, entry in pairs(entries) do
		if entry.Alive and entry ~= exclude then
			local distance = Geometry.Distance(entry, center)
			if distance <= radius and filter(entry) then
				table.insert(found, { Entry = entry, Distance = distance })
			end
		end
	end
	table.sort(found, function(a, b)
		return a.Distance < b.Distance
	end)
	for _, item in ipairs(found) do
		if #targets >= GameConfig.Combat.MaxTargetsPerHit then
			break
		end
		table.insert(targets, { Entry = item.Entry, Scale = scale })
	end
end

function Combat.Resolve(entries, origin, tool, stats, targetUid, aimPos, filter)
	local reach = tool.Range + GameConfig.Combat.RangeTolerance
	local chosen = targetUid and entries[targetUid]
	if chosen and not (chosen.Alive and filter(chosen) and Geometry.Distance(chosen, origin) <= reach) then
		chosen = nil
	end

	if tool.Kind == "Melee" then
		chosen = chosen or nearest(entries, origin, reach, filter)
		if not chosen then
			return nil
		end
		local impact = Geometry.ClosestPoint(chosen, origin)
		local targets = { { Entry = chosen, Scale = 1 } }
		local splash = Formulas.BlastRadius(tool.Id, stats)
		if splash > 0 then
			local scale = if tool.Radius > 0 then GameConfig.Combat.AreaFalloff else GameConfig.Combat.MeleeSplashDamage
			collectAround(entries, impact, splash, chosen, filter, scale, targets)
		end
		return targets, impact
	end

	local impact
	if chosen then
		impact = Geometry.ClosestPoint(chosen, aimPos or origin)
	elseif aimPos and (aimPos - origin).Magnitude <= reach then
		impact = aimPos
	else
		chosen = nearest(entries, origin, reach, filter)
		if not chosen then
			return nil
		end
		impact = Geometry.ClosestPoint(chosen, origin)
	end

	local targets = {}
	if chosen then
		table.insert(targets, { Entry = chosen, Scale = 1 })
	end
	local falloff = chosen and GameConfig.Combat.AreaFalloff or 1
	collectAround(entries, impact, Formulas.BlastRadius(tool.Id, stats), chosen, filter, falloff, targets)
	return targets, impact
end

return Combat

ServerScriptService.Services.EconomyServ.source:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local GameConfig = require(Shared.Config.GameConfig)
local Formulas = require(Shared.Modules.Formulas)
local Format = require(Shared.Modules.Format)
local Signal = require(Shared.Modules.Signal)
local Notifier = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.Notifier)

local BOOST_SYNC_INTERVAL = 15
local MAX_LEVELS_PER_GAIN = 200

local EconomyService = { Priority = 10 }
EconomyService.CashEarned = Signal.new()
EconomyService.ScrapEarned = Signal.new()
EconomyService.LevelUp = Signal.new()
EconomyService.StatsChanged = Signal.new()

local statsCache = {}
local globalBuffs = nil

local function clean(amount)
	if type(amount) ~= "number" or amount ~= amount or amount == math.huge then
		return 0
	end
	return math.max(0, math.floor(amount))
end

local function setupLeaderstats(player, data)
	local folder = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") or Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "leaderstats"
	local cash = folder:FindFirstChild("Cash") or Instance.new("StringValue")
	cash.Name = "Cash"
	cash.Value = Format.Number(data.Cash)
	cash.Parent = folder
	local rebirths = folder:FindFirstChild("Rebirths") or Instance.new("IntValue")
	rebirths.Name = "Rebirths"
	rebirths.Value = data.Rebirths
	rebirths.Parent = folder
	folder.Parent = player
end

function EconomyService:Init(services)
	self.Services = services
	self.Data = services.DataService

	self.Data:OnProfileLoaded(function(player, data)
		setupLeaderstats(player, data)
		self:RefreshStats(player)
	end)

	self.Data.KeyChanged:Connect(function(player, key, value)
		local folder = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
		if not folder then
			return
		end
		if key == "Cash" then
			folder.Cash.Value = Format.Number(value)
		elseif key == "Rebirths" then
			folder.Rebirths.Value = value
		end
	end)

	local monetization = services.MonetizationService
	if monetization and monetization.PassOwned then
		monetization.PassOwned:Connect(function(player)
			self:RefreshStats(player)
		end)
	end
end

function EconomyService:Start()
	local function hookCharacter(player)
		player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
			character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
			task.defer(self.ApplyMovement, self, player)
		end)
	end
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(hookCharacter)
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		hookCharacter(player)
	end
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		statsCache[player] = nil
	end)

	task.spawn(function()
		local last = os.clock()
		local sinceSync = 0
		while true do
			task.wait(1)
			local now = os.clock()
			local elapsed = now - last
			last = now
			sinceSync += elapsed
			local sync = sinceSync >= BOOST_SYNC_INTERVAL
			if sync then
				sinceSync = 0
			end
			for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				local data = self.Data:GetData(player)
				if data and next(data.Boosts) then
					local expired = false
					for boostId, seconds in pairs(data.Boosts) do
						local remaining = seconds - elapsed
						if remaining <= 0 then
							data.Boosts[boostId] = nil
							expired = true
						else
							data.Boosts[boostId] = remaining
						end
					end
					if expired or sync then
						self.Data:Replicate(player, "Boosts")
					end
					if expired then
						self:RefreshStats(player)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

function EconomyService:GetStats(player)
	return statsCache[player] or self:RefreshStats(player)
end

function EconomyService:RefreshStats(player)
	local data = self.Data:GetData(player)
	if not data then
		return Formulas.ComputeStats({}, {})
	end
	local monetization = self.Services.MonetizationService
	local passes = monetization and monetization:GetPasses(player) or {}
	local stats = Formulas.ComputeStats(data, { Passes = passes, Global = globalBuffs })
	statsCache[player] = stats
	self.Data:SetSession(player, "Stats", stats)
	self:ApplyMovement(player)
	self.StatsChanged:Fire(player, stats)
	return stats
end

function EconomyService:ApplyMovement(player)
	local stats = statsCache[player]
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if stats and humanoid then
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = stats.WalkSpeed
	end
end

function EconomyService:AddCash(player, amount, source)
	amount = clean(amount)
	local data = self.Data:GetData(player)
	if not data or amount <= 0 then
		return 0
	end
	if source ~= "Purchase" then
		data.TotalCash += amount
	end
	self.Data:Set(player, "Cash", data.Cash + amount)
	self.CashEarned:Fire(player, amount, source)
	return amount
end

function EconomyService:SpendCash(player, amount)
	amount = clean(amount)
	local data = self.Data:GetData(player)
	if not data or data.Cash < amount then
		return false
	end
	self.Data:Set(player, "Cash", data.Cash - amount)
	return true
end

function EconomyService:AddScrap(player, amount, source, ignoreCapacity)
	amount = clean(amount)
	local data = self.Data:GetData(player)
	if not data or amount <= 0 then
		return 0
	end
	local added = amount
	if not ignoreCapacity then
		local capacity = self:GetStats(player).Capacity
		added = math.max(0, math.min(amount, capacity - data.Scrap))
	end
	if added <= 0 then
		return 0
	end
	data.TotalScrap += added
	self.Data:Set(player, "Scrap", data.Scrap + added)
	self.ScrapEarned:Fire(player, added, source)
	return added
end

function EconomyService:SpendScrap(player, amount)
	amount = clean(amount)
	local data = self.Data:GetData(player)
	if not data or data.Scrap < amount then
		return false
	end
	self.Data:Set(player, "Scrap", data.Scrap - amount)
	return true
end

function EconomyService:AddCores(player, amount)
	amount = clean(amount)
	local data = self.Data:GetData(player)
	if not data or amount <= 0 then
		return 0
	end
	self.Data:Set(player, "ChaosCores", data.ChaosCores + amount)
	return amount
end

function EconomyService:SpendCores(player, amount)
	amount = clean(amount)
	local data = self.Data:GetData(player)
	if not data or data.ChaosCores < amount then
		return false
	end
	self.Data:Set(player, "ChaosCores", data.ChaosCores - amount)
	return true
end

function EconomyService:AddXp(player, amount)
	amount = clean(amount)
	local data = self.Data:GetData(player)
	if not data or amount <= 0 then
		return
	end
	local xp = data.XP + amount
	local level = data.Level
	local gained = 0
	while xp >= Formulas.XpForLevel(level) and gained < MAX_LEVELS_PER_GAIN do
		xp -= Formulas.XpForLevel(level)
		level += 1
		gained += 1
	end
	if gained > 0 then
		self.Data:Set(player, "Level", level)
	end
	self.Data:Set(player, "XP", xp)
	if gained > 0 then
		self.LevelUp:Fire(player, level)
	end
end

function EconomyService:AddBoost(player, boostId, seconds)
	seconds = clean(seconds)
	local data = self.Data:GetData(player)
	if not data or not GameConfig.Boosts[boostId] or seconds <= 0 then
		return false
	end
	local active = (data.Boosts[boostId] or 0) > 0
	data.Boosts[boostId] = (data.Boosts[boostId] or 0) + seconds
	self.Data:Replicate(player, "Boosts")
	if not active then
		self:RefreshStats(player)
	end
	return true
end

function EconomyService:GrantRewards(player, rewards, source, title)
	local granted = {}
	if type(rewards) ~= "table" then
		return granted
	end
	if rewards.Cash then
		granted.Cash = self:AddCash(player, rewards.Cash, source)
	end
	if rewards.Scrap then
		granted.Scrap = self:AddScrap(player, rewards.Scrap, source, true)
	end
	if rewards.ChaosCores then
		granted.ChaosCores = self:AddCores(player, rewards.ChaosCores, source)
	end
	if rewards.Boost and self:AddBoost(player, rewards.Boost.Id, rewards.Boost.Seconds) then
		granted.Boost = { Id = rewards.Boost.Id, Seconds = rewards.Boost.Seconds }
	end
	if rewards.Skin then
		local tools = self.Services.ToolService
		if tools and tools:GrantSkin(player, rewards.Skin) then
			granted.Skin = rewards.Skin
		elseif rewards.SkinFallback then
			local fallback = self:GrantRewards(player, rewards.SkinFallback, source, false)
			granted.Cash = (granted.Cash or 0) + (fallback.Cash or 0)
			granted.Scrap = (granted.Scrap or 0) + (fallback.Scrap or 0)
		end
	end
	if rewards.Xp then
		self:AddXp(player, rewards.Xp)
		granted.Xp = clean(rewards.Xp)
	end
	if title ~= false then
		Notifier.Send(player, { Kind = "Reward", Text = title or "REWARD", Rewards = granted })
	end
	return granted
end

function EconomyService:SetGlobalBuffs(buffs)
	globalBuffs = buffs
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if self.Data:IsLoaded(player) then
			self:RefreshStats(player)
		end
	end
end

function EconomyService:GetGlobalBuffs()
	return globalBuffs
end

return EconomyService

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Config = ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config
local GameConfig = require(Config.GameConfig)
local UpgradeConfig = require(Config.UpgradeConfig)
local ToolConfig = require(Config.ToolConfig)
local ZoneConfig = require(Config.ZoneConfig)
local RebirthConfig = require(Config.RebirthConfig)
local ChaosShopConfig = require(Config.ChaosShopConfig)
local GamepassConfig = require(Config.GamepassConfig)
local DailyRewardConfig = require(Config.DailyRewardConfig)
local PetConfig = require(Config.PetConfig)

local Formulas = {}

function Formulas.RoundNice(value)
	value = tonumber(value) or 0
	if value < 1000 then
		return math.floor(value + 0.5)
	end
	local unit = 10 ^ (math.floor(math.log10(value)) - 2)
	return math.floor(value / unit + 0.5) * unit
end

function Formulas.UpgradePrice(upgradeId, level)
	local upgrade = UpgradeConfig.ById[upgradeId]
	if not upgrade then
		return math.huge
	end
	local easy = math.min(level, UpgradeConfig.EasyLevels)
	local hard = math.max(level - UpgradeConfig.EasyLevels, 0)
	local late=upgrade.LateGrowth^hard
 if upgrade.Scaling~="Exponential"then late=math.min(late,(1+hard/5)^UpgradeConfig.LateCostPower)end
 return Formulas.RoundNice(upgrade.BasePrice*upgrade.EarlyGrowth^easy*late)
end

function Formulas.UpgradeValue(upgradeId, level)
	local upgrade = UpgradeConfig.ById[upgradeId]
	if not upgrade then
		return 0
	end
	level = math.clamp(level or 0, 0, upgrade.MaxLevel)
	if upgrade.Scaling == "Exponential" then
		return math.floor(upgrade.Base * upgrade.PerLevel ^ level)
	end
	return upgrade.Base + upgrade.PerLevel * level
end

function Formulas.RebirthCost(rebirths)
	return Formulas.RoundNice(RebirthConfig.BaseCost * RebirthConfig.CostGrowth ^ (rebirths or 0))
end

function Formulas.RebirthCores(rebirths)
	return RebirthConfig.Cores.Base + RebirthConfig.Cores.PerRebirth * (rebirths or 0)
end

function Formulas.RebirthMultipliers(rebirths)
	rebirths = rebirths or 0
	local rates = RebirthConfig.Multipliers
	return {
		Cash = 1 + rates.Cash * rebirths,
		Damage = 1 + rates.Damage * rebirths,
		Scrap = 1 + rates.Scrap * rebirths,
	}
end

function Formulas.ChaosUpgradeCost(itemId, level)
	local item = ChaosShopConfig.ById[itemId]
	if not item then
		return math.huge
	end
	return item.BaseCost + item.CostStep * (level or 0)
end

function Formulas.ChaosUpgradeBonus(itemId, level)
	local item = ChaosShopConfig.ById[itemId]
	if not item then
		return 0
	end
	return item.PerLevel * math.clamp(level or 0, 0, item.MaxLevel)
end

function Formulas.XpForLevel(level)
	return math.floor(GameConfig.Levels.XpBase * math.max(level, 1) ^ GameConfig.Levels.XpExponent)
end

function Formulas.HighestZone(data)
	local best = ZoneConfig.List[1]
	for _, zone in ipairs(ZoneConfig.List) do
		if data.Zones and data.Zones[zone.Id] and zone.Order > best.Order then
			best = zone
		end
	end
	return best
end

function Formulas.ZonesUnlocked(data)
	local count = 0
	for _, zone in ipairs(ZoneConfig.List) do
		if data.Zones and data.Zones[zone.Id] then
			count += 1
		end
	end
	return count
end

function Formulas.ProgressScale(data)
	return Formulas.HighestZone(data).HealthScale * (1 + 0.5 * (data.Rebirths or 0))
end

function Formulas.CanUnlockZone(zoneId, data)
	local zone = ZoneConfig.ById[zoneId]
	if not zone or not zone.Order then
		return false, "Unknown zone"
	end
	if data.Zones and data.Zones[zoneId] then
		return false, "Already unlocked"
	end
	local previous = ZoneConfig.List[zone.Order - 1]
	if previous and not (data.Zones and data.Zones[previous.Id]) then
		return false, "Unlock " .. previous.Name .. " first"
	end
	if (data.Rebirths or 0) < zone.RequiredRebirths then
		return false, "Requires " .. zone.RequiredRebirths .. " rebirths"
	end
	if (data.Cash or 0) < zone.UnlockCost then
		return false, "Not enough Cash"
	end
	return true
end

function Formulas.BestToolDamage(data)
	local best = 0
	for toolId, owned in pairs(data.Tools or {}) do
		local tool = ToolConfig.ById[toolId]
		if owned and tool and not tool.Premium and not tool.OwnerOnly and tool.Damage > best then
			best = tool.Damage
		end
	end
	return best
end

function Formulas.ToolDamage(toolId, data)
	local tool = ToolConfig.ById[toolId]
	if not tool then
		return 0
	end
	if tool.ScalesWithBest then
		return math.max(tool.Damage, Formulas.BestToolDamage(data) * tool.ScalesWithBest)
	end
	return tool.Damage
end

function Formulas.PassEffects(passes)
	local effects = { Cash = 1, Damage = 1, Magnet = 1, AttackSpeed = 1, LoadoutSlots = 0, AutoScrap = false, DailyBonus = 0 }
	for key, owned in pairs(passes or {}) do
		local pass = owned and GamepassConfig.ByKey[key]
		local e = pass and pass.Effects
		if e then
			effects.Cash *= e.Cash or 1
			effects.Damage *= e.Damage or 1
			effects.Magnet *= e.Magnet or 1
			effects.AttackSpeed *= e.AttackSpeed or 1
			effects.LoadoutSlots += e.LoadoutSlots or 0
			effects.DailyBonus += e.DailyBonus or 0
			if e.AutoScrap then
				effects.AutoScrap = true
			end
		end
	end
	return effects
end

function Formulas.PetBonuses(data)
	local result = { Cash = 0, Damage = 0 }
	local owned = data.Pets or {}
	for _, uid in ipairs(data.EquippedPets or {}) do
		local pet = PetConfig.ById[owned[uid]]
		if pet then
			result.Cash += pet.Cash
			result.Damage += pet.Damage
		end
	end
	return result
end

function Formulas.PetScore(petId)
	local pet = PetConfig.ById[petId]
	return pet and (pet.Cash + pet.Damage) or 0
end

function Formulas.BoostMultipliers(boosts)
	local groups = {}
	for boostId, seconds in pairs(boosts or {}) do
		local boost = GameConfig.Boosts[boostId]
		if boost and seconds > 0 then
			local group = boost.Group or "Default"
			groups[group] = groups[group] or {}
			for stat, multiplier in pairs(boost.Stats) do
				groups[group][stat] = math.max(groups[group][stat] or 1, multiplier)
			end
		end
	end
	local result = { Cash = 1, Damage = 1, Scrap = 1 }
	for _, stats in pairs(groups) do
		for stat, multiplier in pairs(stats) do
			result[stat] = (result[stat] or 1) * multiplier
		end
	end
	return result
end

function Formulas.ComputeStats(data, context)
	context = context or {}
	local global = context.Global or {}
	local upgrades = data.Upgrades or {}
	local chaos = data.ChaosUpgrades or {}
	local rebirth = Formulas.RebirthMultipliers(data.Rebirths)
	local boosts = Formulas.BoostMultipliers(data.Boosts)
	local passes = Formulas.PassEffects(context.Passes)
	local pets = Formulas.PetBonuses(data)

	local function value(upgradeId)
		return Formulas.UpgradeValue(upgradeId, upgrades[upgradeId] or 0)
	end

	local function bonus(itemId)
		return Formulas.ChaosUpgradeBonus(itemId, chaos[itemId] or 0)
	end

	return {
		DamageMultiplier = value("Damage") * rebirth.Damage * (1 + bonus("Damage")) * (1 + pets.Damage) * passes.Damage * boosts.Damage * (global.Damage or 1),
		CashMultiplier = value("CashMultiplier") * rebirth.Cash * (1 + bonus("Cash")) * (1 + pets.Cash) * passes.Cash * boosts.Cash * (global.Cash or 1),
		PetCash = pets.Cash,
		PetDamage = pets.Damage,
		ScrapMultiplier = value("ScrapMultiplier") * rebirth.Scrap * (1 + bonus("Scrap")) * boosts.Scrap * (global.Scrap or 1),
		CritChance = math.min(value("CritChance") + bonus("Crit"), GameConfig.Combat.MaxCritChance),
		CritMultiplier = GameConfig.Combat.CritMultiplier,
		AttackSpeed = value("AttackSpeed") * passes.AttackSpeed,
		ExplosionRadius = value("ExplosionRadius"),
		MeleeSplash = (upgrades.ExplosionRadius or 0) * GameConfig.Combat.MeleeSplashPerLevel,
		MagnetRange = value("MagnetRange") * (1 + bonus("Magnet")) * passes.Magnet,
		WalkSpeed = math.min(value("MoveSpeed") * (1 + bonus("MoveSpeed")), GameConfig.Player.MaxWalkSpeed),
		Capacity = value("InventoryCapacity"),
		AutoScrapRadius = passes.AutoScrap and GameConfig.Drops.AutoScrapRadius or 0,
		LoadoutSlots = GameConfig.Player.BaseLoadoutSlots + passes.LoadoutSlots,
		DailyBonus = passes.DailyBonus,
	}
end

function Formulas.AttackCooldown(toolId, stats)
	local tool = ToolConfig.ById[toolId]
	if not tool then
		return math.huge
	end
	return tool.Cooldown / math.max(stats.AttackSpeed or 1, 0.1)
end

function Formulas.HitDamage(toolId, data, stats, isCrit)
	local damage = Formulas.ToolDamage(toolId, data) * (stats.DamageMultiplier or 1)
	if isCrit then
		damage *= stats.CritMultiplier or GameConfig.Combat.CritMultiplier
	end
	return math.max(1, math.floor(damage))
end

function Formulas.BlastRadius(toolId, stats)
	local tool = ToolConfig.ById[toolId]
	if not tool then
		return 0
	end
	if tool.Radius > 0 then
		return tool.Radius * (stats.ExplosionRadius or 1)
	end
	return stats.MeleeSplash or 0
end

function Formulas.ResolveRewards(rewards, data, multiplier, coreMultiplier)
	multiplier = multiplier or 1
	coreMultiplier = coreMultiplier or 1
	local progress = Formulas.ProgressScale(data)
	local result = {}
	if rewards.Cash then
		result.Cash = Formulas.RoundNice(rewards.Cash * progress * multiplier)
	end
	if rewards.Scrap then
		result.Scrap = Formulas.RoundNice(rewards.Scrap * progress * multiplier)
	end
	if rewards.ChaosCores then
		result.ChaosCores = math.floor(rewards.ChaosCores * coreMultiplier)
	end
	if rewards.Boost then
		result.Boost = { Id = rewards.Boost.Id, Seconds = rewards.Boost.Seconds }
	end
	if rewards.Skin then
		result.Skin = rewards.Skin
		if rewards.SkinFallback then
			result.SkinFallback = Formulas.ResolveRewards(rewards.SkinFallback, data, multiplier, coreMultiplier)
		end
	end
	return result
end

function Formulas.QuestTarget(quest, tier, data)
	tier = tier or 0
	local target = quest.Target
	if quest.Repeat then
		target = target * (quest.Repeat.TargetScale or 1) ^ tier + (quest.Repeat.TargetAdd or 0) * tier
	end
	if quest.ScaleTargetWithProgress then
		target *= Formulas.ProgressScale(data)
	end
	return Formulas.RoundNice(target)
end

function Formulas.QuestRewards(quest, tier, data)
	local scale = 1
	if quest.Repeat then
		scale = (quest.Repeat.RewardScale or 1) ^ (tier or 0)
	end
	return Formulas.ResolveRewards(quest.Rewards, data, scale)
end

function Formulas.DailyRewards(day, data, bonus)
	local entry = DailyRewardConfig.Days[day]
	if not entry then
		return {}
	end
	bonus = bonus or 0
	return Formulas.ResolveRewards(entry.Rewards, data, 1 + bonus, 1 + bonus)
end

function Formulas.CashPackAmount(product, data)
	return Formulas.RoundNice((product.BaseAmount or 0) * Formulas.ProgressScale(data))
end

function Formulas.ZoneRewardMultiplier(zoneId)
	local zone = ZoneConfig.ById[zoneId]
	return zone and zone.RewardMultiplier or 1
end

return Formulas

local TableUtil = {}

function TableUtil.DeepCopy(value)
	if type(value) ~= "table" then
		return value
	end
	local copy = {}
	for key, item in pairs(value) do
		copy[TableUtil.DeepCopy(key)] = TableUtil.DeepCopy(item)
	end
	return copy
end

function TableUtil.Reconcile(target, template)
	for key, value in pairs(template) do
		if target[key] == nil then
			target[key] = TableUtil.DeepCopy(value)
		elseif type(value) == "table" and type(target[key]) == "table" then
			TableUtil.Reconcile(target[key], value)
		end
	end
	return target
end

function TableUtil.Count(dictionary)
	local count = 0
	for _ in pairs(dictionary or {}) do
		count += 1
	end
	return count
end

function TableUtil.Keys(dictionary)
	local keys = {}
	for key in pairs(dictionary or {}) do
		table.insert(keys, key)
	end
	return keys
end

return TableUtil

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local ToolConfig = require(Shared.Config.ToolConfig)
local AssetConfig = require(Shared.Config.AssetConfig)
local Signal = require(Shared.Modules.Signal)
local Ownership = require(Shared.Modules.Ownership)
local Validate = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.Validate)
local Notifier = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.Notifier)

local MAX_SLOTS = 6
local SHOWCASE_MATERIALS = {
	[Enum.Material.Neon] = true,
	[Enum.Material.Glass] = true,
	[Enum.Material.Foil] = true,
}

local ToolService = { Priority = 20 }
ToolService.ToolPurchased = Signal.new()

local function titleCase(text)
	return (string.gsub(string.lower(text), "(%a)(%w*)", function(first, rest)
		return string.upper(first) .. rest
	end))
end

local function buildFallbackTool(def)
	local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
	local handle = Instance.new("Part")
	handle.Name = "Handle"
	handle.Size = Vector3.new(0.4, 3.2, 0.4)
	handle.Color = Color3.fromRGB(70, 52, 40)
	handle.Material = Enum.Material.Wood
	handle.CanCollide = false
	handle.Massless = true
	handle.Parent = tool
	local head = Instance.new("Part")
	head.Name = "Head"
	head.Size = Vector3.new(1.4, 1, 1)
	head.Color = def.Color
	head.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
	head.CanCollide = false
	head.Massless = true
	head.CFrame = handle.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.6, 0)
	head:SetAttribute("SkinSlot", "Primary")
	head.Parent = tool
	local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	weld.Part0 = handle
	weld.Part1 = head
	weld.Parent = head
	local muzzle = Instance.new("Attachment")
	muzzle.Name = "Muzzle"
	muzzle.Parent = head
	tool.Grip = CFrame.new(0, -1, 0)
	return tool
end

local function applySkin(tool, skinId)
	local skin = ToolConfig.SkinsById[skinId]
	if not skin or not skin.Primary then
		return
	end
	for _, part in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			local slot = part:GetAttribute("SkinSlot")
			if slot == "Primary" then
				part.Color = skin.Primary
				if skin.Material then
					local surface = part:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceAppearance")
					if surface and SHOWCASE_MATERIALS[skin.Material] then
						surface:Destroy()
					end
					part.Material = skin.Material
				end
			elseif slot == "Accent" then
				part.Color = skin.Accent
			end
		end
	end
end

local function buildTool(toolId, skinId)
	local def = ToolConfig.ById[toolId]
	local template = ServerStorage.Tools:FindFirstChild(toolId)
	local tool = template and template:Clone() or buildFallbackTool(def)
	tool.Name = titleCase(def.Name)
	tool:SetAttribute("ToolId", toolId)
	tool.CanBeDropped = false
	tool.RequiresHandle = true
	tool.ToolTip = def.Description
	local icon = AssetConfig.Image(def.Icon)
	if icon then
		tool.TextureId = icon
	end
	applySkin(tool, skinId)
	return tool
end

local function weakestIndex(loadout)
	local index, lowest = nil, math.huge
	for i, toolId in ipairs(loadout) do
		local def = ToolConfig.ById[toolId]
		if def and not def.Premium and not def.OwnerOnly and def.Damage < lowest then
			index, lowest = i, def.Damage
		end
	end
	return index or #loadout
end

function ToolService:Init(services)
	self.Services = services
	self.Data = services.DataService

	self.Data:OnProfileLoaded(function(player)
		self:SyncPremium(player)
		self:SyncRebirthSkins(player)
		if player.Character then
			self:GiveLoadout(player)
		end
	end)

	local monetization = services.MonetizationService
	if monetization and monetization.PassOwned then
		monetization.PassOwned:Connect(function(player)
			self:SyncPremium(player)
			self:GiveLoadout(player)
		end)
	end

	local rebirth = services.RebirthService
	if rebirth and rebirth.Reborn then
		rebirth.Reborn:Connect(function(player)
			self:SyncRebirthSkins(player)
		end)
	end
end

function ToolService:Start()
	local antiExploit = self.Services.AntiExploitService
	local economy = self.Services.EconomyService

	local function hookCharacter(player)
		player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
			character.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
				local toolId = child:IsA("Tool") and child:GetAttribute("ToolId")
				local data = self.Data:GetData(player)
				if toolId and data and data.EquippedTool ~= toolId then
					self.Data:Set(player, "EquippedTool", toolId)
				end
			end)
			if not self.Data:WaitForData(player, 30) then
				return
			end
			player:WaitForChild("Backpack", 10)
			self:GiveLoadout(player, true)
		end)
	end
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(hookCharacter)
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		hookCharacter(player)
	end

	antiExploit:Connect("BuyTool", { Rate = 2, Burst = 4 }, function(player, toolId)
		if not Validate.String(toolId, 32) then
			return
		end
		local def = ToolConfig.ById[toolId]
		local data = self.Data:GetData(player)
		if not def or def.Premium or def.OwnerOnly or data.Tools[toolId] then
			return
		end
		if data.Rebirths < def.RequiredRebirths then
			Notifier.Error(player, "REQUIRES " .. def.RequiredRebirths .. " REBIRTHS")
			return
		end
		if not economy:SpendCash(player, def.Price) then
			Notifier.Error(player, "NOT ENOUGH CASH")
			return
		end
		self:GrantTool(player, toolId, true)
		Notifier.Send(player, { Kind = "Purchase", Text = "PURCHASED!", Subtext = def.Name, Icon = def.Icon })
		self.ToolPurchased:Fire(player, toolId)
	end)

	antiExploit:Connect("SetLoadout", { Rate = 3, Burst = 6 }, function(player, list)
		if type(list) ~= "table" or #list < 1 or #list > MAX_SLOTS then
			return
		end
		local slots = economy:GetStats(player).LoadoutSlots
		local loadout, seen = {}, {}
		for _, toolId in ipairs(list) do
			if not Validate.String(toolId, 32) or seen[toolId] or not self:Owns(player, toolId) then
				return
			end
			seen[toolId] = true
			table.insert(loadout, toolId)
		end
		if #loadout > slots then
			return
		end
		self.Data:Set(player, "Loadout", loadout)
		self:GiveLoadout(player)
	end)

	antiExploit:Connect("BuySkin", { Rate = 2, Burst = 4 }, function(player, skinId)
		if not Validate.String(skinId, 32) then
			return
		end
		local skin = ToolConfig.SkinsById[skinId]
		local data = self.Data:GetData(player)
		if not skin or skin.Source ~= "Scrap" or data.Skins[skinId] then
			return
		end
		if not economy:SpendScrap(player, skin.Price) then
			local tooBig = skin.Price > economy:GetStats(player).Capacity
			Notifier.Error(player, tooBig and "BAG TOO SMALL - BUY SCRAP CAPACITY" or "NOT ENOUGH SCRAP")
			return
		end
		self:GrantSkin(player, skinId)
		self.Data:Set(player, "EquippedSkin", skinId)
		self:GiveLoadout(player)
		Notifier.Send(player, { Kind = "Purchase", Text = "PURCHASED!", Subtext = skin.Name .. " SKIN" })
	end)

	antiExploit:Connect("EquipSkin", { Rate = 3, Burst = 6 }, function(player, skinId)
		local data = self.Data:GetData(player)
		if not Validate.String(skinId, 32) or not data.Skins[skinId] or data.EquippedSkin == skinId then
			return
		end
		self.Data:Set(player, "EquippedSkin", skinId)
		self:GiveLoadout(player)
	end)
end

function ToolService:Owns(player, toolId)
	local def = ToolConfig.ById[toolId]
	if not def then
		return false
	end
	if def.OwnerOnly then
		return Ownership.HasOwnerPerks(player)
	end
	if def.Premium then
		local monetization = self.Services.MonetizationService
		return monetization ~= nil and monetization:HasPass(player, def.Premium)
	end
	local data = self.Data:GetData(player)
	return data ~= nil and data.Tools[toolId] == true
end

function ToolService:GetEquippedToolId(player)
	local character = player.Character
	local tool = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
	return tool and tool:GetAttribute("ToolId")
end

function ToolService:AddToLoadout(player, toolId)
	local data = self.Data:GetData(player)
	local loadout = table.clone(data.Loadout)
	if table.find(loadout, toolId) then
		return
	end
	local slots = self.Services.EconomyService:GetStats(player).LoadoutSlots
	if #loadout < slots then
		table.insert(loadout, toolId)
	else
		loadout[weakestIndex(loadout)] = toolId
	end
	self.Data:Set(player, "Loadout", loadout)
end

function ToolService:GrantTool(player, toolId, equip)
	local data = self.Data:GetData(player)
	if not data or not Ownership.CanUseTool(player,ToolConfig.ById[toolId]) then
		return
	end
	data.Tools[toolId] = true
	self.Data:Replicate(player, "Tools")
	self:AddToLoadout(player, toolId)
	if equip then
		self.Data:Set(player, "EquippedTool", toolId)
	end
	self:GiveLoadout(player, equip and "Force")
end

function ToolService:GrantSkin(player, skinId)
	local data = self.Data:GetData(player)
	if not data or not ToolConfig.SkinsById[skinId] or data.Skins[skinId] then
		return false
	end
	data.Skins[skinId] = true
	self.Data:Replicate(player, "Skins")
	return true
end

function ToolService:SyncPremium(player)
	local data = self.Data:GetData(player)
	if not data then
		return false
	end
	local changed = false
	for _, def in ipairs(ToolConfig.List) do
		if def.OwnerOnly and data.Tools[def.Id] and not self:Owns(player, def.Id) then
			data.Tools[def.Id] = nil
			local index = table.find(data.Loadout, def.Id)
			if index then
				table.remove(data.Loadout, index)
				self.Data:Replicate(player, "Loadout")
			end
			self.Data:Replicate(player, "Tools")
		end
		if (def.Premium or def.OwnerOnly) and self:Owns(player, def.Id) then
			if not data.Tools[def.Id] then
				data.Tools[def.Id] = true
				self.Data:Replicate(player, "Tools")
				changed = true
			end
			if not table.find(data.Loadout, def.Id) then
				self:AddToLoadout(player, def.Id)
				changed = true
			end
		end
	end
	return changed
end

function ToolService:SyncRebirthSkins(player)
	local data = self.Data:GetData(player)
	if not data then
		return
	end
	for _, skin in ipairs(ToolConfig.Skins) do
		if skin.Source == "Rebirth" and data.Rebirths >= (skin.RequiredRebirths or 0) then
			self:GrantSkin(player, skin.Id)
		end
	end
end

function ToolService:GiveLoadout(player, autoEquip)
	local data = self.Data:GetData(player)
	local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	local character = player.Character
	if not data or not backpack then
		return
	end
	local equippedId = nil
	for _, container in ipairs({ backpack, character }) do
		if container then
			for _, item in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
				if item:IsA("Tool") and item:GetAttribute("ToolId") then
					if container == character then
						equippedId = item:GetAttribute("ToolId")
					end
					item:Destroy()
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local slots = self.Services.EconomyService:GetStats(player).LoadoutSlots
	local given = {}
	for index, toolId in ipairs(data.Loadout) do
		if index > slots then
			break
		end
		if self:Owns(player, toolId) then
			local tool = buildTool(toolId, data.EquippedSkin)
			tool.Parent = backpack
			given[toolId] = tool
		end
	end

	local tutorialBlocks = not data.Tutorial.Completed and data.Tutorial.Step <= 1
	local allowed = autoEquip == "Force" or (autoEquip and not tutorialBlocks)
	local target = if autoEquip == "Force" then data.EquippedTool else equippedId or (allowed and data.EquippedTool)
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if target and given[target] and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
		humanoid:EquipTool(given[target])
	end
end

return ToolService
