local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local Components = script.Parent.Parent:WaitForChild("Components")
local Widgets = require(Components.Widgets)
local ChatFeed = require(Components.ChatFeed)

local HIDDEN = { Enum.CoreGuiType.Chat, Enum.CoreGuiType.PlayerList, Enum.CoreGuiType.Backpack }
local CHAT_KEYS = { [Enum.KeyCode.Slash] = true, [Enum.KeyCode.Minus] = true, [Enum.KeyCode.KeypadDivide] = true }
local TOUCH_CHAT_TOP = 150

local CoreUiController = { Priority = 2 }

local feed = nil

local function hideCoreGui()
	for _, kind in ipairs(HIDDEN) do
		pcall(StarterGui.SetCoreGuiEnabled, StarterGui, kind, false)
	end
end

function CoreUiController:Init(controllers)
	self.Controllers = controllers
	hideCoreGui()
end

function CoreUiController:Start()
	task.spawn(function()
		for _ = 1, 5 do
			hideCoreGui()
			task.wait(1)
		end
	end)

	local gui = Widgets.ScreenGui("ChatUI", 3, true)
	feed = ChatFeed.new(gui)
	local input = self.Controllers.InputController
	local function arrange()
		feed:Arrange(input:IsTouch(), TOUCH_CHAT_TOP)
	end
	arrange()
	input.InputChanged:Connect(arrange)
	if not input:IsTouch() then
		local key = UserInputService:GetStringForKeyCode(Enum.KeyCode.Slash)
		local hint = if key == "" or key == "/" then "Press / to chat" else "Press / or " .. key .. " to chat"
		feed:Push(nil, hint, Color3.fromRGB(150, 154, 168))
	end

	UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(inputObject, processed)
		if processed or UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then
			return
		end
		local shifted = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightShift)
		if CHAT_KEYS[inputObject.KeyCode] or (shifted and inputObject.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Seven) then
			feed:Focus()
		end
	end)
end

function CoreUiController:OpenChat()
	if feed then
		feed:Focus()
	end
end

return CoreUiController

local Format = {}

local SUFFIXES = { "", "K", "M", "B", "T", "Qa", "Qi", "Sx", "Sp", "Oc", "No", "Dc", "Ud", "Dd", "Td", "Qad", "Qid", "Sxd", "Spd", "Ocd", "Nod", "Vg" }

local function trim(text)
	if string.find(text, "%.") then
		text = string.gsub(text, "0+$", "")
		text = string.gsub(text, "%.$", "")
	end
	return text
end

function Format.Number(value)
	value = tonumber(value) or 0
	if value ~= value or value == math.huge or value == -math.huge then
		return "0"
	end
	local sign = value < 0 and "-" or ""
	value = math.abs(value)
	if value < 1000 then
		if value % 1 == 0 then
			return sign .. tostring(math.floor(value))
		end
		return sign .. trim(string.format("%.1f", math.floor(value * 10) / 10))
	end
	local index = math.min(math.floor(math.log10(value) / 3), #SUFFIXES - 1)
	local scaled = value / 10 ^ (index * 3)
	local text
	if scaled >= 100 then
		text = tostring(math.floor(scaled))
	elseif scaled >= 10 then
		text = trim(string.format("%.1f", math.floor(scaled * 10) / 10))
	else
		text = trim(string.format("%.2f", math.floor(scaled * 100) / 100))
	end
	return sign .. text .. SUFFIXES[index + 1]
end

function Format.Commas(value)
	value = math.floor(tonumber(value) or 0)
	local text = tostring(math.abs(value))
	local result = string.reverse(string.gsub(string.reverse(text), "(%d%d%d)", "%1,"))
	if string.sub(result, 1, 1) == "," then
		result = string.sub(result, 2)
	end
	return (value < 0 and "-" or "") .. result
end

function Format.Smart(value)
	if math.abs(tonumber(value) or 0) < 100000 then
		return Format.Commas(value)
	end
	return Format.Number(value)
end

function Format.Time(seconds)
	seconds = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(seconds) or 0))
	local hours = math.floor(seconds / 3600)
	local minutes = math.floor(seconds % 3600 / 60)
	local secs = seconds % 60
	if hours > 0 then
		return string.format("%dh %02dm", hours, minutes)
	end
	return string.format("%d:%02d", minutes, secs)
end

function Format.Percent(value, decimals)
	value = (tonumber(value) or 0) * 100
	if decimals and decimals > 0 then
		return trim(string.format("%." .. decimals .. "f", value)) .. "%"
	end
	return tostring(math.floor(value + 0.5)) .. "%"
end

function Format.Multiplier(value)
	value = tonumber(value) or 1
	if value >= 1000 then
		return "x" .. Format.Number(value)
	end
	return "x" .. trim(string.format("%.2f", value))
end

return Format

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local EngineRunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local ThemeConfig = require(Shared.Config.ThemeConfig)
local QuestConfig = require(Shared.Config.QuestConfig)
local GameConfig = require(Shared.Config.GameConfig)
local Formulas = require(Shared.Modules.Formulas)
local Format = require(Shared.Modules.Format)
local Net = require(Shared.Modules.Net)
local Components = script.Parent.Parent:WaitForChild("Components")
local UIKit = require(Components.UIKit)
local Widgets = require(Components.Widgets)

local Colors = ThemeConfig.Colors
local Fonts = ThemeConfig.Fonts

local QuestController = { Priority = 42 }

local window = nil
local category = "Contracts"
local focusQuest
local tabs = {}
local refreshVersion = 0

local function rewardText(rewards)
	local parts = {}
	if rewards.Cash then
		table.insert(parts, Format.Number(rewards.Cash) .. " CASH")
	end
	if rewards.Scrap then
		table.insert(parts, Format.Number(rewards.Scrap) .. " SCRAP")
	end
	if rewards.ChaosCores then
		table.insert(parts, rewards.ChaosCores .. " CORES")
	end
	if rewards.Boost then
		local boost = GameConfig.Boosts[rewards.Boost.Id]
		table.insert(parts, (boost and boost.Name or "BOOST") .. " " .. Format.Time(rewards.Boost.Seconds))
	end
	return table.concat(parts, "  +  ")
end

function QuestController:Init(controllers)
	self.Controllers = controllers
end

function QuestController:Start()
	local controllers = self.Controllers
	window = Widgets.Window("QuestUI", { Title = "QUESTS & CONTRACTS", Accent = Colors.Cyan, Tabs = true })
	Widgets.List(window.Content, 10)
	for index, name in ipairs({"Campaign", "Contracts", "Milestones"}) do
		tabs[name] = Widgets.Tab(window.Tabs, {Name=name, Text=string.upper(name), Width=145, Order=index, OnClick=function()
			category=name focusQuest=nil
			self:Refresh()
		end})
	end
	Widgets.Tab(window.Tabs, {Name="Collections", Text="COLLECTIONS", Width=145, Order=4, OnClick=function()
		controllers.PanelController:Open("Collections")
	end})
	for _,tab in ipairs(window.Tabs:GetChildren())do
  if tab:IsA("GuiButton")then tab.Size=UDim2.new(.25,-6,1,0)end
 end
 controllers.PanelController:Register("Quests", window.Gui, {
		OnOpen = function()
			self:Refresh()
		end,
	})
	controllers.DataController:Observe("QuestProgress", function()
		if controllers.PanelController:IsOpen("Quests") then
			self:Refresh()
		end
	end)
end

function QuestController:ViewQuest(questId)
 local quest = questId and QuestConfig.ById[questId]
 if quest and quest.Category=="Collections"then
  self.Controllers.PanelController:Open("Collections",quest.Type=="FindCache"and "Caches"or quest.Zone)
  return
 end
 focusQuest=questId
 category = quest and quest.Category or "Milestones"
 self.Controllers.PanelController:Open("Quests")
end

function QuestController:Refresh()
 refreshVersion+=1
 local version=refreshVersion
	local data = self.Controllers.DataController:GetAll()
	if not data then
		return
	end
	Widgets.Clear(window.Content)
 if category=="Campaign"then
  local intro=Widgets.Card(window.Content,{Name="CampaignIntro",Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,58),Order=-10})
  Widgets.Label(intro,{Text="DISTRICT JOBS · "..#QuestConfig.Chapters.." CHAPTERS / "..(#QuestConfig.Chapters*4).." STAGES\nClaim each stage to unlock the next. Chapters can be played separately.",Position=UDim2.fromOffset(12,6),Size=UDim2.new(1,-24,1,-12),MaxSize=16,Color=Colors.Cyan})
 end
	for name, tab in pairs(tabs) do Widgets.SetVariant(tab, name == category and "Primary" or "Secondary") end
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local compact = camera and camera.ViewportSize.Y < 600
	for _, quest in ipairs(QuestConfig.List) do
		if (quest.Category or "Milestones") ~= category then continue end
		local progress = data.QuestProgress[quest.Id] or { Tier = 0, Progress = 0, Target = quest.Target }
		local target = progress.Target or quest.Target
		local zoneLocked = quest.Zone and quest.Zone~="ScrapYard"and not data.Zones[quest.Zone]
  local previous=quest.Prerequisite and data.QuestProgress[quest.Prerequisite]
  local stageLocked=quest.Prerequisite and (not previous or not previous.Completed)
  local locked=not QuestConfig.IsAvailable(quest,data)
		local ready = not stageLocked and not progress.Completed and (progress.Progress or 0) >= target
		if category=="Campaign"and quest.Step==1 then
   local chapter
   for _,candidate in ipairs(QuestConfig.Chapters)do if candidate.Id==quest.Chapter then chapter=candidate break end end
   local chapterCard=Widgets.Card(window.Content,{Name=quest.Chapter,Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,64),Order=quest.Order-1,Accent=Colors.Cyan})
   Widgets.Label(chapterCard,{Text=chapter.Name,Position=UDim2.fromOffset(12,4),Size=UDim2.new(1,-24,0,23),MaxSize=20,Font=Fonts.Display,Color=Colors.Cyan})
   Widgets.Label(chapterCard,{Text=chapter.Brief,Position=UDim2.fromOffset(12,29),Size=UDim2.new(1,-24,0,30),MaxSize=13,Color=Colors.Muted})
  end
  local card = Widgets.Card(window.Content, { Name = quest.Id, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 130), Order = category=="Campaign"and quest.Order or ((progress.Completed and 100 or ready and 0 or 10) + quest.Order), Accent = ready and Colors.Yellow or Colors.Cyan })
		if ready then
			card.Outline.Color = Colors.Yellow
		end
		Widgets.Icon(card, quest.Icon, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(compact and 38 or 58, compact and 38 or 58), Position = UDim2.new(0, compact and 12 or 18, 0.5, 0), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), FallbackColor = Colors.Cyan })
		local info = UIKit.Create("Frame", { Name = "Info", BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(compact and 64 or 90, 10), Size = UDim2.new(0.72, compact and -70 or -96, 1, -20), Parent = card })
		Widgets.Label(info, { Name = "QuestText", Text = (quest.Step and ("STEP "..quest.Step.."/4 · ")or "")..string.format(quest.Text, Format.Commas(target)), Font = Fonts.Display, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26), MaxSize = 22 })
		local bar = Widgets.Progress(info, { Name = "Bar", Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 32), Color = ready and Colors.Yellow or Colors.Cyan, Value = (progress.Progress or 0) / math.max(target, 1) })
		Widgets.Label(bar, { Name = "Count", Text = Format.Number(math.min(progress.Progress or 0, target)) .. " / " .. Format.Number(target), Font = Fonts.Number, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), AlignX = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, MaxSize = 12, Stroke = 1, ZIndex = 3 })
		local rewards = quest.FixedRewards and quest.Rewards or Formulas.QuestRewards(quest, progress.Tier or 0, data)
		Widgets.Label(info, { Name = "Rewards", Text = "REWARD: " .. rewardText(rewards), Font = Fonts.Number, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 56), MaxSize = 14, Color = Colors.Yellow })
		Widgets.Label(info, {Name="Description", Text=zoneLocked and "Unlock this zone to start"or stageLocked and ("Claim step "..(quest.Step-1).." to unlock this job.")or quest.Description or "Keep playing to reach this milestone.", Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0, 79), Size=UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30), MaxSize=13, Color=Colors.Muted})
		local action = UIKit.Create("Frame", { Name = "Action", BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0.25, 0, 0, 46), Parent = card })
		if progress.Completed then
			Widgets.Button(action, { Name = "Done", Text = "DONE", Variant = "Disabled", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1) })
		else
			local claim = Widgets.Button(action, {
				Name = "Claim",
				Text = ready and "CLAIM"or zoneLocked and "GO TO ZONE"or stageLocked and "PREVIOUS STEP"or "TRACK TASK",
				Variant = ready and "Primary" or "Secondary",
				Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
				OnClick = function()
					if ready then
						Net.Remote("ClaimQuest"):FireServer(quest.Id)
					elseif zoneLocked then
						self.Controllers.PanelController:Open("Travel")
					elseif stageLocked then
						self:ViewQuest(quest.Prerequisite)
					else
						self.Controllers.ActivityController:SelectQuest(quest.Id)
						if quest.Zone then self.Controllers.NavigationController:SetZone(quest.Zone)end
						self.Controllers.PanelController:Close("Quests")
					end
				end,
			})
			if ready then
				UIKit.Pop(claim, 1.15)
			end
		end
	end
 task.defer(function()
  EngineRunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
  if version~=refreshVersion or not self.Controllers.PanelController:IsOpen("Quests")then return end
  local def=focusQuest and QuestConfig.ById[focusQuest]
  local card=def and window.Content:FindFirstChild(def.Step==1 and def.Chapter or focusQuest)
  if not card then return end
  -- List offsets remain stable while the opening animation scales the window.
  local children={}
  for _,child in ipairs(window.Content:GetChildren())do
   if child:IsA("GuiObject")and child.Visible then table.insert(children,child)end
  end
  table.sort(children,function(x,y)return x.LayoutOrder<y.LayoutOrder end)
  local y=0
  local padding=window.Content:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIPadding")
  if padding then y=padding.PaddingTop.Offset end
  local layout=window.Content:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout")
  local gap=layout and layout.Padding.Offset or 0
  for _,child in ipairs(children)do
   if child==card then break end
   y+=child.Size.Y.Offset+gap
  end
  window.Content.CanvasPosition=Vector2.new(0,math.max(0,y-6))
 end)
end

return QuestController

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local EventConfig = require(Shared.Config.EventConfig)
local Formulas = require(Shared.Modules.Formulas)

local ProductHandlers = {}

function ProductHandlers.Cash(services, player, product, data)
	services.EconomyService:AddCash(player, Formulas.CashPackAmount(product, data), "Purchase")
end

function ProductHandlers.Boost(services, player, product)
	assert(services.EconomyService:AddBoost(player, product.Boost, product.Seconds), "boost rejected")
end

function ProductHandlers.Rebirth(services, player)
	assert(services.RebirthService:DoRebirth(player, true), "rebirth rejected")
end

function ProductHandlers.ChaosBoost(services, player, product)
	services.EventService:AddChaosFraction(EventConfig.ChaosBoostFill)
	services.EconomyService:AddBoost(player, product.Boost, product.Seconds)
end

function ProductHandlers.MegaChaos(services, player, product)
	services.EventService:StartChaos({ Mega = true, Buyer = player })
	services.EconomyService:AddBoost(player, product.Boost, product.Seconds)
end

function ProductHandlers.Nuclear(services, player)
	assert(services.EventService:NuclearWreck(player), "nuclear delivery deferred")
end

function ProductHandlers.StarterPack(services, player, product, data)
	-- ProcessReceipt deduplicates PurchaseId; distinct paid receipts must deliver.
	-- Prompt still prevents purchasing the one-time offer again.
	local contents = product.Contents
	local economy = services.EconomyService
	economy:AddCash(player, contents.Cash, "Purchase")
	economy:AddScrap(player, contents.Scrap, "Purchase", true)
	for _, boost in ipairs(contents.Boosts) do
		economy:AddBoost(player, boost.Id, boost.Seconds)
	end
	if contents.Skin and services.ToolService then
		services.ToolService:GrantSkin(player, contents.Skin)
	end
	services.DataService:Update(player, "Purchases", function(purchases)
		purchases.StarterPack = true
		return purchases
	end)
end

return ProductHandlers

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local ThemeConfig = require(Shared.Config.ThemeConfig)
local UpgradeConfig = require(Shared.Config.UpgradeConfig)
local Formulas = require(Shared.Modules.Formulas)
local Format = require(Shared.Modules.Format)
local Net = require(Shared.Modules.Net)
local Components = script.Parent.Parent:WaitForChild("Components")
local UIKit = require(Components.UIKit)
local Widgets = require(Components.Widgets)

local Colors = ThemeConfig.Colors
local Fonts = ThemeConfig.Fonts
local CAPACITY_ID = "InventoryCapacity"
local FILTERS = { { Id = "All", Text = "ALL" }, { Id = "Cash", Text = "CASH" }, { Id = "Scrap", Text = "SCRAP" } }
local SCRAP_HELP = "Scrap drops from every wreck. Spend it here or on skins in TOOLS. Bag full? Grow it with SCRAP CAPACITY, paid in Cash."

local UpgradeController = { Priority = 40 }

local window = nil
local cards = {}
local lastLevels = {}
local filter = "All"

local function shows(upgrade)
	if filter == "All" then
		return true
	end
	if filter == "Scrap" and upgrade.Id == CAPACITY_ID then
		return true
	end
	return upgrade.Currency == filter
end

local function formatValue(upgrade, value)
	if upgrade.Format == "Multiplier" then
		return Format.Multiplier(value)
	elseif upgrade.Format == "Percent" then
		return Format.Percent(value)
	elseif upgrade.Format == "Studs" then
		return string.format("%.1f", value) .. " STUDS"
	elseif upgrade.Format == "Speed" then
		return string.format("%.1f", value)
	end
	return Format.Number(value)
end

local function buildCard(upgrade)
	local card = Widgets.Card(window.Content, { Name = upgrade.Id, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 96), Order = upgrade.Order, Accent = upgrade.Color })
	Widgets.Icon(card, upgrade.Icon, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(60, 60), Position = UDim2.new(0, 18, 0.5, 0), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), FallbackColor = upgrade.Color })
	local info = UIKit.Create("Frame", { Name = "Info", BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(90, 8), Size = UDim2.new(0.58, -96, 1, -16), Parent = card })
	Widgets.Label(info, { Name = "UpgradeName", Text = upgrade.Name, Font = Fonts.Display, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26), MaxSize = 24 })
	Widgets.Label(info, { Name = "Level", Font = Fonts.Number, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 26), MaxSize = 15, Color = Colors.Muted })
	Widgets.Label(info, { Name = "Effect", Font = Fonts.Number, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 46), MaxSize = 19, Color = upgrade.Color, Rich = true })
	Widgets.Label(info, { Name = "Description", Text = upgrade.Description, Font = Fonts.Light, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 66), MaxSize = 13, Color = Colors.Muted })

	local actions = UIKit.Create("Frame", { Name = "Actions", BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0.42, 0, 1, -16), Parent = card })
	local price = Widgets.Chip(actions, { Name = "Price", Icon = upgrade.Currency == "Scrap" and "Scrap" or "Cash", Color = upgrade.Currency == "Scrap" and Colors.Scrap or Colors.Cash, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30), MaxSize = 18 })
	price.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
	local buy = Widgets.Button(actions, {
		Name = "Buy",
		Text = "BUY",
		Size = UDim2.new(0.62, -4, 0, 38),
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -38),
		OnClick = function()
			Net.Remote("BuyUpgrade"):FireServer(upgrade.Id, "One")
		end,
	})
	buy.Name = "Buy"
	Widgets.Button(actions, {
		Name = "Max",
		Text = "MAX",
		Variant = "Secondary",
		Size = UDim2.new(0.38, -4, 0, 38),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -38),
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
		OnClick = function()
			Net.Remote("BuyUpgrade"):FireServer(upgrade.Id, "Max")
		end,
	})
	cards[upgrade.Id] = card
	return card
end

function UpgradeController:Init(controllers)
	self.Controllers = controllers
end

function UpgradeController:Start()
	local controllers = self.Controllers
	window = Widgets.Window("UpgradeUI", { Title = "UPGRADES", Accent = Colors.Red, Tabs = true, FooterHeight = 64 })
	Widgets.List(window.Content, 10)
	for index, entry in ipairs(FILTERS) do
		Widgets.Tab(window.Tabs, { Name = entry.Id .. "Tab", Text = entry.Text, Order = index, OnClick = function()
			filter = entry.Id
			window.Content.CanvasPosition = Vector2.zero
			self:Refresh()
		end })
	end
	local help = Widgets.Card(window.Content, { Name = "ScrapHelp", Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 64), Order = -1, Accent = Colors.Scrap })
	help.Visible = false
	Widgets.Icon(help, "Scrap", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 40), Position = UDim2.new(0, 22, 0.5, 0), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), FallbackColor = Colors.Scrap })
	Widgets.Label(help, { Name = "Text", Text = SCRAP_HELP, Font = Fonts.Body, Size = UDim2.new(1, -92, 1, -12), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(76, 6), MaxSize = 15 })
	for _, upgrade in ipairs(UpgradeConfig.List) do
		buildCard(upgrade)
	end
	local summary = UIKit.Create("Frame", { Name = "Summary", BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), Parent = window.Footer })
	local layout = Widgets.List(summary, 10, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal)
	layout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
	Widgets.Chip(summary, { Name = "DamageStat", Icon = "StatDamage", Color = Colors.Damage, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(170, 36), Order = 1, MaxSize = 18 })
	Widgets.Chip(summary, { Name = "CashStat", Icon = "StatCash", Color = Colors.Cash, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(170, 36), Order = 2, MaxSize = 18 })
	Widgets.Chip(summary, { Name = "CritStat", Icon = "StatCrit", Color = Colors.Crit, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 36), Order = 3, MaxSize = 18 })

	controllers.PanelController:Register("Upgrades", window.Gui, {
		OnOpen = function(arg)
			if arg == "All" or arg == "Cash" or arg == "Scrap" then
				filter = arg
				window.Content.CanvasPosition = Vector2.zero
			end
			self:Refresh()
		end,
	})

	local dataController = controllers.DataController
	for _, key in ipairs({ "Upgrades", "Cash", "Scrap" }) do
		dataController:Observe(key, function()
			if controllers.PanelController:IsOpen("Upgrades") then
				self:Refresh()
			end
		end)
	end
	dataController:ObserveSession("Stats", function()
		if controllers.PanelController:IsOpen("Upgrades") then
			self:Refresh()
		end
	end)
end

function UpgradeController:Refresh()
	local dataController = self.Controllers.DataController
	local data = dataController:GetAll()
	if not data then
		return
	end
	for _, button in ipairs(window.Tabs:GetChildren()) do
		if button:IsA("TextButton") then
			Widgets.SetVariant(button, button.Name == filter .. "Tab" and "Accent" or "Secondary")
		end
	end
	window.Content.ScrapHelp.Visible = filter == "Scrap"
	local stats = dataController:GetStats()
	local capacity = stats.Capacity or 500
	for _, upgrade in ipairs(UpgradeConfig.List) do
		local card = cards[upgrade.Id]
		card.Visible = shows(upgrade)
		card.LayoutOrder = if filter == "Scrap" and upgrade.Id == CAPACITY_ID then 0 else upgrade.Order
		local level = data.Upgrades[upgrade.Id] or 0
		local maxed = level >= upgrade.MaxLevel
		local now = Formulas.UpgradeValue(upgrade.Id, level)
		local info = card.Info
		info.Level.Text = "LV " .. level .. " / " .. upgrade.MaxLevel
		if maxed then
			info.Effect.Text = formatValue(upgrade, now) .. "  MAX"
		else
			info.Effect.Text = formatValue(upgrade, now) .. "  >  " .. formatValue(upgrade, Formulas.UpgradeValue(upgrade.Id, level + 1))
		end
		local price = Formulas.UpgradePrice(upgrade.Id, level)
		local balance = upgrade.Currency == "Scrap" and data.Scrap or data.Cash
		local actions = card.Actions
		actions.Price.Value.Text = maxed and "MAXED" or Format.Number(price)
		local canBuy = not maxed and balance >= price
		local tooBig = upgrade.Currency == "Scrap" and not canBuy and not maxed and price > capacity
		actions.Buy.Text = tooBig and "BAG TOO SMALL" or "BUY"
		info.Description.Text = tooBig and "Bag too small: buy SCRAP CAPACITY" or upgrade.Description
		info.Description.TextColor3 = tooBig and Colors.Red or Colors.Muted
		Widgets.SetVariant(actions.Buy, canBuy and "Primary" or "Disabled")
		Widgets.SetVariant(actions.Max, canBuy and "Secondary" or "Disabled")
		if lastLevels[upgrade.Id] and level > lastLevels[upgrade.Id] then
			UIKit.Pop(info.Effect, 1.25)
			card.Outline.Color = upgrade.Color
			task.delay(0.35, function()
				card.Outline.Color = Colors.Stroke
			end)
			self.Controllers.SoundController:Play("Purchase")
		end
		lastLevels[upgrade.Id] = level
	end
	local summary = window.Footer.Summary
	summary.DamageStat.Value.Text = "DMG " .. Format.Multiplier(stats.DamageMultiplier or 1)
	summary.CashStat.Value.Text = "CASH " .. Format.Multiplier(stats.CashMultiplier or 1)
	summary.CritStat.Value.Text = "CRIT " .. Format.Percent(stats.CritChance or 0)
end

return UpgradeController

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local ThemeConfig = require(Shared.Config.ThemeConfig)

local Formulas = require(Shared.Modules.Formulas)
local Format = require(Shared.Modules.Format)

local Components = script.Parent.Parent:WaitForChild("Components")
local UIKit = require(Components.UIKit)
local Widgets = require(Components.Widgets)

local Colors = ThemeConfig.Colors
local Fonts = ThemeConfig.Fonts

local TravelController = { Priority = 47 }

local listWindow = nil
local modal = nil
local modalZone = nil

local function zoneRow(parent, order, props)
	local card = Widgets.Card(parent, { Name = props.Name, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 84), Order = order, Accent = props.Color })
	Widgets.Icon(card, props.Icon, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(56, 56), Position = UDim2.new(0, 18, 0.5, 0), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), FallbackColor = props.Color })

	Widgets.Label(card, { Name = "Detail", Text = props.Detail, Font = Fonts.Number, Size = UDim2.new(0.62, -90, 0, 32), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(86, 42), MaxSize = 14, Color = Colors.Muted })

		Name = "Action",

		Variant = props.Variant,
		Size = UDim2.new(0.34, 0, 0, 46),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0.5, 0),
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),

	})

end

local function buildModal()
	modal = Widgets.Window("ZoneUnlockUI", { Title = "UNLOCK ZONE", Accent = Colors.Orange, DisplayOrder = 8, Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.42, 0.56), MaxSize = Vector2.new(560, 460), FooterHeight = 74 })
	local content = modal.Content
	content.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
	Widgets.Icon(content, "ZoneDowntown", { Name = "ZoneIcon", Size = UDim2.fromOffset(96, 96), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 4), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0) })
	Widgets.Label(content, { Name = "ZoneName", Font = Fonts.Display, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 104), AlignX = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, MaxSize = 36, Stroke = 2 })
	Widgets.Label(content, { Name = "Description", Font = Fonts.Body, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 146), AlignX = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, MaxSize = 17, Color = Colors.Muted })
	Widgets.Label(content, { Name = "Multiplier", Font = Fonts.Number, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 188), AlignX = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, MaxSize = 24, Color = Colors.Yellow })
	Widgets.Label(content, { Name = "Requirement", Font = Fonts.Display, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 222), AlignX = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, MaxSize = 18, Color = Colors.Red })
	Widgets.Button(modal.Footer, {
		Name = "Unlock",
		Text = "UNLOCK",
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		MaxSize = 28,
		OnClick = function()
			if modalZone then
				Net.Remote("UnlockZone"):FireServer(modalZone)
			end
		end,
	})
end

function TravelController:Init(controllers)
	self.Controllers = controllers
end

function TravelController:Start()
	local controllers = self.Controllers
	listWindow = Widgets.Window("TravelUI", { Title = "ZONES", Accent = Colors.Orange })
	Widgets.List(listWindow.Content, 10)
	buildModal()
	controllers.PanelController:Register("Travel", listWindow.Gui, {
		OnOpen = function()
			self:RefreshList()
		end,
	})
	controllers.PanelController:Register("ZoneUnlock", modal.Gui, {
		OnOpen = function(zoneId)
			modalZone = zoneId
			self:RefreshModal()
		end,
	})
	local dataController = controllers.DataController
	dataController:Observe("Zones", function()
		if modalZone and controllers.PanelController:IsOpen("ZoneUnlock") then
			local data = dataController:GetAll()
			if data and data.Zones[modalZone] then
				controllers.PanelController:Close("ZoneUnlock")
				Net.Remote("Travel"):FireServer(modalZone)
			end
		end
		if controllers.PanelController:IsOpen("Travel") then
			self:RefreshList()
		end
	end)
	for _, key in ipairs({ "Cash", "Rebirths" }) do
		dataController:Observe(key, function()
			if controllers.PanelController:IsOpen("ZoneUnlock") then
				self:RefreshModal()
			end
		end)
	end
end

function TravelController:Go(destination)
	Net.Remote("Travel"):FireServer(destination)
	self.Controllers.PanelController:Close("Travel")
end

function TravelController:RefreshList()
	local dataController = self.Controllers.DataController
	local data = dataController:GetAll()
	if not data then
		return
	end
	local passes = dataController:GetSession("Passes") or {}
	local content = listWindow.Content
	Widgets.Clear(content)
	zoneRow(content, 0, { Name = "Plaza", Title = "SPAWN PLAZA", Icon = "LogoIcon", Color = Colors.White, Detail = "SHOP, UPGRADES, REBIRTH, PORTALS", Action = "TRAVEL", Variant = "Secondary", OnClick = function()
		self:Go("Plaza")
	end })
	zoneRow(content, 1, { Name = "Hall", Title = "HALL OF WRECKERS", Icon = "TitleWreckLegend", Color = Colors.Gold, Detail = "LEADERBOARDS AND CHAMPIONS", Action = "TRAVEL", Variant = "Secondary", OnClick = function()
		self:Go("Hall")
	end })
	zoneRow(content,2,{Name="Worlds",Title="CO-OP WORLDS",Icon="ZoneFuture",Color=Colors.Cyan,Detail="3 FREE WORLDS · BOSSES · MIXED-LEVEL TEAMS",Action="EXPLORE",Variant="Accent",OnClick=function()
  self.Controllers.PanelController:Open("Expeditions")
 end})
 for _, zone in ipairs(ZoneConfig.List) do
  local unlocked = data.Zones[zone.Id] == true
		local props = { Name = zone.Id, Title = zone.Name, Icon = zone.Icon, Color = zone.Color }
		if unlocked then
			props.Detail = "REWARDS x" .. zone.RewardMultiplier
			props.Action = "TRAVEL"
			props.Variant = "Accent"
			props.OnClick = function()
				self:Go(zone.Id)
			end
		else
			local ok, reason = Formulas.CanUnlockZone(zone.Id, data)
			props.Detail = "COST " .. Format.Number(zone.UnlockCost) .. " CASH" .. (zone.RequiredRebirths > 0 and (" | " .. zone.RequiredRebirths .. " REBIRTHS") or "") .. " | x" .. zone.RewardMultiplier
			props.Action = ok and "UNLOCK" or "LOCKED"
			props.Variant = ok and "Primary" or "Disabled"
			props.OnClick = function()
				self.Controllers.PanelController:Open("ZoneUnlock", zone.Id)
			end
			if not ok and reason then
				props.Detail = props.Detail .. "\n" .. string.upper(reason)
			end
		end
		zoneRow(content, 1 + zone.Order, props)
	end
	local vip = ZoneConfig.VIP
	zoneRow(content, 20, {
		Name = "VIP",
		Title = vip.Name,
		Icon = vip.Icon,
		Color = vip.Color,
		Detail = vip.Description,
		Action = passes[vip.RequiredPass] and "TRAVEL" or "VIP PASS",
		Variant = passes[vip.RequiredPass] and "Accent" or "Robux",
		OnClick = function()
			if passes[vip.RequiredPass] then
				self:Go("VIP")
			else
				self.Controllers.PanelController:Open("Shop", vip.RequiredPass)
			end
		end,
	})
end

function TravelController:RefreshModal()
	local data = self.Controllers.DataController:GetAll()
	local zone = modalZone and ZoneConfig.ById[modalZone]
	if not data or not zone or not zone.Order then
		return
	end
	local content = modal.Content
	UIKit.SetIcon(content.ZoneIcon, zone.Icon)
	content.ZoneName.Text = zone.Name
	content.ZoneName.TextColor3 = zone.Color
	content.Description.Text = zone.Description
	content.Multiplier.Text = "REWARDS x" .. zone.RewardMultiplier
	modal.Window.Header.AccentBar.BackgroundColor3 = zone.Color
	local ok, reason = Formulas.CanUnlockZone(zone.Id, data)
	content.Requirement.Text = ok and "" or string.upper(reason or "")
	local button = modal.Footer.Unlock
	button.Text = "UNLOCK  " .. Format.Number(zone.UnlockCost) .. " CASH"
	Widgets.SetVariant(button, ok and "Primary" or "Disabled")
end

return TravelController

local PhysicsService = game:GetService("PhysicsService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local CHARACTER_GROUP = "Characters"
local DEBRIS_GROUP = "Debris"
local ORB_GROUP = "Orbs"

local WorldService = { Priority = 3 }

local function register(name)
	if not PhysicsService:IsCollisionGroupRegistered(name) then
		PhysicsService:RegisterCollisionGroup(name)
	end
end

local function assignCharacter(character)
	for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			part.CollisionGroup = CHARACTER_GROUP
		end
	end
	character.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(part)
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			part.CollisionGroup = CHARACTER_GROUP
		end
	end)
end

function WorldService:Init()
	for _, name in ipairs({ CHARACTER_GROUP, DEBRIS_GROUP, ORB_GROUP }) do
		register(name)
	end
	PhysicsService:CollisionGroupSetCollidable(DEBRIS_GROUP, CHARACTER_GROUP, false)
	PhysicsService:CollisionGroupSetCollidable(DEBRIS_GROUP, DEBRIS_GROUP, false)
	PhysicsService:CollisionGroupSetCollidable(ORB_GROUP, CHARACTER_GROUP, false)
	PhysicsService:CollisionGroupSetCollidable(ORB_GROUP, DEBRIS_GROUP, false)
	PhysicsService:CollisionGroupSetCollidable(ORB_GROUP, ORB_GROUP, false)
	PhysicsService:CollisionGroupSetCollidable(CHARACTER_GROUP, CHARACTER_GROUP, false)
end

function WorldService:Start()
	local function hook(player)
		if player.Character then
			assignCharacter(player.Character)
		end
		player.CharacterAdded:Connect(assignCharacter)
	end
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(hook)
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		hook(player)
	end
end

return WorldService

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local LeaderboardConfig = require(Shared.Config.LeaderboardConfig)
local Format = require(Shared.Modules.Format)
local Net = require(Shared.Modules.Net)
local Podium = require(script.Podium)

local LOG_SCALE = 1e13

local LeaderboardService = { Priority = 70 }

local stores = {}
local names = {}
local online = true
local snapshot = {}
local syncRemote = nil

local function encode(board, value)
	value = math.max(tonumber(value) or 0, 0)
	if board.Encoding == "Log" then
		return math.floor(math.log10(value + 1) * LOG_SCALE)
	end
	return math.floor(value)
end

local function decode(board, stored)
	if board.Encoding == "Log" then
		return math.max(10 ^ (stored / LOG_SCALE) - 1, 0)
	end
	return stored
end

local function nameFor(userId)
	if names[userId] then
		return names[userId]
	end
	local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
	if player then
		names[userId] = player.DisplayName
		return names[userId]
	end
	local ok, name = pcall(Players.GetNameFromUserIdAsync, Players, userId)
	names[userId] = ok and name or "Wrecker"
	return names[userId]
end

local function boardScreen(board)
	local hall = workspace:FindFirstChild("Leaderboards") and workspace.Leaderboards:FindFirstChild("HallOfWreckers")
	local boards = hall and hall:FindFirstChild("Boards")
	local model = boards and boards:FindFirstChild("Board_" .. board.Id)
	local screen = model and model:FindFirstChild("Screen", true)
	return screen and screen:FindFirstChild("Board")
end

local function render(board, rows)
	local gui = boardScreen(board)
	if not gui then
		return
	end
	local title = gui:FindFirstChild("Title", true)
	if title then
		title.Text = board.Name
	end
	local list = gui:FindFirstChild("List", true)
	if not list then
		return
	end
	for index = 1, LeaderboardConfig.Size do
		local row = list:FindFirstChild("Row" .. index)
		if row then
			local entry = rows[index]
			row.Rank.Text = "#" .. index
			row.PlayerName.Text = entry and entry.Name or "---"
			row.Value.Text = entry and Format.Number(entry.Value) or ""
		end
	end
end

function LeaderboardService:Init(services)
	self.Services = services
	self.Data = services.DataService
	for _, board in ipairs(LeaderboardConfig.Boards) do
		local ok, store = pcall(DataStoreService.GetOrderedDataStore, DataStoreService, LeaderboardConfig.StorePrefix .. board.Id)
		if ok then
			stores[board.Id] = store
		else
			online = false
		end
	end
	self.Data.ProfileReleasing:Connect(function(player, data)
		task.spawn(self.Push, self, player, data)
	end)
end

function LeaderboardService:Start()
	syncRemote = Net.Remote("LeaderboardSync")
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
		task.delay(6, function()
			if player.Parent and next(snapshot) then
				syncRemote:FireClient(player, snapshot)
			end
		end)
	end)
	task.spawn(function()
		task.wait(5)
		while true do
			self:Refresh()
			task.wait(LeaderboardConfig.RefreshInterval)
		end
	end)
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(LeaderboardConfig.PushInterval)
			for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				local data = self.Data:GetData(player)
				if data then
					self:Push(player, data)
					task.wait(0.5)
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

function LeaderboardService:Push(player, data)
	if not online or self.Data:GetSession(player, "NoSave") then
		return
	end
	for _, board in ipairs(LeaderboardConfig.Boards) do
		local store = stores[board.Id]
		if store then
			local ok = pcall(store.SetAsync, store, tostring(player.UserId), encode(board, data[board.Stat]))
			if not ok then
				-- Retry on the next scheduled push after transient service failures.
				return
			end
		end
	end
end

function LeaderboardService:Fetch(board)
	local store = stores[board.Id]
	if online and store then
		local ok, pages = pcall(store.GetSortedAsync, store, false, LeaderboardConfig.Size)
		if not ok and string.find(tostring(pages), "Studio") then
			online = false
		end
		if ok then
			local rows = {}
			for _, item in ipairs(pages:GetCurrentPage()) do
				local userId = tonumber(item.key)
				if userId then
					table.insert(rows, { UserId = userId, Name = nameFor(userId), Value = decode(board, item.value) })
				end
			end
			if #rows > 0 then
				return rows
			end
		end
	end
	local rows = {}
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local data = self.Data:GetData(player)
		if data then
			table.insert(rows, { UserId = player.UserId, Name = player.DisplayName, Value = tonumber(data[board.Stat]) or 0 })
		end
	end
	table.sort(rows, function(a, b)
		return a.Value > b.Value
	end)
	return rows
end

function LeaderboardService:Refresh()
	local fresh = {}
	for _, board in ipairs(LeaderboardConfig.Boards) do
		local rows = self:Fetch(board)
		render(board, rows)
		local packed = {}
		for index = 1, math.min(#rows, LeaderboardConfig.Size) do
			packed[index] = { UserId = rows[index].UserId, Name = rows[index].Name, Value = rows[index].Value }
		end
		fresh[board.Id] = packed
		if board.Id == LeaderboardConfig.PodiumBoard then
			task.spawn(Podium.Update, rows)
		end
	end
	snapshot = fresh
	if syncRemote then
		syncRemote:FireAllClients(snapshot)
	end
end

return LeaderboardService

local FILL_TWEEN = TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

local currentEvent = nil

local function bestTitle(data, passes)
	if data.SelectedTitle and data.SelectedTitle ~= "" and data.Titles[data.SelectedTitle] then
		return TitleConfig.ById[data.SelectedTitle]
	end
	local best = TitleConfig.List[1]
	for _, title in ipairs(TitleConfig.List) do
		if data.Titles and data.Titles[title.Id] and title.Order > best.Order then
			best = title
		end
	end
	return best
end

local function setDot(name, visible)
	local button = navButtons[name]
	if button then
		button.Dot.Visible = visible
	end
	local more = navButtons.More
	if more then
		local pending = false
		for _, info in ipairs(Layout.Menu) do
			local secondary = navButtons[info.Name]
			if not info.Primary and secondary and secondary.Dot.Visible then
				pending = true
				break
			end
		end
		more.Dot.Visible = pending
	end
end

function HudController:Init(controllers)

end

function HudController:Start()

		moreGrid.FillDirectionMaxCells = compact and 3 or 2

	arrangeMore()
	if camera then
		camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(arrangeMore)
	end

			button.Parent = moreWindow.Content
			button.Visible = true
			button.Glyph.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(36, 36)
			button.Glyph.Position = UDim2.new(0, 26, 0.5, 0)
			button.Caption.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(52, 0)
			button.Caption.Size = UDim2.new(1, -62, 1, 0)
			button.Caption.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		end
		UIKit.Button(button, function()
			if info.Name == "Chat" then
				controllers.PanelController:Close("More")
				controllers.CoreUiController:OpenChat()
			else
				controllers.PanelController:Toggle(info.Name)
			end
		end)
	end
	UIKit.Button(gui.TopBar.RebirthGoal.Hit, function()
		controllers.PanelController:Open(gui.TopBar.RebirthGoal:GetAttribute("Panel") or "Rebirth", gui.TopBar.RebirthGoal:GetAttribute("Argument"))
	end)

	UIKit.Button(gui.TopBar.Currencies.Scrap.Hit, function()
		controllers.PanelController:Open("Upgrades", "Scrap")
	end)

	local wreck = gui.WreckButton
	wreck.InputBegan:Connect(function(inputObject)
		if inputObject.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or inputObject.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			controllers.CombatController:SetHolding(true, "Auto")
		end
	end)
	wreck.InputEnded:Connect(function(inputObject)
		if inputObject.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or inputObject.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			controllers.CombatController:SetHolding(false, "Auto")
		end
	end)
	controllers.CombatController.Attacked:Connect(function()
		UIKit.Pop(gui.WreckButton.Glyph, 1.25)
	end)

	local profile = gui.ProfileCard
	profile.PlayerName.Text = player.DisplayName
	task.spawn(function()
		local ok, image = pcall(Players.GetUserThumbnailAsync, Players, player.UserId, Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot, Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size100x100)
		if ok then
			profile.Avatar.Image = image
		end
	end)

	for _, key in ipairs({ "Cash", "Scrap", "Cores" }) do
		local counter = Instance.new("NumberValue")
		counter.Name = key .. "Counter"
		counters[key] = counter
		counter.Changed:Connect(function()
			self:RenderCurrency(key)
		end)
	end

	dataController:Observe("Cash", function(value)
		self:SetCurrency("Cash", value)
		self:RefreshProgress()
	end)
	dataController:Observe("Scrap", function(value)
		self:SetCurrency("Scrap", value)
		self:RefreshDots()
	end)
	dataController:Observe("ChaosCores", function(value)
		self:SetCurrency("Cores", value)
	end)
	dataController:ObserveSession("Stats", function()
		self:RenderCurrency("Scrap")
	end)
	for _, key in ipairs({ "Level", "XP", "Titles", "SelectedTitle" }) do
		dataController:Observe(key, function()
			self:RefreshProfile()
		end)
	end
	dataController:ObserveSession("Passes", function()
		self:RefreshProfile()
	end)
	for _, key in ipairs({ "Rebirths", "Upgrades", "Tools", "Zones", "QuestProgress", "DailyReward" }) do
		dataController:Observe(key, function()
			self:RefreshProgress()
		end)
	end
	dataController:Observe("Boosts", function(boosts)
		self:RefreshBoosts(boosts or {})
	end)

	local state = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameState")
	for _, attribute in ipairs({ "ChaosPoints", "ChaosGoal", "ChaosState", "StateEndsAt", "MegaChaos", "ActiveEvent", "ActiveEventEndsAt", "ActiveEventZone" }) do
		state:GetAttributeChangedSignal(attribute):Connect(function()
			self:RefreshChaos(state)
			task.defer(self.RefreshEvent, self, state)
		end)
	end
	self:RefreshChaos(state)
	self:RefreshEvent(state)

	Net.Remote("EventAnnounce").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(payload)
		if type(payload) == "table" then
			self:Announce(payload)
		end
	end)

	local elapsed = 0
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
		local charge = gui.WreckButton.Charge
		local progress = controllers.CombatController:GetCooldownProgress()
		charge.Size = UDim2.fromScale(progress, progress)
		charge.BackgroundTransparency = progress >= 1 and 0.75 or 0.35
		local flow = gui.ChaosMeter.Tube.Fill.Flow
		flow.Offset = (controllers.DataController:Get("Settings")or {}).LowEffects and Vector2.zero or Vector2.new(0,math.sin(os.clock()*2)*.15)
		elapsed += deltaTime
		if elapsed >= 0.25 then
			elapsed = 0
			self:Tick(state)
		end
	end)
end

function HudController:SetCurrency(key, value)
	value = tonumber(value) or 0
	local counter = counters[key]
	local previous = counter:GetAttribute("Target") or 0
	counter:SetAttribute("Target", value)
	if value > previous and previous > 0 then
		local chip = gui.TopBar.Currencies[key]
		local delta = chip.Delta
		delta.Text = "+" .. Format.Number(value - previous)
		delta.TextTransparency = 0
		delta.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 2)
		TweenService:Create(delta, TweenInfo.new(0.8, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { TextTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 14) }):Play()
		UIKit.Pop(chip.Value, 1.15)
	end
	TweenService:Create(counter, COUNT_TWEEN, { Value = value }):Play()
end

function HudController:RenderCurrency(key)
	local counter = counters[key]
	local chip = gui.TopBar.Currencies[key]
	if key == "Scrap" then
		local stats = self.Controllers.DataController:GetStats()
		local capacity = stats.Capacity or 500
		local full = (counter:GetAttribute("Target") or 0) >= capacity
		chip.Value.Text = Format.Number(counter.Value) .. " / " .. Format.Number(capacity)
		chip.Value.TextColor3 = full and Colors.Red or Colors.White
		chip.FullBadge.Visible = full
		if full and not scrapFull then
			UIKit.Pop(chip.FullBadge, 1.4)
		end
		scrapFull = full
	else
		chip.Value.Text = Format.Smart(math.floor(counter.Value))
	end
end

function HudController:RefreshProfile()
	local dataController = self.Controllers.DataController
	local data = dataController:GetAll()
	if not data then
		return
	end
	local profile = gui.ProfileCard
	profile.LevelBadge.Value.Text = "LV " .. data.Level
	local title = bestTitle(data, dataController:GetSession("Passes") or {})
	local passes = dataController:GetSession("Passes") or {}
	profile.Title.Text = title.Name .. (passes.VIPWrecker and "  |  VIP" or "")
	profile.Title.TextColor3 = title.Color
	Widgets.SetProgress(profile.XpBar, data.XP / Formulas.XpForLevel(data.Level), true)
end

function HudController:RefreshProgress()
	local data = self.Controllers.DataController:GetAll()
	if not data then
		return
	end
	local cost = Formulas.RebirthCost(data.Rebirths)
	local objective = "REBIRTH"
	local destination = "REBIRTH"
	if data.Rebirths == 0 then
		if (data.Upgrades.Damage or 0) == 0 then
			cost, objective, destination = Formulas.UpgradePrice("Damage", 0), "DAMAGE", "UPGRADES"
		elseif not data.Zones.Downtown then
			cost, objective, destination = ZoneConfig.ById.Downtown.UnlockCost, "DOWNTOWN", "ZONES"
		elseif not data.Tools.PowerHammer then
			cost, objective, destination = ToolConfig.ById.PowerHammer.Price, "POWER HAMMER", "TOOLS"
		end
	end
	local ratio = math.clamp(data.Cash / cost, 0, 1)
	local goal = gui.TopBar.RebirthGoal
	local destinations = { REBIRTH = "Rebirth", UPGRADES = "Upgrades", ZONES = "Travel", TOOLS = "Tools" }
	goal:SetAttribute("Panel", destinations[destination])
	goal:SetAttribute("Argument", destination == "UPGRADES" and "Damage" or nil)
	Widgets.SetProgress(goal.Bar, ratio, true)
	if ratio >= 1 then
		goal.Caption.Text = objective .. " READY!  > " .. destination
		goal.Caption.TextColor3 = Colors.Yellow
	else
		goal.Caption.Text = "NEXT: " .. objective .. "  " .. Format.Number(data.Cash) .. "/" .. Format.Number(cost)
		goal.Caption.TextColor3 = Colors.White
	end
	self:RefreshDots()
end

function HudController:RefreshDots()
	local data = self.Controllers.DataController:GetAll()
	if not data then
		return
	end
	setDot("Rebirth", data.Cash >= Formulas.RebirthCost(data.Rebirths))

	local affordable = false
	for _, upgrade in ipairs(UpgradeConfig.List) do
		local level = data.Upgrades[upgrade.Id] or 0
		local balance = upgrade.Currency == "Scrap" and data.Scrap or data.Cash
		if level < upgrade.MaxLevel and Formulas.UpgradePrice(upgrade.Id, level) <= balance then
			affordable = true
			break
		end
	end
	setDot("Upgrades", affordable)

	local toolReady = false
	for _, tool in ipairs(ToolConfig.List) do
		if not tool.Premium and not tool.OwnerOnly and not data.Tools[tool.Id] and data.Rebirths >= tool.RequiredRebirths and data.Cash >= tool.Price then
			toolReady = true
			break
		end
	end
	for _, skin in ipairs(ToolConfig.Skins) do
		if skin.Source == "Scrap" and not data.Skins[skin.Id] and data.Scrap >= skin.Price then
			toolReady = true
			break
		end
	end
	setDot("Tools", toolReady)

	local claimable = false
	for _, progress in pairs(data.QuestProgress or {}) do
		if not progress.Completed and (progress.Progress or 0) >= (progress.Target or math.huge) then
			claimable = true
			break
		end
	end
	setDot("Quests", claimable)

	local last = data.DailyReward and data.DailyReward.LastClaim or 0
	setDot("Daily", last == 0 or os.time() - last >= DailyRewardConfig.Cooldown)
end

function HudController:RefreshBoosts(boosts)
	local row = gui.TopBar.Boosts
	Widgets.Clear(row)
	table.clear(boostClock)
	local order = 0
	for boostId, seconds in pairs(boosts) do
		local boost = GameConfig.Boosts[boostId]
		if boost and seconds > 0 then
			order += 1
			local chip = Widgets.Chip(row, { Name = boostId, Icon = boost.Icon, Text = boost.Name, Color = boost.Color, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(170, 28), Order = order, MaxSize = 16 })
			boostClock[boostId] = { Chip = chip, Ends = os.clock() + seconds, Name = boost.Name }
		end
	end
end

function HudController:RefreshChaos(state)
	local meter = gui.ChaosMeter
	local mode = state:GetAttribute("ChaosState") or "Building"
	local points = state:GetAttribute("ChaosPoints") or 0
	local goal = math.max(state:GetAttribute("ChaosGoal") or 1, 1)
	local ratio = mode == "Building" and math.clamp(points / goal, 0, 1) or 1
	TweenService:Create(meter.Tube.Fill, FILL_TWEEN, { Size = UDim2.fromScale(ratio, 1) }):Play()
	if mode == "Building" then
		meter.Percent.Text = math.floor(ratio * 100) .. "%"
		meter.State.Text = ratio >= 0.85 and "ALMOST!" or ""
	elseif mode == "ChaosEvent" then
		meter.State.Text = state:GetAttribute("MegaChaos") and "MEGA CHAOS" or "CHAOS EVENT"
	else
		meter.Percent.Text = "100%"
		meter.State.Text = "TOTAL WRECK"
	end
end

function HudController:RefreshEvent(state)
	local mode = state:GetAttribute("ChaosState")
	local payload
	if mode == "ChaosEvent" or mode == "TotalWreck" then
		payload = {
			Id = mode == "ChaosEvent" and "Chaos" or "TotalWreck",
			Name = mode == "TotalWreck" and "TOTAL WRECK" or (state:GetAttribute("MegaChaos") and "MEGA CHAOS" or "CHAOS EVENT"),
			Description = mode == "TotalWreck" and "City resetting. Your next run starts soon!" or "Smash targets in your zone. Bonus Cash, Scrap and Damage!",
			EndsAt = state:GetAttribute("StateEndsAt"), Color = Colors.Purple, Icon = "EventChaos",
		}
	else
		local id = state:GetAttribute("ActiveEvent")
		for _, event in ipairs(EventConfig.Random.List) do
			if event.Id == id then
				payload = { Id = id, Name = event.Name, Description = event.Description, Color = event.Color, Icon = event.Icon, Zone = state:GetAttribute("ActiveEventZone"), EndsAt = state:GetAttribute("ActiveEventEndsAt") }
				break
			end
		end
	end
	if payload and (payload.EndsAt or 0) > workspace:GetServerTimeNow() then
		local signature = payload.Id .. ":" .. tostring(payload.EndsAt) .. ":" .. tostring(payload.Zone) .. ":" .. payload.Name
		if not currentEvent or currentEvent.Signature ~= signature then
			payload.StateSnapshot = true
			self:Announce(payload)
			currentEvent.Signature = signature
		end
	elseif currentEvent and currentEvent.StateSnapshot then
		currentEvent = nil
		gui.EventBanner.Visible = false
	end
end

function HudController:Announce(payload)
	local banner = gui.EventBanner
	if payload.Phase == "End" then
		if currentEvent and currentEvent.Id == payload.Id then
			currentEvent = nil
			banner.Visible = false
		end
		return
	end
	local duration = payload.EndsAt and math.max(0, payload.EndsAt - workspace:GetServerTimeNow()) or (payload.Duration or 10)
	currentEvent = { Id = payload.Id, Ends = os.clock() + duration, EndsAt = payload.EndsAt, StateSnapshot = payload.StateSnapshot }
	local color = payload.Color or Colors.Purple
	banner.EventName.Text = payload.Name or "EVENT"
	banner.EventName.TextColor3 = color
	local zone = payload.Zone and ZoneConfig.ById[payload.Zone]
	banner.EventDescription.Text = (zone and (zone.Name .. " - ") or "") .. (payload.Description or "")
	banner.Outline.Color = color
	banner.AccentStrip.BackgroundColor3 = color
	UIKit.SetIcon(banner.EventIcon, payload.Icon or "EventChaos", "!")
	banner.Visible = true
	if not payload.StateSnapshot then
		UIKit.Pop(banner.EventIcon, 1.4)
		self.Controllers.SoundController:Play("ChaosAlarm", { Volume = 0.5 })
	end
end

function HudController:Tick(state)
	local now = os.clock()
	for boostId, clock in pairs(boostClock) do
		local remaining = clock.Ends - now
		if clock.Chip.Parent then
			clock.Chip.Value.Text = clock.Name .. " " .. Format.Time(remaining)
		end
		if remaining <= 0 then
			boostClock[boostId] = nil
			clock.Chip:Destroy()
		end
	end
	if currentEvent then
		local remaining = if currentEvent.EndsAt then currentEvent.EndsAt - workspace:GetServerTimeNow() else currentEvent.Ends - now
		gui.EventBanner.Countdown.Text = Format.Time(remaining)
		if remaining <= -1 then
			currentEvent = nil
			gui.EventBanner.Visible = false
			self:RefreshEvent(state)
		end
	end
	if state:GetAttribute("ChaosState") == "ChaosEvent" then
		local remaining = (state:GetAttribute("StateEndsAt") or 0) - workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
		gui.ChaosMeter.Percent.Text = Format.Time(remaining)
	end
end

return HudController

StarterPlayer.StarterPlayerScripts.Contr.source:
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local ThemeConfig = require(Shared.Config.ThemeConfig)
local GamepassConfig = require(Shared.Config.GamepassConfig)
local ProductConfig = require(Shared.Config.ProductConfig)
local Formulas = require(Shared.Modules.Formulas)
local Format = require(Shared.Modules.Format)
local Net = require(Shared.Modules.Net)
local Components = script.Parent.Parent:WaitForChild("Components")
local UIKit = require(Components.UIKit)
local Widgets = require(Components.Widgets)

local Colors = ThemeConfig.Colors
local Fonts = ThemeConfig.Fonts
local TABS = { "Popular", "Passes", "Boosts", "Cash" }

local ShopController = { Priority = 44 }

local window = nil
local tab = "Popular"
local highlight = nil
local storeInfo = nil

local function price(key)
	local value = storeInfo and storeInfo:GetAttribute(key .. "_Price")
	local available = storeInfo and storeInfo:GetAttribute(key .. "_Available")
	return value, available == true
end

local function tabFor(key)
	if GamepassConfig.ByKey[key] then
		return "Passes"
	end
	local product = ProductConfig.ByKey[key]
	if product then
		return product.Category == "Cash" and "Cash" or product.Category == "Popular" and "Popular" or "Boosts"
	end
	return nil
end

local function card(name, order, accent)
	local frame = Widgets.Card(window.Content, { Name = name, Order = order, StrokeColor = accent })
	frame.ClipsDescendants = true
	local glow = UIKit.Create("Frame", { Name = "Glow", BackgroundColor3 = accent, BackgroundTransparency = 0.82, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 96), Parent = frame })
	UIKit.Create("UIGradient", { Rotation = 90, Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0, 1), Parent = glow })
	if highlight == name then
		frame.Outline.Thickness = 4
		frame.Outline.Color = Colors.Yellow
		UIKit.Pop(frame, 1.06)
	end
	return frame
end

local function fill(frame, icon, title, body, accent)
	Widgets.Icon(frame, icon, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(84, 84), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 10), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), FallbackColor = accent })
	Widgets.Label(frame, { Name = "ItemName", Text = title, Font = Fonts.Display, Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 26), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 98), AlignX = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, MaxSize = 22, Color = accent })
	Widgets.Label(frame, { Name = "Benefit", Text = body, Font = Fonts.Body, Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 56), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 126), AlignX = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, AlignY = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, MaxSize = 14, Color = Colors.White })
end

local function buyButton(frame, props)
	props.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 40)
	props.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 1, -50)
	return Widgets.Button(frame, props)
end

function ShopController:Init(controllers)
	self.Controllers = controllers
end

function ShopController:Start()
	local controllers = self.Controllers
	storeInfo = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("StoreInfo", 10)
	window = Widgets.Window("ShopUI", { Title = "SHOP", Accent = Colors.Yellow, Tabs = true })
	local grid = Widgets.Grid(window.Content, UDim2.new(0.5, -8, 0, 236), 12)
	grid.FillDirectionMaxCells = 2
	for index, name in ipairs(TABS) do
		Widgets.Tab(window.Tabs, { Name = name .. "Tab", Text = string.upper(name), Order = index, Width = 140, OnClick = function()
			tab = name
			highlight = nil
			self:Refresh()
		end })
	end
	controllers.PanelController:Register("Shop", window.Gui, {
		OnOpen = function(arg)
			highlight = type(arg) == "string" and arg or nil
			tab = (highlight and tabFor(highlight)) or tab
			self:Refresh()
		end,
	})
	for _, key in ipairs({ "Cash", "Tools", "Rebirths", "Zones", "Purchases" }) do
		controllers.DataController:Observe(key, function()
			if controllers.PanelController:IsOpen("Shop") then
				self:Refresh()
			end
		end)
	end
	controllers.DataController:ObserveSession("Passes", function()
		if controllers.PanelController:IsOpen("Shop") then
			self:Refresh()
		end
	end)
end

function ShopController:AddPass(pass, order, passes)
	if not select(2, price(pass.Key)) then
		return
	end
	local frame = card(pass.Key, order, Colors.Yellow)
	fill(frame, pass.Icon, pass.Name, pass.Description, Colors.Yellow)
	local cost, available = price(pass.Key)
	if passes[pass.Key] then
		buyButton(frame, { Name = "Buy", Text = "OWNED", Variant = "Disabled" })
	elseif not available then
		buyButton(frame, { Name = "Buy", Text = "COMING SOON", Variant = "Disabled" })
	else
		buyButton(frame, { Name = "Buy", Text = "R$ " .. tostring(cost), Variant = "Robux", OnClick = function()
			Net.Remote("RequestPurchase"):FireServer("Pass", pass.Key)
		end })
	end
end

function ShopController:AddProduct(product, order, data)
	if not select(2, price(product.Key)) then
		return
	end
	local accent = product.Kind == "Cash" and Colors.Cash or product.Kind == "StarterPack" and Colors.Orange or Colors.Purple
	local frame = card(product.Key, order, accent)
	local body = product.Description
	if product.Kind == "Cash" then
		body = "YOU GET " .. Format.Commas(Formulas.CashPackAmount(product, data)) .. " CASH\n(scales with your best zone and rebirths)"
	end
	fill(frame, product.Icon, product.Name, body, accent)
	local cost, available = price(product.Key)
	if product.OneTime and data.Purchases and data.Purchases[product.Key] then
		buyButton(frame, { Name = "Buy", Text = "OWNED", Variant = "Disabled" })
	elseif not available then
		buyButton(frame, { Name = "Buy", Text = "COMING SOON", Variant = "Disabled" })
	else
		buyButton(frame, { Name = "Buy", Text = "R$ " .. tostring(cost), Variant = "Robux", OnClick = function()
			Net.Remote("RequestPurchase"):FireServer("Product", product.Key)
		end })
	end
end

function ShopController:Refresh()
	local dataController = self.Controllers.DataController
	local data = dataController:GetAll()
	if not data then
		return
	end
	local passes = dataController:GetSession("Passes") or {}
	Widgets.Clear(window.Content)
	for _, button in ipairs(window.Tabs:GetChildren()) do
		if button:IsA("TextButton") then
			Widgets.SetVariant(button, button.Name == tab .. "Tab" and "Primary" or "Secondary")
		end
	end
	local order = 0
	local function nextOrder()
		order += 1
		return order
	end
	if tab == "Popular" then
		local starter = ProductConfig.ByKey.StarterPack
		if starter and not data.Purchases.StarterPack then
			self:AddProduct(starter, nextOrder(), data)
		end
		for _, pass in ipairs(GamepassConfig.List) do
			if pass.Popular then
				self:AddPass(pass, nextOrder(), passes)
			end
		end
		for _, product in ipairs(ProductConfig.List) do
			if product.Popular and product.Kind ~= "StarterPack" then
				self:AddProduct(product, nextOrder(), data)
			end
		end
	elseif tab == "Passes" then
		for _, pass in ipairs(GamepassConfig.List) do
			self:AddPass(pass, nextOrder(), passes)
		end
	else
		for _, product in ipairs(ProductConfig.List) do
			if product.Category == tab then
				self:AddProduct(product, nextOrder(), data)
			end
		end
	end
end

return ShopController

local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local ToolConfig = require(Shared.Config.ToolConfig)
local AnimationConfig = require(Shared.Config.AnimationConfig)
local DestructibleConfig = require(Shared.Config.DestructibleConfig)
local Formulas = require(Shared.Modules.Formulas)
local Signal = require(Shared.Modules.Signal)
local Net = require(Shared.Modules.Net)

local SLASH_R6 = "rbxassetid://129967390"
local MAX_SWING_SPEED = 2.4
local TAG = "Destructible"
local POINTER_RANGE = 450
local FACING_BIAS = 5
local LOCK_WARNING_COOLDOWN = 3

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local CombatController = { Priority = 20 }
CombatController.Attacked = Signal.new()
CombatController.HitConfirmed = Signal.new()

local lastAttack = 0
local holding = false
local holdSource = "Auto"
local tracks = {}
local holdTrack = nil
local holdName = nil
local attackTrack = nil
local swingIndex = 0
local boxCache = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local attackRemote = nil
local lastLockWarning = 0

local function equippedTool()
	local character = player.Character
	local tool = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
	if tool and tool:GetAttribute("ToolId") then
		return tool
	end
	return nil
end

local function characterAnimator()
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local animator = humanoid and humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
	return humanoid, animator
end

local function loadTrack(animator, key, animationId, priority)
	local cached = tracks[key]
	if cached then
		return cached
	end
	local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
	animation.Name = key
	animation.AnimationId = animationId
	local ok, loaded = pcall(animator.LoadAnimation, animator, animation)
	animation:Destroy()
	if not ok then
		return nil
	end
	loaded.Priority = priority
	tracks[key] = loaded
	return loaded
end

local function boundsOf(model)
	local cached = boxCache[model]
	if not cached then
		local cframe, size = model:GetBoundingBox()
		cached = { CFrame = cframe, Size = size }
		boxCache[model] = cached
	end
	return cached.CFrame, cached.Size
end

local function boxDistance(model, point)
	local cframe, size = boundsOf(model)
	local localPoint = cframe:PointToObjectSpace(point)
	local half = size / 2
	local dx = math.max(math.abs(localPoint.X) - half.X, 0)
	local dy = math.max(math.abs(localPoint.Y) - half.Y, 0)
	local dz = math.max(math.abs(localPoint.Z) - half.Z, 0)
	return math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz)
end

local function destructibleFrom(instance)
	while instance and instance ~= workspace do
		if instance:IsA("Model") and instance:GetAttribute("Uid") then
			return instance
		end
		instance = instance.Parent
	end
	return nil
end

local function isAlive(model)
	return model:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and model:GetAttribute("Alive") ~= false and model:GetAttribute("Invulnerable")~=true and model:GetAttribute("Uid") ~= nil
end

function CombatController:Init(controllers)
	self.Controllers = controllers
end

function CombatController:Start()
	attackRemote = Net.Remote("Attack")

	local function hookTool(tool)
		if not tool:IsA("Tool") or tool:GetAttribute("Hooked") then
			return
		end
		tool:SetAttribute("Hooked", true)
		tool.Activated:Connect(function()
			self:SetHolding(true, "Pointer")
		end)
		tool.Deactivated:Connect(function()
			self:SetHolding(false, "Pointer")
		end)
		tool.Unequipped:Connect(function()
			holding = false
		end)
	end

	local function hookCharacter(character)
		tracks = {}
		holdTrack = nil
		holdName = nil
		attackTrack = nil
		holding = false
		for _, child in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
			hookTool(child)
		end
		character.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
			hookTool(child)
			if child:IsA("Tool") then
				self:RefreshHold()
			end
		end)
		character.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child)
			if child:IsA("Tool") then
				self:RefreshHold()
			end
		end)
		self:RefreshHold()
	end
	if player.Character then
		hookCharacter(player.Character)
	end
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(hookCharacter)

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if holding then
			self:Attack(holdSource)
		end
	end)
end

function CombatController:SetHolding(state, source)
	if state then
		holding = true
		holdSource = source or "Auto"
		self:Attack(holdSource)
	elseif holdSource == (source or holdSource) then
		holding = false
	end
end

function CombatController:GetCooldown(toolId)
	return Formulas.AttackCooldown(toolId, self.Controllers.DataController:GetStats())
end

function CombatController:GetCooldownProgress()
	local tool = equippedTool()
	if not tool then
		return 1
	end
	return math.clamp((os.clock() - lastAttack) / self:GetCooldown(tool:GetAttribute("ToolId")), 0, 1)
end

function CombatController:GetEquippedTool()
	return equippedTool()
end

function CombatController:IsLocked(model)
	local world = self.Controllers.WorldController
	return world ~= nil and world:LockedZoneFor(model) ~= nil
end

function CombatController:NearestTarget(origin, range, direction)
	local best, bestScore = nil, nil
	local blocked, blockedDistance = nil, nil
	for _, model in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged(TAG)) do
		if isAlive(model) then
			local distance = boxDistance(model, origin)
			if distance <= range then
				if self:IsLocked(model) then
					if not blockedDistance or distance < blockedDistance then
						blocked, blockedDistance = model, distance
					end
				else
					local score = distance
					if direction then
						local offset = boundsOf(model).Position - origin
						if offset.Magnitude > 0.01 then
							score -= offset.Unit:Dot(direction) * FACING_BIAS
						end
					end
					if not bestScore or score < bestScore then
						best, bestScore = model, score
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return best, blocked
end

function CombatController:WarnLocked(model)
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - lastLockWarning < LOCK_WARNING_COOLDOWN then
		return
	end
	lastLockWarning = now
	local world = self.Controllers.WorldController
	local zoneId = world:LockedZoneFor(model)
	if not zoneId then
		return
	end
	local def = DestructibleConfig.ById[model:GetAttribute("Type")]
	self.Controllers.NotificationController:Show({
		Kind = "Error",
		Text = (def and def.Name or "TARGET") .. " LOCKED",
		Subtext = world:LockText(zoneId),
		Icon = "IconLock",
	})
end

function CombatController:PointerHit()
	local mouse = player:GetMouse()
	local target = mouse.Target
	if not target then
		return nil, nil
	end
	return destructibleFrom(target), mouse.Hit.Position
end

function CombatController:ResolveTarget(def, root, source)
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local facing = camera and Vector3.new(camera.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, camera.CFrame.LookVector.Z)
	if facing and facing.Magnitude > 0.01 then
		facing = facing.Unit
	else
		facing = nil
	end
	local reach = def.Range + 1.5
	local origin = root.Position

	local pointed = nil
	if source == "Pointer" then
		local model, hitPosition = self:PointerHit()
		if model and isAlive(model) and boxDistance(model, origin) <= reach then
			if not self:IsLocked(model) then
				return model, hitPosition
			end
			pointed = model
		end
		if def.Kind ~= "Melee" and hitPosition and (hitPosition - origin).Magnitude <= reach and (hitPosition - origin).Magnitude <= POINTER_RANGE then
			local nearby, blocked = self:NearestTarget(hitPosition, def.Radius, nil)
			return nearby, hitPosition, if nearby then nil else pointed or blocked
		end
	end

	local model, blocked = self:NearestTarget(origin, reach, facing)
	if model then
		return model, boundsOf(model).Position
	end
	return nil, nil, pointed or blocked
end

function CombatController:GetPreviewTarget()
	local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local tool = equippedTool()
	local def = tool and ToolConfig.ById[tool:GetAttribute("ToolId")]
	if not root or not def then
		return nil
	end
	local source = holding and holdSource or (self.Controllers.InputController:IsTouch() and "Auto" or "Pointer")
	local target, _, blocked = self:ResolveTarget(def, root, source)
	return target or blocked
end

function CombatController:EquipBest()
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	if not humanoid or not backpack then
		return nil
	end
	local best, bestDamage = nil, -1
	local data = self.Controllers.DataController:GetAll() or {}
	for _, tool in ipairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
		local toolId = tool:IsA("Tool") and tool:GetAttribute("ToolId")
		if toolId then
			local damage = Formulas.ToolDamage(toolId, data)
			if damage > bestDamage then
				best, bestDamage = tool, damage
			end
		end
	end
	if best then
		humanoid:EquipTool(best)
	end
	return best
end

function CombatController:CycleTool(direction)
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	if not humanoid or not backpack then
		return
	end
	local tools = {}
	local current = equippedTool()
	if current then
		table.insert(tools, current)
	end
	for _, tool in ipairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
		if tool:IsA("Tool") and tool:GetAttribute("ToolId") then
			table.insert(tools, tool)
		end
	end
	if #tools == 0 then
		return
	end
	table.sort(tools, function(a, b)
		local left = ToolConfig.ById[a:GetAttribute("ToolId")]
		local right = ToolConfig.ById[b:GetAttribute("ToolId")]
		return (left and left.Order or 0) < (right and right.Order or 0)
	end)
	local index = current and table.find(tools, current) or 0
	local nextIndex = (index - 1 + direction) % #tools + 1
	humanoid:EquipTool(tools[nextIndex])
end

function CombatController:RefreshHold()
	local humanoid, animator = characterAnimator()
	local tool = equippedTool()
	local wanted = nil
	if tool and humanoid and humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then
		local def = ToolConfig.ById[tool:GetAttribute("ToolId")]
		local style = def and AnimationConfig.StyleFor(def.Id, def.Kind)
		if style then
			wanted = style.Hold
			if animator then
				for _, name in ipairs(style.Attacks) do
					loadTrack(animator, name, AnimationConfig.Ids[name], Enum.AnimationPriority.Action)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if wanted == holdName then
		return
	end
	if holdTrack then
		holdTrack:Stop(0.2)
		holdTrack = nil
	end
	holdName = wanted
	if wanted and animator then
		holdTrack = loadTrack(animator, wanted, AnimationConfig.Ids[wanted], Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement)
		if holdTrack then
			holdTrack:Play(0.2)
		end
	end
end

function CombatController:PlaySwing(def)
	local humanoid, animator = characterAnimator()
	if not animator then
		return
	end
	local cooldown = self:GetCooldown(def.Id)
	if humanoid.RigType ~= Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then
		if def.Kind == "Melee" then
			local track = loadTrack(animator, "LegacySlash", SLASH_R6, Enum.AnimationPriority.Action)
			if track then
				track:Play(0.06, 1, math.clamp(0.62 / cooldown, 0.9, 2.2))
			end
		end
		return
	end
	if attackTrack and attackTrack.IsPlaying and attackTrack.TimePosition < attackTrack.Length * 0.5 then
		return
	end
	local style = AnimationConfig.StyleFor(def.Id, def.Kind)
	swingIndex = swingIndex % #style.Attacks + 1
	local name = style.Attacks[swingIndex]
	local track = loadTrack(animator, name, AnimationConfig.Ids[name], Enum.AnimationPriority.Action)
	if not track then
		return
	end
	if attackTrack and attackTrack ~= track then
		attackTrack:Stop(0.08)
	end
	attackTrack = track
	local speed = if track.Length > cooldown then math.min(track.Length / cooldown, MAX_SWING_SPEED) else 1
	track:Play(0.06, 1, speed)
end

function CombatController:Attack(source)
	local panels = self.Controllers.PanelController
	if panels and panels:IsAnyOpen() then
		return false
	end
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not root then
		return false
	end
	local tool = equippedTool() or (source ~= "Pointer" and self:EquipBest())
	if not tool then
		return false
	end
	local toolId = tool:GetAttribute("ToolId")
	local def = ToolConfig.ById[toolId]
	if not def then
		return false
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - lastAttack < self:GetCooldown(toolId) then
		return false
	end
	local model, aimPosition, blocked = self:ResolveTarget(def, root, source)
	if blocked then
		self:WarnLocked(blocked)
	end
	if def.Kind == "Melee" and not model and source ~= "Pointer" then
		return false
	end
	lastAttack = now
	attackRemote:FireServer(model and model:GetAttribute("Uid") or nil, aimPosition)
	self:PlaySwing(def)
	local muzzle = tool:FindFirstChild("Muzzle", true)
	local from = if muzzle and muzzle:IsA("Attachment") then muzzle.WorldPosition else root.Position
	self.Attacked:Fire(toolId, model, aimPosition, from)
	return true
end

return CombatController

ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.Signal.source:
local Connection = {}
Connection.__index = Connection

function Connection:Disconnect()
	if not self.Connected then
		return
	end
	self.Connected = false
	local handlers = self._signal._handlers
	local index = table.find(handlers, self)
	if index then
		table.remove(handlers, index)
	end
end

local Signal = {}
Signal.__index = Signal

function Signal.new()
	return setmetatable({ _handlers = {} }, Signal)
end

function Signal:Connect(callback)
	local connection = setmetatable({ Connected = true, _callback = callback, _signal = self }, Connection)
	table.insert(self._handlers, connection)
	return connection
end

function Signal:Once(callback)
	local connection
	connection = self:Connect(function(...)
		connection:Disconnect()
		callback(...)
	end)
	return connection
end

function Signal:Fire(...)
	for _, connection in ipairs(table.clone(self._handlers)) do
		if connection.Connected then
			task.spawn(connection._callback, ...)
		end
	end
end

function Signal:Wait()
	local thread = coroutine.running()
	self:Once(function(...)
		task.spawn(thread, ...)
	end)
	return coroutine.yield()
end

function Signal:DisconnectAll()
	for _, connection in ipairs(table.clone(self._handlers)) do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
end

return Signal
