local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local ThemeConfig = require(Shared.Config.ThemeConfig)
local AssetConfig = require(Shared.Config.AssetConfig)
local UIKit = require(script.Parent.UIKit)

local Colors = ThemeConfig.Colors
local Fonts = ThemeConfig.Fonts
local create = UIKit.Create

local VARIANTS = {
	Primary = { Background = Colors.Yellow, Text = Colors.Black, Stroke = Color3.fromRGB(150, 110, 10) },
	Accent = { Background = Colors.Orange, Text = Colors.Black, Stroke = Color3.fromRGB(150, 60, 10) },
	Secondary = { Background = Colors.PanelLight, Text = Colors.White, Stroke = Colors.Stroke },
	Danger = { Background = Colors.Red, Text = Colors.Black, Stroke = Color3.fromRGB(140, 20, 20) },
	Chaos = { Background = Color3.fromRGB(126, 60, 194), Text = Colors.White, Stroke = Color3.fromRGB(80, 30, 140) },
	Scrap = { Background = Colors.Cyan, Text = Colors.Black, Stroke = Color3.fromRGB(10, 110, 130) },
	Robux = { Background = Color3.fromRGB(0, 176, 111), Text = Colors.Black, Stroke = Color3.fromRGB(0, 100, 62) },
	Disabled = { Background = Colors.Locked, Text = Colors.Muted, Stroke = Colors.Stroke },
}

local Widgets = {}

Widgets.Variants = VARIANTS

function Widgets.Corner(parent, radius)
	return create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = radius or ThemeConfig.Corner, Parent = parent })
end

function Widgets.Stroke(parent, color, thickness)
	return create("UIStroke", { Color = color or Colors.Stroke, Thickness = thickness or ThemeConfig.StrokeThickness, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border, Parent = parent })
end

function Widgets.Padding(parent, all)
	local value = UDim.new(0, all)
	return create("UIPadding", { PaddingTop = value, PaddingBottom = value, PaddingLeft = value, PaddingRight = value, Parent = parent })
end

function Widgets.Label(parent, props)
	local label = create("TextLabel", {
		Name = props.Name or "Label",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Text = props.Text or "",
		FontFace = props.Font or Fonts.Body,
		TextColor3 = props.Color or Colors.White,
		TextScaled = true,
		TextXAlignment = props.AlignX or Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextYAlignment = props.AlignY or Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
		Size = props.Size or UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24),
		Position = props.Position or UDim2.new(),
		AnchorPoint = props.AnchorPoint or Vector2.zero,
		LayoutOrder = props.Order or 0,
		RichText = props.Rich or false,
		TextWrapped = true,
		ZIndex = props.ZIndex or 1,
		Parent = parent,
	})
	create("UITextSizeConstraint", { MaxTextSize = props.MaxSize or 28, MinTextSize = props.MinSize or 8, Parent = label })
	if props.Stroke then
		create("UIStroke", { Color = Colors.Black, Thickness = props.Stroke, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Contextual, Parent = label })
	end
	return label
end

function Widgets.Icon(parent, key, props)
	props = props or {}
	local image = create("ImageLabel", {
		Name = props.Name or "Icon",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
		Size = props.Size or UDim2.fromOffset(40, 40),
		Position = props.Position or UDim2.new(),
		AnchorPoint = props.AnchorPoint or Vector2.zero,
		LayoutOrder = props.Order or 0,
		ZIndex = props.ZIndex or 1,
		Parent = parent,
	})
	UIKit.SetIcon(image, key, props.Fallback)
	local glyph = image:FindFirstChild("Fallback")
	if glyph and props.FallbackColor then
		glyph.TextColor3 = props.FallbackColor
	end
	return image
end

function Widgets.Button(parent, props)
	local variant = VARIANTS[props.Variant or "Primary"]
	local button = create("TextButton", {
		Name = props.Name or "Button",
		AutoButtonColor = false,
		BackgroundColor3 = variant.Background,
		Text = props.Text or "",
		FontFace = props.Font or Fonts.Display,
		TextColor3 = variant.Text,
		TextScaled = true,
		Size = props.Size or UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 44),
		Position = props.Position or UDim2.new(),
		AnchorPoint = props.AnchorPoint or Vector2.zero,
		LayoutOrder = props.Order or 0,
		ZIndex = props.ZIndex or 1,
		Parent = parent,
	})
	button:SetAttribute("Variant", props.Variant or "Primary")
	Widgets.Corner(button, props.Radius or UDim.new(0, 10))
	local stroke = Widgets.Stroke(button, variant.Stroke, 2)
	stroke.Name = "Edge"
	create("UIGradient", {
		Name = "Shade",
		Rotation = 90,
		Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)),
		Parent = button,
	})
	create("UITextSizeConstraint", { MaxTextSize = props.MaxSize or 24, MinTextSize = 8, Parent = button })
	create("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 8), PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 4), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 4), Parent = button })
	local gloss = AssetConfig.Image("ButtonTexture")
	if gloss then
		local sheen = create("ImageLabel", {
			Name = "Gloss",
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Image = gloss,
			ImageTransparency = 0.86,
			ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Stretch,
			Position = UDim2.new(0, -8, 0, -4),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 16, 0.55, 4),
			Parent = button,
		})
		Widgets.Corner(sheen, props.Radius or UDim.new(0, 10))
	end
	if props.OnClick then
		UIKit.Button(button, props.OnClick)
	end
	return button
end

function Widgets.SetVariant(button, variantName)
	local variant = VARIANTS[variantName] or VARIANTS.Primary
	button.BackgroundColor3 = variant.Background
	button.TextColor3 = variant.Text
	local edge = button:FindFirstChild("Edge")
	if edge then
		edge.Color = variant.Stroke
	end
	button:SetAttribute("Variant", variantName)
end

function Widgets.Card(parent, props)
	props = props or {}
	local card = create("Frame", {
		Name = props.Name or "Card",
		BackgroundColor3 = props.Color or Colors.Panel,
		Size = props.Size or UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 90),
		Position = props.Position or UDim2.new(),
		LayoutOrder = props.Order or 0,
		Parent = parent,
	})
	Widgets.Corner(card, UDim.new(0, 12))
	local stroke = Widgets.Stroke(card, props.StrokeColor or Colors.Stroke, 2)
	stroke.Name = "Outline"
	if props.Accent then
		local strip = create("Frame", {
			Name = "AccentStrip",
			BackgroundColor3 = props.Accent,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Size = UDim2.new(0, 5, 1, -16),
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 8),
			Parent = card,
		})
		Widgets.Corner(strip, UDim.new(0, 3))
	end
	return card
end

function Widgets.Progress(parent, props)
	local track = create("Frame", {
		Name = props.Name or "Progress",
		BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Black,
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.1,
		Size = props.Size or UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14),
		Position = props.Position or UDim2.new(),
		AnchorPoint = props.AnchorPoint or Vector2.zero,
		LayoutOrder = props.Order or 0,
		ClipsDescendants = true,
		Parent = parent,
	})
	Widgets.Corner(track, UDim.new(1, 0))
	Widgets.Stroke(track, Colors.Stroke, 1.5)
	local fill = create("Frame", {
		Name = "Fill",
		BackgroundColor3 = props.Color or Colors.Orange,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(props.Value or 0, 0, 1), 1),
		Parent = track,
	})
	Widgets.Corner(fill, UDim.new(1, 0))
	create("UIGradient", { Rotation = 90, Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.fromRGB(185, 185, 185)), Parent = fill })
	return track, fill
end

function Widgets.SetProgress(track, value, animate)
	local fill = track:FindFirstChild("Fill")
	if not fill then
		return
	end
	local size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(value, 0, 1), 1)
	if animate then
		UIKit.Tween(fill, ThemeConfig.Tween.Normal, { Size = size })
	else
		fill.Size = size
	end
end

function Widgets.List(parent, padding, direction)
	return create("UIListLayout", {
		Name = "Layout",
		Padding = UDim.new(0, padding or 10),
		FillDirection = direction or Enum.FillDirection.Vertical,
		SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,

	if camera then
		local connection = camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(arrangeWindow)
		gui.Destroying:Once(function() connection:Disconnect() end)
	end
	arrangeWindow()
	return { Gui = gui, Window = window, Header = header, Close = close, Tabs = tabs, Content = content, Footer = footer }

function Widgets.Tab(tabs, props)

		Order = props.Order,
		MaxSize = 18,
		OnClick = props.OnClick,
	})
	return button
end

local scaleTargets = {}
local viewportHooked = false

function Widgets.ViewportScale()
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local size = camera and camera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1366, 768)
	return math.clamp(math.min(size.X / 1366, size.Y / 768), 0.55, 1.15)
end

local function refreshScales()
	local value = Widgets.ViewportScale()
	for scale, factor in pairs(scaleTargets) do
		if scale.Parent then
			scale.Scale = value * factor
		else
			scaleTargets[scale] = nil
		end
	end
end

function Widgets.AutoScale(guiObject, factor)
	local scale = guiObject:FindFirstChild("ViewportScale") or create("UIScale", { Name = "ViewportScale", Parent = guiObject })
	scaleTargets[scale] = factor or 1
	if not viewportHooked then
		viewportHooked = true
		local function hookCamera()
			local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
			if camera then
				camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(refreshScales)
			end
			refreshScales()
		end
		workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(hookCamera)
		hookCamera()
	end
	scale.Scale = Widgets.ViewportScale() * (factor or 1)
	return scale
end

function Widgets.Chip(parent, props)
	local chip = create("Frame", {
		Name = props.Name or "Chip",

		AnchorPoint = props.AnchorPoint or Vector2.zero,

	Widgets.Corner(chip, UDim.new(1, 0))
	Widgets.Stroke(chip, props.Color or Colors.Stroke, 2)
	if props.Icon then
		Widgets.Icon(chip, props.Icon, { Size = UDim2.new(1, 4, 1, 4), Position = UDim2.new(0, -4, 0.5, 0), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Fallback = props.Fallback, FallbackColor = props.Color }).SizeConstraint = Enum.SizeConstraint.RelativeYY
	end
	Widgets.Label(chip, {
		Name = "Value",
		Text = props.Text or "",
		Font = Fonts.Number,
		Color = props.TextColor or Colors.White,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, props.Icon and -42 or -16, 1, -8),
		Position = UDim2.new(0, props.Icon and 34 or 8, 0, 4),
		MaxSize = props.MaxSize or 22,
	})
	return chip
end

return Widgets

local sideVectors = {
	North = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1),
	South = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1),
	East = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0),
	West = Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0),
}

function ZoneConfig.CellCenter(cell)
	return Vector3.new(cell.X * ZoneConfig.CellPitch, 0, cell.Y * ZoneConfig.CellPitch)
end

function ZoneConfig.Center(zoneId)
	local zone = ZoneConfig.ById[zoneId]
	return zone and ZoneConfig.CellCenter(zone.Cell)
end

function ZoneConfig.GateCFrame(zoneId)
	local zone = ZoneConfig.ById[zoneId]
	if not zone then
		return nil
	end
	local center = ZoneConfig.CellCenter(zone.Cell)
	local outward = sideVectors[zone.GateSide]
	local position = center + outward * ((zone.CellSize or ZoneConfig.CellSize) / 2)
	return CFrame.lookAt(position, position - outward)
end

function ZoneConfig.EntryCFrame(zoneId)
	local gate = ZoneConfig.GateCFrame(zoneId)
	return gate and gate * CFrame.new(0, 4, -16)
end

function ZoneConfig.Contains(zoneId, position)
	local center = ZoneConfig.Center(zoneId)
	if not center then
		return false
	end
	local half = (ZoneConfig.ById[zoneId].CellSize or ZoneConfig.CellSize) / 2
	return math.abs(position.X - center.X) <= half and math.abs(position.Z - center.Z) <= half
end

function ZoneConfig.ZoneAt(position)
	for id in pairs(ZoneConfig.ById) do
		if ZoneConfig.Contains(id, position) then
			return id
		end
	end
	return nil
end

return ZoneConfig

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local ThemeConfig = require(Shared.Config.ThemeConfig)
local ToolConfig = require(Shared.Config.ToolConfig)
local Components = script.Parent.Parent:WaitForChild("Components")
local UIKit = require(Components.UIKit)
local Widgets = require(Components.Widgets)

local Colors = ThemeConfig.Colors
local Fonts = ThemeConfig.Fonts
local SLOT_SIZE = 64
local KEYS = { Enum.KeyCode.One, Enum.KeyCode.Two, Enum.KeyCode.Three, Enum.KeyCode.Four, Enum.KeyCode.Five, Enum.KeyCode.Six }

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local HotbarController = { Priority = 32 }

local bar = nil
local slots = {}
local pending = false

local function ownedTools()
	local list = {}
	local character = player.Character
	local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	for _, container in ipairs({ character, backpack }) do
		if container then
			for _, item in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
				if item:IsA("Tool") and item:GetAttribute("ToolId") then
					table.insert(list, item)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return list
end

function HotbarController:Init(controllers)
	self.Controllers = controllers
end

function HotbarController:Start()
	local gui = Widgets.ScreenGui("HotbarUI", 2, true)
	bar = UIKit.Create("Frame", { Name = "Hotbar", BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -14), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6 * (SLOT_SIZE + 10), SLOT_SIZE), Parent = gui })
	local layout = Widgets.List(bar, 10, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal)
	layout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom
	Widgets.AutoScale(bar)

	local function schedule()
		if pending then
			return
		end
		pending = true
		task.defer(function()
			pending = false
			self:Refresh()
		end)
	end
	local function watch(container)
		container.ChildAdded:Connect(schedule)
		container.ChildRemoved:Connect(schedule)
	end
	local function hookCharacter(character)
		watch(character)
		watch(player:WaitForChild("Backpack"))
		schedule()
	end
	if player.Character then
		hookCharacter(player.Character)
	end
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(hookCharacter)
	self.Controllers.DataController:Observe("Loadout", schedule)

	UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
		if processed or UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then
			return
		end
		local index = table.find(KEYS, input.KeyCode)
		if index then
			self:Select(index)
		end
	end)
end

function HotbarController:Select(index)
	local slot = slots[index]
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not slot or not humanoid then
		return
	end
	if slot.Tool.Parent == character then
		humanoid:UnequipTools()
	else
		humanoid:EquipTool(slot.Tool)
	end
	self.Controllers.SoundController:Play("Click")
end

function HotbarController:Refresh()
	if not bar then
		return
	end
	Widgets.Clear(bar)
	table.clear(slots)
	local loadout = self.Controllers.DataController:Get("Loadout") or {}
	local tools = ownedTools()
	table.sort(tools, function(a, b)
		local left = table.find(loadout, a:GetAttribute("ToolId")) or 99
		local right = table.find(loadout, b:GetAttribute("ToolId")) or 99
		return left < right
	end)
	local character = player.Character
	for index, tool in ipairs(tools) do
		if index > #KEYS then
			break
		end
		local def = ToolConfig.ById[tool:GetAttribute("ToolId")]
		local equipped = tool.Parent == character
		local button = UIKit.Create("TextButton", {
			Name = "Slot" .. index,
			Text = "",
			AutoButtonColor = false,
			BackgroundColor3 = equipped and Colors.PanelLight or Colors.Dark,
			BackgroundTransparency = 0.1,
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(SLOT_SIZE, SLOT_SIZE),
			LayoutOrder = index,
			Parent = bar,
		})
		Widgets.Corner(button, UDim.new(0, 12))
		Widgets.Stroke(button, equipped and Colors.Orange or (def and def.Color or Colors.Stroke), equipped and 3 or 2)
		Widgets.Icon(button, def and def.Icon or "NavTools", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.78, 0.78), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), FallbackColor = def and def.Color })
		Widgets.Label(button, { Name = "Key", Text = tostring(index), Font = Fonts.Number, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 2), MaxSize = 14, Color = equipped and Colors.Yellow or Colors.Muted, Stroke = 1, ZIndex = 2 })
		UIKit.Button(button, function()
			self:Select(index)
		end)
		slots[index] = { Tool = tool, Button = button }
	end
end

return HotbarController

		end
	end
	return false
end

local function recordReceipt(data, purchaseId, key)
	local receipts = data.Purchases.Receipts
	table.insert(receipts, { Id = purchaseId, Key = key, Time = os.time() })
end

local function publishStoreInfo()
	for _, pass in ipairs(GamepassConfig.List) do
		storeInfo:SetAttribute(pass.Key .. "_Price", pass.Price)
		storeInfo:SetAttribute(pass.Key .. "_Available", pass.Id > 0)
	end
	for _, product in ipairs(ProductConfig.List) do
		storeInfo:SetAttribute(product.Key .. "_Price", product.Price)
		storeInfo:SetAttribute(product.Key .. "_Available", product.Id > 0)
	end
	task.spawn(function()
		for _, pass in ipairs(GamepassConfig.List) do
			if pass.Id > 0 then
				local ok, info = pcall(MarketplaceService.GetProductInfo, MarketplaceService, pass.Id, Enum.InfoType.GamePass)
				if ok and info and info.PriceInRobux then
					storeInfo:SetAttribute(pass.Key .. "_Price", info.PriceInRobux)
				end
			end
		end
		for _, product in ipairs(ProductConfig.List) do
			if product.Id > 0 then
				local ok, info = pcall(MarketplaceService.GetProductInfo, MarketplaceService, product.Id, Enum.InfoType.Product)
				if ok and info and info.PriceInRobux then
					storeInfo:SetAttribute(product.Key .. "_Price", info.PriceInRobux)
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

function MonetizationService:Init(services)
	self.Services = services
	self.Data = services.DataService
	openPanel = Net.Remote("OpenPanel")
	storeInfo = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("StoreInfo") or Instance.new("Configuration")
	storeInfo.Name = "StoreInfo"
	storeInfo.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	for _, product in ipairs(ProductConfig.List) do
		if product.Id > 0 then
			productsById[product.Id] = product
		end
	end
	for _, pass in ipairs(GamepassConfig.List) do
		if pass.Id > 0 then
			passesById[pass.Id] = pass
		end
	end

	self.Data:OnProfileLoaded(function(player, data)
		self.Data:SetSession(player, "Passes", table.clone(owned[player] or {}))
		self:ScheduleStarterOffer(player, data)
	end)
end

function MonetizationService:Start()
	publishStoreInfo()

	local function loadPasses(player)
		owned[player] = owned[player] or {}
		for _, pass in ipairs(GamepassConfig.List) do
			if pass.Id > 0 then
				local ok, result = pcall(MarketplaceService.UserOwnsGamePassAsync, MarketplaceService, player.UserId, pass.Id)
				if not ok then
					task.wait(2)
					ok, result = pcall(MarketplaceService.UserOwnsGamePassAsync, MarketplaceService, player.UserId, pass.Id)
				end
				if ok and result and player.Parent then
					self:GrantPass(player, pass.Key, false)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(loadPasses)
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		task.spawn(loadPasses, player)
	end
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		owned[player] = nil
	end)

	MarketplaceService.PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished:Connect(function(player, passId, purchased)
		local pass = passesById[passId]
		if purchased and pass and player.Parent then
			self:GrantPass(player, pass.Key, true)
		end
	end)

	MarketplaceService.ProcessReceipt = function(receipt)
		return self:ProcessReceipt(receipt)
	end

	local antiExploit = self.Services.AntiExploitService
	antiExploit:Connect("RequestPurchase", { Rate = 2, Burst = 3 }, function(player, kind, key)
		if not Validate.OneOf(kind, { "Pass", "Product" }) or not Validate.String(key, 32) then
			return
		end
		self:Prompt(player, kind, key)
	end)
	antiExploit:Connect("DismissOffer", { Rate = 1, Burst = 3 }, function(player, offerId)
		if offerId == "StarterPack" then
			self.Data:Update(player, "Purchases", function(purchases)
				purchases.StarterPackDismissed = true
				return purchases
			end)
		end
	end)
end

function MonetizationService:HasPass(player, key)
	local passes = owned[player]
	return passes ~= nil and passes[key] == true
end

function MonetizationService:GetPasses(player)
	return owned[player] or {}
end

function MonetizationService:GrantPass(player, key, isLivePurchase)
	owned[player] = owned[player] or {}
	if owned[player][key] then
		return
	end
	owned[player][key] = true
	self.Data:SetSession(player, "Passes", table.clone(owned[player]))
	self.PassOwned:Fire(player, key, isLivePurchase)
	if isLivePurchase then
		local pass = GamepassConfig.ByKey[key]
		Notifier.Send(player, { Kind = "Purchase", Text = "PURCHASED!", Subtext = pass and pass.Name or key, Icon = pass and pass.Icon })
	end
end

function MonetizationService:Prompt(player, kind, key)
	if kind == "Pass" then
		local pass = GamepassConfig.ByKey[key]
		if not pass then
			return
		end
		if pass.Id <= 0 then
			Notifier.Error(player, "THIS ITEM IS NOT AVAILABLE YET")
			return
		end
		if self:HasPass(player, key) then
			Notifier.Toast(player, "ALREADY OWNED")
			return
		end
		MarketplaceService:PromptGamePassPurchase(player, pass.Id)
	else
		local product = ProductConfig.ByKey[key]
		if not product then
			return
		end
		if product.Id <= 0 then
			Notifier.Error(player, "THIS ITEM IS NOT AVAILABLE YET")
			return
		end
		local data = self.Data:GetData(player)
		if product.OneTime and data.Purchases[product.Key] then
			Notifier.Error(player, "ALREADY PURCHASED")
			return
		end
		MarketplaceService:PromptProductPurchase(player, product.Id)
	end
	self.PromptShown:Fire(player, kind, key)
end

function MonetizationService:ProcessReceipt(receipt)
	local purchaseId = tostring(receipt.PurchaseId)
	if processingReceipts[purchaseId] then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end
	processingReceipts[purchaseId] = true
	local ok, result = pcall(self.ProcessReceiptOnce, self, receipt)
	processingReceipts[purchaseId] = nil
	if not ok then
		warn("[MonetizationService] receipt failed: " .. tostring(result))
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end
	return result
end

function MonetizationService:ProcessReceiptOnce(receipt)
	local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(receipt.PlayerId)
	if not player then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end
	local data = self.Data:GetData(player)
	if not data then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end
	local product = productsById[receipt.ProductId]
	if not product then
		warn("[MonetizationService] unknown product id " .. tostring(receipt.ProductId))
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end

	local purchaseId = tostring(receipt.PurchaseId)
	local unsavedStudio = RunService:IsStudio() and self.Data:GetSession(player, "NoSave")
	if hasReceipt(data, purchaseId) then
		if unsavedStudio or self.Data:SaveNow(player) then
			return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
		end
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end

	local handler = ProductHandlers[product.Kind]
	if not handler then
		warn("[MonetizationService] no handler for " .. tostring(product.Kind))
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end
	local ok, err = pcall(handler, self.Services, player, product, data)
	if not ok then
		warn("[MonetizationService] grant failed for " .. product.Key .. ": " .. tostring(err))
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end

	if self.Data:GetData(player) ~= data then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end
	recordReceipt(data, purchaseId, product.Key)
	Notifier.Send(player, { Kind = "Purchase", Text = "PURCHASED!", Subtext = product.Name, Icon = product.Icon })
	self.ProductPurchased:Fire(player, product.Key)

	if unsavedStudio or self.Data:SaveNow(player) then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
	end
	return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
end

function MonetizationService:ScheduleStarterOffer(player, data)
	local product = ProductConfig.ByKey.StarterPack
	if not product or product.Id <= 0 or data.Purchases.StarterPack or data.Purchases.StarterPackDismissed then
		return
	end
	task.delay(GameConfig.Offers.StarterPackDelay, function()
		local current = self.Data:GetData(player)
		while current and not current.Tutorial.Completed and not current.Purchases.StarterPack and not current.Purchases.StarterPackDismissed do
			task.wait(5)
			current = self.Data:GetData(player)
		end
		if current and not current.Purchases.StarterPack and not current.Purchases.StarterPackDismissed then
			openPanel:FireClient(player, "StarterPack")
		end
	end)
end

return MonetizationService

-- Personal challenge drops are server data; the client only draws them.
local SalvageRun={}
function SalvageRun.Drop(services,player,record,mode,entry,stamp)
 if entry.IsEvent or not services.ZoneService:IsUnlocked(player,entry.Zone)or
  (entry.RewardZone and not services.ZoneService:IsUnlocked(player,entry.RewardZone))then return false end
 if record.SeenWrecks[entry.Uid]then return false end
 record.SeenWrecks[entry.Uid]=true
 if #record.Pickups>=mode.MaxPending then return false end
 local position=entry.Position-Vector3.new(0,entry.Size.Y/2-1.5,0)
 table.insert(record.Pickups,{Uid=entry.Uid,Position=position,Zone=entry.Zone,RewardZone=entry.RewardZone,ExpiresAt=stamp+mode.PickupLifetime})
 return true
end
function SalvageRun.Snapshot(record)
 local snapshot={}
 for _,drop in ipairs(record.Pickups or {})do
  table.insert(snapshot,{Uid=drop.Uid,X=drop.Position.X,Y=drop.Position.Y,Z=drop.Position.Z,ExpiresAt=drop.ExpiresAt})
 end
 return snapshot
end
function SalvageRun.Tick(services,player,record,mode,stamp)
 local changed=false local collected=0
 local character=player.Character
 local human=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 local root=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 for index=#record.Pickups,1,-1 do
  local drop=record.Pickups[index]
  local accessible=services.ZoneService:IsUnlocked(player,drop.Zone)and
   (not drop.RewardZone or services.ZoneService:IsUnlocked(player,drop.RewardZone))
  if stamp>=drop.ExpiresAt or not accessible then
   table.remove(record.Pickups,index)changed=true
  elseif root and human and human.Health>0 and (root.Position-drop.Position).Magnitude<=mode.PickupRadius then
   table.remove(record.Pickups,index)changed=true collected+=1
  end
 end
 return changed,collected
end
return SalvageRun

local ContextActionService = game:GetService("ContextActionService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local Signal = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared").Modules.Signal)

local GAMEPAD_TYPES = {
	[Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1] = true,
	[Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad2] = true,
	[Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad3] = true,
	[Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad4] = true,
}

local InputController = { Priority = 4 }
InputController.InputChanged = Signal.new()

local preferred = "KeyboardMouse"

local function classify(inputType)
	if GAMEPAD_TYPES[inputType] then
		return "Gamepad"
	elseif inputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		return "Touch"
	elseif inputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard or string.find(inputType.Name, "Mouse") then
		return "KeyboardMouse"
	end
	return nil
end

function InputController:Init(controllers)
	self.Controllers = controllers
	if UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled then
		preferred = "Touch"
	elseif UserInputService.GamepadEnabled and not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled then
		preferred = "Gamepad"
	end
end

function InputController:Start()
	UserInputService.LastInputTypeChanged:Connect(function(inputType)
		local kind = classify(inputType)
		if kind and kind ~= preferred then
			preferred = kind
			self.InputChanged:Fire(kind)
		end
	end)

	local controllers = self.Controllers
	ContextActionService:BindAction("WreckHold", function(_, inputState)
		local combat = controllers.CombatController
  if UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox()then
   if combat then combat:SetHolding(false,"Auto")end
   return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
  end
  if inputState==Enum.UserInputState.Begin and controllers.PanelController:IsAnyOpen()then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass end
		if combat then
			if inputState == Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
				combat:SetHolding(true, "Auto")
			elseif inputState == Enum.UserInputState.End or inputState == Enum.UserInputState.Cancel then
				combat:SetHolding(false, "Auto")
			end
		end
		return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
	end, false, Enum.KeyCode.ButtonR2, Enum.KeyCode.F)

	ContextActionService:BindAction("WreckShop", function(_, inputState)
		if inputState == Enum.UserInputState.Begin and controllers.PanelController then
			controllers.PanelController:Toggle("Shop")
		end
		return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
	end, false, Enum.KeyCode.ButtonX)

	ContextActionService:BindAction("WreckClose", function(_, inputState)
		local panels = controllers.PanelController
  if UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox()then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass end
		if inputState == Enum.UserInputState.Begin and panels and panels:IsAnyOpen() then
			panels:GoBack()
			return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
		end
		return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
	end, false, Enum.KeyCode.ButtonB, Enum.KeyCode.Backspace)

 ContextActionService:BindAction("WreckActivities",function(_,state)
  if state==Enum.UserInputState.Begin and controllers.PanelController then controllers.PanelController:Toggle("Activities")end
  return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
 end,false,Enum.KeyCode.ButtonY)

 ContextActionService:BindAction("WreckCycle", function(_, inputState, input)
		if inputState == Enum.UserInputState.Begin and controllers.CombatController then
			controllers.CombatController:CycleTool(input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL1 and -1 or 1)
		end
		return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
	end, false, Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL1, Enum.KeyCode.ButtonR1)
end

function InputController:GetPreferred()
	return preferred
end

function InputController:IsTouch()
	return preferred == "Touch"
end

function InputController:IsGamepad()
	return preferred == "Gamepad"
end

return InputController

function CollectionController:RefreshCaches()
 local data=self.Controllers.DataController:GetAll()
 local folder=workspace:FindFirstChild("SalvageCaches")
 if not folder then return end
 for _,model in ipairs(folder:GetChildren())do
  local cache=Caches.ById[model:GetAttribute("CacheId")]
  local progress=cache and data and data.QuestProgress[cache.QuestId]

  for _,n in ipairs(model:GetDescendants())do
   if n:IsA("BasePart")then n.LocalTransparencyModifier=found and 1 or 0

 interactionCard.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,1)interactionCard.Visible=false

  if heldPrompt then heldPrompt:InputHoldEnd()end
  heldPrompt=nil heldInput=nil heldAt=nil
 end
 button.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
  if (input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch)and activePrompt and interactionCard.Visible then
   endHold()heldPrompt=activePrompt heldInput=input heldAt=os.clock()
   activePrompt:InputHoldBegin()
  end
 end)
 UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
  if heldInput and (input==heldInput or (input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and heldInput.UserInputType==input.UserInputType))then endHold()end
 end)
 ProximityPromptService.PromptShown:Connect(function(prompt)
  local folder=workspace:FindFirstChild("SalvageCaches")
  if folder and prompt:IsDescendantOf(folder)then activePrompt=prompt end
 end)

 end)
 ProximityPromptService.PromptButtonHoldBegan:Connect(function(prompt)
  if activePrompt==prompt then heldAt=os.clock()end
 end)
 ProximityPromptService.PromptButtonHoldEnded:Connect(function(prompt)

 end)
 local elapsed=0
 EngineRunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)

  local touch=self.Controllers.InputController:IsTouch()
  interactionCard.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(touch and 230 or 280,62)

  if not interactionCard.Visible and heldPrompt then endHold()end
  local ratio=heldAt and activePrompt and math.clamp((os.clock()-heldAt)/math.max(.01,activePrompt.HoldDuration),0,1)or 0
  Widgets.SetProgress(progress,ratio,false)
  button.Text=heldAt and "COLLECTING..."or touch and "HOLD TO COLLECT"or "HOLD E / HOLD TO COLLECT"
 end)
end

function CollectionController:Start()
 self:CreateInteraction()
 window=Widgets.Window("CollectionUI",{Title="WRECKER COLLECTIONS",Accent=Theme.Colors.Cyan,Tabs=true})
 Widgets.List(window.Content,8)

 task.spawn(function()

function CollectionController:Refresh()
 local data=self.Controllers.DataController:GetAll()if not data then return end
 Widgets.Clear(window.Content)
 for id,tab in pairs(tabs)do Widgets.SetVariant(tab,id==zoneId and "Primary"or "Secondary")end
 local order=0
 local function render(questId,chapter)
  local quest=Quests.ById[questId]

  Widgets.Label(header,{Text=locked and self.Controllers.WorldController:LockText(zoneId)or isTrail and quest.Description or "Break each object type once; shared credit counts.",Color=Theme.Colors.Muted,Position=UDim2.fromOffset(12,58),Size=UDim2.new(1,-24,0,20),MaxSize=14})

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local RebirthConfig = require(Shared.Config.RebirthConfig)
local UpgradeConfig = require(Shared.Config.UpgradeConfig)
local ToolConfig = require(Shared.Config.ToolConfig)
local GameConfig = require(Shared.Config.GameConfig)
local Formulas = require(Shared.Modules.Formulas)
local Format = require(Shared.Modules.Format)
local Signal = require(Shared.Modules.Signal)
local Net = require(Shared.Modules.Net)
local Notifier = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.Notifier)

local RebirthService = { Priority = 42 }
RebirthService.Reborn = Signal.new()

function RebirthService:Init(services)
	self.Services = services
	self.Data = services.DataService
	self.WorldFx = Net.Remote("WorldFx")
end

function RebirthService:Start()
	self.Services.AntiExploitService:Connect("Rebirth", { Rate = 1, Burst = 2 }, function(player)
		if not self:DoRebirth(player, false) then
			Notifier.Error(player, "NOT ENOUGH CASH TO REBIRTH")
		end
	end)
end

function RebirthService:CanRebirth(player)
	local data = self.Data:GetData(player)
	return data ~= nil and data.Cash >= Formulas.RebirthCost(data.Rebirths)
end

function RebirthService:DoRebirth(player, free)
	local data = self.Data:GetData(player)
	if not data or (not free and not self:CanRebirth(player)) then
		return false
	end
	local services = self.Services
	local previous = data.Rebirths
	local cores = Formulas.RebirthCores(previous)

	local kept = {}
	for _, toolId in ipairs(RebirthConfig.KeepTools) do
		kept[toolId] = true
	end
	for _, def in ipairs(ToolConfig.List) do
		if (def.Premium or def.OwnerOnly) and data.Tools[def.Id] then
			kept[def.Id] = true
		end
	end
	local loadout = {}
	for _, toolId in ipairs(data.Loadout) do
		if kept[toolId] then
			table.insert(loadout, toolId)
		end
	end
	if #loadout == 0 then
		loadout = { GameConfig.Start.Tool }
	end

	local upgrades = table.clone(data.Upgrades)
	for _, upgrade in ipairs(UpgradeConfig.List) do
		if upgrade.ResetsOnRebirth then
			upgrades[upgrade.Id] = 0
		end
	end

	self.Data:Set(player, "Cash", 0)
	self.Data:Set(player, "Scrap", 0)
	self.Data:Set(player, "Upgrades", upgrades)
	self.Data:Set(player, "Tools", kept)
	self.Data:Set(player, "Loadout", loadout)
	if not kept[data.EquippedTool] then
		self.Data:Set(player, "EquippedTool", loadout[1])
	end
	self.Data:Set(player, "ChaosCores", data.ChaosCores + cores)
	self.Data:Set(player, "Rebirths", previous + 1)

	local economy = services.EconomyService
	economy:RefreshStats(player)
	if services.ToolService then
		services.ToolService:SyncPremium(player)
		services.ToolService:GiveLoadout(player, true)
	end

	local before = Formulas.RebirthMultipliers(previous)
	local after = Formulas.RebirthMultipliers(previous + 1)
	Notifier.Send(player, {
		Kind = "Rebirth",
		Text = "CHAOS REBIRTH!",
		Subtext = string.format("CASH %s > %s   +%d CHAOS CORES", Format.Multiplier(before.Cash), Format.Multiplier(after.Cash), cores),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(166, 77, 255),
	})
	self.WorldFx:FireAllClients("Rebirth", { UserId = player.UserId })
	self.Reborn:Fire(player, previous + 1)
	return true
end

return RebirthService

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local ThemeConfig = require(Shared.Config.ThemeConfig)
local TitleConfig = require(Shared.Config.TitleConfig)
local UpdateConfig = require(Shared.Config.UpdateConfig)
local Net = require(Shared.Modules.Net)
local Components = script.Parent.Parent:WaitForChild("Components")
local UIKit = require(Components.UIKit)
local Widgets = require(Components.Widgets)

local Colors = ThemeConfig.Colors
local Fonts = ThemeConfig.Fonts

local TOGGLES = {
	{ Key = "Music", Text = "MUSIC" },
	{ Key = "Sfx", Text = "SOUND EFFECTS" },
	{ Key = "Shake", Text = "CAMERA SHAKE" },
	{ Key = "DamageNumbers", Text = "DAMAGE NUMBERS" },
	{ Key = "LowEffects", Text = "LOW EFFECTS (FASTER)" },
}

local SettingsController = { Priority = 46 }

local window = nil
local pending = {}
local pendingVersion={}

function SettingsController:Init(controllers)
	self.Controllers = controllers
end

function SettingsController:Start()
	local controllers = self.Controllers
	window = Widgets.Window("SettingsUI", { Title = "SETTINGS", Accent = Colors.Muted, Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.46, 0.74), MaxSize = Vector2.new(620, 640) })
	Widgets.List(window.Content, 10)
	controllers.PanelController:Register("Settings", window.Gui, {
		OnOpen = function()
			self:Refresh()
		end,
	})
	for _, key in ipairs({ "Settings", "Titles", "SelectedTitle" }) do
		controllers.DataController:Observe(key, function()
   if key=="Settings"then
    local current=controllers.DataController:Get("Settings")or {}
    for pendingKey,value in pairs(pending)do if current[pendingKey]==value then pending[pendingKey]=nil end end
   end
			if controllers.PanelController:IsOpen("Settings") then
				self:Refresh()
			end
		end)
	end
end

function SettingsController:Refresh()
	local data = self.Controllers.DataController:GetAll()
	if not data then
		return
	end
	Widgets.Clear(window.Content)
	for index, toggle in ipairs(TOGGLES) do
		local value = pending[toggle.Key]
		if value == nil then
			value = data.Settings[toggle.Key] == true
		end
		local row = Widgets.Card(window.Content, { Name = toggle.Key, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 56), Order = index })
		Widgets.Label(row, { Name = "Caption", Text = toggle.Text, Font = Fonts.Display, Size = UDim2.new(0.65, 0, 1, -16), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 8), MaxSize = 20 })
		Widgets.Button(row, {
			Name = "Switch",
			Text = value and "ON" or "OFF",
			Variant = value and "Accent" or "Secondary",
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(96, 38),
			Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0.5, 0),
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
			OnClick = function()
				pending[toggle.Key] = not value
    pendingVersion[toggle.Key]=(pendingVersion[toggle.Key]or 0)+1
    local token=pendingVersion[toggle.Key]
    task.delay(3,function()
     if pendingVersion[toggle.Key]==token and pending[toggle.Key]~=nil then
      pending[toggle.Key]=nil
      if self.Controllers.PanelController:IsOpen("Settings")then self:Refresh()end
      self.Controllers.NotificationController:Toast("SETTING NOT CONFIRMED",Colors.Muted,nil,"Try changing it again.")
     end
    end)
    Net.Remote("UpdateSettings"):FireServer(toggle.Key, not value)
				self:Refresh()
			end,
		})
	end

	Widgets.Label(window.Content, { Name = "TitlesHeader", Text = "TITLE", Font = Fonts.Display, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30), Order = 20, MaxSize = 22, Color = Colors.Orange })
	local titles = table.clone(TitleConfig.List)
	table.insert(titles, TitleConfig.VIP)
	local order = 20
	Widgets.Button(window.Content, {
		Name = "AutoTitle",
		Text = "AUTO (BEST TITLE)",
		Variant = data.SelectedTitle == "" and "Accent" or "Secondary",
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 42),
		Order = 21,
		OnClick = function()
			Net.Remote("SelectTitle"):FireServer("")
		end,
	})
	for _, title in ipairs(titles) do
		if data.Titles[title.Id] then
			order += 2
			local button = Widgets.Button(window.Content, {
				Name = title.Id,
				Text = title.Name,
				Variant = data.SelectedTitle == title.Id and "Accent" or "Secondary",
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 42),
				Order = order,
				OnClick = function()
					Net.Remote("SelectTitle"):FireServer(title.Id)
				end,
			})
			if data.SelectedTitle ~= title.Id then
				button.TextColor3 = title.Color
			end
		end
	end
	Widgets.Label(window.Content, { Name = "Version", Text = "WRECKRUSH v" .. UpdateConfig.Current, Font = Fonts.Light, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22), Order = 200, AlignX = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, MaxSize = 14, Color = Colors.Muted })
end

return SettingsController

local Spawning = require(script.Parent.Spawning)

local CASH_RAIN_SCALE = 800
local CASH_RAIN_WAVES = 4
local METEOR_FALL_TIME = 1.2

local RandomEvents = {}

local active = nil

local function serverNow()
	return workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
end

local function pickEvent()
	local total = 0
	for _, event in ipairs(EventConfig.Random.List) do
		total += event.Weight
	end
	local roll = math.random() * total
	for _, event in ipairs(EventConfig.Random.List) do
		roll -= event.Weight
		if roll <= 0 then
			return event
		end
	end
	return EventConfig.Random.List[1]
end

local function cashRain(service, event, run)
	local perWave = math.max(1, math.floor(event.DropsPerPlayer / CASH_RAIN_WAVES))
	for wave = 1, CASH_RAIN_WAVES do
		if active ~= run then
			return
		end
		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			local data = service.Data:GetData(player)
			local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if data and root then
				local value = Formulas.ProgressScale(data) * CASH_RAIN_SCALE / CASH_RAIN_WAVES
				service.Services.DropService:Spawn(player, "Cash", value, root.Position, perWave, { Spread = 26, Lifetime = event.Duration + 12 })
			end
		end
		if wave < CASH_RAIN_WAVES then
			task.wait(event.Duration / CASH_RAIN_WAVES)
		end
	end
end

local function meteorShower(service, event, zoneId, crowd, run)
	local def = EventConfig.Objects[event.Object]
	local window = event.Duration * 0.5
	for index = 1, event.Count do
		task.delay((index - 1) * window / event.Count, function()
			if active ~= run then
				return
			end
			local spot = Spawning.FindSpot(zoneId, def.Size)
			local target = spot.Position
			local from = target + Vector3.new(math.random(-70, 70), 180, math.random(-70, 70))
			service:WorldFx("Meteor", { From = from, To = target, Delay = METEOR_FALL_TIME })
			active.Pending += 1
			task.wait(METEOR_FALL_TIME)
			if active == run then
				active.Pending -= 1
				local remaining = math.max(active.EndsAt - serverNow(), 5)
				local uid = Spawning.SpawnObject(service.Services.DestructionService, event.Object, zoneId, crowd, event.Id, remaining, spot)
				if uid then
					active.Uids[uid] = true
				end
			end
		end)
	end
end

function RandomEvents.Start(service, event)
	if active then
		RandomEvents.Stop(service)
	end
	local state = service:GetState()
	local zoneId, crowd = Spawning.BusiestZone()
	active = { Event = event, Uids = {}, Pending = 0, EndsAt = serverNow() + event.Duration, Zone = zoneId }
	state:SetAttribute("ActiveEvent", event.Id)
	state:SetAttribute("ActiveEventEndsAt", active.EndsAt)
	state:SetAttribute("ActiveEventZone", zoneId)
	service:Announce({ Id = event.Id, Name = event.Name, Description = event.Description, Phase = "Start", Duration = event.Duration, Color = event.Color, Icon = event.Icon, Zone = zoneId })
	service.RandomEventStarted:Fire(event.Id, zoneId)

	local run = active
	if event.Id == "CashRain" then
		task.spawn(cashRain, service, event, run)
	elseif event.Id == "MeteorChaos" then
		meteorShower(service, event, zoneId, crowd, run)
	elseif event.Object then
		for _ = 1, event.Count or 1 do
			local uid = Spawning.SpawnObject(service.Services.DestructionService, event.Object, zoneId, crowd, event.Id, event.Duration)
			if uid then
				active.Uids[uid] = true
			end
		end
	end

	local current = active
	task.delay(event.Duration, function()
		if active == current then
			RandomEvents.Stop(service)
		end
	end)
end

function RandomEvents.Stop(service)
	if not active then
		return
	end
	local finished = active
	active = nil
	for uid in pairs(finished.Uids) do
		local entry = service.Services.DestructionService:GetEntry(uid)
		if entry and entry.Alive then
			service.Services.DestructionService:Despawn(uid)
		end
	end
	local state = service:GetState()
	state:SetAttribute("ActiveEvent", "")
	state:SetAttribute("ActiveEventEndsAt", 0)
	state:SetAttribute("ActiveEventZone", "")
	service:Announce({ Id = finished.Event.Id, Name = finished.Event.Name, Phase = "End", Color = finished.Event.Color, Icon = finished.Event.Icon })
	service.RandomEventEnded:Fire(finished.Event.Id)
end

function RandomEvents.OnWrecked(service, entry)
	if not active or not entry.EventId or not active.Uids[entry.Uid] then
		return
	end
	active.Uids[entry.Uid] = nil
	if next(active.Uids) == nil and active.Pending == 0 and active.Event.Id ~= "MeteorChaos" then
		RandomEvents.Stop(service)
	end
end

function RandomEvents.Scheduler(service)
	task.wait(EventConfig.Random.FirstDelay)
	while true do
		if not active and not service:IsChaosActive() and #Players:GetPlayers() > 0 then
			RandomEvents.Start(service, pickEvent())
		end
		task.wait(math.random(EventConfig.Random.MinInterval, EventConfig.Random.MaxInterval))
	end
end

return RandomEvents

StarterPlayer.StarterPlayerScripts.Contr.source:
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
local Shared=ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local QuestConfig=require(Shared.Config.QuestConfig)
local RunConfig=require(Shared.Config.RunConfig)
local ZoneConfig=require(Shared.Config.ZoneConfig)
local Format=require(Shared.Modules.Format)
local Net=require(Shared.Modules.Net)
local Theme=require(Shared.Config.ThemeConfig)
local Widgets=require(script.Parent.Parent.Components.Widgets)
local UIKit=require(script.Parent.Parent.Components.UIKit)
local ActivityController={Priority=43}
local Colors=Theme.Colors
local window,gui,tracker
local runCards={}
local projectCard
local activityPage="Recommended"
local activityTabs={}
local cancelConfirm
local ToolConfig=require(Shared.Config.ToolConfig)
local selectedQuest
local runPending=false

function ActivityController:Init(controllers)self.Controllers=controllers end

function ActivityController:SelectQuest(id)
 if not QuestConfig.IsAvailable(QuestConfig.ById[id],self.Controllers.DataController:GetAll())then return false end
 selectedQuest=id
 self:Refresh()
end

function ActivityController:GetQuest()
 local data=self.Controllers.DataController:GetAll()
 if not data then return nil end
 local fallback,bestScore,pinned,pinnedProgress,readyQuest,readyProgress
 for _,quest in ipairs(QuestConfig.List)do
  local p=data.QuestProgress[quest.Id]
  if p and not p.Completed and QuestConfig.IsStageUnlocked(quest,data)and (QuestConfig.IsAvailable(quest,data)or p.Progress>=p.Target)then
   local ready=p.Progress>=p.Target
   if ready and not readyQuest then readyQuest=quest readyProgress=p end
   if quest.Id==selectedQuest and (not quest.Zone or data.Zones[quest.Zone])then pinned=quest pinnedProgress=p end
   if not quest.Zone or data.Zones[quest.Zone]then
    local score=(quest.Category=="Contracts"and 10 or 0)+(p.Progress/math.max(1,p.Target))
    if not bestScore or score>bestScore then fallback=quest bestScore=score end
   end
  end
 end
 if pinned then return pinned,pinnedProgress end
 if readyQuest then return readyQuest,readyProgress end
 return fallback,fallback and data.QuestProgress[fallback.Id]
end

function ActivityController:Arrange()
 local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
 local compact=camera and camera.ViewportSize.Y<500
 tracker.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(compact and 176 or 278,compact and 68 or 105)
 tracker.Position=UDim2.new(1,-14,0,compact and 67 or 150)
 tracker.Heading.Size=UDim2.new(1,-20,0,compact and 14 or 20)
 tracker.QuestName.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(10,compact and 20 or 34)
 tracker.QuestName.Size=UDim2.new(1,-20,0,compact and 20 or 26)
 tracker.Count.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(10,compact and 43 or 66)
 tracker.Count.Size=UDim2.new(1,-20,0,compact and 16 or 20)
 tracker.Bar.Position=UDim2.new(0,10,1,-6)
 tracker.Hint.Visible=not compact
end

function ActivityController:Start()
 local C=self.Controllers
 window=Widgets.Window("ActivityUI",{Title="WHAT TO DO",Accent=Colors.Cyan,Tabs=true})
 for index,info in ipairs({{"Recommended","START HERE"},{"Challenges","CHALLENGES"},{"Explore","EXPLORE"}})do
  activityTabs[info[1]]=Widgets.Tab(window.Tabs,{Name=info[1],Text=info[2],Width=140,Order=index,OnClick=function()
   activityPage=info[1]cancelConfirm=nil window.Content.CanvasPosition=Vector2.zero self:BuildActivities()
  end})
  activityTabs[info[1]].Size=UDim2.new(1/3,-6,1,0)
 end
 Widgets.List(window.Content,10)
 C.PanelController:Register("Activities",window.Gui,{OnOpen=function()
  local run=C.DataController:GetSession("DemolitionRun")
  if run and run.Active then
   activityPage=(run.ModeId=="FreeRoam"or run.ModeId=="SalvageRush"or run.ModeId=="TargetHunt"or run.ModeId=="ToolRelay"or run.ModeId=="ChainRush")and "Recommended"or "Challenges"
  end
  window.Content.CanvasPosition=Vector2.zero self:BuildActivities()
 end})
 gui=Widgets.ScreenGui("ActivityHUD",2,true)
 tracker=Widgets.Card(gui,{Name="QuestTracker",Color=Colors.Dark,StrokeColor=Colors.Cyan})
 tracker.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,0)
 Widgets.Label(tracker,{Name="Heading",Text="YOUR NEXT TASK",Position=UDim2.fromOffset(10,4),MaxSize=13,Color=Colors.Cyan})
 Widgets.Label(tracker,{Name="QuestName",Font=Theme.Fonts.Display,MaxSize=18})
 Widgets.Label(tracker,{Name="Count",Font=Theme.Fonts.Number,MaxSize=14,Color=Colors.Muted})
 Widgets.Progress(tracker,{Name="Bar",Size=UDim2.new(1,-20,0,3),Color=Colors.Cyan})
 Widgets.Label(tracker,{Name="Hint",Text="Open to view or claim your task",Position=UDim2.fromOffset(10,88),Size=UDim2.new(1,-20,0,12),MaxSize=12,Color=Colors.Muted})
 local hit=UIKit.Create("TextButton",{Name="Hit",Text="",BackgroundTransparency=1,Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),ZIndex=5,Parent=tracker})
 UIKit.Button(hit,function()
 if C.ExpeditionController and C.ExpeditionController:GetTracker()then C.PanelController:Open("Expeditions")return end
 local run=C.DataController:GetSession("DemolitionRun")
 if run and run.Active then C.PanelController:Open("Activities")
 else local quest=self:GetQuest() if quest and quest.Category=="Collections"then
  C.PanelController:Open("Collections",quest.Type=="FindCache"and "Caches"or quest.Zone)
 else C.QuestController:ViewQuest(quest and quest.Id)end
 end
end)
 self:Arrange()
 if workspace.CurrentCamera then workspace.CurrentCamera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(function()self:Arrange()end)end
 for _,key in ipairs({"QuestProgress","Zones","Tutorial"})do
  C.DataController:Observe(key,function()self:Refresh()end)
 end
 C.DataController:ObserveSession("DemolitionRun",function()
  local startedHere=runPending
  runPending=false cancelConfirm=nil self:Refresh()
  local run=C.DataController:GetSession("DemolitionRun")
  if startedHere and startedHere~="CancelRun"and run and run.Active then
   C.PanelController:Close("Activities")
   if run.TargetZone and run.TargetZone~=""then C.NavigationController:SetZone(run.TargetZone)end
  elseif C.PanelController:IsOpen("Activities")then self:RenderRuns()self:RenderProject()end
 end)
 C.DataController:ObserveSession("CommunityProject",function()
  if C.PanelController:IsOpen("Activities")then self:RenderProject()end
 end)
 local elapsed=0
 RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
  elapsed+=dt
  if elapsed<0.25 then return end
  elapsed=0
  self:Refresh()
  if C.PanelController:IsOpen("Activities")then self:RenderRuns()self:RenderProject()end
 end)
 self:Refresh()
end

function ActivityController:Refresh()
 if not tracker then return end
 local C=self.Controllers
 local data=C.DataController:GetAll()
 tracker.Visible=data~=nil and data.Tutorial.Completed and not C.PanelController:IsAnyOpen()
 if not data then return end
 local expedition=C.ExpeditionController and C.ExpeditionController:GetTracker()
 if expedition then
  tracker.Visible=not C.PanelController:IsAnyOpen()
  tracker.Heading.Text=expedition.Heading tracker.QuestName.Text=expedition.Detail tracker.Count.Text=expedition.Count
  tracker.Hint.Text="Open WORLDS to rally friends or manage this encounter."
  tracker.Bar.Visible=true Widgets.SetProgress(tracker.Bar,expedition.Progress,false)return
 end
 local run=C.DataController:GetSession("DemolitionRun")
 if run and run.Active then
  local left=math.max(0,math.ceil(run.EndsAt-workspace:GetServerTimeNow()))
  local mode=RunConfig.ById[run.ModeId or "WreckRun"]
  tracker.Heading.Text=mode.Name..(mode.Untimed and " · YOUR PACE"or (" · "..Format.Time(left)))
  local goal=mode.Untimed and math.max(1,run.Count)or mode.Tiers[#mode.Tiers].Target
  tracker.QuestName.Text=run.Count.." / "..goal.." "..mode.Unit
  local tier=mode.Untimed and "NO TIMER"or ("AIM FOR "..mode.Tiers[1].Name)
  for _,medal in ipairs(mode.Tiers)do if run.Count>=medal.Target then tier=medal.Name end end
  if mode.Kind=="Hunt"then
   local required=ToolConfig.ById[run.RequiredTool]
   tracker.QuestName.Text=run.TargetUid~=""and (C.HuntController:GetDirection().." · "..run.TargetName)or "FINDING NEXT TARGET"
   tracker.Count.Text=(mode.Untimed and (run.Count.." cleared")or (run.Count.."/"..goal)).." · "..(required and (run.ToolHit and "FINISH TARGET"or required.Name)or C.HuntController:GetHint())
   tracker.Hint.Text=mode.Untimed and "No timer. Normal wreck rewards and quest progress count."or required and ("Hit with "..required.Name..", then finish the marked target")or "Only the marked object counts; shared wreck credit works."
  elseif mode.Kind=="Salvage"then
   local salvage=C.SalvageController
   tracker.QuestName.Text=#(run.Pickups or {})>0 and salvage:GetHint()or "BREAK TO DROP SALVAGE"
   tracker.Count.Text=run.Count.."/"..goal.." · "..#(run.Pickups or {}).." DROPS WAITING"
   tracker.Hint.Text="Walk near your orange drops. Each disappears after 20 seconds."
  elseif mode.Kind=="Chain"then
   local chainLeft=math.max(0,(run.ChainEndsAt or 0)-workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
   tracker.Count.Text=(run.Chain or 0)>0 and ("CHAIN "..run.Chain.." · "..string.format("%.1fs",chainLeft))or "WRECK TO START A CHAIN"
   tracker.Hint.Text=tier.." secured · next wreck within "..mode.ChainWindow.."s"
  else
   tracker.Count.Text=tier.." · KEEP SMASHING"
   tracker.Hint.Text="Open PLAY to view this challenge"
  end
  tracker.Bar.Visible=not mode.Untimed
  Widgets.SetProgress(tracker.Bar,run.Count/goal,false)
 else
  local quest,p=self:GetQuest()
  tracker.Heading.Text="YOUR NEXT TASK"
  tracker.Bar.Visible=true
  if quest then
   tracker.QuestName.Text=string.format(quest.Text,Format.Number(p.Target))
   local ready=p.Progress>=p.Target
   local hint=C.NavigationController and C.NavigationController:GetHint()
   local destination=C.NavigationController and C.NavigationController:GetDestinationName()
   if destination and not ready then tracker.Heading.Text=C.NavigationController:GetDirection().." · "..destination end
   tracker.Count.Text=ready and "REWARD READY · OPEN QUESTS"or(Format.Number(p.Progress).." / "..Format.Number(p.Target)..(hint and (" · "..hint:match("^(%d+)").." studs")or " · VIEW TASK"))
   tracker.Hint.Text=hint or "Open to view or claim your task"
   Widgets.SetProgress(tracker.Bar,p.Progress/math.max(1,p.Target),false)
  else
   tracker.QuestName.Text="EXPLORE THE CITY"
   tracker.Count.Text="Open PLAY for activities"
   Widgets.SetProgress(tracker.Bar,0,false)
  end
 end
end

function ActivityController:RenderRuns()
 local data=self.Controllers.DataController:GetAll()
 local run=self.Controllers.DataController:GetSession("DemolitionRun")or{}
 local left=math.max(0,math.ceil((run.ReadyAt or 0)-workspace:GetServerTimeNow()))
 for _,mode in ipairs(RunConfig.Modes)do
  local card=runCards[mode.Id]
  if not card or not card.Parent then continue end
  local active=run.Active==true
  local same=active and (run.ModeId or "WreckRun")==mode.Id
  local switchable=active and RunConfig.ById[run.ModeId].Untimed and not same
  local goal=mode.Untimed and 0 or mode.Tiers[#mode.Tiers].Target
  card.Detail.Text=same and (run.Count.." / "..goal.." "..mode.Unit.." · "..Format.Time(math.max(0,run.EndsAt-workspace:GetServerTimeNow())).." left")or mode.Description
  if same and mode.Kind=="Hunt"then
   local required=ToolConfig.ById[run.RequiredTool]
   card.Detail.Text=(mode.Untimed and (run.Count.." cleared")or (run.Count.."/"..goal)).." · "..run.TargetName..(required and (" · "..(run.ToolHit and "FINISH IT"or ("USE "..required.Name)))or " · FOLLOW MARKER")
  elseif same and mode.Kind=="Salvage"then
   card.Detail.Text=run.Count.."/"..mode.Tiers[#mode.Tiers].Target.." collected · "..#(run.Pickups or {}).." pending · "..Format.Time(math.max(0,run.EndsAt-workspace:GetServerTimeNow())).." left"
  elseif same and mode.Kind=="Chain"then
   local remaining=math.max(0,(run.ChainEndsAt or 0)-workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
   card.Detail.Text="BEST "..run.Count.." · CHAIN "..(run.Chain or 0).." · "..string.format("%.1fs",remaining).." to link · "..Format.Time(math.max(0,run.EndsAt-workspace:GetServerTimeNow())).." left"
  elseif not active and run.ModeId==mode.Id and run.Medal and run.Medal~=""then
   card.Detail.Text="LAST RESULT: "..run.Medal.." · "..run.Count.." "..mode.Unit
  end
  local toolCount=0 local seen={}
  for _,id in ipairs(data and data.Loadout or {})do
   if data.Tools[id]and not seen[id]then seen[id]=true toolCount+=1 end
  end
  local needTools=mode.RequireTool and toolCount<2
  if runPending then card.Action.Text="WAITING..."
  elseif same then card.Action.Text=cancelConfirm==mode.Id and (mode.Untimed and "CONFIRM END SESSION"or "CONFIRM END · NO PRIZE")or (mode.Untimed and "END FREE SESSION"or "END THIS RUN")
  elseif active and not switchable then card.Action.Text="ANOTHER ACTIVITY IS ACTIVE"
  elseif data and not data.Tutorial.Completed then card.Action.Text="FINISH STARTER GUIDE"
  elseif needTools then card.Action.Text="NEED 2 TOOLS IN HOTBAR"
  elseif not mode.Untimed and left>0 then card.Action.Text="WAIT "..Format.Time(left)
  else card.Action.Text="START "..mode.Name end
  local enabled=not runPending and data and data.Tutorial.Completed and (same or ((not active or switchable)and (mode.Untimed or left==0)and not needTools))
  Widgets.SetVariant(card.Action,enabled and (same and "Secondary"or "Primary")or "Disabled")
 end
end

function ActivityController:BuildActivities()
 local C=self.Controllers
 Widgets.Clear(window.Content)
 table.clear(runCards)
 projectCard=nil
 for name,tab in pairs(activityTabs)do Widgets.SetVariant(tab,name==activityPage and "Primary"or "Secondary")end
 local intro=Widgets.Card(window.Content,{Name="Intro",Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,38),Order=0})
 intro.Visible=not(workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.Y<500)
 Widgets.Label(intro,{Text=activityPage=="Recommended"and "Choose free wrecking at your own pace, explore, or try an optional challenge."or activityPage=="Challenges"and "Eight optional challenges. A medal pays once; paid runs share a 3-minute cooldown."or "Explore districts, collections, contracts and free rewards.",Position=UDim2.fromOffset(12,8),Size=UDim2.new(1,-24,1,-16),MaxSize=18})
 local featured={FreeRoam=1,SalvageRush=2,TargetHunt=3,ToolRelay=4,ChainRush=5}
 local current=C.DataController:GetSession("DemolitionRun")or{}

  end
  Widgets.Label(card,{Text=mode.Untimed and "Normal wreck rewards · quests count\nNo extra prize · stop whenever you like"or (prizes[1].."  |  "..prizes[2].."\n"..prizes[3].." · best medal pays once"),Position=UDim2.fromOffset(14,74),Size=UDim2.new(1,-28,0,30),MaxSize=14,Color=Colors.Muted})
  Widgets.Button(card,{Name="Action",Text="START",Position=UDim2.fromOffset(14,112),Size=UDim2.new(1,-28,0,44),OnClick=function()
   local run=self.Controllers.DataController:GetSession("DemolitionRun")or{}
   local data=self.Controllers.DataController:GetAll()
   if not data or not data.Tutorial.Completed or runPending then return end
   if run.Active then
    if run.ModeId~=mode.Id then
     if RunConfig.ById[run.ModeId].Untimed and workspace:GetServerTimeNow()>=(run.ReadyAt or 0)then
      runPending=mode.Id Net.Remote("StartDemolitionRun"):FireServer(mode.Id)
      task.delay(3,function()if runPending==mode.Id then runPending=false self:RenderRuns()end end)
      self:RenderRuns()
     end
     return
    end
    if cancelConfirm~=mode.Id then
     cancelConfirm=mode.Id self:RenderRuns()
     task.delay(3,function()if cancelConfirm==mode.Id then cancelConfirm=nil self:RenderRuns()end end)
     return
    end
    runPending="CancelRun"
    Net.Remote("StartDemolitionRun"):FireServer("CancelRun")
    task.delay(3,function()if runPending=="CancelRun"then runPending=false self:RenderRuns()end end)
    self:RenderRuns()return
   end
   if not mode.Untimed and workspace:GetServerTimeNow()<(run.ReadyAt or 0)then return end
   runPending=mode.Id
   Net.Remote("StartDemolitionRun"):FireServer(mode.Id)
   task.delay(3,function()if runPending==mode.Id then runPending=false self:RenderRuns()end end)
   self:RenderRuns()
  end})
 end
 self:RenderRuns()

 projectCard=Widgets.Card(window.Content,{Name="CommunityProject",Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,200),Order=11,Accent=Colors.Yellow})

ServerScriptService.Modules.Notifier.source:
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Net = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.Net)

local notify = Net.Remote("Notify")

local Notifier = {}

function Notifier.Send(player, payload)
	if player and player.Parent then
		notify:FireClient(player, payload)
	end
end

function Notifier.Broadcast(payload)
	notify:FireAllClients(payload)
end

function Notifier.Toast(player, text, color, icon)
	Notifier.Send(player, { Kind = "Toast", Text = text, Color = color, Icon = icon })
end

function Notifier.Error(player, text)
	Notifier.Send(player, { Kind = "Error", Text = text })
end

function Notifier.Big(player, text, color, subtext)
	Notifier.Send(player, { Kind = "Big", Text = text, Color = color, Subtext = subtext })
end

return Notifier

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local Config = Shared.Config
local GameConfig = require(Config.GameConfig)
local UpgradeConfig = require(Config.UpgradeConfig)
local ChaosShopConfig = require(Config.ChaosShopConfig)
local ToolConfig = require(Config.ToolConfig)
local ZoneConfig = require(Config.ZoneConfig)
local TitleConfig = require(Config.TitleConfig)
local PetConfig = require(Config.PetConfig)
local TableUtil = require(Shared.Modules.TableUtil)
local DefaultData = require(script.Parent.DefaultData)

local NUMBER_KEYS = {
	"Cash", "Scrap", "ChaosCores", "Rebirths", "XP", "DailyStreak", "TotalDamage", "TotalCash",
	"TotalDestroyed", "TotalScrap", "ChaosEventsCompleted", "PlayTime", "FirstJoin", "LastJoin",
}

local TABLE_KEYS = {
	"Tools", "Skins", "Upgrades", "ChaosUpgrades", "Zones", "Boosts", "QuestProgress", "Titles",
	"Badges", "Metrics", "Settings", "Tutorial", "Purchases", "DailyReward", "Loadout",
	"Pets", "EquippedPets",
}

local function finite(value, fallback)
	if type(value) == "number" and value == value and value > -math.huge and value < math.huge then
		return value
	end
	return fallback
end

local function keepKnown(dictionary, known)
	for key, value in pairs(dictionary) do
		if not known[key] or value ~= true then
			dictionary[key] = nil
		end
	end
end

local function clampLevels(levels, list)
	local valid = {}
	for _, entry in ipairs(list) do
		valid[entry.Id] = math.clamp(math.floor(finite(levels[entry.Id], 0)), 0, entry.MaxLevel)
	end
	return valid
end

return function(raw)
	local data = type(raw) == "table" and raw or {}
	local defaults = DefaultData()

	for _, key in ipairs(TABLE_KEYS) do
		if data[key] ~= nil and type(data[key]) ~= "table" then
			data[key] = nil
		end
	end
	TableUtil.Reconcile(data, defaults)

	for _, key in ipairs(NUMBER_KEYS) do
		data[key] = math.max(0, finite(data[key], defaults[key] or 0))
	end
	data.Level = math.max(1, math.floor(finite(data.Level, 1)))

	keepKnown(data.Tools, ToolConfig.ById)
	data.Tools[GameConfig.Start.Tool] = true

	keepKnown(data.Skins, ToolConfig.SkinsById)
	data.Skins.Default = true
	if type(data.EquippedSkin) ~= "string" or not data.Skins[data.EquippedSkin] then
		data.EquippedSkin = "Default"
	end

	keepKnown(data.Zones, ZoneConfig.ById)
	data.Zones.VIP = nil
	data.Zones[GameConfig.Start.Zone] = true

	keepKnown(data.Titles, TitleConfig.ById)
	data.Titles.NewbieWrecker = true
	if type(data.SelectedTitle) ~= "string" or (data.SelectedTitle ~= "" and not TitleConfig.ById[data.SelectedTitle]) then
		data.SelectedTitle = ""
	end

	data.Upgrades = clampLevels(data.Upgrades, UpgradeConfig.List)
	data.ChaosUpgrades = clampLevels(data.ChaosUpgrades, ChaosShopConfig.List)

	for boostId, seconds in pairs(data.Boosts) do
		if not GameConfig.Boosts[boostId] or finite(seconds, 0) <= 0 then
			data.Boosts[boostId] = nil
		end
	end

	local loadout, seen = {}, {}
	for _, toolId in ipairs(data.Loadout) do
		if type(toolId) == "string" and data.Tools[toolId] and not seen[toolId] then
			seen[toolId] = true
			table.insert(loadout, toolId)
		end
	end
	if #loadout == 0 then
		loadout = { GameConfig.Start.Tool }
	end
	data.Loadout = loadout
	if type(data.EquippedTool) ~= "string" or not data.Tools[data.EquippedTool] then
		data.EquippedTool = loadout[1]
	end

	for key, value in pairs(defaults.Settings) do
		if type(data.Settings[key]) ~= "boolean" then
			data.Settings[key] = value
		end
	end

	data.Tutorial.Step = math.clamp(math.floor(finite(data.Tutorial.Step, 1)), 1, 7)
	data.Tutorial.Completed = data.Tutorial.Completed == true

	data.DailyReward.Day = math.clamp(math.floor(finite(data.DailyReward.Day, 0)), 0, 7)
	data.DailyReward.LastClaim = math.max(0, finite(data.DailyReward.LastClaim, 0))

	data.Purchases.StarterPack = data.Purchases.StarterPack == true
	data.Purchases.StarterPackDismissed = data.Purchases.StarterPackDismissed == true
	local receipts = {}
	local seenReceipts = {}
	local rawReceipts = type(data.Purchases.Receipts) == "table" and data.Purchases.Receipts or {}
	for _, receipt in ipairs(rawReceipts) do
		if type(receipt) == "table" and type(receipt.Id) == "string" and not seenReceipts[receipt.Id] then
			seenReceipts[receipt.Id] = true
			table.insert(receipts, { Id = receipt.Id, Key = type(receipt.Key) == "string" and receipt.Key or "", Time = math.max(0, finite(receipt.Time, 0)) })
		end
	end
	data.Purchases.Receipts = receipts

	for questId, progress in pairs(data.QuestProgress) do
		if type(progress) ~= "table" then
			data.QuestProgress[questId] = nil
		end
	end

	local pets, petCount = {}, 0
	for uid, petId in pairs(data.Pets) do
		if type(uid) == "string" and #uid <= 16 and PetConfig.ById[petId] and petCount < PetConfig.InventoryLimit then
			pets[uid] = petId
			petCount += 1
		end
	end
	data.Pets = pets
	local equipped, seenPets = {}, {}
	for _, uid in ipairs(data.EquippedPets) do
		if pets[uid] and not seenPets[uid] and #equipped < PetConfig.MaxEquipped then
			seenPets[uid] = true
			table.insert(equipped, uid)
		end
	end
	data.EquippedPets = equipped

	data.Version = GameConfig.Data.SchemaVersion
	return data
end

ServerScriptService.Services.RunService..source:
local Zones=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config.ZoneConfig)
local Hunt={}
local function tools(services,player,data)
 local ids={}local seen={}
 for _,id in ipairs(data.Loadout)do
  if not seen[id]and services.ToolService:Owns(player,id)then
   seen[id]=true table.insert(ids,id)
  end
 end
 return ids
end
local function candidates(services,player,zone,seen)
 local list={}
 for _,entry in ipairs(services.DestructionService:GetAliveInZone(zone))do
  if entry.SizeClass=="Small"and not entry.IsEvent and not seen[entry.Uid]then table.insert(list,entry)end
 end
 return list
end
function Hunt.Prepare(services,player,record,mode,data)
 local char=player.Character local root=char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 local human=char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 if not root or not human or human.Health<=0 then return false,"RESPAWN BEFORE STARTING A HUNT"end
 local zone=Zones.ZoneAt(root.Position)
 if zone=="VIP"or not zone or not services.ZoneService:IsUnlocked(player,zone)then zone="ScrapYard"end
 local cycle=mode.RequireTool and tools(services,player,data)or {}
 if mode.RequireTool and #cycle<2 then return false,"PUT TWO OWNED TOOLS IN YOUR HOTBAR"end
 if not mode.Untimed and #candidates(services,player,zone,{})==0 then return false,"TARGETS ARE RESPAWNING. TRY AGAIN SOON"end
 record.TargetZone=zone record.ToolCycle=cycle record.PreviousType=nil
 return true
end
function Hunt.Assign(services,player,record,mode)
 local root=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 local origin=root and root.Position or Zones.Center(record.TargetZone)
 local pool=candidates(services,player,record.TargetZone,record.SeenWrecks)
 if mode.Untimed and #pool==0 then table.clear(record.SeenWrecks) pool=candidates(services,player,record.TargetZone,record.SeenWrecks)end
 local chosen,score
 for _,entry in ipairs(pool)do
  local value=(entry.Position-origin).Magnitude+(entry.TypeId==record.PreviousType and 500 or 0)
  if not score or value<score or (value==score and entry.Uid<chosen.Uid)then chosen=entry score=value end
 end
 record.TargetUid=chosen and chosen.Uid or ""
 record.TargetName=chosen and chosen.Def.Name or "WAITING FOR TARGET"
 record.RequiredTool=mode.RequireTool and record.ToolCycle[record.Count%#record.ToolCycle+1]or ""
 record.ToolHit=false
 return chosen
end
return Hunt

function Controller:GetTracker()
 local w=self:CurrentWorld()local s=w and self.States and self.States:FindFirstChild(w.Id)
 if not s then return nil end
 local phase=s:GetAttribute("Phase")or "Ready"
 local heading=w.Name local detail="EXPLORE · LAUNCH FROM WORLDS"
 local count=(s:GetAttribute("Players")or 1).." explorers · CO-OP"
 local progress=0
 if phase=="Shield"then
  detail=(w.Mechanic=="Beacons"and "CHARGE BEACONS"or w.Mechanic=="Coolant"and "BREAK COOLANT"or "BREAK POWER ROOTS").." · "..(s:GetAttribute("Nodes")or 0).."/"..w.Nodes
  count=w.Mechanic=="Beacons"and "Hold E / tap nearby"or count
  progress=(s:GetAttribute("Nodes")or 0)/w.Nodes
 elseif phase=="Active"then
  progress=(s:GetAttribute("Health")or 0)/math.max(1,s:GetAttribute("MaxHealth")or 1)
  heading=w.BossName detail=math.ceil(progress*100).."% HP · CORE OPEN"
  local attack=s:GetAttribute("AttackAt")or 0
  if attack>workspace:GetServerTimeNow()then count="JUMP / LEAVE ORANGE"
  elseif w.Window then count="STRIKE · "..math.max(0,math.ceil((s:GetAttribute("WindowEnds")or 0)-workspace:GetServerTimeNow())).."s OPEN"end
 elseif phase=="Complete"then detail="BOSS DEFEATED"count="Explore · rally friends"progress=1 end
 return {Heading=heading,Detail=detail,Count=count,Progress=progress}
end

  card.Status.Text=people.." EXPLORERS · "..status
  card.Main.Text=inWorld and ((phase=="Ready"or phase=="Complete")and cooldown==0 and "START BOSS"or "BACK TO GAME")or "TRAVEL TO WORLD"
  card.Rally.Text=inWorld and "RALLY"or people>0 and "JOIN TEAM"or "EXPLORE"
  card.LayoutOrder=inWorld and 0 or table.find(Config.Worlds,world)
 end
end
local function dangerPart(folder,size,cf,shape)
 local p=Instance.new("Part")p.Name="DangerPreview"p.Anchored=true p.CanCollide=false p.CanTouch=false p.CanQuery=false p.CastShadow=false p.Size=size p.CFrame=cf p.Color=Color3.fromRGB(242,135,72)p.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic p.Transparency=.4
 if shape then p.Shape=shape end p.Parent=folder return p
end
function Controller:ClearHazards(id)
 local f=hazards[id]if f then f:Destroy()hazards[id]=nil end lastAttack[id]=nil
end
function Controller:UpdateHazards()
 local current=self:CurrentWorld()
 for _,world in Config.Worlds do
  local s=self.States:FindFirstChild(world.Id)
  local stamp=s and s:GetAttribute("AttackAt")or 0
  local valid=current and current.Id==world.Id and stamp>workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
  if not valid then self:ClearHazards(world.Id)
  elseif stamp~=lastAttack[world.Id]then
   self:ClearHazards(world.Id)lastAttack[world.Id]=stamp
   local f=Instance.new("Folder")f.Name="ExpeditionWarning"f.Parent=workspace.CurrentCamera hazards[world.Id]=f
   local boss=Config.BossPosition(world)local c=Vector3.new(boss.X,.8,boss.Z)
   local kind=s:GetAttribute("AttackKind")
   if kind=="Disc"then dangerPart(f,Vector3.new(.18,58,58),CFrame.new(c)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.pi/2),Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
   elseif kind=="Lane"then
    dangerPart(f,Vector3.new(18,.18,178),CFrame.new(c)*CFrame.Angles(0,s:GetAttribute("AttackAxis")==0 and 0 or math.pi/2,0))
   else
    for i=1,32 do
     local a=i/32*math.pi*2 local p=c+Vector3.new(math.cos(a)*39.5,0,math.sin(a)*39.5)
     dangerPart(f,Vector3.new(2*math.pi*39.5/32+.5,.18,35),CFrame.lookAt(p,c))
    end
   end
  end
 end
end
function Controller:Animate()
 local root=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 if not root then return end
 local settings=self.Controllers.DataController:Get("Settings")or {}
 local low=settings.LowEffects==true
 local time=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
 local world=self:CurrentWorld()local state=world and self.States:FindFirstChild(world.Id)
 local winding=state and (state:GetAttribute("AttackAt")or 0)>time
 for p,base in pairs(animated)do
  if not p.Parent then animated[p]=nil
  elseif (base.Position-root.Position).Magnitude<220 then
   local kind=p:GetAttribute("ExpeditionMotion")
   if low then p.CFrame=base
   elseif kind=="Rotor"then p.CFrame=base*CFrame.Angles(0,0,time*.45)
   elseif kind=="Orb"then p.CFrame=base*CFrame.new(0,math.sin(time*1.2+base.Position.X)*.5,0)
   elseif kind=="Arm"then p.CFrame=base*CFrame.Angles(winding and -.45 or math.sin(time*1.4)*.12,0,0)
   elseif kind=="Wing"then p.CFrame=base*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.sin(time*1.3)*.12)
   elseif kind=="Leaf"then p.CFrame=base*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.sin(time+base.Position.X)*.04)
   elseif kind=="Core"then p.CFrame=base*CFrame.Angles(0,0,time*.25)end
  end
 end
end
function Controller:Start()
 self.States=RS:WaitForChild("ExpeditionState",20)if not self.States then return end
 window=Widgets.Window("ExpeditionUI",{Title="WORLDS · CO-OP",Accent=Color3.fromRGB(129,207,216),FooterHeight=64})
 Widgets.List(window.Content,12)
 Widgets.Button(window.Footer,{Name="Return",Text="RETURN TO THE CITY",Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,44),OnClick=function()self:Go("Plaza")end})
 for index,world in Config.Worlds do

  Widgets.Label(card,{Name="Description",Text=world.Description,Position=UDim2.fromOffset(14,42),Size=UDim2.new(1,-28,0,42),MaxSize=15,Color=Theme.Colors.White})

  Widgets.Label(card,{Name="Rules",Text="FREE ACCESS · Damage balanced for mixed-level teams",Position=UDim2.fromOffset(14,116),Size=UDim2.new(1,-28,0,24),MaxSize=13,Color=Theme.Colors.Muted})
  Widgets.Label(card,{Name="Status",Text="",Position=UDim2.fromOffset(14,143),Size=UDim2.new(1,-28,0,21),MaxSize=14,Color=world.Color})
  Widgets.Button(card,{Name="Main",Text="TRAVEL",Size=UDim2.new(.64,-18,0,44),Position=UDim2.fromOffset(14,172),OnClick=function()
   local current=self:CurrentWorld()local s=self.States:FindFirstChild(world.Id)
   if not current or current.Id~=world.Id then self:Go(world.Id)
   else
    local phase=s and s:GetAttribute("Phase")
    if (phase=="Ready"or phase=="Complete")and (s:GetAttribute("ReadyAt")or 0)<=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()then Net.Remote("ExpeditionAction"):FireServer("Start",world.Id)end
    self.Controllers.PanelController:Close("Expeditions")
   end
  end})
  Widgets.Button(card,{Name="Rally",Text="JOIN TEAM",Variant="Secondary",Size=UDim2.new(.36,-18,0,44),Position=UDim2.new(.64,4,0,172),OnClick=function()
   local current=self:CurrentWorld()
   if current and current.Id==world.Id then Net.Remote("ExpeditionAction"):FireServer("Rally",world.Id)else self:Go(world.Id)end
  end})
 end
 self.Controllers.PanelController:Register("Expeditions",window.Gui,{OnOpen=function()self:Refresh()end})
 local function add(p)if p:IsA("BasePart")then animated[p]=p.CFrame end end
 for _,p in CollectionService:GetTagged("ExpeditionAnimated")do add(p)end
 CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal("ExpeditionAnimated"):Connect(add)
 CollectionService:GetInstanceRemovedSignal("ExpeditionAnimated"):Connect(function(p)animated[p]=nil end)
 local elapsed=0 local animationElapsed=0
 RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
  elapsed+=dt animationElapsed+=dt
  if animationElapsed>=1/30 then animationElapsed=0 self:Animate()end
  if elapsed>=.15 then elapsed=0 self:UpdateHazards()if self.Controllers.PanelController:IsOpen("Expeditions")then self:Refresh()end end
 end)
 player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()for id in pairs(hazards)do self:ClearHazards(id)end end)
 self:Refresh()

local controllersFolder = script.Parent:WaitForChild("Controllers")

local controllers = {}
local ordered = {}

local function report(name, stage)
	return function(err)
		warn(string.format("[%s] %s failed: %s\n%s", name, stage, tostring(err), debug.traceback()))
	end
end

for _, module in ipairs(controllersFolder:GetChildren()) do
	if module:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		local ok, controller = xpcall(require, report(module.Name, "require"), module)
		if ok and type(controller) == "table" then
			controllers[module.Name] = controller
			table.insert(ordered, { Name = module.Name, Controller = controller })
		end
	end
end

table.sort(ordered, function(a, b)
	local left, right = a.Controller.Priority or 100, b.Controller.Priority or 100
	if left == right then
		return a.Name < b.Name
	end
	return left < right
end)

for _, entry in ipairs(ordered) do
	if type(entry.Controller.Init) == "function" then
		xpcall(entry.Controller.Init, report(entry.Name, "Init"), entry.Controller, controllers)
	end
end

for _, entry in ipairs(ordered) do
	if type(entry.Controller.Start) == "function" then
		task.spawn(xpcall, entry.Controller.Start, report(entry.Name, "Start"), entry.Controller)
	end
end
