local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local ThemeConfig = require(Shared.Config.ThemeConfig)
local Net = require(Shared.Modules.Net)
local Formulas = require(Shared.Modules.Formulas)
local Format = require(Shared.Modules.Format)
local Components = script.Parent.Parent:WaitForChild("Components")
local UIKit = require(Components.UIKit)
local Widgets = require(Components.Widgets)

local Colors = ThemeConfig.Colors
local Fonts = ThemeConfig.Fonts
local FINAL_STEP = 7
local WRECK_GOAL = 10

local STEPS = {
	{ Verb = "GRAB YOUR TOOL", Hint = "Press 1 or tap the hammer in your hotbar", Icon = "ToolScrapHammer" },
	{ Verb = "BREAK SOMETHING", Hint = "Follow the arrow. Hold WRECK to keep hitting", Icon = "NavTools" },
	{ Verb = "GET CASH", Hint = "Wreck objects to earn Cash, then use it to upgrade your damage", Icon = "Cash" },
	{ Verb = "UPGRADE", Hint = "Open UPGRADES and buy DAMAGE for 25 Cash", Icon = "NavUpgrades" },
	{ Verb = "WRECK MORE", Hint = "Wreck 10 objects", Icon = "StatExplosion" },
	{ Verb = "PLAY YOUR WAY", Hint = "Open PLAY. Choose free wrecking, exploring or an optional challenge", Icon = "NavTools" },
}

local function upgradeHint(controllers)
	local price = Formulas.UpgradePrice("Damage", 0)
	local cash = controllers.DataController:Get("Cash") or 0
	if cash < price then
		return "Wreck small objects for " .. Format.Number(price - cash) .. " more Cash, then buy DAMAGE"
	end
	return "Open UPGRADES > DAMAGE: " .. Format.Number(price) .. " Cash"
end

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local OnboardingController = { Priority = 50 }

local card = nil
local arrow = nil
local currentStep = nil
local wrecks = 0
local cashCollected = false
local sent = {}
local skipping = false

local function buildCard()
	local gui = Widgets.ScreenGui("OnboardingUI", 9, true)
	card = Widgets.Card(gui, { Name = "StepCard", Color = Colors.Dark, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(330, 112), StrokeColor = Colors.Orange, Accent = Colors.Orange })
	card.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
	card.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -104)
	card.Visible = false
	Widgets.AutoScale(card)
	local badge = UIKit.Create("Frame", { Name = "StepBadge", BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Orange, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(56, 56), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 14), Parent = card })
	Widgets.Corner(badge, UDim.new(1, 0))
	Widgets.Icon(badge, "NavTools", { Name = "StepIcon", Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.7, 0.7), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), FallbackColor = Colors.White })
	Widgets.Label(card, { Name = "StepNumber", Font = Fonts.Number, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(60, 20), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 74), AlignX = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, MaxSize = 14, Color = Colors.Muted })
	local verb = Widgets.Label(card, { Name = "Verb", Font = Fonts.Display, Size = UDim2.new(1, -96, 0, 36), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(86, 10), MaxSize = 32, Color = Colors.Orange, Stroke = 1.5 })
	verb.Rotation = ThemeConfig.Slant / 2
	Widgets.Label(card, { Name = "Hint", Font = Fonts.Body, Size = UDim2.new(1, -96, 0, 34), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(86, 46), MaxSize = 15, Color = Colors.White })
	local dots = UIKit.Create("Frame", { Name = "Dots", BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, -170, 0, 12), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(86, 88), Parent = card })
	local layout = Widgets.List(dots, 6, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal)
	layout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left
	for index = 1, #STEPS do
		local dot = UIKit.Create("Frame", { Name = "Dot" .. index, BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Stroke, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 8), LayoutOrder = index, Parent = dots })
		Widgets.Corner(dot, UDim.new(1, 0))
	end
	Widgets.Button(card, { Name = "Skip", Text = "SKIP", Variant = "Secondary", Size = UDim2.fromOffset(64, 44), Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 1, -8), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1), MaxSize = 14, OnClick = function()
		OnboardingController:Skip()
	end })
end

local function buildArrow()
	local start = Instance.new("Attachment")
	start.Name = "GuideStart"
	local finish = Instance.new("Attachment")
	finish.Name = "GuideEnd"
	finish.Parent = workspace.Terrain
	local beam = Instance.new("Beam")
	beam.Name = "GuideBeam"
	beam.Attachment0 = start
	beam.Attachment1 = finish
	beam.Color = ColorSequence.new(Colors.Yellow, Colors.Orange)
	beam.LightEmission = 1
	beam.LightInfluence = 0
	beam.FaceCamera = true
	beam.Width0 = 0.9
	beam.Width1 = 0.2
	beam.Segments = 12
	beam.CurveSize0 = 6
	beam.CurveSize1 = -3
	beam.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
	beam.TextureMode = Enum.TextureMode.Wrap
	beam.TextureLength = 3
	beam.TextureSpeed = 1
	beam.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.1)
	beam.Enabled = false
	beam.Parent = finish
	local marker = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	marker.Name = "GuideMarker"
	marker.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 50)
	marker.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
	marker.AlwaysOnTop = true
	marker.LightInfluence = 0
	marker.Enabled = false
	marker.Parent = finish
	local label = Widgets.Label(marker, { Name = "Callout", Text = "SMASH IT!", Font = Fonts.Display, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), AlignX = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, MaxSize = 32, Color = Colors.Yellow, Stroke = 2 })
	UIKit.Create("UIScale", { Name = "Pulse", Parent = label })
	arrow = { Start = start, Finish = finish, Beam = beam, Marker = marker }
end

local function nearestTarget()
	local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then
		return nil
	end
	local best, bestDistance = nil, math.huge
	local fallback, fallbackDistance = nil, math.huge
	for _, model in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("Destructible")) do
		if model:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and model:GetAttribute("Alive") ~= false and model:GetAttribute("Zone") == "ScrapYard" then
			local distance = (model:GetPivot().Position - root.Position).Magnitude
			if distance < fallbackDistance then
				fallback, fallbackDistance = model, distance
			end
			if (model:GetAttribute("MaxHealth") or math.huge) <= 70 and distance < bestDistance then
				best, bestDistance = model, distance
			end
		end
	end
	return best or fallback
end

function OnboardingController:Init(controllers)
	self.Controllers = controllers
end

function OnboardingController:Start()
	local controllers = self.Controllers
	buildCard()
	buildArrow()
	local function visibility()
		card.Visible = currentStep ~= nil and not skipping and not controllers.PanelController:IsAnyOpen()
	end
	controllers.PanelController.Opened:Connect(visibility)
	controllers.PanelController.Closed:Connect(visibility)
	local function arrange()
		card.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, controllers.InputController:IsTouch() and -64 or -104)
	end
	controllers.InputController.InputChanged:Connect(arrange)
	arrange()

	controllers.DataController:Observe("Tutorial", function(tutorial)
		if type(tutorial) == "table" then
			self:Show(tutorial.Completed and FINAL_STEP or tutorial.Step)
		end
	end)

	local function watchCharacter(character)
		character.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
			if child:IsA("Tool") and currentStep == 1 then
				self:Complete(1)
			end
		end)
		local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
		if root and player.Character == character then
			arrow.Start:Destroy()
			arrow.Start = Instance.new("Attachment")
			arrow.Start.Name = "GuideStart"
			arrow.Start.Parent = root
			arrow.Beam.Attachment0 = arrow.Start
		end
	end
	if player.Character then
		task.spawn(watchCharacter, player.Character)
	end
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(watchCharacter)

	Net.Remote("RewardFx").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(payload)
		if not payload.Counted then
			return
		end
		if (tonumber(payload.Cash) or 0) > 0 then
			cashCollected = true
			if currentStep == 3 then
				self:Complete(3)
			end
		end
		if currentStep == 2 then
			self:Complete(2)
		elseif currentStep == 5 then
			wrecks += 1
			card.Hint.Text = "Wreck " .. WRECK_GOAL .. " objects  (" .. wrecks .. "/" .. WRECK_GOAL .. ")"
			if wrecks >= WRECK_GOAL then
				self:Complete(5)
			end
		end
	end)

	controllers.DataController:Observe("Cash", function()
		if currentStep == 4 then
			card.Hint.Text = upgradeHint(controllers)
		end
	end)

	controllers.DataController:Observe("Upgrades", function(upgrades)
		if currentStep == 4 and type(upgrades) == "table" and (upgrades.Damage or 0) > 0 then
			self:Complete(4)
		end
	end)

	controllers.PanelController.Opened:Connect(function(name)
		if currentStep == 6 and name == "Activities" then
			self:Complete(6)
		end
	end)

	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(0.5)
			self:UpdateArrow()
		end
	end)
end

function OnboardingController:Show(step)
	if step >= FINAL_STEP then
		currentStep = nil
		card.Visible = false
		arrow.Beam.Enabled = false
		arrow.Marker.Enabled = false
		return
	end
	if step == currentStep then
		return
	end
	currentStep = step
	local info = STEPS[step]
	card.Visible = not skipping and not self.Controllers.PanelController:IsAnyOpen()
	card.Verb.Text = info.Verb
	card.Hint.Text = info.Hint
	card.StepNumber.Text = step .. " / " .. #STEPS
	UIKit.SetIcon(card.StepBadge.StepIcon, info.Icon, tostring(step))
	for index = 1, #STEPS do
		card.Dots["Dot" .. index].BackgroundColor3 = index < step and Colors.Yellow or index == step and Colors.Orange or Colors.Stroke
	end
	UIKit.Pop(card.Verb, 1.3)
	if step == 3 then
		if cashCollected then
			task.delay(0.5, self.Complete, self, 3)
		end
	elseif step == 1 then
		local character = player.Character
		if character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") then
			task.delay(0.5, self.Complete, self, 1)
		end
	elseif step == 5 then
		wrecks = 0
	elseif step == 4 then
		card.Hint.Text = upgradeHint(self.Controllers)
		local upgrades = self.Controllers.DataController:Get("Upgrades") or {}
		if (upgrades.Damage or 0) > 0 then
			task.delay(0.5, self.Complete, self, 4)
		end
	end
end

function OnboardingController:Complete(step)
	if currentStep ~= step or sent[step] then
		return
	end
	sent[step] = true
	self.Controllers.SoundController:Play("Quest")
	local check = card.StepBadge
	check.BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Yellow
	UIKit.Pop(check, 1.4)
	task.delay(0.35, function()

function OnboardingController:Skip()
	if not currentStep then
		return
	end
	local from = currentStep
	skipping = true
	currentStep = nil
	card.Visible = false
	task.spawn(function()
		for step = from + 1, FINAL_STEP do
			Net.Remote("TutorialProgress"):FireServer(step)
			task.wait(0.25)

	end)

	local needsCash = currentStep == 4 and (self.Controllers.DataController:Get("Cash") or 0) < Formulas.UpgradePrice("Damage", 0)

 arrow.Beam.TextureSpeed=low and 0 or 1
 arrow.Beam.Enabled = target ~= nil and arrow.Start.Parent ~= nil

	if target then

local function eggTemplate(eggId)

local function frame(parent, size)
	local view = Instance.new("ViewportFrame")
	view.Name = "Preview"
	view.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	view.Size = size
	view.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 180)

local function frameModel(view, model, distanceScale)
	model.Parent = view
	local cframe, size = model:GetBoundingBox()
	local radius = size.Magnitude / 2
	local camera = Instance.new("Camera")
	camera.FieldOfView = 38
	local eye = cframe.Position + Vector3.new(radius * 1.3, radius * 0.9, -radius * 2.3) * (distanceScale or 1)
	camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(eye, cframe.Position)
	camera.Parent = view
	view.CurrentCamera = camera
end

function Preview.Pet(parent, template, size)
	local view = frame(parent, size)

function Preview.Egg(parent, color, accent, size, eggId)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local Net = require(Shared.Modules.Net)
local Panel = require(script.Panel)
local Preview = require(script.Preview)

local SLOTS = { Vector3.new(-3.4, 0, 3.2), Vector3.new(3.4, 0, 3.2), Vector3.new(0, 0, 5.6) }
local HOVER = 0.35
local FOLLOW_SHARPNESS = 8
local R6_HIP = 2

local PetController = { Priority = 51 }

local rendered = {}
local folder = nil
local templates = nil

local function liftOf(model)
	local box, size = model:GetBoundingBox()
	return model:GetPivot().Position.Y - (box.Position.Y - size.Y / 2)
end

local function groundBelow(character, root)
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid then
		return root.Position.Y - 3
	end
	local hip = if humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 then R6_HIP else humanoid.HipHeight
	return root.Position.Y - hip - root.Size.Y / 2
end

local function clear(entry)
	for _, pet in ipairs(entry.Pets) do
		pet.Model:Destroy()
	end
end

local function rebuild(player)
	local key = player:GetAttribute("EquippedPets") or ""
	local entry = rendered[player]
	if entry and entry.Key == key then
		return
	end
	if entry then
		clear(entry)
	end
	entry = { Key = key, Pets = {} }
	local slot = 0
	for petId in string.gmatch(key, "[^,]+") do
		local template = templates:FindFirstChild(petId)
		if template and slot < #SLOTS then
			slot += 1
			local clone = template:Clone()
			clone.Name = player.Name .. "_" .. petId
			clone.Parent = folder
			table.insert(entry.Pets, { Model = clone, Slot = slot, Phase = math.random() * math.pi * 2, Lift = liftOf(clone) })
		end
	end
	rendered[player] = entry
end

local function track(player)
	rebuild(player)
	player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("EquippedPets"):Connect(function()
		rebuild(player)
	end)
end

function PetController:Init(controllers)
	self.Controllers = controllers
end

function PetController:Start()
	templates = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Assets"):WaitForChild("Pets")
	folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "Pets"
	folder.Parent = workspace:WaitForChild("ClientEffects")

	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		track(player)
	end
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(track)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		local entry = rendered[player]
		if entry then
			clear(entry)
			rendered[player] = nil
		end
	end)

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
		local now = os.clock()
		local alpha = 1 - math.exp(-FOLLOW_SHARPNESS * deltaTime)
		for player, entry in pairs(rendered) do
			local character = player.Character
			local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if root then
				local _, yaw = root.CFrame:ToOrientation()
				local base = CFrame.new(root.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)
				local ground = groundBelow(character, root)
				for _, pet in ipairs(entry.Pets) do
					local bob = math.sin(now * 3 + pet.Phase) * HOVER
					local spot = (base * CFrame.new(SLOTS[pet.Slot])).Position
					local target = Vector3.new(spot.X, ground + pet.Lift + HOVER + bob, spot.Z)
					local current = pet.Position or target
					local position = current:Lerp(target, alpha)
					pet.Position = position
					local sway = math.sin(now * 2 + pet.Phase) * 0.07
					pet.Model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(position) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, sway))
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	Panel.Setup(self.Controllers, templates)
	Net.Remote("PetFx").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(kind, data)
		if kind == "Hatch" and type(data) == "table" then
			Panel.PlayHatch(data.Egg, data.Pet)
		end
	end)

	local hud = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"):WaitForChild("MainUI", 20)
	local button = hud and hud:FindFirstChild("PetsButton", true)
	if button then
		local glyph = button:FindFirstChild("Glyph")
		if glyph then
			glyph.Visible = false
		end
		local view = Preview.Pet(button, templates:FindFirstChild("VoidKitten"), UDim2.fromScale(0.78, 0.7))
		view.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.36)
		view.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	end
end

return PetController

	local controllers = self.Controllers

	Widgets.List(window.Content, 8)
	local order = 0
	for _, board in ipairs(LeaderboardConfig.Boards) do
		order += 1
		Widgets.Tab(window.Tabs, { Name = board.Id .. "Tab", Text = string.gsub(board.Name, "TOP ", ""), Order = order, Width = 118, OnClick = function()
			tab = board.Id
			self:Refresh()
		end })
	end
	Widgets.Tab(window.Tabs, { Name = "ServerTab", Text = "SERVER", Order = order + 1, Width = 118, OnClick = function()
		tab = "Server"
		self:Refresh()
	end })
	Widgets.Button(window.Footer, {
		Name = "Visit",
		Text = "VISIT THE HALL OF WRECKERS",
		Variant = "Accent",
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		MaxSize = 20,
		OnClick = function()
			Net.Remote("Travel"):FireServer("Hall")
			controllers.PanelController:Close("Leaderboard")
		end,
	})
	controllers.PanelController:Register("Leaderboard", window.Gui, {
		OnOpen = function()
			self:Refresh()
		end,
	})
	Net.Remote("LeaderboardSync").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(snapshot)
		if type(snapshot) == "table" then
			boards = snapshot
			if controllers.PanelController:IsOpen("Leaderboard") and tab ~= "Server" then
				self:Refresh()
			end
		end
	end)
	local function serverChanged()
		if tab == "Server" and controllers.PanelController:IsOpen("Leaderboard") then
			self:Refresh()
		end
	end
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(serverChanged)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function()
		task.defer(serverChanged)
	end)

function LeaderboardController:Refresh()
	Widgets.Clear(window.Content)
	for _, button in ipairs(window.Tabs:GetChildren()) do
		if button:IsA("TextButton") then
			Widgets.SetVariant(button, button.Name == tab .. "Tab" and "Primary" or "Secondary")
		end
	end
	if tab == "Server" then
		local list = {}
		for _, other in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			local stats = other:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
			local cash = stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Cash")
			local rebirths = stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Rebirths")
			table.insert(list, { Player = other, Cash = cash and cash.Value or "0", Rebirths = rebirths and rebirths.Value or 0 })
		end
		table.sort(list, function(a, b)
			return a.Rebirths > b.Rebirths
		end)
		for index, entry in ipairs(list) do
			row(index, entry.Player.UserId, entry.Player.DisplayName, entry.Cash .. " CASH  |  " .. entry.Rebirths .. " RB", Colors.Cyan)
		end
		return
	end
	local board = nil
	for _, candidate in ipairs(LeaderboardConfig.Boards) do
		if candidate.Id == tab then
			board = candidate
		end
	end
	local rows = boards[tab] or {}
	if #rows == 0 then
		Widgets.Label(window.Content, { Name = "Empty", Text = "Rankings are loading...", Font = Fonts.Body, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40), AlignX = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, MaxSize = 18, Color = Colors.Muted })
		return
	end
	for index, entry in ipairs(rows) do
		row(index, entry.UserId, entry.Name, Format.Number(entry.Value), board and board.Color or Colors.Yellow)
	end
end

return LeaderboardController

local function now()return workspace:GetServerTimeNow()end
local function aliveRoot(player)
 local c=player.Character local h=c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

end
function Service:InWorld(player,id)
 local root=aliveRoot(player)

function Service:Publish(r)
 local folder=r.State

 local count=0 for _,p in Players:GetPlayers()do if self:InWorld(p,r.Def.Id)then count+=1 end end

 if r.Phase=="Ready"then objective="EXPLORE OR LAUNCH AN ENCOUNTER"
 elseif r.Phase=="Shield"then objective=r.Def.Mechanic=="Beacons"and "HOLD E / TAP THE THREE BEACONS"or "BREAK THE POWER NODES"
 elseif r.Phase=="Active"then objective=r.Def.Mechanic=="Coolant"and "CORE OPEN · STRIKE BEFORE IT CLOSES"or "CORE OPEN · HIT THE BOSS, WATCH THE FLOOR"
 else objective="BOSS DEFEATED · YOUR CONTRIBUTION COUNTS"end
 for k,v in pairs({Phase=r.Phase,Objective=objective,Nodes=r.NodesDone,Goal=r.Def.Nodes,Health=boss and boss.Health or 0,MaxHealth=boss and boss.MaxHealth or 1,ReadyAt=r.ReadyAt,WindowEnds=r.WindowEnds or 0,Players=count,AttackAt=r.AttackAt or 0,AttackKind=r.AttackKind or "",AttackAxis=r.AttackAxis or 0,Enraged=r.Enraged==true})do folder:SetAttribute(k,v)end
 local world=self.WorldFolder:FindFirstChild(r.Def.Id)
 local display=world and world:FindFirstChild("EncounterBoard")and world.EncounterBoard:FindFirstChild("Display")
 if display then
  display.Heading.Text=r.Def.BossName
  display.Detail.Text=objective.."\n"..(r.Phase=="Shield"and (r.NodesDone.." / "..r.Def.Nodes.." · ")or "")..count.." EXPLORERS · ALL TOOLS CAN HELP"
 end

function Service:GetRecord(id)return records[id]end
function Service:Contribute(player,r)
 if not self.Data:IsLoaded(player)or not self:InWorld(player,r.Def.Id)then return end
 local item=r.Contributors[player.UserId]or {Actions=0,Last=0}
 item.Actions+=1 item.Last=now()r.Contributors[player.UserId]=item

 for uid in pairs(r.Targets)do uidWorld[uid]=nil X:Despawn(uid)end

 r.WindowEnds=0
 local world=self.WorldFolder and self.WorldFolder:FindFirstChild(r.Def.Id)

 r.Phase="Shield"r.NodesDone=0 r.Beacons={}r.WindowEnds=0 r.AttackAt=0 r.AttackKind=""
 local X=self.Services.DestructionService local boss=X:GetEntry(r.BossUid)

 for uid,kind in pairs(r.Targets)do if kind=="Node"then uidWorld[uid]=nil r.Targets[uid]=nil X:Despawn(uid)end end
 for i=1,r.Def.Nodes do

function Service:OpenCore(r)

 r.Phase="Active"r.NextAttack=now()+4

 local boss=self.Services.DestructionService:GetEntry(r.BossUid)

function Service:StartEncounter(player,id)
 local r=records[id]
 if not r or not self:InWorld(player,id)or not self.Data:IsLoaded(player)then return false end
 if r.Phase~="Ready"and r.Phase~="Complete"then Notifier.Error(player,"THIS ENCOUNTER IS ALREADY RUNNING")return false end
 if now()<r.ReadyAt then Notifier.Error(player,"EXPLORE WHILE THE ARENA RECOVERS")return false end
 self:RemoveTargets(r)
 r.Generation+=1 r.Contributors={}r.Rewarded={}r.Enraged=false r.LastOccupied=now()r.AttackAt=0 r.AttackKind=""

function Service:ActivateBeacon(player,id,index)

function Service:OnWreck(entry,credits)

  r.NodesDone+=1

function Service:Finish(r)

 local boss=self.Services.DestructionService:GetEntry(r.BossUid)

function Service:ResolveHazard(r)
 local c=Config.BossPosition(r.Def)
 for _,p in Players:GetPlayers()do
  local root=aliveRoot(p)
  if root and self:InWorld(p,r.Def.Id)then
   local offset=root.Position-c local distance=Vector2.new(offset.X,offset.Z).Magnitude
   local hit=false
   if r.AttackKind=="Disc"then hit=distance<29
   elseif r.AttackKind=="Lane"then hit=distance<90 and math.abs(r.AttackAxis==0 and offset.X or offset.Z)<9
   elseif r.AttackKind=="Ring"then hit=distance>22 and distance<57 end
   if hit and root.Position.Y<7 then
    local h=p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if h then h:TakeDamage(r.Enraged and 20 or 15)end
   end
  end
 end
 r.AttackAt=0 r.AttackKind=""r.NextAttack=now()+(r.Enraged and 4 or 7)
 self:Publish(r)
end
function Service:Tick(r)
 local stamp=now()
 if r.Phase=="Complete"then if stamp>=r.ReadyAt then r.Phase="Ready"self:Publish(r)end return end
 if r.Phase~="Shield"and r.Phase~="Active"then return end
 local boss=r.BossUid and self.Services.DestructionService:GetEntry(r.BossUid)
 if not boss then self:RemoveTargets(r)r.Phase="Ready"r.AttackAt=0 r.AttackKind=""self:Publish(r)return end
 local occupied=false for _,p in Players:GetPlayers()do if self:InWorld(p,r.Def.Id)then occupied=true break end end
 if occupied then r.LastOccupied=stamp
 elseif stamp-r.LastOccupied>=Config.IdleTimeout then
  self:RemoveTargets(r)r.Phase="Ready"r.AttackAt=0 r.AttackKind=""self:Publish(r)return
 end
 if r.Phase=="Active"then
  if r.WindowEnds>0 and stamp>=r.WindowEnds then self:MakeNodes(r)return end
  if r.AttackAt>0 then if stamp>=r.AttackAt then self:ResolveHazard(r)end
  elseif stamp>=r.NextAttack and occupied then
   r.AttackKind=r.Def.Attack r.AttackAxis=(r.AttackAxis+1)%2 r.AttackAt=stamp+1.8 self:Publish(r)
  end
 end
end
function Service:Rally(player,id)
 local r=records[id]
 if not r or not self:InWorld(player,id)then return false end
 local stamp=now()if stamp-(rallyAt[player]or -100)<30 then return false end rallyAt[player]=stamp
 for _,p in Players:GetPlayers()do
  if p~=player and self.Data:IsLoaded(p)then
   Notifier.Send(p,{Kind="Info",Text="CO-OP RALLY · "..r.Def.Name,Subtext="Open WORLDS to join the expedition.",Icon=r.Def.Icon})

 local remote=RS.Remotes:FindFirstChild("ExpeditionAction")or Instance.new("RemoteEvent")remote.Name="ExpeditionAction"remote.Parent=RS.Remotes

  local state=states:FindFirstChild(def.Id)or Instance.new("Folder")state.Name=def.Id state.Parent=states
  records[def.Id]={Def=def,State=state,Phase="Ready",Generation=0,NodesDone=0,Targets={},Contributors={},Rewarded={},Beacons={},ReadyAt=0,AttackAt=0,AttackAxis=0,WindowEnds=0}
 end

   self:Contribute(player,r)

   self:Publish(r)

 end)

end

 self.WorldFolder=Builder.Build()

  if prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt")and prompt:GetAttribute("ExpeditionAction")then
   if prompt:GetAttribute("ExpeditionAction")=="Beacon"then prompt.Enabled=false end
   prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
    local root=aliveRoot(player)local parent=prompt.Parent
    if not root or not parent:IsA("BasePart")or (root.Position-parent.Position).Magnitude>17 then return end
    local id=prompt:GetAttribute("ExpeditionWorld")local action=prompt:GetAttribute("ExpeditionAction")
    if action=="Start"then self:StartEncounter(player,id)
    elseif action=="Return"then self.Services.ZoneService:Travel(player,"Plaza")
    elseif action=="Beacon"then self:ActivateBeacon(player,id,prompt:GetAttribute("BeaconIndex"))end
   end)
  end
 end

  if type(action)~="string"or type(id)~="string"or not Config.ById[id]then return end

 end)
 Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)rallyAt[player]=nil end)
 task.spawn(function()
  local elapsed=0
  while true do task.wait(.15)elapsed+=.15
   for _,r in pairs(records)do self:Tick(r)if elapsed>=1 then self:Publish(r)end end
   if elapsed>=1 then elapsed=0 end
  end
 end)
end
return Service

local Geometry = {}

function Geometry.Distance(entry, point)
	local localPoint = entry.BoxCFrame:PointToObjectSpace(point)
	local half = entry.Size / 2
	local dx = math.max(math.abs(localPoint.X) - half.X, 0)
	local dy = math.max(math.abs(localPoint.Y) - half.Y, 0)
	local dz = math.max(math.abs(localPoint.Z) - half.Z, 0)
	return math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz)
end

function Geometry.ClosestPoint(entry, point)
	if not point then
		return entry.Position
	end
	local localPoint = entry.BoxCFrame:PointToObjectSpace(point)
	local half = entry.Size / 2
	local clamped = Vector3.new(
		math.clamp(localPoint.X, -half.X, half.X),
		math.clamp(localPoint.Y, -half.Y, half.Y),
		math.clamp(localPoint.Z, -half.Z, half.Z)
	)
	return entry.BoxCFrame:PointToWorldSpace(clamped)
end

function Geometry.BuildFallback(def)
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = def.Id

	local body = Instance.new("Part")
	body.Name = "Body"
	body.Size = def.Size
	body.Color = def.Primary
	body.Material = Enum.Material.DiamondPlate
	body.Anchored = true
	body.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, def.Size.Y / 2, 0)
	body.Parent = model

	local band = Instance.new("Part")
	band.Name = "GlowBand"
	band.Size = Vector3.new(def.Size.X + 0.2, math.max(def.Size.Y * 0.12, 0.4), def.Size.Z + 0.2)
	band.Color = def.Secondary
	band.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	band.Anchored = true
	band.CanCollide = false
	band.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, def.Size.Y * 0.6, 0)
	band.Parent = model

	model.PrimaryPart = body
	model.WorldPivot = CFrame.new()
	return model
end

return Geometry

		highlight.Adornee = target
		highlight.OutlineColor = color
		highlight.Enabled = true
	end)

local CHECK_INTERVAL = 0.5
local BLEND = TweenInfo.new(1.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)
local TINT_STRENGTH = 0.1
local HAZE_STRENGTH = 0.18

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local AmbienceController = { Priority = 60 }

local grade = nil
local atmosphere = nil
local baseHaze = nil
local current = false

function AmbienceController:Start()
	grade = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
	grade.Name = "ZoneGrade"
	grade.Parent = Lighting
	atmosphere = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
	baseHaze = atmosphere and atmosphere.Color

	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(CHECK_INTERVAL)
			local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local zoneId = root and ZoneConfig.ZoneAt(root.Position) or nil
			if zoneId ~= current then
				current = zoneId
				self:Blend(zoneId and ZoneConfig.ById[zoneId])
			end
		end
	end)
end

function AmbienceController:Blend(zone)
	local white = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	local tint = zone and white:Lerp(zone.Color, TINT_STRENGTH) or white
	TweenService:Create(grade, BLEND, { TintColor = tint, Saturation = zone and 0.06 or 0 }):Play()
	if atmosphere and baseHaze then
		local haze = zone and baseHaze:Lerp(zone.Accent or zone.Color, HAZE_STRENGTH) or baseHaze
		TweenService:Create(atmosphere, BLEND, { Color = haze }):Play()
	end
end

return AmbienceController

local function gateOf(zoneId)
	local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
	if not map then
		return nil
	end
	if zoneId == "VIP" then
		local area = map:FindFirstChild("VIPArea")
		return area and area:FindFirstChild("Gate")
	end
	local zones = map:FindFirstChild("Zones")
	local zone = zones and zones:FindFirstChild(zoneId)
	return zone and zone:FindFirstChild("Gate")
end

local function setStatus(gate, unlocked, color)
	local sign = gate:FindFirstChild("Sign")
	local display = sign and sign:FindFirstChild("Display")
	local status = display and display:FindFirstChild("Status", true)
	if status and status:IsA("TextLabel") then
		status.Text = unlocked and "UNLOCKED" or "LOCKED"
		status.TextColor3 = unlocked and color or Colors.Red
	end
end

function WorldController:Init(controllers)
	self.Controllers = controllers
end

function WorldController:Start()
	local dataController = self.Controllers.DataController
	dataController:Observe("Zones", function()
		self:Refresh()
	end)
	dataController:Observe("Rebirths", function()
		Locks.Refresh()
	end)
	dataController:ObserveSession("Passes", function()
		self:Refresh()
	end)
	local function watch(map)
		map.DescendantAdded:Connect(function()
			if not pendingRefresh then
				pendingRefresh = true
				task.delay(1, function()
					pendingRefresh = false
					self:Refresh()
				end)
			end
		end)
	end
	Locks.Setup(self)
	local map = workspace:WaitForChild("Map", 30)
	if map then
		watch(map)
	end
	self:Refresh()
end

function WorldController:IsUnlocked(zoneId)
 if ZoneConfig.ById[zoneId]and ZoneConfig.ById[zoneId].FreeAccess then return true end
	local dataController = self.Controllers.DataController
	if zoneId == "ScrapYard" then
		return true
	end
	if zoneId == "VIP" then
		local passes = dataController:GetSession("Passes") or {}
		return passes[ZoneConfig.VIP.RequiredPass] == true
	end
	local zones = dataController:Get("Zones") or {}
	return zones[zoneId] == true
end

function WorldController:LockedZoneFor(model)
	local zoneId = model:GetAttribute("Zone")
	if zoneId and not self:IsUnlocked(zoneId) then
		return zoneId
	end
	local def = DestructibleConfig.ById[model:GetAttribute("Type")]
	local tier = def and def.TierZone
	if tier and tier ~= zoneId and not self:IsUnlocked(tier) then
		return tier
	end
	return nil
end

function WorldController:LockText(zoneId)
	if zoneId == "VIP" then
		return "NEEDS THE VIP PASS"
	end
	local zone = ZoneConfig.ById[zoneId]
	if not zone then
		return "LOCKED"
	end
	local rebirths = self.Controllers.DataController:Get("Rebirths") or 0
	if rebirths < (zone.RequiredRebirths or 0) then
		return "NEEDS " .. zone.RequiredRebirths .. " REBIRTHS, THEN UNLOCK " .. zone.Name
	end
	return "UNLOCK " .. zone.Name .. " IN ZONES (" .. Format.Number(zone.UnlockCost or 0) .. " CASH)"
end

function WorldController:Refresh()
	if not self.Controllers.DataController:IsLoaded() then
		return
	end
	local ids = {}
	for _, zone in ipairs(ZoneConfig.List) do
		table.insert(ids, zone.Id)
	end
	table.insert(ids, "VIP")
	for _, zoneId in ipairs(ids) do
		local gate = gateOf(zoneId)
		if gate then
			local unlocked = self:IsUnlocked(zoneId)
			local barrier = gate:FindFirstChild("Barrier")
			if barrier and barrier:IsA("BasePart") then
				if barrier:GetAttribute("BaseTransparency") == nil then
					barrier:SetAttribute("BaseTransparency", barrier.Transparency)
				end
				barrier.CanCollide = not unlocked
				barrier.CanQuery = not unlocked
				barrier.Transparency = unlocked and 1 or barrier:GetAttribute("BaseTransparency")
			end
			local zone = ZoneConfig.ById[zoneId]
			setStatus(gate, unlocked, zone and zone.Color or Colors.White)
		end
	end
	Locks.Refresh()
end

return WorldController

function Panel.Refresh()
	local dataController = controllers.DataController
	local data = dataController:GetAll()
	if not data or not window then
		return
	end
	Widgets.Clear(window.Content)
	local grid = window.Content:FindFirstChild("Grid")
	for _, button in ipairs(window.Tabs:GetChildren()) do
		if button:IsA("TextButton") then
			Widgets.SetVariant(button, button.Name == tab .. "Tab" and "Primary" or "Secondary")
		end
	end
	local bonuses = Formulas.PetBonuses(data)
	local owned = data.Pets or {}
	local count = 0
	for _ in pairs(owned) do
		count += 1
	end
	window.Footer.Summary.Value.Text = "EQUIPPED " .. #data.EquippedPets .. "/" .. PetConfig.MaxEquipped .. "   +" .. Format.Percent(bonuses.Cash) .. " CASH  +" .. Format.Percent(bonuses.Damage) .. " DMG"

	if tab == "Pets" then
		grid.CellSize = UDim2.new(1 / 3, -10, 0, 196)
		local uids = {}
		for uid in pairs(owned) do
			table.insert(uids, uid)
		end
		table.sort(uids, function(a, b)
			local equippedA = table.find(data.EquippedPets, a) ~= nil
			local equippedB = table.find(data.EquippedPets, b) ~= nil
			if equippedA ~= equippedB then
				return equippedA
			end
			return Formulas.PetScore(owned[a]) > Formulas.PetScore(owned[b])
		end)
		for index, uid in ipairs(uids) do
			petCard(uid, owned[uid], table.find(data.EquippedPets, uid) ~= nil, index)
		end
		Widgets.Label(window.Content, { Name = "Capacity", Text = count .. " / " .. PetConfig.InventoryLimit .. " PETS", Font = Fonts.Number, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20), Order = 999, AlignX = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, MaxSize = 14, Color = Colors.Muted })
	else
		grid.CellSize = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 132)
		local restricted = dataController:GetSession("EggsRestricted") == true
		for index, egg in ipairs(PetConfig.Eggs) do
			eggCard(egg, data, restricted, index)
		end
	end
end

	hatchGui.Enabled = false

	track.Parent = gui
	local trackCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	trackCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
	trackCorner.Parent = track
	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Thickness = 2
	stroke.Color = Colors.Stroke
	stroke.Parent = track

	local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
	fill.Name = "Fill"
	fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
	fill.BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Yellow
	fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	fill.Parent = track
	local fillCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	fillCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
	fillCorner.Parent = fill
	local gradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	gradient.Rotation = 90
	gradient.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.fromRGB(190, 190, 190))
	gradient.Parent = fill

	local value = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	value.Name = "Value"
	value.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	value.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	value.FontFace = ThemeConfig.Fonts.Number
	value.TextScaled = true
	value.TextColor3 = Colors.White
	value.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.1
	value.ZIndex = 2
	value.Parent = track
	local padding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	padding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 3)
	padding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 3)
	padding.Parent = value

	gui.Parent = folder
	return { Gui = gui, Fill = fill, Value = value, Title = title }
end

local function healthColor(ratio)
	if ratio > 0.6 then
		return Colors.Yellow
	elseif ratio > 0.3 then
		return Colors.Orange
	end
	return Colors.Red
end

local function refresh(bar)
	local model = bar.Model
	local health = model:GetAttribute("Health") or 0
	local maxHealth = math.max(model:GetAttribute("MaxHealth") or 1, 1)
	local ratio = math.clamp(health / maxHealth, 0, 1)
	TweenService:Create(bar.Fill, FILL_TWEEN, { Size = UDim2.fromScale(ratio, 1), BackgroundColor3 = healthColor(ratio) }):Play()
	bar.Value.Text = Format.Number(health) .. " / " .. Format.Number(maxHealth)
end

local function release(bar)
	if bar.Connection then
		bar.Connection:Disconnect()
		bar.Connection = nil
	end
	bar.Gui.Enabled = false
	bar.Gui.Adornee = nil
	bar.Model = nil
	bar.Uid = nil
end

function HealthBars.Setup()
	folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "HealthBars"
	folder.Parent = workspace:WaitForChild("ClientEffects")
	for index = 1, MAX_BARS do
		bars[index] = buildBar()
	end

	local function added(model)
		local uid = model:GetAttribute("Uid")
		if uid then
			byUid[uid] = model
		else
			model:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Uid"):Once(function()
				local assigned = model:GetAttribute("Uid")
				if assigned then
					byUid[assigned] = model
				end
			end)
		end
	end
	for _, model in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("Destructible")) do
		added(model)
	end
	CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal("Destructible"):Connect(added)
	CollectionService:GetInstanceRemovedSignal("Destructible"):Connect(function(model)
		local uid = model:GetAttribute("Uid")
		if uid and byUid[uid] == model then
			byUid[uid] = nil
			HealthBars.Release(uid)
		end
	end)

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local now = os.clock()
		for _, bar in ipairs(bars) do
			if bar.Model and (now - bar.LastHit > HIDE_AFTER or not bar.Model:IsDescendantOf(workspace) or bar.Model:GetAttribute("Alive") == false) then
				release(bar)
			end
		end
	end)
end

function HealthBars.Track(uid)
	local model = byUid[uid]
	if not model or not model:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
		return
	end
	local chosen, oldest = nil, math.huge
	for _, bar in ipairs(bars) do
		if bar.Uid == uid then
			chosen = bar
			break
		end
		local stamp = bar.Model and bar.LastHit or -1
		if stamp < oldest then
			chosen, oldest = bar, stamp
		end
	end
	if chosen.Uid ~= uid then
		release(chosen)
		local anchor = model.PrimaryPart or model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
		if not anchor then
			return
		end
		local cframe, size = model:GetBoundingBox()
		chosen.Model = model
		chosen.Uid = uid
		chosen.Gui.Adornee = anchor
		chosen.Gui.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, cframe.Position.Y + size.Y / 2 - anchor.Position.Y + 2.2, 0)
		chosen.Title.Text = displayName(model)
		chosen.Title.TextColor3 = rarityColor(model)
		chosen.Fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp((model:GetAttribute("Health") or 0) / math.max(model:GetAttribute("MaxHealth") or 1, 1), 0, 1), 1)
		chosen.Connection = model:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Health"):Connect(function()
			refresh(chosen)
		end)
		chosen.Gui.Enabled = true
	end
	chosen.LastHit = os.clock()
	refresh(chosen)
end

function HealthBars.Release(uid)
	for _, bar in ipairs(bars) do
		if bar.Uid == uid then
			release(bar)
		end
	end
end

return HealthBars

ServerScriptService.Services.PetService.source:
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local PolicyService = game:GetService("PolicyService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local PetConfig = require(Shared.Config.PetConfig)
local GameConfig = require(Shared.Config.GameConfig)
local Formulas = require(Shared.Modules.Formulas)
local Signal = require(Shared.Modules.Signal)
local Net = require(Shared.Modules.Net)
local TableUtil = require(Shared.Modules.TableUtil)
local Ownership = require(Shared.Modules.Ownership)
local Validate = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.Validate)
local Notifier = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.Notifier)

local PetService = { Priority = 46 }
PetService.Hatched = Signal.new()

local restricted = {}
local random = Random.new()
local fxRemote = nil

local function newUid(owned)
	local uid
	repeat
		uid = string.sub(string.gsub(HttpService:GenerateGUID(false), "-", ""), 1, 10)
	until not owned[uid]
	return uid
end

local function roll(egg)
	local ticket = random:NextNumber() * egg.TotalWeight
	for _, entry in ipairs(egg.Odds) do
		ticket -= entry.Weight
		if ticket <= 0 then
			return entry.Pet
		end
	end
	return egg.Odds[#egg.Odds].Pet
end

function PetService:Init(services)
	self.Services = services
	self.Data = services.DataService
	fxRemote = Net.Remote("PetFx")

	self.Data:OnProfileLoaded(function(player, data)
		if next(data.Pets) == nil and PetConfig.StarterPet then
			local uid = newUid(data.Pets)
			data.Pets[uid] = PetConfig.StarterPet
			data.EquippedPets = { uid }
			self.Data:Replicate(player, "Pets")
			self.Data:Replicate(player, "EquippedPets")
		end
		self:SyncOwnerPets(player, data)
		self:Apply(player)
		task.spawn(self.CheckPolicy, self, player)
	end)
end

function PetService:Start()
	local antiExploit = self.Services.AntiExploitService

	antiExploit:Connect("HatchEgg", { Rate = 1.5, Burst = 3 }, function(player, eggId)
		if Validate.String(eggId, 32) then
			self:Hatch(player, eggId)
		end
	end)
	antiExploit:Connect("EquipPet", { Rate = 5, Burst = 8 }, function(player, uid)
		if Validate.String(uid, 16) then
			self:Equip(player, uid)
		end
	end)
	antiExploit:Connect("UnequipPet", { Rate = 5, Burst = 8 }, function(player, uid)
		if Validate.String(uid, 16) then
			self:Unequip(player, uid)
		end
	end)
	antiExploit:Connect("EquipBestPets", { Rate = 1, Burst = 3 }, function(player)
		self:EquipBest(player)
	end)
	antiExploit:Connect("DeletePet", { Rate = 4, Burst = 6 }, function(player, uid)
		if Validate.String(uid, 16) then
			self:Delete(player, uid)
		end
	end)

	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		restricted[player] = nil
	end)
end

function PetService:CheckPolicy(player)
	local ok, policy = pcall(PolicyService.GetPolicyInfoForPlayerAsync, PolicyService, player)
	if ok and policy then
		restricted[player] = policy.ArePaidRandomItemsRestricted == true
	else
		restricted[player] = not RunService:IsStudio()
	end
	self.Data:SetSession(player, "EggsRestricted", restricted[player])
	return restricted[player]
end

function PetService:SyncOwnerPets(player, data)
	local isOwner = Ownership.HasOwnerPerks(player)
	local changed = false
	local hasOwnerPet = false
	for uid, petId in pairs(data.Pets) do
		local def = PetConfig.ById[petId]
		if def and def.OwnerOnly and not isOwner then
			data.Pets[uid] = nil
			local index = table.find(data.EquippedPets, uid)
			if index then
				table.remove(data.EquippedPets, index)
			end
			changed = true
		elseif petId == GameConfig.Owner.Pet then
			hasOwnerPet = true
		end
	end
	if isOwner and not hasOwnerPet and PetConfig.ById[GameConfig.Owner.Pet] then
		local uid = newUid(data.Pets)
		data.Pets[uid] = GameConfig.Owner.Pet
		table.insert(data.EquippedPets, 1, uid)
		while #data.EquippedPets > PetConfig.MaxEquipped do
			table.remove(data.EquippedPets)
		end
		changed = true
	end
	if changed then
		self.Data:Replicate(player, "Pets")
		self.Data:Replicate(player, "EquippedPets")
	end
end

function PetService:GrantPet(player, petId)
 local data=self.Data:GetData(player)
 local def=PetConfig.ById[petId]
 if not data or not def then return nil,"Mascota inválida o perfil no disponible." end
 if not Ownership.CanHavePet(player,def)then return nil,"Esta mascota está reservada para staff."end
 if TableUtil.Count(data.Pets)>=PetConfig.InventoryLimit then return nil,"Inventario de mascotas lleno." end
 local uid=newUid(data.Pets)
 data.Pets[uid]=petId
 self.Data:Replicate(player,"Pets")
 if #data.EquippedPets<PetConfig.MaxEquipped then
  table.insert(data.EquippedPets,uid)
  self.Data:Replicate(player,"EquippedPets")
  self:Apply(player)
 end
 return uid
end

function PetService:Apply(player)
	local data = self.Data:GetData(player)
	if not data then
		return
	end
	local ids = {}
	for _, uid in ipairs(data.EquippedPets) do
		table.insert(ids, data.Pets[uid])
	end
	player:SetAttribute("EquippedPets", table.concat(ids, ","))
	self.Services.EconomyService:RefreshStats(player)
end

function PetService:Hatch(player, eggId)
	local egg = PetConfig.EggsById[eggId]
	local data = self.Data:GetData(player)
	if not egg or not data then
		return
	end
	if restricted[player] == nil or restricted[player] then
		if self:CheckPolicy(player) then
			Notifier.Error(player, "EGGS ARE NOT AVAILABLE IN YOUR REGION")
			return
		end
	end
	if data.Rebirths < egg.RequiredRebirths then
		Notifier.Error(player, "REQUIRES " .. egg.RequiredRebirths .. " REBIRTH")
		return
	end
	if TableUtil.Count(data.Pets) >= PetConfig.InventoryLimit then
		Notifier.Error(player, "PET INVENTORY FULL")
		return
	end
	if not self.Services.EconomyService:SpendCash(player, egg.Price) then
		Notifier.Error(player, "NOT ENOUGH CASH")
		return
	end
	local petId = roll(egg)
	local uid = newUid(data.Pets)
	data.Pets[uid] = petId
	self.Data:Replicate(player, "Pets")
	if #data.EquippedPets < PetConfig.MaxEquipped then
		table.insert(data.EquippedPets, uid)
		self.Data:Replicate(player, "EquippedPets")
		self:Apply(player)
	end
	fxRemote:FireClient(player, "Hatch", { Egg = eggId, Pet = petId, Uid = uid })
	self.Hatched:Fire(player, petId)
end

function PetService:Equip(player, uid)
	local data = self.Data:GetData(player)
	if not data.Pets[uid] or table.find(data.EquippedPets, uid) then
		return
	end
	if not Ownership.CanHavePet(player, PetConfig.ById[data.Pets[uid]]) then
		return
	end
	if #data.EquippedPets >= PetConfig.MaxEquipped then
		Notifier.Error(player, "UNEQUIP A PET FIRST")
		return
	end
	table.insert(data.EquippedPets, uid)
	self.Data:Replicate(player, "EquippedPets")
	self:Apply(player)
end

function PetService:Unequip(player, uid)
	local data = self.Data:GetData(player)
	local index = table.find(data.EquippedPets, uid)
	if not index then
		return
	end
	table.remove(data.EquippedPets, index)
	self.Data:Replicate(player, "EquippedPets")
	self:Apply(player)
end

function PetService:EquipBest(player)
	local data = self.Data:GetData(player)
	local uids = TableUtil.Keys(data.Pets)
	table.sort(uids, function(a, b)
		return Formulas.PetScore(data.Pets[a]) > Formulas.PetScore(data.Pets[b])
	end)
	local equipped = {}
	for index = 1, math.min(#uids, PetConfig.MaxEquipped) do
		equipped[index] = uids[index]
	end
	data.EquippedPets = equipped
	self.Data:Replicate(player, "EquippedPets")
	self:Apply(player)
end

function PetService:Delete(player, uid)
	local data = self.Data:GetData(player)
	local def = PetConfig.ById[data.Pets[uid]]
	if not def or def.OwnerOnly or TableUtil.Count(data.Pets) <= 1 then
		return
	end
	local index = table.find(data.EquippedPets, uid)
	if index then
		table.remove(data.EquippedPets, index)
		self.Data:Replicate(player, "EquippedPets")
	end
	data.Pets[uid] = nil
	self.Data:Replicate(player, "Pets")
	self:Apply(player)
end

return PetService

local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local Config=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config.ProjectConfig)
local ProjectService={Priority=54}
local cycle
local contributions={}
local dirty=false
local function now()return workspace:GetServerTimeNow()end
local function qualifies(def,entry)
 if def.Kind=="Metal"then return entry.Def and entry.Def.MaterialType=="Metal"end
 if def.Kind=="Heavy"then return entry.SizeClass=="Medium"or entry.SizeClass=="Large"or entry.SizeClass=="Huge"end
 return true
end

function ProjectService:Snapshot(player)
 if not cycle then return {Active=false}end
 local participants=0
 for p,count in pairs(contributions)do
  if p.Parent==Players and self.Data:IsLoaded(p)and count>=Config.MinimumContribution then participants+=1 end
 end
 return {Id=cycle.Def.Id,Name=cycle.Def.Name,Description=cycle.Def.Description,
  Active=cycle.Active,Untimed=Config.Untimed==true,Count=cycle.Count,Target=cycle.Def.Target,EndsAt=cycle.EndsAt,
  ReadyAt=cycle.ReadyAt,Contribution=contributions[player]or 0,
  Minimum=Config.MinimumContribution,Participants=participants,Result=cycle.Result,
  Rewarded=cycle.Rewarded[player]==true,Rewards=cycle.Def.Rewards}
end
function ProjectService:Publish()
 dirty=false
 for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do
  if self.Data:IsLoaded(p)then self.Data:SetSession(p,"CommunityProject",self:Snapshot(p))end
 end
end
function ProjectService:Begin(index)
 if cycle and cycle.Active then return false end
 local def=Config.List[index]
 if not def then return false end
 contributions={}
 cycle={Index=index,Def=def,Active=true,Count=0,EndsAt=Config.Untimed and 0 or now()+Config.Duration,ReadyAt=0,
  Seen={},Rewarded={},Result=""}
 self:Publish()
 return true
end
function ProjectService:Finish(success)
 if not cycle or not cycle.Active or (success and cycle.Count<cycle.Def.Target)then return false end
 -- Seal the cycle before callbacks, grants or replication can run.
 cycle.Active=false cycle.ReadyAt=now()+Config.Cooldown
 cycle.Result=success and "COMPLETE"or "TIME UP"
 if success then
  for p,count in pairs(contributions)do
   if p.Parent==Players and self.Data:IsLoaded(p)and count>=Config.MinimumContribution then
    cycle.Rewarded[p]=true
    self.Services.EconomyService:GrantRewards(p,cycle.Def.Rewards,"Challenge","COMMUNITY PROJECT COMPLETE")
   end
  end
 end
 self:Publish()
 return true
end
function ProjectService:CountWreck(entry,credits)
 if not cycle or not cycle.Active then return false end
 if cycle.EndsAt>0 and now()>=cycle.EndsAt then self:Finish(false)return false end
 if not entry.Uid or cycle.Seen[entry.Uid]or not qualifies(cycle.Def,entry)then return false end
 local credited={}
 for _,credit in ipairs(credits)do
  local p=credit.Player
  if (credit.Counted or credit.Assisted) and p and p.Parent==Players and self.Data:IsLoaded(p)
   and self.Services.ZoneService:IsUnlocked(p,entry.Zone)then credited[p]=true end
 end
 if not next(credited)then return false end
 cycle.Seen[entry.Uid]=true
 cycle.Count+=1 -- A shared object counts once globally, once for each real contributor.
 for p in pairs(credited)do contributions[p]=(contributions[p]or 0)+1 end
 dirty=true
 if cycle.Count>=cycle.Def.Target then self:Finish(true)end
 return true
end
function ProjectService:Init(services)
 self.Services=services self.Data=services.DataService
 self.Data:OnProfileLoaded(function(p)
  if cycle then self.Data:SetSession(p,"CommunityProject",self:Snapshot(p))end
 end)
 self.Data.ProfileReleasing:Connect(function(p)
  contributions[p]=nil if cycle then cycle.Rewarded[p]=nil end dirty=true
 end)
 services.DestructionService.Wrecked:Connect(function(entry,credits)self:CountWreck(entry,credits)end)
end
function ProjectService:Start()
 self:Begin(1)
 task.spawn(function()
  while true do
   task.wait(1)
   if cycle.Active and cycle.EndsAt>0 and now()>=cycle.EndsAt then self:Finish(false)
   elseif not cycle.Active and now()>=cycle.ReadyAt then self:Begin(cycle.Index%#Config.List+1)
   elseif dirty then self:Publish()end
  end
 end)
end
return ProjectService

local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local EngineRunService=game:GetService("RunService")
local Theme=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config.ThemeConfig)
local player=Players.LocalPlayer
local SalvageController={Priority=46}
function SalvageController:Init(controllers)self.Controllers=controllers self.Markers={}end
function SalvageController:GetNearest()
 local run=self.Controllers.DataController:GetSession("DemolitionRun")
 local root=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 if not run or not run.Active or run.ModeId~="SalvageRush"or not root then return nil end
 local nearest,best
 for _,drop in ipairs(run.Pickups or {})do
  if drop.ExpiresAt>workspace:GetServerTimeNow()then
   local distance=(Vector3.new(drop.X,drop.Y,drop.Z)-root.Position).Magnitude
   if not best or distance<best then nearest=drop best=distance end
  end
 end
 return nearest,best
end
function SalvageController:GetHint()
 local drop,distance=self:GetNearest()
 if not drop then return "BREAK TO DROP SALVAGE"end
 local root=player.Character.HumanoidRootPart local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
 local direction="AHEAD"
 if camera then
  local delta=Vector3.new(drop.X-root.Position.X,0,drop.Z-root.Position.Z)
  local look=camera.CFrame.LookVector local forward=Vector3.new(look.X,0,look.Z)
  local r=camera.CFrame.RightVector local right=Vector3.new(r.X,0,r.Z)
  if delta.Magnitude>1 and forward.Magnitude>.001 then
   if delta.Unit:Dot(forward.Unit)<-.5 then direction="TURN BACK"
   elseif right.Magnitude>.001 then
    local side=delta.Unit:Dot(right.Unit)
    if side>.5 then direction="RIGHT"elseif side<-.5 then direction="LEFT"end
   end
  end
 end
 local seconds=math.max(0,math.ceil(drop.ExpiresAt-workspace:GetServerTimeNow()))
 return direction.." · "..math.floor(distance).." studs · "..seconds.."s"
end
function SalvageController:CreateMarker(drop)
 local model=Instance.new("Model")model.Name="PersonalSalvage_"..drop.Uid
 local function part(name,size,color,offset,material)
  local p=Instance.new("Part")p.Name=name p.Size=size p.Color=color
  p.Material=material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
  p.Anchored=true p.CanCollide=false p.CanTouch=false p.CanQuery=false p.CastShadow=false
  p.CFrame=CFrame.new(Vector3.new(drop.X,drop.Y,drop.Z)+offset)
  p.Parent=model return p
 end
 local box=part("Salvage",Vector3.new(2.2,1.4,1.7),Theme.Colors.Orange,Vector3.zero)
 part("Band",Vector3.new(2.3,.18,1.8),Theme.Colors.Cyan,Vector3.zero)
 part("Handle",Vector3.new(.8,.25,.7),Theme.Colors.Dark,Vector3.new(0,.82,0))
 model.PrimaryPart=box
 model.Parent=self.Folder
 return model
end
function SalvageController:Refresh()
 if not self.Folder then return end
 local C=self.Controllers local run=C.DataController:GetSession("DemolitionRun")
 local human=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 local visible=run and run.Active and run.ModeId=="SalvageRush"and human and human.Health>0 and not C.PanelController:IsAnyOpen()
 local wanted={}local settings=C.DataController:Get("Settings")or {}
 local stamp=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
 if visible then
  for _,drop in ipairs(run.Pickups or {})do
   if drop.ExpiresAt>stamp then
    wanted[drop.Uid]=true
    local model=self.Markers[drop.Uid]
    if not model then model=self:CreateMarker(drop)self.Markers[drop.Uid]=model end
    local bob=settings.LowEffects and 0 or math.sin(stamp*3)*.15
    local turn=settings.LowEffects and 0 or stamp*.8
    model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(drop.X,drop.Y+bob,drop.Z)*CFrame.Angles(0,turn,0))
   end
  end
 end
 for uid,model in pairs(self.Markers)do
  if not wanted[uid]then model:Destroy()self.Markers[uid]=nil end
 end
end
function SalvageController:Start()
 local folder=Instance.new("Folder")folder.Name="PersonalSalvage"
 folder.Parent=workspace:WaitForChild("ClientEffects")self.Folder=folder
 self.Controllers.DataController:ObserveSession("DemolitionRun",function()self:Refresh()end)
 local elapsed=0
 EngineRunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
  elapsed+=dt if elapsed<.1 then return end elapsed=0 self:Refresh()
 end)
 player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()
  for uid,model in pairs(self.Markers)do model:Destroy()self.Markers[uid]=nil end
 end)
 self:Refresh()
end
return SalvageController

local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local CollectionService=game:GetService("CollectionService")
local EngineRunService=game:GetService("RunService")
local Theme=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config.ThemeConfig)
local HuntController={Priority=45}
local player=Players.LocalPlayer
function HuntController:Init(controllers)self.Controllers=controllers self.Models={}end
function HuntController:GetTarget()
 local run=self.Controllers.DataController:GetSession("DemolitionRun")
 local model=run and run.Active and self.Models[run.TargetUid]
 return model and model:IsDescendantOf(workspace)and model:GetAttribute("Alive")~=false and model or nil
end
function HuntController:GetHint()
 local model=self:GetTarget()
 local root=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 if not model or not root then return "FINDING NEXT TARGET"end
 return math.floor((model:GetPivot().Position-root.Position).Magnitude).." studs · CYAN TARGET"
end
function HuntController:GetDirection()
 local target=self:GetTarget()
 local root=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
 if not target or not root or not camera then return "AHEAD"end
 local delta=target:GetPivot().Position-root.Position
 delta=Vector3.new(delta.X,0,delta.Z)

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Config = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("Config")
local ThemeConfig = require(Config.ThemeConfig)
local AssetConfig = require(Config.AssetConfig)

local UIKit = {}

UIKit.ClickHandler = nil
UIKit.ReducedMotion=false

function UIKit.Create(className, props, children)
	local instance = Instance.new(className)
	local parent = nil
	for key, value in pairs(props or {}) do
		if key == "Parent" then
			parent = value
		else
			instance[key] = value
		end
	end
	for _, child in ipairs(children or {}) do
		child.Parent = instance
	end
	if parent then
		instance.Parent = parent
	end
	return instance
end

function UIKit.Tween(instance, info, goal)
 if UIKit.ReducedMotion and instance:IsA("UIScale")then goal={Scale=1}info=TweenInfo.new(0)end
	local tween = TweenService:Create(instance, info, goal)
	tween:Play()
	return tween
end

function UIKit.SetIcon(imageLabel, key, fallbackText)
	local image = AssetConfig.Image(key)
	local glyph = imageLabel:FindFirstChild("Fallback")
	if image then
		imageLabel.Image = image
		if glyph then
			glyph.Visible = false
		end
		return
	end
	imageLabel.Image = ""
	if not glyph then
		glyph = UIKit.Create("TextLabel", {
			Name = "Fallback",
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
			FontFace = ThemeConfig.Fonts.Display,
			TextScaled = true,
			Parent = imageLabel,
		})
	end
	local fallback = AssetConfig.Fallback[key]
	glyph.Text = (fallback and fallback.Glyph) or fallbackText or string.upper(string.sub(tostring(key or "?"), 1, 1))
	glyph.TextColor3 = (fallback and fallback.Color) or ThemeConfig.Colors.White
	glyph.Visible = true
end

function UIKit.Button(button, onClick)
	local scale = button:FindFirstChild("PressScale") or UIKit.Create("UIScale", { Name = "PressScale", Parent = button })
	button.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		UIKit.Tween(scale, ThemeConfig.Tween.Fast, { Scale = 1.05 })
	end)
	button.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		UIKit.Tween(scale, ThemeConfig.Tween.Fast, { Scale = 1 })
	end)
	button.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
		UIKit.Tween(scale, ThemeConfig.Tween.Fast, { Scale = 0.93 })
	end)
	button.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
		UIKit.Tween(scale, ThemeConfig.Tween.Pop, { Scale = 1 })
	end)
	button.SelectionGained:Connect(function()
		UIKit.Tween(scale, ThemeConfig.Tween.Fast, { Scale = 1.05 })
	end)
	button.SelectionLost:Connect(function()
		UIKit.Tween(scale, ThemeConfig.Tween.Fast, { Scale = 1 })
	end)
	return button.Activated:Connect(function(...)
		if button:GetAttribute("Variant") == "Disabled" then
			return
		end
		if UIKit.ClickHandler then
			UIKit.ClickHandler()
		end
		onClick(...)
	end)
end

function UIKit.Pop(guiObject, amount)
	local scale = guiObject:FindFirstChild("PopScale") or UIKit.Create("UIScale", { Name = "PopScale", Parent = guiObject })
	scale.Scale = UIKit.ReducedMotion and 1 or (amount or 1.18)
	UIKit.Tween(scale, ThemeConfig.Tween.Pop, { Scale = 1 })
end

function UIKit.Shake(guiObject)
 if UIKit.ReducedMotion then return end
	local origin = guiObject.Position
	task.spawn(function()
		for i = 1, 6 do
			local offset = (i % 2 == 0 and 1 or -1) * (7 - i)
			guiObject.Position = origin + UDim2.fromOffset(offset, 0)
			task.wait(0.03)
		end
		guiObject.Position = origin
	end)
end

return UIKit

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local DailyRewardConfig = require(Shared.Config.DailyRewardConfig)
local Formulas = require(Shared.Modules.Formulas)
local Notifier = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.Notifier)

local REMINDER_DELAY = 6
local TUTORIAL_READY_STEP = 5

local DailyRewardService = { Priority = 51 }

local shown = {}

function DailyRewardService.Status(data)
 local claimable,nextDay=DailyRewardConfig.Status(data)
 return claimable,nextDay,false
end

local function tutorialReady(data)
	return data.Tutorial.Completed or data.Tutorial.Step >= TUTORIAL_READY_STEP
end

function DailyRewardService:Init(services)
	self.Services = services
	self.Data = services.DataService

	self.Data:OnProfileLoaded(function(player)
		task.delay(REMINDER_DELAY, function()
			self:TryReminder(player)
		end)
	end)
	self.Data.KeyChanged:Connect(function(player, key)
		if key == "Tutorial" then
			self:TryReminder(player)
		end
	end)
	self.Data.ProfileReleasing:Connect(function(player)
		shown[player] = nil
	end)
end

function DailyRewardService:Start()
	self.Services.AntiExploitService:Connect("ClaimDaily", { Rate = 1, Burst = 3 }, function(player)
		self:Claim(player)
	end)
end

function DailyRewardService:TryReminder(player)
	local data = self.Data:GetData(player)
	if not data or shown[player] or not tutorialReady(data) then
		return
	end
	if DailyRewardService.Status(data) then
		shown[player] = true
		Notifier.Send(player, { Kind = "Info", Text = "DAILY REWARD READY", Subtext = "Open MENU > DAILY to claim", Icon = "NavDaily" })
	end
end

function DailyRewardService:Claim(player)
	local data = self.Data:GetData(player)
	if not data then return end
	local claimable, nextDay, reset = DailyRewardService.Status(data)
	if not claimable then
		Notifier.Error(player, "COME BACK LATER")
		return
	end
	local stats = self.Services.EconomyService:GetStats(player)
	local rewards = Formulas.DailyRewards(nextDay, data, stats.DailyBonus)
	self.Data:Set(player, "DailyReward", { Day = nextDay, LastClaim = os.time() })
	self.Data:Set(player, "DailyStreak", (data.DailyStreak or 0) + 1)
	self.Services.EconomyService:GrantRewards(player, rewards, "Daily", "WRECKER DAILY - DAY " .. nextDay)
end

return DailyRewardService
