local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local ThemeConfig = require(Shared.Config.ThemeConfig)
local DestructibleConfig = require(Shared.Config.DestructibleConfig)
local Components = script.Parent.Parent.Parent:WaitForChild("Components")
local Widgets = require(Components.Widgets)

local Colors = ThemeConfig.Colors
local Fonts = ThemeConfig.Fonts
local TAG = "Destructible"

local Locks = {}

local world = nil
local folder = nil
local tags = {}

local function ready()
	return world ~= nil and folder ~= nil and world.Controllers.DataController:IsLoaded()
end

local function tierLock(model)
	local def = DestructibleConfig.ById[model:GetAttribute("Type")]
	local zoneId = model:GetAttribute("Zone")
	if not def or not def.TierZone or def.TierZone == zoneId then
		return nil
	end
	if zoneId and not world:IsUnlocked(zoneId) then
		return nil
	end
	if world:IsUnlocked(def.TierZone) then
		return nil
	end
	return def.TierZone
end

local function build(model, zoneId)
	local anchor = model.PrimaryPart or model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	if not anchor then
		return nil
	end
	local box, size = model:GetBoundingBox()
	local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	gui.Name = "Lock"
	gui.Adornee = anchor
	gui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(240, 60)
	gui.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(box.Position.X - anchor.Position.X, box.Position.Y + size.Y / 2 + 2.4 - anchor.Position.Y, box.Position.Z - anchor.Position.Z)
	gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
	gui.LightInfluence = 0
	gui.MaxDistance = 110

	local plate = Instance.new("Frame")
	plate.Name = "Plate"
	plate.BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Black
	plate.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
	plate.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	plate.Parent = gui
	Widgets.Corner(plate, UDim.new(0, 12))
	Widgets.Stroke(plate, Colors.Red, 2)
	Widgets.Icon(plate, "IconLock", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 40), Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0.5, 0), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Fallback = "X", FallbackColor = Colors.Red })
	Widgets.Label(plate, { Name = "Title", Text = "LOCKED", Font = Fonts.Display, Size = UDim2.new(1, -66, 0, 26), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(58, 4), MaxSize = 22, Color = Colors.Red, Stroke = 1 })
	Widgets.Label(plate, { Name = "Detail", Text = world:LockText(zoneId), Font = Fonts.Body, Size = UDim2.new(1, -66, 0, 22), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(58, 31), MaxSize = 14 })

	gui.Parent = folder
	return gui
end

local function drop(model)
	local gui = tags[model]
	if gui then
		gui:Destroy()
		tags[model] = nil
	end
end

function Locks.Update(model)
	if not ready() or not model:IsA("Model") then
		return
	end
	local zoneId = model:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and tierLock(model) or nil
	if zoneId then
		local gui = tags[model] or build(model, zoneId)
		tags[model] = gui
		if gui then
			gui.Plate.Detail.Text = world:LockText(zoneId)
		end
	else
		drop(model)
	end
end

function Locks.Refresh()
	if not ready() then
		return
	end
	for model in pairs(tags) do
		if not model:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
			drop(model)
		end
	end
	for _, model in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged(TAG)) do
		Locks.Update(model)
	end
end

function Locks.Setup(controller)
	world = controller
	task.spawn(function()
		local effects = workspace:WaitForChild("ClientEffects", 30)
		if not effects then
			return
		end
		folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name = "Locks"
		folder.Parent = effects
		CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal(TAG):Connect(function(model)
			task.defer(Locks.Update, model)
		end)
		CollectionService:GetInstanceRemovedSignal(TAG):Connect(drop)
		Locks.Refresh()
	end)
end

return Locks

ServerScriptService.Services.Destruction.source:
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local GameConfig = require(Shared.Config.GameConfig)
local DestructibleConfig = require(Shared.Config.DestructibleConfig)
local EventConfig = require(Shared.Config.EventConfig)
local ToolConfig = require(Shared.Config.ToolConfig)
local ZoneConfig = require(Shared.Config.ZoneConfig)
local Formulas = require(Shared.Modules.Formulas)
local Signal = require(Shared.Modules.Signal)
local Net = require(Shared.Modules.Net)
local Validate = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.Validate)
local Geometry = require(script.Geometry)
local Combat = require(script.Combat)

local TAG = "Destructible"

local DestructionService = { Priority = 30 }
DestructionService.Damaged = Signal.new()
DestructionService.Wrecked = Signal.new()

local entries = {}
local uidCounter = 0
local respawnScale = 1
local remotes = {}
local pool = nil

local function nextUid()
	uidCounter += 1
	return "D" .. uidCounter
end

local function zoneXp(zoneId)
	local zone = ZoneConfig.ById[zoneId]
	return zone and zone.XpMultiplier or 1
end

local function register(model, def, zoneId, options)
	local boxCFrame, size = model:GetBoundingBox()
	local rewardZone = def.TierZone or zoneId
	local entry = {
		Uid = nextUid(),
		Model = model,
		TypeId = def.Id,
		Def = def,
		Zone = zoneId,
		RewardZone = rewardZone,
		MaxHealth = math.max(1, math.floor(options.MaxHealth or def.MaxHealth)),
		Reward = options.Reward or def.Reward,
		ScrapReward = options.ScrapReward or def.ScrapReward,
		ChaosPoints = GameConfig.ChaosPoints[def.SizeClass] or 1,
		Xp = options.Xp or math.floor((GameConfig.Levels.SizeXp[def.SizeClass] or 1) * zoneXp(rewardZone)),
  ExpeditionId=options.ExpeditionId,MinHit=options.MinHit,MaxHit=options.MaxHit,
		SizeClass = def.SizeClass,
		Alive = true,
		IsEvent = options.IsEvent == true,
		EventId = options.EventId,
		DamageBy = {},
		Position = boxCFrame.Position,
		BoxCFrame = boxCFrame,
		Size = size,
		Home = model.Parent,
		RespawnToken = 0,
	}
	entry.Health = entry.MaxHealth
	model:SetAttribute("Uid", entry.Uid)
	model:SetAttribute("Type", def.Id)
	model:SetAttribute("Zone", zoneId)
	model:SetAttribute("MaxHealth", entry.MaxHealth)
	model:SetAttribute("Health", entry.Health)
	model:SetAttribute("Alive", true)
	CollectionService:AddTag(model, TAG)
	entries[entry.Uid] = entry
	return entry
end

local function registerPlaced(model)
	if not model:IsA("Model") or model:GetAttribute("Uid") then
		return
	end
	local typeId = model:GetAttribute("Type") or model.Name
	local def = DestructibleConfig.ById[typeId]
	if not def then
		return
	end
	local zoneId = model:GetAttribute("Zone") or def.Zone
	register(model, def, zoneId, {})
end

local function respawn(entry)
	if entry.Alive or entries[entry.Uid] ~= entry then
		return
	end
	entry.Alive = true
	entry.Health = entry.MaxHealth
	table.clear(entry.DamageBy)
	local model = entry.Model
	model:SetAttribute("Health", entry.Health)
	model:SetAttribute("Alive", true)
	model.Parent = entry.Home
	remotes.WorldFx:FireAllClients("Respawn", { Uid = entry.Uid, Position = entry.Position, Size = entry.Size })
end

local function scheduleRespawn(entry)
	entry.RespawnToken += 1
	local token = entry.RespawnToken
	local delay = math.max((entry.Def.RespawnTime or 10) * respawnScale, GameConfig.Wreck.MinRespawn)
	task.delay(delay, function()
		if entry.RespawnToken == token then
			respawn(entry)
		end
	end)
end

local function creditFor(entry, player, share, killer, multiplier)
	local economy = DestructionService.Services.EconomyService
	local stats = economy:GetStats(player)
	local zoneReward = Formulas.ZoneRewardMultiplier(entry.RewardZone)
	local counted = share >= GameConfig.Wreck.CreditShare or player == killer
	return {
		Player = player,
		Share = share,
		Cash = math.floor(entry.Reward * zoneReward * share * stats.CashMultiplier * multiplier),
		Scrap = math.floor(entry.ScrapReward * zoneReward * share * stats.ScrapMultiplier * multiplier),
		Xp = counted and entry.Xp or math.floor(entry.Xp * share),
		Counted = counted,
		Assisted = share > 0, -- Actual damage; cooperative project participation only.
	}
end

local function computeCredits(entry, killer)
	local credits = {}
	local dataService = DestructionService.Services.DataService
	for userId, damage in pairs(entry.DamageBy) do
		local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
		if player and dataService:IsLoaded(player) and damage > 0 then
			table.insert(credits, creditFor(entry, player, math.min(damage / entry.MaxHealth, 1), killer, 1))
		end
	end
	return credits
end

local function orbCount(entry)
	local byClass = { Small = 1, Medium = 2, Large = 4, Huge = 6, Event = 6 }
	return math.min(byClass[entry.SizeClass] or 2, GameConfig.Drops.MaxOrbsPerWreck)
end

local function payCredit(entry, credit)
	local services = DestructionService.Services
	local player = credit.Player
	services.EconomyService:AddCash(player, credit.Cash, "Wreck")
	if credit.Scrap > 0 and services.DropService then
		services.DropService:Spawn(player, "Scrap", credit.Scrap, entry.Position, orbCount(entry))
	end
	services.EconomyService:AddXp(player, credit.Xp)
	if credit.Counted then
		local data = services.DataService:GetData(player)
		if data then
			data.TotalDestroyed += 1
		end
	end
	remotes.RewardFx:FireClient(player, {
		Cash = credit.Cash,
		Scrap = credit.Scrap,
		Xp = credit.Xp,
		Position = entry.Position,
		Wrecked = true,
		Counted = credit.Counted,
	})
end

local function wreck(entry, killer, presetCredits)
	if not entry.Alive then
		return
	end
	entry.Alive = false
	entry.Health = 0
	local model = entry.Model
	model:SetAttribute("Health", 0)
	model:SetAttribute("Alive", false)
	local credits = presetCredits or computeCredits(entry, killer)
	for _, credit in ipairs(credits) do
		payCredit(entry, credit)
	end
	remotes.WreckFx:FireAllClients({
		Uid = entry.Uid,
		Position = entry.Position,
		Size = entry.Size,
		Primary = entry.Def.Primary,
		Secondary = entry.Def.Secondary,
		Explosion = entry.Def.ExplosionType,
		MaterialType = entry.Def.MaterialType,
		SizeClass = entry.SizeClass,
	})
	if entry.IsEvent then
		entries[entry.Uid] = nil
		model:Destroy()
	else
		model.Parent = pool
		scheduleRespawn(entry)
	end
	DestructionService.Wrecked:Fire(entry, credits, killer)
end

local function canDamage(player, entry)
	if not entry.Alive or entry.Invulnerable then
		return false
	end
	local zones = DestructionService.Services.ZoneService
	if not zones then
		return true
	end
	if entry.Zone and not zones:IsUnlocked(player, entry.Zone) then
		return false
	end
	if entry.RewardZone ~= entry.Zone and not zones:IsUnlocked(player, entry.RewardZone) then
		return false
	end
	return true
end

local function handleAttack(player, targetUid, aimPos)
	if targetUid ~= nil and not Validate.String(targetUid, 32) then
		return
	end
	if aimPos ~= nil and not Validate.Vector3(aimPos) then
		return
	end
	local services = DestructionService.Services
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not root then
		return
	end
	local tool = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
	local toolId = tool and tool:GetAttribute("ToolId")
	local toolDef = toolId and ToolConfig.ById[toolId]
	if not toolDef or not services.ToolService:Owns(player, toolId) then
		return
	end
	local data = services.DataService:GetData(player)
	local stats = services.EconomyService:GetStats(player)
	if not Combat.ConsumeCooldown(player, toolId, stats) then
		return
	end

	local function filter(entry)
		return canDamage(player, entry)
	end
	local targets, impact = Combat.Resolve(entries, root.Position, toolDef, stats, targetUid, aimPos, filter)
	if not targets then
		return
	end

	local feedback = {}
	local anyCrit = false
	for _, target in ipairs(targets) do
		local entry = target.Entry
		if entry.Alive then
			local crit = math.random() < stats.CritChance + (entry.Def.CriticalChance or 0)
			anyCrit = anyCrit or crit
			local damage = math.max(1, math.floor(Formulas.HitDamage(toolId, data, stats, crit) * target.Scale))
			if entry.ExpeditionId then damage=math.clamp(damage,entry.MinHit or 1,entry.MaxHit or damage)end
   local applied = math.min(damage, entry.Health)
			entry.Health -= applied
			entry.DamageBy[player.UserId] = (entry.DamageBy[player.UserId] or 0) + applied
			entry.Model:SetAttribute("Health", entry.Health)
			data.TotalDamage += applied
			table.insert(feedback, { Uid = entry.Uid, Damage = damage, Crit = crit, MaterialType=entry.Def.MaterialType,SizeClass=entry.SizeClass, Position = Geometry.ClosestPoint(entry, impact) })
			DestructionService.Damaged:Fire(player, entry, applied, toolId, crit)
			if entry.Health <= 0 then
				wreck(entry, player)
			end
		end
	end

	if #feedback > 0 then
		remotes.HitFeedback:FireClient(player, feedback)
		remotes.HitFx:FireAllClients({ Position = feedback[1].Position,MaterialType=feedback[1].MaterialType, Crit = anyCrit, ToolId = toolId, UserId = player.UserId })
		if toolDef.Kind ~= "Melee" then
			local muzzle = tool:FindFirstChild("Muzzle", true)
			local from = if muzzle and muzzle:IsA("Attachment") then muzzle.WorldPosition else root.Position
			remotes.AttackConfirmed:FireClient(player, { ToolId = toolId, From = from, To = impact })
		end
		if toolDef.Fx == "Shockwave" then
			remotes.WorldFx:FireAllClients("Shockwave", {
				UserId = player.UserId,
				Position = impact,
				Ground = Vector3.new(impact.X, root.Position.Y - 2.9, impact.Z),
				Radius = Formulas.BlastRadius(toolId, stats),
			})
		end
	end
	if toolDef.Kind ~= "Melee" then
		local muzzle = tool:FindFirstChild("Muzzle", true)
		local from = if muzzle and muzzle:IsA("Attachment") then muzzle.WorldPosition else root.Position
		remotes.AttackFx:FireAllClients({ UserId = player.UserId, ToolId = toolId, From = from, To = impact, Confirmed = #feedback > 0 })
	end
end

function DestructionService:Init(services)
	self.Services = services
	for _, name in ipairs({ "HitFeedback", "HitFx", "AttackFx", "AttackConfirmed", "RewardFx", "WreckFx", "WorldFx" }) do
		remotes[name] = Net.Remote(name)
	end
	pool = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("Pool") or Instance.new("Folder")
	pool.Name = "Pool"
	pool.Parent = ServerStorage
end

function DestructionService:Start()
	local root = workspace:WaitForChild("Destructibles")
	for _, zoneFolder in ipairs(root:GetChildren()) do
		for _, model in ipairs(zoneFolder:GetChildren()) do
			registerPlaced(model)
		end
		zoneFolder.ChildAdded:Connect(registerPlaced)
	end
	root.ChildAdded:Connect(function(zoneFolder)
		zoneFolder.ChildAdded:Connect(registerPlaced)
	end)

	self.Services.AntiExploitService:Connect("Attack", { Rate = 14, Burst = 8 }, handleAttack)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(Combat.Forget)
end

function DestructionService:GetEntry(uid)
	return entries[uid]
end

function DestructionService:Spawn(objectId, cframe, options)
	options = options or {}
	local def = EventConfig.Objects[objectId]
	if not def then
		return nil
	end
	local folder = ServerStorage.Destructibles:FindFirstChild("Event")
	local template = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(objectId)
	local model = template and template:Clone() or Geometry.BuildFallback(def)
	model.Name = objectId
	model:PivotTo(cframe)
	model:SetAttribute("Type", objectId)
	model:SetAttribute("Zone", options.Zone)
	model:SetAttribute("Uid", nil)
	model.Parent = workspace.EventObjects
	local entry = register(model, def, options.Zone, {
		MaxHealth = options.MaxHealth or def.BaseHealth,
		Reward = options.Reward or def.BaseReward,
		ScrapReward = options.ScrapReward or def.BaseScrap,
		IsEvent = true,
		EventId = options.EventId,
  Xp=options.Xp,ExpeditionId=options.ExpeditionId,MinHit=options.MinHit,MaxHit=options.MaxHit,
	})
	if options.Lifetime then
		task.delay(options.Lifetime, function()
			if entries[entry.Uid] == entry and entry.Alive then
				self:Despawn(entry.Uid)
			end
		end)
	end
	return entry.Uid
end

function DestructionService:Despawn(uid)
	local entry = entries[uid]
	if not entry then
		return
	end
	entries[uid] = nil
	entry.Alive = false
	entry.Model:Destroy()
end

function DestructionService:WreckEntry(uid, killer)
	local entry = entries[uid]
	if entry then
		wreck(entry, killer)
	end
end

function DestructionService:GetAliveInZone(zoneId)
	local list = {}
	for _, entry in pairs(entries) do
		if entry.Alive and entry.Zone == zoneId then
			table.insert(list, entry)
		end
	end
	return list
end

function DestructionService:WreckZone(zoneId, player, multiplier)
	local targets = {}
	for _, entry in ipairs(self:GetAliveInZone(zoneId)) do
		if not entry.IsEvent then
			table.insert(targets, entry)
		end
	end
	for _, entry in ipairs(targets) do
		if entry.Alive and player.Parent and self.Services.DataService:IsLoaded(player) then
			wreck(entry, player, { creditFor(entry, player, 1, player, multiplier or 1) })
		end
	end
	return #targets
end

function DestructionService:WreckAllEvents()
	for uid, entry in pairs(entries) do
		if entry.IsEvent and entry.Alive and not entry.ExpeditionId then
			if next(entry.DamageBy) then
				wreck(entry, nil)
			else
				self:Despawn(uid)
			end
		end
	end
end

function DestructionService:ResetAll()
	for _, entry in pairs(entries) do
		if not entry.Alive and not entry.IsEvent then
			entry.RespawnToken += 1
			respawn(entry)
		end
	end
end

function DestructionService:SetRespawnScale(scale)
	respawnScale = math.clamp(tonumber(scale) or 1, 0.05, 5)
end

return DestructionService

ServerScriptService.Services.QuestServic.source:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local QuestConfig = require(Shared.Config.QuestConfig)
local Formulas = require(Shared.Modules.Formulas)
local Format = require(Shared.Modules.Format)
local Signal = require(Shared.Modules.Signal)
local TableUtil = require(Shared.Modules.TableUtil)
local Validate = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.Validate)
local Notifier = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.Notifier)

local FLUSH_INTERVAL = 0.5
local IGNORED_CASH_SOURCES = { Purchase = true, Quest = true, Daily = true, Challenge = true }

local QuestService = { Priority = 50 }
QuestService.QuestClaimed = Signal.new()

local dirty = {}

local function ensure(data)
	for _, quest in ipairs(QuestConfig.List) do
		local progress = data.QuestProgress[quest.Id]
		if type(progress) ~= "table" then
			progress = {}
			data.QuestProgress[quest.Id] = progress
		end
		progress.Tier = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(progress.Tier) or 0))
		progress.Progress = math.max(0, tonumber(progress.Progress) or 0)
		if type(progress.Target) ~= "number" or progress.Target <= 0 then
			progress.Target = Formulas.QuestTarget(quest, progress.Tier, data)
		end
		progress.Completed = progress.Completed == true
		progress.Notified = progress.Notified == true
		if (quest.Type == "UseTools" or quest.Type == "CollectTypes" or quest.Type == "FindCache") and type(progress.Used) ~= "table" then
			progress.Used = {}
		end
	end
	for questId in pairs(data.QuestProgress) do
		if not QuestConfig.ById[questId] then
			data.QuestProgress[questId] = nil
		end
	end
end

function QuestService:Init(services)
	self.Services = services
	self.Data = services.DataService

	self.Data:OnProfileLoaded(function(player, data)
		ensure(data)
		self.Data:Replicate(player, "QuestProgress")
	end)

	local destruction = services.DestructionService
	destruction.Wrecked:Connect(function(entry, credits)
		for _, credit in ipairs(credits) do
			if credit.Counted then
				self:Advance(credit.Player, "Destroy", 1, nil, entry.Zone)
				self:Advance(credit.Player, "CollectTypes", 0, entry.TypeId, entry.Zone)
				self:Advance(credit.Player, "DestroyMaterial", 1, entry.Def.MaterialType, entry.Zone)
				self:Advance(credit.Player, "DestroyZone", 1, entry.Zone, entry.Zone)
				if entry.SizeClass=="Medium" or entry.SizeClass=="Large" or entry.SizeClass=="Huge" then self:Advance(credit.Player,"DestroyHeavy",1,nil,entry.Zone) end
				if entry.IsEvent then self:Advance(credit.Player, "DestroyEvent", 1) end
			end
		end
	end)
	destruction.Damaged:Connect(function(player, _, amount, toolId)
		self:Advance(player, "Damage", amount)
		self:Advance(player, "UseTools", 0, toolId)
	end)
	services.EconomyService.CashEarned:Connect(function(player, amount, source)
		if not IGNORED_CASH_SOURCES[source] then
			self:Advance(player, "EarnCash", amount)
		end
	end)
 services.RunService.TargetCleared:Connect(function(player)
  self:Advance(player,"HuntTargets",1)
 end)
 services.RunService.SalvageCollected:Connect(function(player,amount)
  self:Advance(player,"SalvagePickups",amount)
 end)
 services.RunService.ChallengeFinished:Connect(function(player,modeId)
  if modeId=="TargetHunt"then self:Advance(player,"FinishHunt",1)
  elseif modeId=="ToolRelay"then self:Advance(player,"FinishRelay",1)
  elseif modeId=="SalvageRush"then self:Advance(player,"FinishSalvage",1)end
 end)
	if services.EventService then
		services.EventService.ChaosCompleted:Connect(function(participants)
			for _, player in ipairs(participants) do
				self:Advance(player, "ChaosEvent", 1)
			end
		end)
	end
end

function QuestService:Start()
	self.Services.AntiExploitService:Connect("ClaimQuest", { Rate = 3, Burst = 6 }, function(player, questId)
		if Validate.String(questId, 32) then
			self:Claim(player, questId)
		end
	end)

	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		dirty[player] = nil
	end)

	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(FLUSH_INTERVAL)
			for player in pairs(dirty) do
				dirty[player] = nil
				self.Data:Replicate(player, "QuestProgress")
			end
		end
	end)
end

function QuestService:Advance(player, questType, amount, toolId, zoneId)
	local data = self.Data:GetData(player)
	if not data then
		return
	end
	for _, quest in ipairs(QuestConfig.List) do
		local matches = quest.Type == questType
			and QuestConfig.IsAvailable(quest,data)
			and (not quest.Zone or quest.Zone==zoneId)
			and (questType ~= "DestroyMaterial" or quest.Material == toolId)
			and (questType ~= "DestroyZone" or quest.Zone == toolId)
			and ((questType ~= "CollectTypes" and questType ~= "FindCache") or (quest.ObjectIds and quest.ObjectIds[toolId] == true))
		local progress = matches and data.QuestProgress[quest.Id]
		if progress and not progress.Completed and progress.Progress < progress.Target then
			if questType == "UseTools" or questType == "CollectTypes" or questType == "FindCache" then
				if toolId and not progress.Used[toolId] then
					progress.Used[toolId] = true
					progress.Progress = math.min(TableUtil.Count(progress.Used), progress.Target)
					dirty[player] = true
				end
			else
				progress.Progress = math.min(progress.Progress + amount, progress.Target)
				dirty[player] = true
			end
			if progress.Progress >= progress.Target and not progress.Notified then
				progress.Notified = true
				Notifier.Send(player, {
					Kind = "Quest",
					Text = "QUEST COMPLETE!",
					Subtext = string.format(quest.Text, Format.Commas(progress.Target)),
					Icon = quest.Icon,
				})
			end
		end
	end
end

function QuestService:Claim(player, questId)
	local quest = QuestConfig.ById[questId]
	local data = self.Data:GetData(player)
	local progress = quest and data and data.QuestProgress[questId]
	if not progress or not QuestConfig.IsStageUnlocked(quest,data) or progress.Completed or progress.Progress < progress.Target then
		return
	end
	local rewards = quest.FixedRewards and quest.Rewards or Formulas.QuestRewards(quest, progress.Tier or 0, data)
	if quest.Repeat then
		progress.Tier += 1
		progress.Progress = 0
		progress.Notified = false
		progress.Target = Formulas.QuestTarget(quest, progress.Tier, data)
		if quest.Type == "UseTools" then
			progress.Used = {}
		end
	else
		progress.Completed = true
	end
	self.Data:Replicate(player, "QuestProgress")
	self.Services.EconomyService:GrantRewards(player, rewards, "Quest", "QUEST REWARD")
	self.QuestClaimed:Fire(player, questId)
end

return QuestService

ServerScriptService.Services.DevToolsSer.source:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

local DevToolsService = { Priority = 90 }

local function target(userId)
	if userId then
		return Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
	end
	return Players:GetPlayers()[1]
end

function DevToolsService:Init(services)
	self.Services = services
end

function DevToolsService:Start()
	if not RunService:IsStudio() then
		return
	end
	local services = self.Services
	local commands = {
		AddCash = function(player, amount)
			return services.EconomyService:AddCash(player, amount, "Studio")
		end,
		AddScrap = function(player, amount)
			return services.EconomyService:AddScrap(player, amount, "Studio", true)
		end,
		AddCores = function(player, amount)
			return services.EconomyService:AddCores(player, amount, "Studio")
		end,
		SetRebirths = function(player, amount)
			services.DataService:Set(player, "Rebirths", amount)
			return services.EconomyService:RefreshStats(player).CashMultiplier
		end,
		StartChaos = function(_, mega)
			services.EventService:StartChaos({ Mega = mega == true })
			return true
		end,
		FillChaos = function(_, fraction)
			services.EventService:AddChaosFraction(fraction or 1)
			return true
		end,
		Nuke = function(player)
			services.EventService:NuclearWreck(player)
			return true
		end,
		Snapshot = function(player)
			local data = services.DataService:GetData(player)
			return data and {
				Cash = data.Cash,
				Scrap = data.Scrap,
				ChaosCores = data.ChaosCores,
				Rebirths = data.Rebirths,
				Level = data.Level,
				Zones = data.Zones,
				Tools = data.Tools,
				Loadout = data.Loadout,
				Upgrades = data.Upgrades,
				Tutorial = data.Tutorial,
				TotalDestroyed = data.TotalDestroyed,
				QuestProgress = data.QuestProgress,
				Boosts = data.Boosts,
			}
		end,
	}
	local bridge = Instance.new("BindableFunction")
	bridge.Name = "StudioCommand"
	bridge.OnInvoke = function(command, value, userId)
		local player = target(userId)
		local handler = commands[command]
		if not player or not handler then
			return nil
		end
		return handler(player, value)
	end
	bridge.Parent = ServerStorage
end

return DevToolsService

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local ToolConfig = require(Shared.Config.ToolConfig)

local rgb = Color3.fromRGB

local STYLES = {
	TNT = { Color = rgb(255, 59, 59), Speed = 75, Arc = 0.35, Size = Vector3.new(0.6, 0.6, 1.6), Impact = rgb(255, 130, 30), Scale = 1.3 },
	Rocket = { Color = rgb(235, 235, 240), Speed = 210, Arc = 0, Size = Vector3.new(0.6, 0.6, 2.2), Impact = rgb(255, 110, 20), Scale = 1.8 },
	Plasma = { Color = rgb(34, 225, 255), Speed = 260, Arc = 0, Size = Vector3.new(1.3, 1.3, 1.3), Impact = rgb(60, 230, 255), Scale = 2.2, Ball = true },
	ChaosRay = { Color = rgb(166, 77, 255), Beam = true, Width = 1.8, Impact = rgb(180, 90, 255), Scale = 2.6 },
	Void = { Color = rgb(120, 40, 255), Beam = true, Width = 2.6, Impact = rgb(140, 50, 255), Scale = 3 },
}

local Projectiles = {}

local Fx = nil
local folder = nil
local lowEffects = false
local trailTexture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/explosion01_core_main.dds"

local function trail(part, color)
	local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment.Name = "TrailPoint"
	attachment.Parent = part
	local particles = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	particles.Name = "Exhaust"
	particles.Texture = trailTexture
	particles.LightEmission = lowEffects and 0.4 or 0.8
	particles.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	particles.Rate = lowEffects and 12 or 60
	particles.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.2, 0.35)
	particles.Speed = NumberRange.new(0, 1)
	particles.Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1.1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) })
	particles.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.2), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) })
	particles.Parent = attachment
end

local function flight(style, from, to, showImpact)
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = "Projectile"
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.CastShadow = false
	part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	part.Color = style.Color
	part.Size = style.Size
	if style.Ball then
		part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	end
	part.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(from, to)
	part.Parent = folder
	trail(part, style.Color)

	local distance = (to - from).Magnitude
	local duration = math.clamp(distance / style.Speed, 0.08, 1.1)
	local height = distance * style.Arc
	local started = os.clock()
	local connection
	connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local alpha = math.min((os.clock() - started) / duration, 1)
		local position = from:Lerp(to, alpha) + Vector3.new(0, math.sin(alpha * math.pi) * height, 0)
		local ahead = from:Lerp(to, math.min(alpha + 0.05, 1)) + Vector3.new(0, math.sin(math.min(alpha + 0.05, 1) * math.pi) * height, 0)
		if (ahead - position).Magnitude > 0.01 then
			part.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(position, ahead)
		else
			part.Position = position
		end
		if alpha >= 1 then
			connection:Disconnect()
			part:Destroy()
			if showImpact then
				Fx.Impact(to, style.Impact, style.Scale)
			end
		end
	end)
end

local function beam(style, from, to, showImpact)
	local start = Instance.new("Attachment")
	start.Name = "BeamStart"
	start.WorldPosition = from
	start.Parent = workspace.Terrain
	local finish = Instance.new("Attachment")
	finish.Name = "BeamEnd"
	finish.WorldPosition = to
	finish.Parent = workspace.Terrain
	local ray = Instance.new("Beam")
	ray.Name = "Ray"
	ray.Attachment0 = start
	ray.Attachment1 = finish
	ray.FaceCamera = true
	ray.LightEmission = lowEffects and 0.4 or 0.8
	ray.LightInfluence = 0
	ray.Segments = 1
	ray.Width0 = style.Width * (lowEffects and 0.5 or 1)
	ray.Width1 = style.Width * (lowEffects and 0.7 or 1.6)
	ray.Color = ColorSequence.new(style.Color, rgb(255, 255, 255))
	ray.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.05)
	ray.Parent = start
	local core = ray:Clone()
	core.Name = "Core"
	core.Width0 = style.Width * 0.35
	core.Width1 = style.Width * 0.5
	core.Color = ColorSequence.new(lowEffects and style.Color or rgb(255, 255, 255))
	core.Enabled = not lowEffects
	core.Parent = start
	if showImpact then
		Fx.Impact(to, style.Impact, style.Scale)
	end
	local fade = TweenInfo.new(0.28, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
	TweenService:Create(ray, fade, { Width0 = 0, Width1 = 0 }):Play()
	local tween = TweenService:Create(core, fade, { Width0 = 0, Width1 = 0 })
	tween:Play()
	tween.Completed:Once(function()
		start:Destroy()
		finish:Destroy()
	end)
end

function Projectiles.Setup(fx)
	Fx = fx
	folder = fx.Folder()
end

function Projectiles.SetLowEffects(value)
	lowEffects = value == true
end

function Projectiles.Fire(toolId, from, to, _, showImpact)
	local def = ToolConfig.ById[toolId]
	local style = def and STYLES[def.Fx]
	if not style or typeof(from) ~= "Vector3" or typeof(to) ~= "Vector3" then
		return
	end
	if style.Beam then
		beam(style, from, to, showImpact ~= false)
	else
		flight(style, from, to, showImpact ~= false)
	end
end

function Projectiles.Impact(toolId, from, to)
	local def = ToolConfig.ById[toolId]
	local style = def and STYLES[def.Fx]
	if not style or typeof(from) ~= "Vector3" or typeof(to) ~= "Vector3" then
		return
	end
	Fx.Impact(to, style.Impact, style.Scale)
end

return Projectiles

ServerScriptService.Services.TitleServic.source:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local TitleConfig = require(Shared.Config.TitleConfig)
local RebirthConfig = require(Shared.Config.RebirthConfig)
local ThemeConfig = require(Shared.Config.ThemeConfig)
local Net = require(Shared.Modules.Net)
local Ownership = require(Shared.Modules.Ownership)
local Notifier = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.Notifier)
local Nametag = require(script.Nametag)

local VIP_PASS = "VIPWrecker"

local TitleService = { Priority = 45 }

local worldFx = nil

local function meets(requirement, data, isVip)
	if requirement.Level and data.Level < requirement.Level then
		return false
	end
	if requirement.Rebirths and data.Rebirths < requirement.Rebirths then
		return false
	end
	if requirement.Pass and not isVip then
		return false
	end
	return true
end

local function bestAura(rebirths)
	local best = nil
	for _, aura in ipairs(RebirthConfig.Auras) do
		if rebirths >= aura.Rebirths then
			best = aura
		end
	end
	return best
end

function TitleService:Init(services)
	self.Services = services
	self.Data = services.DataService
	worldFx = Net.Remote("WorldFx")

	self.Data:OnProfileLoaded(function(player)
		self:Refresh(player)
	end)

	services.EconomyService.LevelUp:Connect(function(player, level)
		Notifier.Send(player, { Kind = "LevelUp", Text = "LEVEL UP!", Subtext = "LEVEL " .. level, Color = ThemeConfig.Colors.Yellow })
		worldFx:FireAllClients("LevelUp", { UserId = player.UserId })
		self:Refresh(player)
	end)

	if services.RebirthService then
		services.RebirthService.Reborn:Connect(function(player)
			self:Refresh(player)
		end)
	end
	if services.MonetizationService then
		services.MonetizationService.PassOwned:Connect(function(player)
			self:Refresh(player)
		end)
	end
end

function TitleService:Start()
	local function hookCharacter(player)
		if Ownership.IsOwner(player) then
			player:SetAttribute("Owner", true)
		end
		player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
			character:WaitForChild("Head", 10)
			character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
			if self.Data:IsLoaded(player) then
				self:Decorate(player)
			end
		end)
	end
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(hookCharacter)
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		hookCharacter(player)
	end

	self.Services.AntiExploitService:Connect("SelectTitle", { Rate = 2, Burst = 4 }, function(player, titleId)
		local data = self.Data:GetData(player)
		if titleId == "" or (type(titleId) == "string" and data.Titles[titleId]) then
			self.Data:Set(player, "SelectedTitle", titleId)
			self:Decorate(player)
		end
	end)
end

function TitleService:IsVip(player)
	local monetization = self.Services.MonetizationService
	return monetization ~= nil and monetization:HasPass(player, VIP_PASS)
end

function TitleService:GetTitle(player)
	local data = self.Data:GetData(player)
	if not data then
		return TitleConfig.List[1]
	end
	if data.SelectedTitle ~= "" and data.Titles[data.SelectedTitle] then
		return TitleConfig.ById[data.SelectedTitle]
	end
	local best = TitleConfig.List[1]
	for _, title in ipairs(TitleConfig.List) do
		if data.Titles[title.Id] and title.Order > best.Order then
			best = title
		end
	end
	return best
end

function TitleService:Refresh(player)
	local data = self.Data:GetData(player)
	if not data then
		return
	end
	local isVip = self:IsVip(player)
	local changed = false
	local candidates = table.clone(TitleConfig.List)
	table.insert(candidates, TitleConfig.VIP)
	for _, title in ipairs(candidates) do
		if not data.Titles[title.Id] and meets(title.Requirement, data, isVip) then
			data.Titles[title.Id] = true
			changed = true
			if title.Order and title.Order > 1 then
				Notifier.Send(player, { Kind = "Unlock", Text = "NEW TITLE!", Subtext = title.Name, Color = title.Color, Icon = title.Icon })
			end
		end
	end
	if changed then
		self.Data:Replicate(player, "Titles")
	end
	self:Decorate(player)
end

function TitleService:Decorate(player)
	local data = self.Data:GetData(player)
	local character = player.Character
	if not data or not character then
		return
	end
	local isVip = self:IsVip(player)
	local isOwner = Ownership.IsOwner(player)
	local isLeadDeveloper = Ownership.IsLeadDeveloper(player)
	player:SetAttribute("Owner", isOwner)
	player:SetAttribute("LeadDeveloper", isLeadDeveloper)
	local title = self:GetTitle(player)
	Nametag.Apply(character, {
		Name = player.DisplayName,
		Title = title.Name,
		TitleColor = title.Color,
		Level = data.Level,
		Vip = isVip,
		Owner = isOwner,
		LeadDeveloper = isLeadDeveloper,
	})
	Nametag.ApplyAura(character, bestAura(data.Rebirths), isVip, isOwner)
end

return TitleService

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local ThemeConfig = require(Shared.Config.ThemeConfig)
local DailyRewardConfig = require(Shared.Config.DailyRewardConfig)
local GameConfig = require(Shared.Config.GameConfig)
local ToolConfig = require(Shared.Config.ToolConfig)
local Formulas = require(Shared.Modules.Formulas)
local Format = require(Shared.Modules.Format)
local Net = require(Shared.Modules.Net)
local Components = script.Parent.Parent:WaitForChild("Components")
local UIKit = require(Components.UIKit)
local Widgets = require(Components.Widgets)

local Colors = ThemeConfig.Colors
local Fonts = ThemeConfig.Fonts

local DailyController = { Priority = 45 }

local window = nil

local function status(data)
 return DailyRewardConfig.Status(data)
end

local function describe(rewards)
	local lines = {}
	if rewards.Cash then
		table.insert(lines, Format.Number(rewards.Cash) .. " CASH")
	end
	if rewards.Scrap then
		table.insert(lines, Format.Number(rewards.Scrap) .. " SCRAP")
	end
	if rewards.ChaosCores then
		table.insert(lines, rewards.ChaosCores .. " CORES")
	end
	if rewards.Boost then
		local boost = GameConfig.Boosts[rewards.Boost.Id]
		table.insert(lines, (boost and boost.Name or "BOOST") .. " " .. math.floor(rewards.Boost.Seconds / 60) .. "M")
	end
	if rewards.Skin then
		local skin = ToolConfig.SkinsById[rewards.Skin]
		table.insert(lines, (skin and skin.Name or rewards.Skin) .. " SKIN")
	end
	return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

function DailyController:Init(controllers)
	self.Controllers = controllers
end

function DailyController:Start()
	local controllers = self.Controllers
	window = Widgets.Window("DailyUI", { Title = DailyRewardConfig.Name, Accent = Colors.Gold, FooterHeight = 76 })
	local grid = Widgets.Grid(window.Content, UDim2.new(0.25, -10, 0, 170), 10)
	grid.FillDirectionMaxCells = 4
	local footer = window.Footer
	Widgets.Chip(footer, { Name = "Streak", Icon = "DailyMega", Color = Colors.Gold, Size = UDim2.new(0.4, -6, 0, 44), MaxSize = 20 }).Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, -22)
	Widgets.Button(footer, {
		Name = "Claim",
		Text = "CLAIM",
		Size = UDim2.new(0.6, -6, 1, 0),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0),
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
		MaxSize = 28,
		OnClick = function()
			local data = controllers.DataController:GetAll()
			if data and status(data) then
				Net.Remote("ClaimDaily"):FireServer()
			end
		end,
	})
	controllers.PanelController:Register("Daily", window.Gui, {
		OnOpen = function()
			self:Refresh()
		end,
	})
	controllers.DataController:Observe("DailyReward", function()
		if controllers.PanelController:IsOpen("Daily") then
			self:Refresh()
		end
	end)
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(1)
			if controllers.PanelController:IsOpen("Daily") then
				self:RefreshFooter()
			end
		end
	end)
end

function DailyController:RefreshFooter()
	local dataController = self.Controllers.DataController
	local data = dataController:GetAll()
	if not data then
		return
	end
	local claimable, _, wait = status(data)
	local claim = window.Footer.Claim
	claim.Text = claimable and "CLAIM REWARD" or ("NEXT IN " .. Format.Time(wait))
	Widgets.SetVariant(claim, claimable and "Primary" or "Disabled")
	local bonus = dataController:GetStats().DailyBonus or 0
	window.Footer.Streak.Value.Text = "VISITS " .. data.DailyStreak .. (bonus > 0 and "  VIP +" .. math.floor(bonus * 100) .. "%" or "")
end

function DailyController:Refresh()
	local dataController = self.Controllers.DataController
	local data = dataController:GetAll()
	if not data then
		return
	end
	local claimable, nextDay = status(data)
	local bonus = dataController:GetStats().DailyBonus or 0
	Widgets.Clear(window.Content)
	for _, day in ipairs(DailyRewardConfig.Days) do
		local isToday = day.Day == nextDay
		local claimed = day.Day < nextDay
		local accent = day.Day == 7 and Colors.Gold or isToday and Colors.Yellow or Colors.Stroke
		local card = Widgets.Card(window.Content, { Name = "Day" .. day.Day, Order = day.Day, StrokeColor = accent })
		if isToday and claimable then
			card.Outline.Thickness = 4
			UIKit.Pop(card, 1.08)
		end
		if claimed then
			card.BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Black
		end
		Widgets.Label(card, { Name = "DayLabel", Text = "VISIT " .. day.Day, Font = Fonts.Display, Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 24), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6), AlignX = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, MaxSize = 20, Color = accent == Colors.Stroke and Colors.Muted or accent })
		Widgets.Icon(card, day.Icon, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(54, 54), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 32), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), FallbackColor = Colors.Gold })
		local rewards = Formulas.DailyRewards(day.Day, data, bonus)
		Widgets.Label(card, { Name = "Reward", Text = day.Name .. "\n" .. describe(rewards), Font = Fonts.Number, Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 72), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(5, 90), AlignX = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, AlignY = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, MaxSize = 13 })
		if claimed then
			Widgets.Label(card, { Name = "Claimed", Text = "CLAIMED", Font = Fonts.Display, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.4), AlignX = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, MaxSize = 22, Color = Colors.Cyan, Stroke = 2, ZIndex = 3 }).Rotation = -12
		end
	end
	self:RefreshFooter()
end

return DailyController

ServerScriptService.Services.RunService.source:
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Config=require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config.RunConfig)
local Notifier=require(game.ServerScriptService.Modules.Notifier)
local Validate=require(game.ServerScriptService.Modules.Validate)
local Hunt=require(script.TargetHunt)
local Salvage=require(script.SalvageRun)
local Signal=require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.Signal)
local RunService={Priority=52}
RunService.TargetCleared=Signal.new()
RunService.SalvageCollected=Signal.new()
RunService.ChallengeFinished=Signal.new()
local runs={}
local heavy={Medium=true,Large=true,Huge=true,Event=true}
local function now()return workspace:GetServerTimeNow()end

function RunService:Publish(player,record)
 self.Data:SetSession(player,"DemolitionRun",{
  Active=record.Active,Count=record.Count,EndsAt=record.EndsAt,
  ReadyAt=record.ReadyAt,Medal=record.Medal,ModeId=record.ModeId,
  Chain=record.Chain or 0,ChainEndsAt=record.ChainEndsAt or 0,
  TargetUid=record.TargetUid or "",TargetName=record.TargetName or "",
  TargetZone=record.TargetZone or "",RequiredTool=record.RequiredTool or "",
  ToolHit=record.ToolHit==true,Pickups=Salvage.Snapshot(record),
 })
end

function RunService:Init(services)
 self.Services=services self.Data=services.DataService
 self.Data:OnProfileLoaded(function(player)
  local record={Active=false,Count=0,EndsAt=0,ReadyAt=0,Medal="",ModeId="WreckRun",Seen={},SeenWrecks={},Chain=0,ChainEndsAt=0}
  runs[player]=record self:Publish(player,record)
 end)
 self.Data.ProfileReleasing:Connect(function(player)runs[player]=nil end)
 services.DestructionService.Wrecked:Connect(function(entry,credits)
  for _,credit in ipairs(credits)do
   local record=runs[credit.Player]
   if credit.Counted and record and record.Active then self:CountWreck(credit.Player,entry,record)end
  end
  -- A public target can be taken by someone else; replace it without granting progress.
  for player,record in pairs(runs)do
   if record.Active and record.TargetUid==entry.Uid then self:RefreshTarget(player,record)end
  end
 end)
 services.DestructionService.Damaged:Connect(function(player,entry,amount,toolId)
  local record=runs[player]
  if record and record.Active and (record.EndsAt==0 or now()<record.EndsAt) and amount>0 and
   record.TargetUid==entry.Uid and record.RequiredTool==toolId and not record.ToolHit then
   record.ToolHit=true self:Publish(player,record)
  end
 end)
end

function RunService:RefreshTarget(player,record)
 if runs[player]~=record or not record.Active then return end
 if record.EndsAt>0 and now()>=record.EndsAt then self:Finish(player,record)return end
 Hunt.Assign(self.Services,player,record,Config.ById[record.ModeId])
 self:Publish(player,record)
end

function RunService:CountWreck(player,entry,record)
 if runs[player]~=record or not record.Active then return end
 if record.EndsAt>0 and now()>=record.EndsAt then self:Finish(player,record)return end
 if not entry.Uid or record.SeenWrecks[entry.Uid]then return end
 if not self.Services.ZoneService:IsUnlocked(player,entry.Zone)then return end
 local mode=Config.ById[record.ModeId]
 if mode.Kind=="Salvage"then
  if Salvage.Drop(self.Services,player,record,mode,entry,now())then self:Publish(player,record)end
  return
 end
 if mode.Kind=="Hunt"then
  if record.TargetUid~=entry.Uid then return end
  if mode.RequireTool and not record.ToolHit then
   Notifier.Error(player,"HIT THE MARKED TARGET WITH THE NAMED TOOL")
   return
  end
 end
 local key
 if mode.Kind=="Materials"then key=entry.Def.MaterialType
 elseif mode.Kind=="Types"then key=entry.TypeId
 elseif mode.Kind=="Heavy"and not heavy[entry.SizeClass]then return end
 if mode.Kind=="Materials"or mode.Kind=="Types"then
  if not key or record.Seen[key]then return end
  record.Seen[key]=true
 end
 record.SeenWrecks[entry.Uid]=true
 if mode.Kind=="Chain"then
  local stamp=now()
  record.Chain=(stamp<record.ChainEndsAt and record.Chain or 0)+1
  record.ChainEndsAt=stamp+mode.ChainWindow
  record.Count=math.max(record.Count,record.Chain)
 else record.Count+=1 end
 if not mode.Untimed and record.Count>=mode.Tiers[#mode.Tiers].Target then self:Finish(player,record)
 else
  if mode.Kind=="Hunt"then
   record.PreviousType=entry.TypeId
   Hunt.Assign(self.Services,player,record,mode)
  end
  self:Publish(player,record)
 end
 if mode.Kind=="Hunt"then self.TargetCleared:Fire(player,mode.Id)end
end

function RunService:Begin(player,modeId)
 modeId=modeId or "WreckRun"
 local mode=Config.ById[modeId]
 local record=runs[player]local data=self.Data:GetData(player)
 if not mode or not data or not record then return false end
 if record.Active and (not Config.ById[record.ModeId].Untimed or record.ModeId==modeId)then return false end
 if not mode.Untimed and now()<record.ReadyAt then Notifier.Error(player,"CHALLENGE COOLING DOWN")return false end
 if not data.Tutorial.Completed then Notifier.Error(player,"FINISH THE STARTER GUIDE FIRST")return false end
 if mode.Kind=="Hunt"then
  local ready,reason=Hunt.Prepare(self.Services,player,record,mode,data)
  if not ready then Notifier.Error(player,reason)return false end
 else record.TargetUid=""record.RequiredTool=""record.TargetZone=""end
 if record.Active then self:Cancel(player)end
 record.Pickups={}
 record.Active=true record.Count=0 record.Medal="" record.ModeId=modeId record.Seen={} record.SeenWrecks={} record.Chain=0 record.ChainEndsAt=0
 if mode.Kind=="Hunt"then Hunt.Assign(self.Services,player,record,mode)end
 record.EndsAt=mode.Untimed and 0 or now()+mode.Duration
 self:Publish(player,record)
 return true
end

function RunService:Finish(player,record)
 if runs[player]~=record or not record.Active then return false end
 record.Pickups={}
 record.Active=false record.EndsAt=0 record.ChainEndsAt=0
 record.TargetUid="" record.RequiredTool="" record.ToolHit=false
 local mode=Config.ById[record.ModeId]
 if mode.Untimed then record.Medal="FREE SESSION ENDED" self:Publish(player,record)return true end
 local best
 for _,tier in ipairs(mode.Tiers)do if record.Count>=tier.Target then best=tier end end
 record.ReadyAt=now()+(best and Config.Cooldown or Config.RetryCooldown)
 record.Medal=best and best.Name or "TRY AGAIN"
 self:Publish(player,record)
 if best then
  self.Services.EconomyService:GrantRewards(player,best.Rewards,"Challenge",mode.Name.." - "..best.Name)
  self.ChallengeFinished:Fire(player,mode.Id,best.Name)
 else
  Notifier.Send(player,{Kind="Info",Text="CHALLENGE FINISHED",Subtext="Try again: "..mode.Tiers[1].Target.." "..string.lower(mode.Unit).." earn Bronze.",Icon="QuestDestroy"})
 end
 return true
end

function RunService:Cancel(player)
 local record=runs[player]
 if not record or not record.Active then return false end
 record.Pickups={}
 record.Active=false record.EndsAt=0 record.Chain=0 record.ChainEndsAt=0
 record.TargetUid=""record.RequiredTool=""record.ToolHit=false
 local free=Config.ById[record.ModeId].Untimed
 if not free then record.ReadyAt=now()+Config.RetryCooldown end
 record.Medal=free and "FREE SESSION ENDED"or "CANCELLED"
 self:Publish(player,record)
 Notifier.Send(player,{Kind="Info",Text=free and "FREE SESSION ENDED"or "CHALLENGE ENDED",Subtext=free and "Explore, or choose another activity whenever you like."or "No challenge prize. Quest progress stays. Retry in 15s.",Icon="QuestDestroy"})
 return true
end

function RunService:TickSalvage(player,record,stamp)
 if runs[player]~=record or not record.Active or Config.ById[record.ModeId].Kind~="Salvage"then return end
 stamp=stamp or now()
 if record.EndsAt>0 and stamp>=record.EndsAt then self:Finish(player,record)return end
 local mode=Config.ById[record.ModeId]
 local changed,collected=Salvage.Tick(self.Services,player,record,mode,stamp)
 if not changed then return end
 local accepted=math.min(collected,mode.Tiers[#mode.Tiers].Target-record.Count)
 record.Count+=accepted
 if record.Count>=mode.Tiers[#mode.Tiers].Target then self:Finish(player,record)else self:Publish(player,record)end
 if accepted>0 then self.SalvageCollected:Fire(player,accepted)end
end

function RunService:Start()
 self.Services.AntiExploitService:Connect("StartDemolitionRun",{Rate=0.5,Burst=2},function(player,...)
  local argc=select("#",...)
  if argc>1 then return end
  local modeId=...
  if modeId~=nil and not Validate.String(modeId,32)then return end
  if modeId=="CancelRun"then self:Cancel(player)else self:Begin(player,modeId)end
 end)
 Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)runs[player]=nil end)
 task.spawn(function()
  while true do
   task.wait(.5)
   local stamp=now()
   for player,record in pairs(runs)do
    if record.Active then
     if record.EndsAt>0 and stamp>=record.EndsAt then self:Finish(player,record)
     elseif Config.ById[record.ModeId].Kind=="Salvage"then self:TickSalvage(player,record,stamp)
     elseif Config.ById[record.ModeId].Kind=="Hunt"then
      if not self.Services.ZoneService:IsUnlocked(player,record.TargetZone)or
       (record.RequiredTool~=""and not self.Services.ToolService:Owns(player,record.RequiredTool))then self:Cancel(player)
      else
       local target=self.Services.DestructionService:GetEntry(record.TargetUid)
       if not target or not target.Alive then self:RefreshTarget(player,record)end
      end
     elseif record.Chain>0 and stamp>=record.ChainEndsAt then
      record.Chain=0 record.ChainEndsAt=0 self:Publish(player,record)
     end
    end
   end
  end
 end)
end
return RunService

ServerScriptService.Services.AdminServic.source:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local EventConfig = require(Shared.Config.EventConfig)
local ToolConfig = require(Shared.Config.ToolConfig)
local PetConfig = require(Shared.Config.PetConfig)
local Ownership = require(Shared.Modules.Ownership)
local RandomEvents = require(script.Parent.EventService.RandomEvents)
local Net = require(Shared.Modules.Net)
local AnnouncementText=require(script.AnnouncementText)
local AdminService = { Priority = 90 }
local lastCommand = {}
local LIMITS = { Cash = 1000000000, Scrap = 100000000, ChaosCores = 10000 }
local BOOSTS = { Cash2x=true, Cash3x=true, Damage2x=true, Scrap2x=true, ChaosRush=true, OrbRush=true }
local lastAnnouncement = {}
function AdminService:IsAuthorized(player)
 return Ownership.IsOwner(player) or Ownership.IsLeadDeveloper(player)
end
function AdminService:Reply(player, ok, message, requestId)
 self.Remote:FireClient(player, {Kind="Result", Ok=ok, Message=message,RequestId=requestId})
end
function AdminService:Init(services)
 self.Services=services
 self.Data=services.DataService
 self.Remote=ReplicatedStorage.Remotes:WaitForChild("AdminCommand")
 self.Notify=Net.Remote("Notify")
 self.Data:OnProfileLoaded(function(player)
  player:SetAttribute("Owner", Ownership.IsOwner(player))
  player:SetAttribute("LeadDeveloper", Ownership.IsLeadDeveloper(player))
  if Ownership.HasOwnerPerks(player) then
   services.ToolService:SyncPremium(player)
   services.ToolService:GiveLoadout(player)
  end
 end)
end
function AdminService:HandleCommand(player, payload)
  if not self:IsAuthorized(player)or not self.Data:IsLoaded(player)then return end
  if type(payload)~="table"or type(payload.Action)~="string"or #payload.Action>32 then return end
  local requestId=payload.RequestId
  if requestId~=nil and (type(requestId)~="string"or #requestId>64)then return end
  local function reply(ok,message)self:Reply(player,ok,message,requestId)end
  local now=os.clock()
  if lastCommand[player]and now-lastCommand[player]<0.5 then reply(false,"Espera un momento antes de otra acción."); return end
  lastCommand[player]=now
  local action=payload.Action
  local target=nil
  if payload.TargetId~=nil then
   local targetId=payload.TargetId
   if type(targetId)~="number" or targetId%1~=0 or targetId<1 then reply(false,"Jugador inválido."); return end
   target=Players:GetPlayerByUserId(targetId)
   if not target then reply(false,"Ese jugador ya no está en el servidor."); return end
   if not self.Data:IsLoaded(target) then reply(false,"El perfil del jugador aún está cargando."); return end
  end
  if action=="Announcement" then
   local title=payload.Title
   local message=payload.Message
   local style=payload.Style
   if type(title)~="string" or type(message)~="string" or type(style)~="string" then reply(false,"Completa el título y el mensaje."); return end
   title=AnnouncementText.Normalize(title,42)
   message=AnnouncementText.Normalize(message,220)
   if not title or not message or (style~="Big" and style~="Toast") then reply(false,"Título: hasta 42 caracteres; mensaje: hasta 220."); return end
   if lastAnnouncement[player]and now-lastAnnouncement[player]<15 then reply(false,"Espera 15 segundos entre anuncios."); return end
   lastAnnouncement[player]=now
   title,message=AnnouncementText.Filter(title,message,player.UserId)
   if not title or not message then reply(false,"No se pudo verificar el texto. Espera 15 s y vuelve a intentarlo.")return end
   if not self:IsAuthorized(player)or not self.Data:IsLoaded(player)or player.Parent~=Players then return end
   local color=style=="Big" and Color3.fromRGB(255,196,40) or Color3.fromRGB(54,205,230)
   for _,recipient in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    self.Notify:FireClient(recipient,{Kind=style,Text=title,Subtext=message,Color=color})
   end
   print(string.format("[AdminAnnouncement] %s (%d): %s — %s",player.Name,player.UserId,title,message))
   reply(true,"Anuncio enviado a "..#Players:GetPlayers().." jugadores.")
   return
  end
  if action=="GrantCurrency" then
   local currency=payload.Currency
   local maximum=LIMITS[currency]
   local amount=payload.Amount
   if not target or not maximum or type(amount)~="number" or amount%1~=0 or amount<1 or amount>maximum then reply(false,"Moneda o cantidad inválida; revisa el límite."); return end
   if currency=="Cash" then self.Services.EconomyService:AddCash(target,amount,"Admin")
   elseif currency=="Scrap" then self.Services.EconomyService:AddScrap(target,amount,"Admin",true)
   else self.Services.EconomyService:AddCores(target,amount) end
   reply(true,string.format("%s recibió %s %s.",target.DisplayName,amount,currency)); return
  elseif action=="GrantTool" then
   if not target or type(payload.Id)~="string" or #payload.Id>32 then reply(false,"Herramienta inválida."); return end
   local def=ToolConfig.ById[payload.Id]
   if not def or def.Premium or (def.OwnerOnly and not Ownership.HasOwnerPerks(target)) then reply(false,"Esa herramienta no se puede dar a esta cuenta."); return end
   local data=self.Data:GetData(target)
   if data.Tools[payload.Id] then reply(false,"El jugador ya tiene esa herramienta."); return end
   self.Services.ToolService:GrantTool(target,payload.Id,false)
   reply(true,string.format("Herramienta %s entregada a %s.",def.Name,target.DisplayName)); return
  elseif action=="GrantPet" then
   if not target or type(payload.Id)~="string" or #payload.Id>32 then reply(false,"Mascota inválida."); return end
   local def=PetConfig.ById[payload.Id]
   if not def or (def.OwnerOnly and not Ownership.HasOwnerPerks(target)) then reply(false,"Esa mascota no se puede dar a esta cuenta."); return end
   local uid,reason=self.Services.PetService:GrantPet(target,payload.Id)
   if not uid then reply(false,reason or "No se pudo entregar la mascota."); return end
   reply(true,string.format("%s recibió %s.",target.DisplayName,def.Name)); return
  elseif action=="GrantBoost" then
   local boostId,seconds=payload.Id,payload.Seconds
   if not target or type(boostId)~="string" or not BOOSTS[boostId] or type(seconds)~="number" or seconds%1~=0 or seconds<30 or seconds>86400 then reply(false,"Boost inválido (30 a 86400 segundos)."); return end
   if not self.Services.EconomyService:AddBoost(target,boostId,seconds) then reply(false,"No se pudo aplicar el boost."); return end
   reply(true,string.format("%s recibió %s por %d segundos.",target.DisplayName,boostId,seconds)); return
  elseif action=="StartChaos" or action=="StartMegaChaos" then
   local state=self.Services.EventService:GetState()
   if state:GetAttribute("ChaosState")=="TotalWreck" then reply(false,"Espera a que termine Total Wreck."); return end
   self.Services.EventService:StartChaos({Mega=action=="StartMegaChaos"})
   reply(true,action=="StartMegaChaos" and "Mega Chaos iniciado o ampliado." or "Chaos iniciado."); return
  elseif action=="StartRandomEvent" then
   local state=self.Services.EventService:GetState()
   if self.Services.EventService:IsChaosActive() then reply(false,"No se puede iniciar durante Chaos."); return end
   if state:GetAttribute("ActiveEvent")~="" then reply(false,"Ya hay un evento aleatorio activo."); return end
   local chosen=nil
   for _,event in ipairs(EventConfig.Random.List) do if event.Id==payload.Id then chosen=event break end end
   if not chosen then reply(false,"Evento inválido."); return end
   RandomEvents.Start(self.Services.EventService,chosen)
   reply(true,"Evento "..chosen.Name.." iniciado."); return
  end
  reply(false,"Acción no reconocida.")
end
function AdminService:Start()
 self.Services.AntiExploitService:Connect("AdminCommand",{Rate=2,Burst=4},function(player,payload)
  self:HandleCommand(player,payload)
 end)
 Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player) lastCommand[player]=nil; lastAnnouncement[player]=nil end)
end
return AdminService

ServerScriptService.Services.DataService.source:
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local MessagingService = game:GetService("MessagingService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local GameConfig = require(Shared.Config.GameConfig)
local Signal = require(Shared.Modules.Signal)
local Net = require(Shared.Modules.Net)
local TableUtil = require(Shared.Modules.TableUtil)
local Notifier = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.Notifier)
local DefaultData = require(script.DefaultData)
local Sanitize = require(script.Sanitize)

local SETTINGS_KEYS = { Music = true, Sfx = true, Shake = true, DamageNumbers = true, LowEffects = true }
local FINAL_TUTORIAL_STEP = 7
local RELEASE_TOPIC = "WreckRushProfileRelease"
local RELEASE_WAIT = 10
local LOCK_POLL = 2
local CLOSE_TIMEOUT = 25

local DataService = { Priority = 1 }
DataService.ProfileLoaded = Signal.new()
DataService.ProfileReleasing = Signal.new()
DataService.KeyChanged = Signal.new()

local profiles = {}
local store = nil
local syncRemote = nil
local useFallback = false

local function recordKey(player)
	return "Player_" .. player.UserId
end

local function canFallback(err)
	if not RunService:IsStudio() then
		return false
	end
	local text = string.lower(tostring(err))
	return game.PlaceId == 0 or string.find(text, "studio") ~= nil or string.find(text, "publish") ~= nil or string.find(text, "api") ~= nil
end

local function withRetries(callback)
	local lastError
	for attempt = 1, GameConfig.Data.MaxRetries do
		local ok, result, extra = pcall(callback)
		if ok then
			return true, result, extra
		end
		lastError = result
		if canFallback(result) then
			break
		end
		task.wait(GameConfig.Data.RetryDelay * 2 ^ (attempt - 1))
	end
	return false, lastError
end

local function lockedByOther(record, token)
	local lock = if type(record) == "table" then record.Lock else nil
	if type(lock) ~= "table" then
		return lock ~= nil
	end
	local stamp = lock.Time
	if type(stamp) ~= "number" or stamp ~= stamp then
		return true
	end
	return lock.Token ~= token and os.time() - stamp < GameConfig.Data.SessionLockTimeout
end

local function ownsLock(record, profile)
	return type(record) == "table" and type(record.Lock) == "table" and record.Lock.Token == profile.Token
end

local function acquire(player, token, force)
	local blocked = false
	local existed = false
	local ok, result = withRetries(function()
		return store:UpdateAsync(recordKey(player), function(record)
			blocked = false
			if not force and lockedByOther(record, token) then
				blocked = true
				return nil
			end
			existed = type(record) == "table" and record.Data ~= nil
			record = type(record) == "table" and record or {}
			record.Lock = { JobId = game.JobId, Token = token, Time = os.time() }
			record.SchemaVersion = record.SchemaVersion or GameConfig.Data.SchemaVersion
			return record
		end)
	end)
	return ok, result, blocked, existed
end

local function send(player, kind, a, b)
	if syncRemote and player.Parent then
		syncRemote:FireClient(player, kind, a, b)
	end
end

local function sendFull(player, profile)
	send(player, "Full", profile.Data, profile.Session)
end

local function createProfile(player, data, isNew, noSave, token)
	return {
		Data = data,
		Session = { Passes = {}, Stats = {}, IsNew = isNew, NoSave = noSave },
		Loaded = true,
		Token = token,
		Releasing = false,
		Saving = false,
		LastTick = os.clock(),
	}
end

local function requestRelease(player, token)
	task.spawn(pcall, MessagingService.PublishAsync, MessagingService, RELEASE_TOPIC, {
		UserId = player.UserId,
		Token = token,
		JobId = game.JobId,
	})
end

local function loadRecord(player, token)
	local deadline = os.clock() + RELEASE_WAIT
	local requested = false
	while os.clock() < deadline do
		local ok, result, blocked, existed = acquire(player, token, false)
		if not ok then
			return false, result
		end
		if not blocked then
			return true, result, existed
		end
		if not player.Parent then
			return false, "left"
		end
		if not requested then
			requested = true
			requestRelease(player, token)
		end
		task.wait(LOCK_POLL)
	end
	if not player.Parent then
		return false, "left"
	end
	local ok, result, _, existed = acquire(player, token, true)
	if not ok then
		return false, result
	end
	return true, result, existed
end

local function readRecord(player)
	return withRetries(function()
		return store:GetAsync(recordKey(player))
	end)
end

local function writeProfile(player, profile, release)
	if profile.Session.NoSave or not profile.Loaded or (profile.Releasing and not release) or not store then
		return false
	end
	while profile.Saving do
		task.wait(0.1)
	end
	if not profile.Loaded or (profile.Releasing and not release) then
		return false
	end
	profile.Saving = true
	local now = os.clock()
	profile.Data.PlayTime += math.floor(now - profile.LastTick)
	profile.LastTick = now
	local payload = TableUtil.DeepCopy(profile.Data)
	local written = false
	local lostLock = false
	local ok, err = withRetries(function()
		return store:UpdateAsync(recordKey(player), function(record)
			written = false
			if not ownsLock(record, profile) then
				lostLock = true
				return nil
			end
			record = type(record) == "table" and record or {}
			record.Data = payload
			record.SchemaVersion = GameConfig.Data.SchemaVersion
			record.Lock = if release then nil else { JobId = game.JobId, Token = profile.Token, Time = os.time() }
			written = true
			return record
		end)
	end)
	profile.Saving = false
	if lostLock then
		profile.Loaded = false
		if player.Parent and profiles[player] == profile then
			player:Kick("Your profile is active in another session. Please rejoin.")
		end
	end
	if not ok then
		warn("[DataService] save failed for " .. player.UserId .. ": " .. tostring(err))
	end
	return ok and written
end

local function loadProfile(player)
	local token = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
	local data, isNew, noSave
	if useFallback then
		data, isNew, noSave = DefaultData(), true, true
	elseif RunService:IsStudio() and GameConfig.Data.StudioReadOnly then
		local ok, record = readRecord(player)
		local saved = ok and type(record) == "table" and record.Data or nil
		if not ok and canFallback(record) then
			useFallback = true
		end
		data, isNew, noSave = Sanitize(saved), saved == nil, true
	else
		local ok, record, existed = loadRecord(player, token)
		if not ok then
			if canFallback(record) then
				useFallback = true
				data, isNew, noSave = DefaultData(), true, true
			else
				if player.Parent then
					player:Kick("Your data could not be loaded safely. Please rejoin.")
				end
				return
			end
		else
			data = Sanitize(existed and record.Data or nil)
			isNew = not existed
			noSave = false
		end
	end
	if not player.Parent then
		if not noSave then
			local ghost = createProfile(player, data, isNew, false, token)
			writeProfile(player, ghost, true)
		end
		return
	end
	if isNew then
		data = Sanitize(data)
	end
	data.LastJoin = os.time()
	local profile = createProfile(player, data, isNew, noSave, token)
	profiles[player] = profile
	sendFull(player, profile)
	DataService.ProfileLoaded:Fire(player, data)
	if noSave then
		task.delay(4, Notifier.Toast, player, "STUDIO MODE: PROGRESS IS NOT SAVED", Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 20))
	end
end

local function releaseProfile(player)
	local profile = profiles[player]
	if not profile or profile.Releasing then
		return
	end
	profile.Releasing = true
	DataService.ProfileReleasing:Fire(player, profile.Data)
	writeProfile(player, profile, true)
	profile.Loaded = false
	if profiles[player] == profile then
		profiles[player] = nil
	end
end

function DataService:Init(services)
	self.Services = services
	syncRemote = Net.Remote("DataSync")
	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return DataStoreService:GetDataStore(GameConfig.Data.StoreName)
	end)
	if ok then
		store = result
	else
		useFallback = canFallback(result)
		if not useFallback then
			warn("[DataService] datastore unavailable: " .. tostring(result))
		end
	end
end

function DataService:Start()
	local antiExploit = self.Services.AntiExploitService

	antiExploit:Connect("DataSync", { Rate = 1, Burst = 3, RequireData = false }, function(player, request)
		local profile = profiles[player]
		if request == "Ready" and self:IsLoaded(player) then
			sendFull(player, profile)
		end
	end)

	antiExploit:Connect("UpdateSettings", { Rate = 4, Burst = 8 }, function(player, key, value)
		if type(key) ~= "string" or not SETTINGS_KEYS[key] or type(value) ~= "boolean" then
			return
		end
		self:Update(player, "Settings", function(settings)
			settings[key] = value
			return settings
		end)
	end)

	antiExploit:Connect("TutorialProgress", { Rate = 2, Burst = 8 }, function(player, step)
		local data = self:GetData(player)
		if type(step) ~= "number" or data.Tutorial.Completed or step ~= data.Tutorial.Step + 1 then
			return
		end
		self:Update(player, "Tutorial", function(tutorial)
			tutorial.Step = math.min(step, FINAL_TUTORIAL_STEP)
			tutorial.Completed = tutorial.Step >= FINAL_TUTORIAL_STEP
			return tutorial
		end)
	end)

	task.spawn(function()
		local ok, err = pcall(MessagingService.SubscribeAsync, MessagingService, RELEASE_TOPIC, function(message)
			local payload = message.Data
			if type(payload) ~= "table" or payload.JobId == game.JobId then
				return
			end
			local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(tonumber(payload.UserId) or 0)
			local profile = player and profiles[player]
			if profile and profile.Token ~= payload.Token then
				releaseProfile(player)
				if player.Parent then
					player:Kick("You joined WRECKRUSH from another session.")
				end
			end
		end)
		if not ok then
			warn("[DataService] release channel unavailable: " .. tostring(err))
		end
	end)

	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(loadProfile)
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		task.spawn(loadProfile, player)
	end
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(releaseProfile)

	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(GameConfig.Data.AutosaveInterval)
			for player, profile in pairs(profiles) do
				task.spawn(writeProfile, player, profile, false)
				task.wait(0.5)
			end
		end
	end)

	game:BindToClose(function()
		local pending = 0
		for player in pairs(profiles) do
			pending += 1
			task.spawn(function()
				releaseProfile(player)
				pending -= 1
			end)
		end
		local started = os.clock()
		while (pending > 0 or next(profiles) ~= nil) and os.clock() - started < CLOSE_TIMEOUT do
			task.wait(0.2)
		end
	end)
end

function DataService:OnProfileLoaded(callback)
	for player, profile in pairs(profiles) do
		task.spawn(callback, player, profile.Data)
	end
	return self.ProfileLoaded:Connect(callback)
end

function DataService:GetData(player)
	local profile = profiles[player]
	return profile and profile.Loaded and not profile.Releasing and profile.Data or nil
end

function DataService:IsLoaded(player)
	local profile = profiles[player]
	return profile ~= nil and profile.Loaded and not profile.Releasing
end

function DataService:WaitForData(player, timeout)
	local started = os.clock()
	while not self:IsLoaded(player) and player.Parent and os.clock() - started < (timeout or 30) do
		task.wait(0.1)
	end
	return self:GetData(player)
end

function DataService:Set(player, key, value)
	local profile = profiles[player]
	if not profile or not profile.Loaded or profile.Releasing then
		return
	end
	profile.Data[key] = value
	send(player, "Set", key, value)
	self.KeyChanged:Fire(player, key, value)
end

function DataService:Update(player, key, callback)
	local profile = profiles[player]
	if not profile or not profile.Loaded or profile.Releasing then
		return nil
	end
	local value = callback(profile.Data[key])
	if value ~= nil then
		profile.Data[key] = value
	end
	send(player, "Set", key, profile.Data[key])
	self.KeyChanged:Fire(player, key, profile.Data[key])
	return profile.Data[key]
end

function DataService:Increment(player, key, delta)
	local profile = profiles[player]
	if not profile or not profile.Loaded or profile.Releasing or type(delta) ~= "number" or delta ~= delta then
		return nil
	end
	local value = (profile.Data[key] or 0) + delta
	self:Set(player, key, value)
	return value
end

function DataService:Replicate(player, key)
	local profile = profiles[player]
	if profile and profile.Loaded and not profile.Releasing then
		send(player, "Set", key, profile.Data[key])
		self.KeyChanged:Fire(player, key, profile.Data[key])
	end
end

function DataService:SetSession(player, key, value)
	local profile = profiles[player]
	if profile and profile.Loaded and not profile.Releasing then
		profile.Session[key] = value
		send(player, "Session", key, value)
	end
end

function DataService:GetSession(player, key)
	local profile = profiles[player]
	return profile and profile.Session[key]
end

function DataService:SaveNow(player)
	local profile = profiles[player]
	if not profile or not profile.Loaded or profile.Releasing then
		return false
	end
	return writeProfile(player, profile, false)
end

return DataService

ServerScriptService.Services.DropService.source:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local GameConfig = require(Shared.Config.GameConfig)
local Net = require(Shared.Modules.Net)
local Notifier = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.Notifier)

local FULL_NOTICE_COOLDOWN = 30
local PICKUP_PADDING = 2.5
local ORB_HEIGHT = 1.6

local DropService = { Priority = 25 }

local pending = {}
local pendingCount = {}
local lastFullNotice = {}
local idCounter = 0
local remote = nil
local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

local function groundAt(position)
	local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
	if map then
		rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { map }
		local hit = workspace:Raycast(position + Vector3.new(0, 30, 0), Vector3.new(0, -80, 0), rayParams)
		if hit then
			return hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, ORB_HEIGHT, 0)
		end
	end
	return Vector3.new(position.X, ORB_HEIGHT, position.Z)
end

local function removeOldest(player)
	local list = pending[player]
	local oldestId, oldestTime = nil, math.huge
	for id, drop in pairs(list) do
		if drop.ExpiresAt < oldestTime then
			oldestId, oldestTime = id, drop.ExpiresAt
		end
	end
	if oldestId then
		list[oldestId] = nil
		pendingCount[player] -= 1
		remote:FireClient(player, "Expire", { oldestId })
	end
end

function DropService:Init(services)
	self.Services = services
	remote = Net.Remote("ScrapDrops")
end

function DropService:Spawn(player, kind, totalValue, position, count, extra)
	if not self.Services.DataService:IsLoaded(player) then
		return
	end
	totalValue = math.floor(tonumber(totalValue) or 0)
	if totalValue <= 0 and kind ~= "Boost" then
		return
	end
	count = math.clamp(math.floor(count or 1), 1, 24)
	if kind ~= "Boost" then
		count = math.min(count, totalValue)
	end
	pending[player] = pending[player] or {}
	pendingCount[player] = pendingCount[player] or 0
	local list = pending[player]
	local share = math.floor(totalValue / count)
	local remainder = totalValue - share * count
	local spread = (extra and extra.Spread) or 6
	local spawned = {}
	for index = 1, count do
		if pendingCount[player] >= GameConfig.Drops.MaxPendingPerPlayer then
			removeOldest(player)
		end
		idCounter += 1
		local angle = math.random() * math.pi * 2
		local radius = 2.5 + math.random() * spread
		local spot = groundAt(position + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * radius, 0, math.sin(angle) * radius))
		local drop = {
			Id = idCounter,
			Kind = kind,
			Value = share + (index == 1 and remainder or 0),
			Position = spot,
			ExpiresAt = os.clock() + ((extra and extra.Lifetime) or GameConfig.Drops.Lifetime),
			Boost = extra and extra.Boost,
			Seconds = extra and extra.Seconds,
		}
		list[drop.Id] = drop
		pendingCount[player] += 1
		table.insert(spawned, { Id = drop.Id, Kind = kind, Value = drop.Value, Position = spot, Origin = position })
	end
	remote:FireClient(player, "Spawn", spawned)
end

local function collect(self, player, drop)
	local economy = self.Services.EconomyService
	if drop.Kind == "Scrap" then
		local added = economy:AddScrap(player, drop.Value, "Drop")
		if added >= drop.Value then
			return true
		end
		drop.Value -= added
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - (lastFullNotice[player] or 0) > FULL_NOTICE_COOLDOWN then
			lastFullNotice[player] = now
			Notifier.Send(player, { Kind = "Error", Text = "SCRAP BAG FULL", Subtext = "Tap your Scrap to spend it or grow the bag", Icon = "Scrap" })
		end
		return false
	elseif drop.Kind == "Cash" then
		economy:AddCash(player, drop.Value, "Drop")
		return true
	elseif drop.Kind == "Boost" then
		economy:AddBoost(player, drop.Boost, drop.Seconds)
		return true
	end
	return true
end

function DropService:Start()
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		pending[player] = nil
		pendingCount[player] = nil
		lastFullNotice[player] = nil
	end)

	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(GameConfig.Drops.CollectInterval)
			local now = os.clock()
			for player, list in pairs(pending) do
				if next(list) then
					local character = player.Character
					local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
					local alive = root ~= nil and humanoid ~= nil and humanoid.Health > 0 and character == player.Character
					local radius = 0
					if alive then
						local stats = self.Services.EconomyService:GetStats(player)
						radius = math.max(stats.MagnetRange, stats.AutoScrapRadius) + PICKUP_PADDING
					end
					local collected, expired = {}, {}
					for id, drop in pairs(list) do
						if now >= drop.ExpiresAt then
							list[id] = nil
							table.insert(expired, id)
						elseif alive and (drop.Position - root.Position).Magnitude <= radius and collect(self, player, drop) then
							list[id] = nil
							table.insert(collected, id)
						end
					end
					pendingCount[player] -= #collected + #expired
					if #collected > 0 then
						remote:FireClient(player, "Collect", collected)
					end
					if #expired > 0 then
						remote:FireClient(player, "Expire", expired)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

return DropService

		Text = "INSTANT REBIRTH",
		Variant = "Robux",
		Size = UDim2.new(0.42, -6, 1, 0),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0),

			if controllers.PanelController:IsOpen("Rebirth") then
				self:Refresh()
			end
		end)
	end
end

function RebirthController:TryRebirth()
	local data = self.Controllers.DataController:GetAll()
	if not data or data.Cash < Formulas.RebirthCost(data.Rebirths) then
		return
	end
	if os.clock() < confirmUntil then
		confirmUntil = 0
		Net.Remote("Rebirth"):FireServer()
		self.Controllers.PanelController:Close("Rebirth")
	else
		confirmUntil = os.clock() + CONFIRM_WINDOW
		local button = window.Footer.RebirthButton
		button.Text = if data.Scrap > 0 then "TAP AGAIN - " .. Format.Number(data.Scrap) .. " SCRAP WILL BE LOST" else "TAP AGAIN TO CONFIRM"
		UIKit.Shake(button)
		task.delay(CONFIRM_WINDOW, function()
			if os.clock() >= confirmUntil then
				self:Refresh()
			end
		end)
	end
end

	if not data then
		return
