		Widgets.Label(header, { Name = "Right", Text = "CURRENT  >  AFTER", Font = Fonts.Display, Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0), AlignX = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, MaxSize = 20, Color = Colors.Muted })
		local before = Formulas.RebirthMultipliers(data.Rebirths)
		local after = Formulas.RebirthMultipliers(data.Rebirths + 1)
		compareRow(compare, "CASH MULTIPLIER", Format.Multiplier(before.Cash), Format.Multiplier(after.Cash), Colors.Cash, 1)
		compareRow(compare, "DAMAGE", Format.Multiplier(before.Damage), Format.Multiplier(after.Damage), Colors.Damage, 2)
		compareRow(compare, "SCRAP", Format.Multiplier(before.Scrap), Format.Multiplier(after.Scrap), Colors.Scrap, 3)
		compareRow(compare, "CHAOS CORES", Format.Number(data.ChaosCores), Format.Number(data.ChaosCores + Formulas.RebirthCores(data.Rebirths)), Colors.Cores, 4)

		local requirement = Widgets.Card(window.Content, { Name = "Requirement", Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 76), Order = 2 })
		Widgets.Label(requirement, { Name = "Caption", Text = ready and "READY TO REBIRTH!" or "REQUIREMENT", Font = Fonts.Display, Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 26), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 8), MaxSize = 20, Color = ready and Colors.Yellow or Colors.White })
		local bar = Widgets.Progress(requirement, { Name = "Bar", Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 22), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 42), Color = Colors.Purple, Value = data.Cash / cost })
		Widgets.Label(bar, { Name = "Amount", Text = Format.Number(data.Cash) .. " / " .. Format.Number(cost) .. " CASH", Font = Fonts.Number, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), AlignX = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, MaxSize = 14, Stroke = 1, ZIndex = 3 })

		local rules = Widgets.Card(window.Content, { Name = "Rules", Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 96), Order = 3 })
		Widgets.Label(rules, { Name = "Lose", Text = "RESETS: Cash, Scrap, tools (except Scrap Hammer and premium tools), Damage / Speed / Crit / Blast / Cash / Scrap upgrades", Font = Fonts.Body, Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 38), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 8), MaxSize = 15, Color = Colors.Red })
		Widgets.Label(rules, { Name = "Keep", Text = "KEEPS: zones, pets, skins, Chaos Cores, Chaos Shop, Magnet / Move Speed / Capacity, quests, boosts", Font = Fonts.Body, Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 38), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 50), MaxSize = 15, Color = Colors.Cyan })

		local milestone = nil
		for _, entry in ipairs(RebirthConfig.Milestones) do
			if entry.Rebirths > data.Rebirths then

		if milestone then

		balance.BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Panel

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Net = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.Net)

local FLAG_WINDOW = 60
local KICK_THRESHOLD = 300

local AntiExploitService = { Priority = 2 }

local buckets = {}
local flags = {}

local function consume(player, name, rate, burst)
	local owned = buckets[player]
	if not owned then
		owned = {}
		buckets[player] = owned
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	local bucket = owned[name]
	if not bucket then
		bucket = { Tokens = burst, Stamp = now }
		owned[name] = bucket
	end
	bucket.Tokens = math.min(burst, bucket.Tokens + (now - bucket.Stamp) * rate)
	bucket.Stamp = now
	if bucket.Tokens < 1 then
		return false
	end
	bucket.Tokens -= 1
	return true
end

function AntiExploitService:Init(services)
	self.Services = services
end

function AntiExploitService:Start()
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		buckets[player] = nil
		flags[player] = nil
	end)
end

function AntiExploitService:Flag(player, reason)
	local now = os.clock()
	local record = flags[player]
	if not record or now - record.Since > FLAG_WINDOW then
		record = { Count = 0, Since = now, Reasons = {} }
		flags[player] = record
	end
	record.Count += 1
	record.Reasons[reason] = (record.Reasons[reason] or 0) + 1
	if record.Count >= KICK_THRESHOLD and player.Parent then
		player:Kick("Unusual network activity detected.")
	end
end

function AntiExploitService:Connect(remoteName, options, handler)
	options = options or {}
	local rate = options.Rate or 5
	local burst = options.Burst or rate
	local requireData = options.RequireData ~= false
	local remote = Net.Remote(remoteName)
	return remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, ...)
		if not consume(player, remoteName, rate, burst) then
			self:Flag(player, remoteName)
			return
		end
		if requireData and not self.Services.DataService:IsLoaded(player) then
			return
		end
		local ok, err = pcall(handler, player, ...)
		if not ok then
			warn(string.format("[%s] %s: %s", remoteName, player.Name, tostring(err)))
		end
	end)
end

return AntiExploitService

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local ThemeConfig = require(Shared.Config.ThemeConfig)
local ToolConfig = require(Shared.Config.ToolConfig)
local Formulas = require(Shared.Modules.Formulas)
local Format = require(Shared.Modules.Format)
local Net = require(Shared.Modules.Net)
local Ownership = require(Shared.Modules.Ownership)
local Components = script.Parent.Parent:WaitForChild("Components")
local UIKit = require(Components.UIKit)
local Widgets = require(Components.Widgets)

local Colors = ThemeConfig.Colors
local Fonts = ThemeConfig.Fonts

local SKIN_SOURCES = { Default = "DEFAULT", StarterPack = "STARTER PACK", Daily = "WRECKER DAILY DAY 5", Scrap = "SCRAP", Rebirth = "REBIRTH" }
local TOOL_TYPES = { Melee = "MELEE", Projectile = "PROJECTILE", Beam = "BEAM" }

local ToolsController = { Priority = 41 }

local window = nil
local tab = "Tools"

local function compactLayout()
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	return camera and camera.ViewportSize.Y < 600
end

local function rowCard(name, order, accent, height)
	local card = Widgets.Card(window.Content, { Name = name, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height or 92), Order = order, Accent = accent })
	local info = UIKit.Create("Frame", { Name = "Info", BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(compactLayout() and 64 or 92, 8), Size = UDim2.new(0.65, compactLayout() and -68 or -96, 1, -16), Parent = card })

	return card, info, action
end

function ToolsController:Init(controllers)
	self.Controllers = controllers
end

function ToolsController:Start()
	local controllers = self.Controllers
	window = Widgets.Window("ToolsUI", { Title = "TOOLS", Accent = Colors.Orange, Tabs = true, FooterHeight = 64 })
	Widgets.List(window.Content, 10)
	for index, name in ipairs({ "Tools", "Skins" }) do
		Widgets.Tab(window.Tabs, { Name = name .. "Tab", Text = string.upper(name), Order = index, OnClick = function()
			tab = name
			self:Refresh()
		end })
	end
	local footer = window.Footer
	Widgets.Chip(footer, { Name = "Slots", Icon = "NavTools", Color = Colors.Orange, Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -6, 0, 44), MaxSize = 20 }).Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, -22)
	Widgets.Button(footer, {
		Name = "ExtraLoadout",
		Text = "EXTRA LOADOUT +3",
		Variant = "Robux",
		Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -6, 0, 44),

		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),

			controllers.PanelController:Open("Shop", "ExtraLoadout")
		end,
	})

	controllers.PanelController:Register("Tools", window.Gui, {
		OnOpen = function()
			self:Refresh()
		end,
	})
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if camera then
		camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(function()
			if controllers.PanelController:IsOpen("Tools") then
				self:Refresh()
			end

	end
	controllers.DataController.Loaded:Connect(function()
		if controllers.PanelController:IsOpen("Tools") then
			self:Refresh()
		end
	end)
	for _, key in ipairs({ "Tools", "Loadout", "Skins", "EquippedSkin", "Cash", "Scrap", "Rebirths" }) do
		controllers.DataController:Observe(key, function()
			if controllers.PanelController:IsOpen("Tools") then
				self:Refresh()
			end
		end)
	end
	controllers.DataController:ObserveSession("Stats", function()
		if controllers.PanelController:IsOpen("Tools") then
			self:Refresh()
		end
	end)
	controllers.DataController:ObserveSession("Passes", function()
		if controllers.PanelController:IsOpen("Tools") then
			self:Refresh()
		end
	end)
end

function ToolsController:ToggleLoadout(toolId)
	local dataController = self.Controllers.DataController
	local loadout = table.clone(dataController:Get("Loadout") or {})
	local slots = dataController:GetStats().LoadoutSlots or 3
	local index = table.find(loadout, toolId)
	if index then
		if #loadout <= 1 then
			return
		end
		table.remove(loadout, index)
	else
		if #loadout >= slots then
			table.remove(loadout, #loadout)
		end
		table.insert(loadout, toolId)
	end
	Net.Remote("SetLoadout"):FireServer(loadout)
end

function ToolsController:Refresh()
	local dataController = self.Controllers.DataController
	local data = dataController:GetAll()
	if not data then
		return
	end
	local passes = dataController:GetSession("Passes") or {}
	local stats = dataController:GetStats()
	local slots = stats.LoadoutSlots or 3
	Widgets.Clear(window.Content)
	for _, button in ipairs(window.Tabs:GetChildren()) do
		if button:IsA("TextButton") then
			Widgets.SetVariant(button, button.Name == tab .. "Tab" and "Accent" or "Secondary")
		end
	end
	window.Footer.Slots.Value.Text = "LOADOUT " .. #data.Loadout .. " / " .. slots
	window.Footer.ExtraLoadout.Visible = slots <= 3

	if tab == "Tools" then
		local isOwner = Ownership.HasOwnerPerks(Players.LocalPlayer)
		for _, tool in ipairs(ToolConfig.List) do
			if tool.OwnerOnly and not isOwner then
				continue
			end
			local compact = compactLayout()
			local card, info, action = rowCard(tool.Id, tool.Order, tool.Color, compact and 108 or 132)
			Widgets.Icon(card, tool.Icon, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(compact and 42 or 62, compact and 42 or 62), Position = UDim2.new(0, compact and 12 or 18, 0.5, 0), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), FallbackColor = tool.Color })
			Widgets.Label(info, { Name = "ToolName", Text = tool.Name, Font = Fonts.Display, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26), MaxSize = 24, Color = if tool.OwnerOnly then Colors.Gold elseif tool.Premium then Colors.Purple else Colors.White })
			local radius = Formulas.BlastRadius(tool.Id, stats)
			local cooldown = Formulas.AttackCooldown(tool.Id, stats)
			local damage = Formulas.HitDamage(tool.Id, data, stats, false)
			Widgets.Label(info, { Name = "Stats", Text = "HIT " .. Format.Number(damage) .. "  |  " .. string.format("%.2fs", cooldown), Font = Fonts.Number, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 28), MaxSize = 17, Color = Colors.Yellow })
			local role=tool.Kind=="Melee"and "CLOSE & PRECISE"or tool.Kind=="Beam"and "DISTANT TARGETS"or "GROUPS OF OBJECTS"
   local reach = "RANGE " .. Format.Number(tool.Range)
			local area = radius > 0 and ("  |  AREA " .. Format.Number(radius)) or ""
			Widgets.Label(info, { Name = "Reach", Text = role .. "\n" .. reach .. area, Font = Fonts.Number, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 36), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 54), MaxSize = 14, Color = Colors.Cyan })
			local description = Widgets.Label(info, { Name = "Description", Text = tool.Description, Font = Fonts.Light, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 92), MaxSize = 13, Color = Colors.Muted })
			description.Visible = not compact

			local owned = if tool.OwnerOnly then isOwner elseif tool.Premium then passes[tool.Premium] == true else data.Tools[tool.Id] == true
			if owned then
				local inLoadout = table.find(data.Loadout, tool.Id) ~= nil
				Widgets.Button(action, {
					Name = "Toggle",
					Text = inLoadout and "IN LOADOUT" or "EQUIP",
					Variant = inLoadout and "Secondary" or "Accent",
					Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.62),
					Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.19),
					OnClick = function()
						self:ToggleLoadout(tool.Id)
					end,
				})
			elseif tool.Premium then
				Widgets.Button(action, {
					Name = "Premium",
					Text = "GAME PASS",
					Variant = "Robux",
					Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.62),
					Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.19),
					OnClick = function()
						self.Controllers.PanelController:Open("Shop", tool.Premium)
					end,
				})
			elseif data.Rebirths < tool.RequiredRebirths then
				Widgets.Button(action, { Name = "Locked", Text = "REBIRTH " .. tool.RequiredRebirths, Variant = "Disabled", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.62), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.19) })
			else
				local affordable = data.Cash >= tool.Price
				local price = Widgets.Chip(action, { Name = "Price", Icon = "Cash", Text = Format.Number(tool.Price), Color = Colors.Cash, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.42, 0), MaxSize = 18 })
				price.Position = UDim2.new()
				Widgets.Button(action, {
					Name = "Buy",
					Text = "BUY",
					Variant = affordable and "Primary" or "Disabled",
					Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.5),
					Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.5),
					OnClick = function()
						Net.Remote("BuyTool"):FireServer(tool.Id)
					end,
				})
			end
		end
	else
		for _, skin in ipairs(ToolConfig.Skins) do
			local compact = compactLayout()
			local card, info, action = rowCard(skin.Id, skin.Order, skin.Primary or Colors.Muted)
			local swatch = UIKit.Create("Frame", { Name = "Swatch", BackgroundColor3 = skin.Primary or Colors.PanelLight, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(compact and 42 or 58, compact and 42 or 58), Position = UDim2.new(0, compact and 12 or 18, 0.5, 0), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Parent = card })
			Widgets.Corner(swatch, UDim.new(0, 12))
			Widgets.Stroke(swatch, skin.Accent or Colors.Stroke, 4)
			Widgets.Label(info, { Name = "SkinName", Text = skin.Name, Font = Fonts.Display, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28), MaxSize = 24 })
			local source = SKIN_SOURCES[skin.Source] or skin.Source
			if skin.Source == "Scrap" then
				source = Format.Number(skin.Price) .. " SCRAP"
			elseif skin.Source == "Rebirth" then
				source = "REACH " .. skin.RequiredRebirths .. " REBIRTHS"
			end
			Widgets.Label(info, { Name = "Source", Text = source, Font = Fonts.Number, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 34), MaxSize = 16, Color = Colors.Muted })
			local owned = data.Skins[skin.Id] == true
			local equipped = data.EquippedSkin == skin.Id
			local props = { Name = "Act", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.62), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.19) }
			if equipped then

				props.Variant = "Secondary"
			elseif owned then
				props.Text = "EQUIP"
				props.Variant = "Accent"

					Net.Remote("EquipSkin"):FireServer(skin.Id)

			elseif skin.Source == "Scrap" and data.Scrap < skin.Price and skin.Price > (stats.Capacity or 500) then
				props.Text = "BAG TOO SMALL"
				props.Variant = "Secondary"
				props.OnClick = function()
					self.Controllers.PanelController:Open("Upgrades", "Scrap")
				end
			elseif skin.Source == "Scrap" then
				props.Text = "BUY"
				props.Variant = data.Scrap >= skin.Price and "Scrap" or "Disabled"
				props.OnClick = function()
					Net.Remote("BuySkin"):FireServer(skin.Id)

			else

				props.Variant = "Disabled"
			end
			Widgets.Button(action, props)
		end
	end
end

return ToolsController

ServerScriptService.Services.ZoneService.source:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local GameConfig = require(Shared.Config.GameConfig)
local ZoneConfig = require(Shared.Config.ZoneConfig)
local Formulas = require(Shared.Modules.Formulas)
local Format = require(Shared.Modules.Format)
local Signal = require(Shared.Modules.Signal)
local Net = require(Shared.Modules.Net)
local Validate = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.Validate)
local Notifier = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.Notifier)

local TOUCH_COOLDOWN = 1.5
local INTRUSION_INTERVAL = 1
local MAP_LIMIT = 386
local FALL_LIMIT = -40

local ZoneService = { Priority = 35 }
ZoneService.ZoneUnlocked = Signal.new()

local lastTouch = {}
local lastTravel = {}
local bound = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local openPanel = nil

local function playerFromHit(hit)
	local model = hit:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
	local player = model and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
	if not player then
		return nil
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - (lastTouch[player] or 0) < TOUCH_COOLDOWN then
		return nil
	end
	local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return nil
	end
	lastTouch[player] = now
	return player
end

local function plazaCFrame()
	local position = GameConfig.SpawnPosition
	return CFrame.lookAt(position, position + Vector3.new(0, 0, -1))
end

local function hallCFrame()
	local center = ZoneConfig.CellCenter(ZoneConfig.Hall.Cell)
	local position = center + Vector3.new(0, 4, -70)
	return CFrame.lookAt(position, center + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0))
end

local function zoneForGate(gate)
	local owner = gate.Parent
	if not owner then
		return nil
	end
	if owner.Name == "VIPArea" then
		return "VIP"
	end
	return ZoneConfig.ById[owner.Name] and owner.Name or nil
end

local function writeSign(sign, zoneId)
	local display = sign:FindFirstChild("Display")
	local zone = ZoneConfig.ById[zoneId]
	if not display or not zone then
		return
	end
	local function setText(name, text)
		local label = display:FindFirstChild(name, true)
		if label and label:IsA("TextLabel") then
			label.Text = text
		end
	end
	setText("ZoneName", zone.Name)
	if zoneId == "VIP" then
		setText("Price", "VIP WRECKER PASS")
		setText("Requirement", "GOLDEN VAULTS x3 REWARDS")
	elseif zone.UnlockCost > 0 then
		setText("Price", Format.Number(zone.UnlockCost) .. " CASH")
		setText("Requirement", zone.RequiredRebirths > 0 and ("REQUIRES " .. zone.RequiredRebirths .. " REBIRTHS") or ("REWARDS x" .. zone.RewardMultiplier))
	else
		setText("Price", "FREE")
		setText("Requirement", "REWARDS x" .. zone.RewardMultiplier)
	end
	setText("Status", (zone.UnlockCost or 1) > 0 and "LOCKED" or "OPEN")
end

function ZoneService:Init(services)
	self.Services = services
	self.Data = services.DataService
	openPanel = Net.Remote("OpenPanel")
end

function ZoneService:BindPart(part)
	if not part:IsA("BasePart") or bound[part] then
		return
	end
	local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
	local portals = map and map:FindFirstChild("Portals")
	local handler = nil
	if part.Name == "Pad" and portals and part.Parent and part.Parent.Parent == portals then
		local destination = part.Parent.Name
		handler = function(player)
			self:Travel(player, destination)
		end
	elseif part.Name == "ReturnPad" then
		handler = function(player)
			self:Travel(player, "Plaza")
		end
	elseif part.Name == "Trigger" and part.Parent and part.Parent.Name == "Gate" then
		local zoneId = zoneForGate(part.Parent)
		if zoneId then
			handler = function(player)
				if not self:IsUnlocked(player, zoneId) then
					self:PromptUnlock(player, zoneId)
				end
			end
		end
	elseif part.Name == "Sign" and part.Parent and part.Parent.Name == "Gate" then
		local zoneId = zoneForGate(part.Parent)
		if zoneId then
			task.defer(writeSign, part, zoneId)
		end
		return
	end
	if handler then
		bound[part] = true
		part.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
			local player = playerFromHit(hit)
			if player and self.Data:IsLoaded(player) then
				handler(player)
			end
		end)
	end
end

function ZoneService:Start()
	local antiExploit = self.Services.AntiExploitService
	local economy = self.Services.EconomyService

	local function watchMap(map)
		for _, descendant in ipairs(map:GetDescendants()) do
			self:BindPart(descendant)
		end
		map.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(descendant)
			task.defer(self.BindPart, self, descendant)
		end)
	end
	local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
	if map then
		watchMap(map)
	else
		workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
			if child.Name == "Map" then
				watchMap(child)
			end
		end)
	end

	antiExploit:Connect("UnlockZone", { Rate = 2, Burst = 4 }, function(player, zoneId)
		if not Validate.String(zoneId, 32) then
			return
		end
		local data = self.Data:GetData(player)
		local ok, reason = Formulas.CanUnlockZone(zoneId, data)
		if not ok then
			Notifier.Error(player, string.upper(reason))
			return
		end
		local zone = ZoneConfig.ById[zoneId]
		if not economy:SpendCash(player, zone.UnlockCost) then
			Notifier.Error(player, "NOT ENOUGH CASH")
			return
		end
		data.Zones[zoneId] = true
		self.Data:Replicate(player, "Zones")
		Notifier.Send(player, { Kind = "Unlock", Text = "ZONE UNLOCKED!", Subtext = zone.Name, Color = zone.Color, Icon = zone.Icon })
		self.ZoneUnlocked:Fire(player, zoneId)
	end)

	antiExploit:Connect("Travel", { Rate = 2, Burst = 3 }, function(player, destination)
		if Validate.String(destination, 32) then
			self:Travel(player, destination)
		end
	end)

	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		lastTouch[player] = nil
		lastTravel[player] = nil
	end)

	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(INTRUSION_INTERVAL)
			for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				local position = root and root.Position
				local currentZone=position and ZoneConfig.ById[ZoneConfig.ZoneAt(position)]
    local inExpedition=currentZone and currentZone.Expedition==true and position.Y<180
    if position and (position.Y < FALL_LIMIT or ((math.abs(position.X)>MAP_LIMIT or math.abs(position.Z)>MAP_LIMIT)and not inExpedition))then
					player.Character:PivotTo(plazaCFrame())
				elseif root and self.Data:IsLoaded(player) then
					local zoneId = ZoneConfig.ZoneAt(root.Position)
					if zoneId and not self:IsUnlocked(player, zoneId) then
						player.Character:PivotTo(plazaCFrame())
						Notifier.Error(player, "UNLOCK THIS ZONE FIRST!")
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

function ZoneService:IsUnlocked(player, zoneId)
 if ZoneConfig.ById[zoneId]and ZoneConfig.ById[zoneId].FreeAccess then return self.Data:IsLoaded(player)end
	if zoneId == nil or zoneId == GameConfig.Start.Zone then
		return true
	end
	if zoneId == "VIP" then
		local monetization = self.Services.MonetizationService
		return monetization ~= nil and monetization:HasPass(player, ZoneConfig.VIP.RequiredPass)
	end
	local data = self.Data:GetData(player)
	return data ~= nil and data.Zones[zoneId] == true
end

function ZoneService:GetZone(player)
	local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	return root and ZoneConfig.ZoneAt(root.Position)
end

function ZoneService:PromptUnlock(player, zoneId)
	if zoneId == "VIP" then
		openPanel:FireClient(player, "Shop", ZoneConfig.VIP.RequiredPass)
	else
		openPanel:FireClient(player, "ZoneUnlock", zoneId)
	end
end

function ZoneService:Travel(player, destination)
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return false
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - (lastTravel[player] or 0) < TOUCH_COOLDOWN then
		return false
	end
	local target = nil
	if destination == "Plaza" then
		target = plazaCFrame()
	elseif destination == "Hall" then
		target = hallCFrame()
	elseif ZoneConfig.ById[destination] then
		if not self:IsUnlocked(player, destination) then
			self:PromptUnlock(player, destination)
			return false
		end
		target = ZoneConfig.EntryCFrame(destination)
	end
	if not target then
		return false
	end
	lastTravel[player] = now
	character:PivotTo(target)
	return true
end

return ZoneService

StarterPlayer.StarterPlayerScripts.Contr.source:
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local ThemeConfig = require(Shared.Config.ThemeConfig)
local GameConfig = require(Shared.Config.GameConfig)
local ToolConfig = require(Shared.Config.ToolConfig)
local Format = require(Shared.Modules.Format)
local Net = require(Shared.Modules.Net)
local Components = script.Parent.Parent:WaitForChild("Components")
local UIKit = require(Components.UIKit)
local Widgets = require(Components.Widgets)

local Colors = ThemeConfig.Colors
local Fonts = ThemeConfig.Fonts
local MAX_TOASTS = 4
local TOAST_TIME = 3.2
local BIG_TIME = 1.7
local EngineRunService=game:GetService("RunService")
local pendingToasts={}
local activeToasts={}
local recent={}
local sequence=0
local compact=false
local toastLimit=MAX_TOASTS
local layoutKey

local KIND_STYLE = {
	Toast = { Color = Colors.Orange, Sound = "Click" },
	Error = { Color = Colors.Red, Sound = "Error" },
	Quest = { Color = Colors.Cyan, Sound = "Quest" },
	Badge = { Color = Colors.Gold, Sound = "Unlock" },
	Big = { Color = Colors.Orange, Sound = nil, Big = true },
	LevelUp = { Color = Colors.Yellow, Sound = nil, Big = true },
	Rebirth = { Color = Colors.Purple, Sound = nil, Big = true },
	Purchase = { Color = Colors.Yellow, Sound = "Purchase", Big = true },
	Unlock = { Color = Colors.Orange, Sound = "Unlock", Big = true },
}

local NotificationController = { Priority = 8 }

local toasts = nil
local bigFrame = nil
local rewardFrame = nil
local bigToken = 0
local rewardToken = 0
local bigTweens={}

local function buildGui()
	local gui = Widgets.ScreenGui("NotificationUI", 10, true)

	toasts = UIKit.Create("Frame", {
		Name = "Toasts",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 150),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(330, 300),
		Parent = gui,
	})
	local layout = Widgets.List(toasts, 8)
	layout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center

	bigFrame = UIKit.Create("Frame", {
		Name = "BigMessage",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.36),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(760, 150),
		Visible = false,
		Parent = gui,
	})
	Widgets.AutoScale(bigFrame)
	local title = Widgets.Label(bigFrame, { Name = "Headline", Font = Fonts.Display, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.66, 0), AlignX = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, MaxSize = 96, Stroke = 4 })
	title.Rotation = ThemeConfig.Slant
	UIKit.Create("UIGradient", { Name = "Shine", Rotation = 90, Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.fromRGB(210, 210, 210)), Parent = title })
	Widgets.Label(bigFrame, { Name = "Subtext", Font = Fonts.Body, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.3, 0), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.68), AlignX = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, MaxSize = 30, Stroke = 2 })
	UIKit.Create("UIScale", { Name = "Pop", Parent = title })

	rewardFrame = Widgets.Card(gui, { Name = "RewardCard", Color = Colors.Dark, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(420, 120), StrokeColor = Colors.Yellow })
	rewardFrame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
	rewardFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 150)
	rewardFrame.Visible = false
	Widgets.AutoScale(rewardFrame)
	Widgets.Label(rewardFrame, { Name = "Heading", Font = Fonts.Display, Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 34), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 6), AlignX = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, MaxSize = 28, Color = Colors.Yellow, Stroke = 1 })
	local items = UIKit.Create("Frame", { Name = "Items", BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 64), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 46), Parent = rewardFrame })
	local itemLayout = Widgets.List(items, 8, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal)
	itemLayout.Wraps = true
end

local function arrangeToast(toast,payload)
 local width=compact and 244 or 320
 toast.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(width,compact and 40 or 62)
 local offset=payload.Icon and (compact and 36 or 52)or 12
 local icon=toast:FindFirstChild("Icon")
 if icon then icon.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(compact and 22 or 34,compact and 22 or 34)end
 local message=toast:FindFirstChild("Message")
 if message then
  message.Size=UDim2.new(1,-offset-8,0,compact and 18 or 22)
  message.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(offset,payload.Subtext and (compact and 1 or 4)or (compact and 11 or 15))
  local cap=message:FindFirstChildOfClass("UITextSizeConstraint")if cap then cap.MaxTextSize=compact and 15 or 22 end
 end
 local detail=toast:FindFirstChild("Detail")
 if detail then
  detail.Size=UDim2.new(1,-offset-8,0,compact and 18 or 26)
  detail.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(offset,compact and 20 or 27)
  local cap=detail:FindFirstChildOfClass("UITextSizeConstraint")if cap then cap.MaxTextSize=compact and 12 or 16 end
 end
end

function NotificationController:Arrange()
 local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
 compact=camera and camera.ViewportSize.Y<500
 local y=compact and 104 or 150
 local main=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("MainUI")
 local banner=main and main:FindFirstChild("EventBanner")
 if not compact and banner and banner.Visible then y=math.max(y,banner.AbsolutePosition.Y+banner.AbsoluteSize.Y-toasts.Parent.AbsolutePosition.Y+8)end
 local room=toasts.Parent.AbsoluteSize.Y-172-y
 toastLimit=compact and 1 or math.clamp(math.floor((room+8)/70),1,MAX_TOASTS)
 local key=tostring(compact)..":"..y..":"..toastLimit
 if key==layoutKey then return end layoutKey=key
 toasts.Position=UDim2.new(.5,0,0,y)
 toasts.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(compact and 244 or 320,compact and 40 or 290)
 local ordered={}for toast in pairs(activeToasts)do if toast.Parent then table.insert(ordered,toast)end end
 table.sort(ordered,function(a,b)return a.LayoutOrder<b.LayoutOrder end)
 for i=#ordered,1,-1 do
  local toast=ordered[i]local payload=activeToasts[toast]
  if i>toastLimit then activeToasts[toast]=nil table.insert(pendingToasts,1,payload)toast:Destroy()
  else arrangeToast(toast,payload)end
 end
end

function NotificationController:Pump()
 self:Arrange()
 if bigFrame.Visible or rewardFrame.Visible or self.Controllers.PanelController:IsAnyOpen()then toasts.Visible=false return end
 toasts.Visible=true
 local count=0 for toast in pairs(activeToasts)do
  if not toast.Parent then activeToasts[toast]=nil else count+=1 end
 end
 while count<toastLimit and #pendingToasts>0 do
  local payload=table.remove(pendingToasts,1)
  self:DisplayToast(payload)
  count+=1
 end
end

function NotificationController:Init(controllers)
	self.Controllers = controllers
end

function NotificationController:Start()
	buildGui()
 self:Arrange()
 if workspace.CurrentCamera then workspace.CurrentCamera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(function()self:Arrange()end)end
 local elapsed=0
 EngineRunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
  elapsed+=dt if elapsed<.2 then return end elapsed=0
  for key,stamp in pairs(recent)do if os.clock()-stamp>10 then recent[key]=nil end end
  self:Pump()
 end)
	Net.Remote("Notify").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(payload)
		if type(payload) == "table" then
			self:Show(payload)
		end
	end)
end

function NotificationController:Show(payload)
	local kind = payload.Kind or "Toast"
	if kind == "Reward" then
		self:Reward(payload.Text or "REWARD", payload.Rewards or {})
		return
	end
	local style = KIND_STYLE[kind] or KIND_STYLE.Toast
	local color = payload.Color or style.Color
	if style.Big then
  if style.Sound then self.Controllers.SoundController:Play(style.Sound)end
		self:Big(payload.Text or "", color, payload.Subtext)
	else
		if self:Toast(payload.Text or "", color, payload.Icon, payload.Subtext, kind == "Error")and style.Sound then self.Controllers.SoundController:Play(style.Sound)end
	end
end

function NotificationController:Toast(text,color,icon,subtext,shake)
 local key=tostring(text).."|"..tostring(subtext)
 if recent[key]and os.clock()-recent[key]<10 then return false end
 recent[key]=os.clock()
 if self.Controllers.PanelController:IsAnyOpen()and self.Controllers.PanelController:ShowNotice(text,color or Colors.Orange,subtext)then return true end
 if #pendingToasts>=20 then table.remove(pendingToasts,1)end
 table.insert(pendingToasts,{Text=text,Color=color or Colors.Orange,Icon=icon,Subtext=subtext,Shake=shake})
 self:Pump()
 return true
end

function NotificationController:DisplayToast(payload)
 local low=(self.Controllers.DataController:Get("Settings")or {}).LowEffects
 local color=payload.Color
 local toast=Widgets.Card(toasts,{Name="Toast",Color=Colors.Dark,Size=UDim2.fromOffset(compact and 244 or 320,compact and 54 or 62),StrokeColor=color,Accent=color})
 sequence+=1 toast.LayoutOrder=sequence toast.BackgroundTransparency=.05 activeToasts[toast]=payload
 local offset=12
 if payload.Icon then
  Widgets.Icon(toast,payload.Icon,{Size=UDim2.fromOffset(compact and 24 or 34,compact and 24 or 34),Position=UDim2.new(0,10,.5,0),AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0,.5),FallbackColor=color})
  offset=compact and 42 or 52
 end
 Widgets.Label(toast,{Name="Message",Text=payload.Text,Font=Fonts.Display,Size=UDim2.new(1,-offset-8,0,22),Position=UDim2.fromOffset(offset,payload.Subtext and 4 or 15),MinSize=12,MaxSize=compact and 17 or 22,Color=Colors.White})
 if payload.Subtext then
  Widgets.Label(toast,{Name="Detail",Text=payload.Subtext,Font=Fonts.Body,Size=UDim2.new(1,-offset-8,0,compact and 24 or 26),Position=UDim2.fromOffset(offset,27),MinSize=10,MaxSize=compact and 12 or 16,Color=Colors.Muted})
 end
 arrangeToast(toast,payload)
 if not low then UIKit.Pop(toast,.9)end
 task.delay(TOAST_TIME,function()
  activeToasts[toast]=nil toast:Destroy()self:Pump()
 end)
end

function NotificationController:Big(text, color, subtext)
 if compact then self:Toast(text,color,nil,subtext)return end
	bigToken += 1
 for _,tween in ipairs(bigTweens)do tween:Cancel()end
 table.clear(bigTweens)
 local token = bigToken
	local headline = bigFrame.Headline
	headline.Text = text
	headline.TextColor3 = color or Colors.Orange
	headline.TextTransparency = 0
	bigFrame.Subtext.Text = subtext or ""
	bigFrame.Subtext.TextTransparency = 0
	bigFrame.Visible = true
	headline.Pop.Scale = (self.Controllers.DataController:Get("Settings")or {}).LowEffects and 1 or 1.3
	local pop=TweenService:Create(headline.Pop,TweenInfo.new(.4,Enum.EasingStyle.Back,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),{Scale=1})
 table.insert(bigTweens,pop)pop:Play()
	task.delay(BIG_TIME, function()
		if token ~= bigToken then
			return
		end
		local fade = TweenInfo.new(0.35)
		local titleFade=TweenService:Create(headline,fade,{TextTransparency=1})
  table.insert(bigTweens,titleFade)titleFade:Play()
		local tween = TweenService:Create(bigFrame.Subtext, fade, { TextTransparency = 1 })
  table.insert(bigTweens,tween)
		tween:Play()
		tween.Completed:Once(function()
			if token == bigToken then
				bigFrame.Visible = false
			end
		end)
	end)
end

local function rewardChip(items, icon, text, color, order)
	local chip = Widgets.Chip(items, { Name = "Reward", Icon = icon, Text = text, Color = color, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(190, 34), Order = order })
	return chip
end

function NotificationController:Reward(title, rewards)
 if compact then
  local lines={}
  if (rewards.Cash or 0)>0 then table.insert(lines,"+"..Format.Number(rewards.Cash).." CASH")end
  if (rewards.Scrap or 0)>0 then table.insert(lines,"+"..Format.Number(rewards.Scrap).." SCRAP")end
  if (rewards.ChaosCores or 0)>0 then table.insert(lines,"+"..Format.Number(rewards.ChaosCores).." CORES")end
  if rewards.Boost then
   local boost=GameConfig.Boosts[rewards.Boost.Id]
   table.insert(lines,(boost and boost.Name or "BOOST").." "..Format.Time(rewards.Boost.Seconds))
  end
  if rewards.Skin then local skin=ToolConfig.SkinsById[rewards.Skin]table.insert(lines,(skin and skin.Name or rewards.Skin).." SKIN")end
  for index=1,#lines,2 do
   local detail=lines[index]..(lines[index+1]and (" · "..lines[index+1])or "")
   self:Toast(title,Colors.Yellow,nil,detail)
  end
  if #lines>0 then self.Controllers.SoundController:Play("Purchase")end
  return
 end
	rewardToken += 1
	local token = rewardToken
	local items = rewardFrame.Items
	Widgets.Clear(items)
	local order = 0
	local function add(icon, text, color)
		order += 1
		rewardChip(items, icon, text, color, order)
	end
	if (rewards.Cash or 0) > 0 then
		add("Cash", "+" .. Format.Number(rewards.Cash), Colors.Cash)
	end
	if (rewards.Scrap or 0) > 0 then
		add("Scrap", "+" .. Format.Number(rewards.Scrap), Colors.Scrap)
	end
	if (rewards.ChaosCores or 0) > 0 then
		add("ChaosCore", "+" .. Format.Number(rewards.ChaosCores), Colors.Cores)
	end
	if rewards.Boost then
		local boost = GameConfig.Boosts[rewards.Boost.Id]
		add(boost and boost.Icon or "BoostCash", (boost and boost.Name or "BOOST") .. " " .. Format.Time(rewards.Boost.Seconds), boost and boost.Color or Colors.Orange)
	end
	if rewards.Skin then
		local skin = ToolConfig.SkinsById[rewards.Skin]
		add("DailySkin", (skin and skin.Name or rewards.Skin) .. " SKIN", Colors.Purple)
	end
	if order == 0 then
		return
	end
	rewardFrame.Heading.Text = title
	local rows=math.ceil(order/2)
 local itemHeight=rows*34+(rows-1)*8
 items.Size=UDim2.new(1,-20,0,itemHeight)
 rewardFrame.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(420,math.max(120,46+itemHeight+14))
	rewardFrame.Visible = true
	if not (self.Controllers.DataController:Get("Settings")or {}).LowEffects then UIKit.Pop(items, .9)end
	self.Controllers.SoundController:Play("Purchase")
	task.delay(3, function()
		if token == rewardToken then
			rewardFrame.Visible = false
		end
	end)
end

return NotificationController

local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
local ProximityPromptService = game:GetService("ProximityPromptService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local ThemeConfig = require(Shared.Config.ThemeConfig)
local Signal = require(Shared.Modules.Signal)
local UIKit=require(script.Parent.Parent.Components.UIKit)
local Net = require(Shared.Modules.Net)

local MODALS = { ZoneUnlock = true, StarterPack = true }
local ALIASES = { ChaosShop = "Rebirth" }
local OPEN_INFO = TweenInfo.new(0.32, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
local CLOSE_INFO = TweenInfo.new(0.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)

local PanelController = { Priority = 5 }
PanelController.Opened = Signal.new()
PanelController.Closed = Signal.new()

local panels = {}
local openMain = nil
local openModals = {}
local modalOrder={}

local function usable(button)
 if not button or not button.Parent or not button:IsA("GuiButton")or not button.Selectable
  or button:GetAttribute("Variant")=="Disabled"then return false end
 local current=button
 while current do
  if current:IsA("GuiObject")and not current.Visible then return false end
  if current:IsA("ScreenGui")then
   if not current.Enabled then return false end
   for _,entry in pairs(panels)do if entry.Gui==current and not entry.IsOpen then return false end end
   return true
  end
  current=current.Parent
 end
 return false
end
local function firstButton(gui)
 for _,button in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants())do
  if button:IsA("GuiButton")and button.Name~="Dim"and button.Name~="Close"and usable(button)then return button end
 end
 local close=gui:FindFirstChild("Close",true)
 return usable(close)and close or nil
end

local function animate(entry, opening)
	local gui = entry.Gui
	local window = gui:FindFirstChild("Window")
	local dim = gui:FindFirstChild("Dim")
	local scale = window and window:FindFirstChild("PopScale")
 if UIKit.ReducedMotion then
  gui.Enabled=opening if scale then scale.Scale=1 end
  if dim then dim.BackgroundTransparency=.45 end return
 end
	if opening then
		gui.Enabled = true
		if scale then
			scale.Scale = 0.86
			TweenService:Create(scale, OPEN_INFO, { Scale = 1 }):Play()
		end
		if dim then
			dim.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			TweenService:Create(dim, ThemeConfig.Tween.Normal, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.45 }):Play()
		end
	else
		if scale then
			local tween = TweenService:Create(scale, CLOSE_INFO, { Scale = 0.9 })
			tween:Play()
			tween.Completed:Once(function()
				if not entry.IsOpen then
					gui.Enabled = false
				end
			end)
		else
			gui.Enabled = false
		end
	end
end

function PanelController:ShowNotice(text,color,detail)
 local entry=panels[modalOrder[#modalOrder]or openMain]
 local header=entry and entry.Gui:FindFirstChild("Header",true)
 local title=header and header:FindFirstChild("Title")
 if not title then return false end
 local notice=header:FindFirstChild("Notice")
 if not notice then
  notice=title:Clone()notice.Name="Notice"notice.Rotation=0 notice.ZIndex=title.ZIndex+1 notice.Parent=header
 end
 entry.NoticeToken=(entry.NoticeToken or 0)+1 local token=entry.NoticeToken
 notice.Size=title.Size notice.Position=title.Position
 local limit=notice:FindFirstChildOfClass("UITextSizeConstraint")
 if limit then limit.MaxTextSize=20 limit.MinTextSize=10 end
 notice.Text=tostring(text)..(detail and ("\n"..tostring(detail))or "")
 notice.TextColor3=color notice.Visible=true title.Visible=false
 task.delay(3.2,function()
  if entry.NoticeToken==token and title.Parent then title.Visible=true notice.Visible=false end
 end)
 return true
end

function PanelController:Init(controllers)
	self.Controllers = controllers
end

function PanelController:Start()
	Net.Remote("OpenPanel").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(name, arg)
		if type(name) == "string" then
   if name=="StarterPack"then
    local purchases=self.Controllers.DataController:Get("Purchases")
    if purchases and not purchases.StarterPack and not purchases.StarterPackDismissed then
     self.Controllers.NotificationController:Toast("STARTER PACK AVAILABLE",ThemeConfig.Colors.Yellow,nil,"View the offer in SHOP.")
    end
    return
   end
			self:Open(name, arg)
		end
	end)
 local input=self.Controllers.InputController
 if input then input.InputChanged:Connect(function(kind)
  if kind=="Gamepad"then self:FocusCurrent()else GuiService.SelectedObject=nil end
 end)end
 ProximityPromptService.PromptTriggered:Connect(function(prompt)
		local panel = prompt:GetAttribute("Panel")
		if type(panel) == "string" then
			self:Open(panel)
		end
	end)
end

function PanelController:Register(name, gui, callbacks)
	callbacks = callbacks or {}
	local entry = { Name = name, Gui = gui, OnOpen = callbacks.OnOpen, OnClose = callbacks.OnClose, IsOpen = false }
	panels[name] = entry
	gui.Enabled = false
	local window = gui:FindFirstChild("Window")
	local close = window and window:FindFirstChild("Close", true)
	if close and close:IsA("GuiButton") then
		close.Activated:Connect(function()
			self:Close(name)
		end)
	end
	local dim = gui:FindFirstChild("Dim")
	if dim and dim:IsA("GuiButton") then
		dim.Activated:Connect(function()
			self:Close(name)
		end)
	end
	return entry
end

function PanelController:Open(name, arg)
	local target = ALIASES[name] or name
	local entry = panels[target]
 if target=="StarterPack"and self.Controllers.DataController then
  local purchases=self.Controllers.DataController:Get("Purchases")
  if purchases and purchases.StarterPack then return false end
 end
	if not entry then
		return false
	end
	if MODALS[target] then
  if not openModals[target]then table.insert(modalOrder,target)end
		openModals[target] = true
	elseif openMain and openMain ~= target then
		self:Close(openMain)
	end
	if not MODALS[target] then
		openMain = target
	end
	local wasOpen = entry.IsOpen
 if not wasOpen then entry.PreviousSelection=GuiService.SelectedObject end
	entry.IsOpen = true
	if entry.OnOpen then
		task.spawn(entry.OnOpen, name ~= target and name or arg)
	end
	if not wasOpen then
		animate(entry, true)
		local sound = self.Controllers.SoundController
		if sound then
			sound:Play("Open")
		end
		self.Opened:Fire(target)
	end
	self:FocusCurrent()
	return true
end

function PanelController:Close(name)
	local entry = panels[ALIASES[name] or name]
	if not entry or not entry.IsOpen then
		return
	end
	entry.IsOpen = false
	if openMain == entry.Name then
		openMain = nil
	end
	openModals[entry.Name] = nil
 local index=table.find(modalOrder,entry.Name)if index then table.remove(modalOrder,index)end
	if entry.OnClose then
		task.spawn(entry.OnClose)
	end
	animate(entry, false)
	if GuiService.SelectedObject and GuiService.SelectedObject:IsDescendantOf(entry.Gui) then
		GuiService.SelectedObject = nil
	end
	self.Closed:Fire(entry.Name)
 self:FocusCurrent(entry.PreviousSelection)
end

function PanelController:FocusCurrent(previous)
 local input=self.Controllers.InputController
 if not input or not input:IsGamepad()then return end
 task.defer(function()
  local name=modalOrder[#modalOrder]or openMain
  local entry=name and panels[name]
  if usable(previous)and (not entry or previous:IsDescendantOf(entry.Gui))then
   GuiService.SelectedObject=previous
  elseif entry and entry.IsOpen then GuiService.SelectedObject=firstButton(entry.Gui)
  else GuiService.SelectedObject=nil end
 end)
end

function PanelController:GoBack()
 local target=modalOrder[#modalOrder]or openMain
 if not target then return false end
 self:Close(target)
 return true
end

function PanelController:CloseAll()
	for _,name in ipairs(table.clone(modalOrder))do
		self:Close(name)
	end
	if openMain then
		self:Close(openMain)
	end
end

function PanelController:Toggle(name, arg)
	local entry = panels[ALIASES[name] or name]
	if entry and entry.IsOpen then
		self:Close(name)
	else
		self:Open(name, arg)
	end
end

function PanelController:IsOpen(name)
	local entry = panels[ALIASES[name] or name]
	return entry ~= nil and entry.IsOpen
end

function PanelController:IsAnyOpen()
	return openMain ~= nil or next(openModals) ~= nil
end

return PanelController

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local ThemeConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config.ThemeConfig)
local GameConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config.GameConfig)

local Colors = ThemeConfig.Colors
local Fonts = ThemeConfig.Fonts
local SPARKLE_TEXTURE = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
local OWNER_SPARKLE = ColorSequence.new(Colors.Gold, Colors.Red)
local OWNER_LABEL = "OWNER · LEAD DEVELOPER"

local Nametag = {}

local function label(name, parent, props)
	local text = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	text.Name = name
	text.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	text.TextScaled = true
	text.TextColor3 = Colors.White
	text.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.35
	text.TextStrokeColor3 = Colors.Black
	for key, value in pairs(props) do
		text[key] = value
	end
	text.Parent = parent
	return text
end

local function build(head)
	local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	gui.Name = "Nametag"
	gui.Size = UDim2.fromScale(6.2, 1.9)
	gui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.9, 0)
	gui.MaxDistance = 90
	gui.LightInfluence = 0
	gui.AlwaysOnTop = false

	local title = label("Title", gui, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.34, 0),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0),
		FontFace = Fonts.Display,
	})
	local gradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	gradient.Name = "Shine"
	gradient.Rotation = 90
	gradient.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.15) })
	gradient.Parent = title

	label("PlayerName", gui, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.4, 0),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.32),
		FontFace = Fonts.Body,
	})

	local chips = Instance.new("Frame")
	chips.Name = "Chips"
	chips.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	chips.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.26, 0)
	chips.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.74)
	chips.Parent = gui
	local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	layout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
	layout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
	layout.Padding = UDim.new(0.03, 0)
	layout.Parent = chips

	for _, chip in ipairs({ { "LevelChip", Colors.Dark, Colors.Yellow }, { "VipChip", Colors.Gold, Colors.Black } }) do
		local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
		frame.Name = chip[1]
		frame.Size = UDim2.new(0.28, 0, 1, 0)
		frame.BackgroundColor3 = chip[2]
		frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
		frame.Parent = chips
		local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)
		corner.Parent = frame
		label("Value", frame, {
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
			FontFace = Fonts.Number,
			TextColor3 = chip[3],
			TextStrokeTransparency = 1,
		})
	end

	gui.Parent = head
	return gui
end

local function buildOwnerTag(head, roleLabel, isLeadDeveloper)
	local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	gui.Name = "OwnerTag"
	gui.Size = UDim2.fromScale(3.4, 0.78)
	gui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 4.4, 0)
	gui.MaxDistance = 140
	gui.LightInfluence = 0
	gui.AlwaysOnTop = false

	local plate = Instance.new("Frame")
	plate.Name = "Plate"
	plate.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	plate.BackgroundColor3 = Colors.White
	plate.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
	plate.Parent = gui
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)
	corner.Parent = plate
	local fill = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	fill.Name = "Fill"
	fill.Rotation = 90
	fill.Color = isLeadDeveloper and ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 190), Color3.fromRGB(15, 70, 120)) or ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 60), Color3.fromRGB(140, 14, 20))
	fill.Parent = plate
	local edge = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	edge.Name = "Edge"
	edge.Color = isLeadDeveloper and Color3.fromRGB(80, 225, 255) or Colors.Gold
	edge.Thickness = 2.5
	edge.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
	edge.Parent = plate

	local text = label("Label", plate, {
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.86, 0.78),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.07, 0.11),
		FontFace = Fonts.Display,
		TextColor3 = Colors.White,
		TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2,
	})
	local shine = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	shine.Name = "Shine"
	shine.Rotation = 90
	shine.Color = isLeadDeveloper and ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(230, 255, 255), Color3.fromRGB(80, 225, 255)) or ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 244, 190), Colors.Gold)
	shine.Parent = text

	gui.Parent = head
	return gui
end

function Nametag.Apply(character, info)
	local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not head then
		return
	end
	if humanoid then
		humanoid.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
	end
	local gui = head:FindFirstChild("Nametag") or build(head)
	gui.Title.Text = info.Title
	gui.Title.TextColor3 = info.TitleColor
	gui.PlayerName.Text = info.Name
	gui.PlayerName.TextColor3 = info.Owner and Colors.Gold or Colors.White
	gui.Chips.LevelChip.Value.Text = "LV " .. info.Level
	gui.Chips.VipChip.Visible = info.Vip
	gui.Chips.VipChip.Value.Text = "VIP"

	local role = info.Owner and "Owner" or (info.LeadDeveloper and "LeadDev" or nil)
	for _, tagName in ipairs({"OwnerTag", "LeadDevTag"}) do
		local tag = head:FindFirstChild(tagName)
		local isRole = (role == "Owner" and tagName == "OwnerTag") or (role == "LeadDev" and tagName == "LeadDevTag")
		if isRole then
			tag = tag or buildOwnerTag(head, role == "Owner" and OWNER_LABEL or GameConfig.LeadDevelopers.Label, role == "LeadDev")
			tag.Name = tagName
			tag.Plate.Label.Text = role == "Owner" and OWNER_LABEL or GameConfig.LeadDevelopers.Label
		elseif tag then
			tag:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

local function emitter(name, color, rate, parent)
	local particles = parent:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not particles then
		particles = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		particles.Name = name
		particles.Texture = SPARKLE_TEXTURE
		particles.LightEmission = 1
		particles.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.8, 1.4)
		particles.Speed = NumberRange.new(1, 3)
		particles.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
		particles.Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.35), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) })
		particles.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) })
		particles.Parent = parent
	end
	particles.Color = if typeof(color) == "ColorSequence" then color else ColorSequence.new(color)
	particles.Rate = rate
	return particles
end

function Nametag.ApplyAura(character, aura, isVip, isOwner)
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then
		return
	end
	local existing = root:FindFirstChild("RebirthAura")
	local light = root:FindFirstChild("RebirthGlow")
	if aura then
		emitter("RebirthAura", aura.Color, 7, root)
		if not light then
			light = Instance.new("PointLight")
			light.Name = "RebirthGlow"
			light.Range = 9
			light.Brightness = 1.2
			light.Parent = root
		end
		light.Color = aura.Color
	else
		if existing then
			existing:Destroy()
		end
		if light then
			light:Destroy()
		end
	end
	local sparkle = root:FindFirstChild("VipSparkle")
	if isVip then
		emitter("VipSparkle", Colors.Gold, 4, root)
	elseif sparkle then
		sparkle:Destroy()
	end
	local crown = root:FindFirstChild("OwnerSparkle")
	if isOwner then
		emitter("OwnerSparkle", OWNER_SPARKLE, 8, root)
	elseif crown then
		crown:Destroy()
	end
end

return Nametag

local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local rgb = Color3.fromRGB

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local WorldEvents = {}

local Fx = nil
local Shake = nil
local controllers = nil
local flashFrame = nil
local tint = nil

local function rootPosition()
	local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	return root and root.Position
end

local function characterOf(userId)
	local target = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
	local root = target and target.Character and target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	return root
end

local function screenFlash(color, peak, duration)
	flashFrame.BackgroundColor3 = color
	-- Keep the event visible without covering the world with an opaque flash.
	flashFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - math.clamp(peak * 0.32, 0, 0.32)
	TweenService:Create(flashFrame, TweenInfo.new(math.min(duration, 0.85), Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play()
end

local function pulseTint(color, strength, duration)
	tint.TintColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1):Lerp(color, math.clamp(strength * 0.35, 0, 0.5))
	tint.Saturation = 0.25 * strength
	tint.Contrast = 0.15 * strength
	tint.Enabled = true
	local tween = TweenService:Create(tint, TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { TintColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Saturation = 0, Contrast = 0 })
	tween:Play()
end

local function fovPunch(amount, duration)
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera then
		return
	end
	local base = 70
	camera.FieldOfView = base + amount
	TweenService:Create(camera, TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { FieldOfView = base }):Play()
end

local function column(position, color, height, width, duration)
	local pillar = Instance.new("Part")
	pillar.Name = "LightColumn"
	pillar.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
	pillar.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	pillar.Color = color
	pillar.Anchored = true
	pillar.CanCollide = false
	pillar.CanQuery = false
	pillar.CanTouch = false
	pillar.CastShadow = false
	pillar.Transparency = 0.2
	pillar.Size = Vector3.new(height, width, width)
	pillar.CFrame = CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, height / 2, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
	pillar.Parent = Fx.Folder()
	local tween = TweenService:Create(pillar, TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), { Transparency = 1, Size = Vector3.new(height, 0.2, 0.2) })
	tween:Play()
	tween.Completed:Once(function()
		pillar:Destroy()
	end)
end

local function ring(position, color, radius, duration)
	local disc = Instance.new("Part")
	disc.Name = "Shockwave"
	disc.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
	disc.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	disc.Color = color
	disc.Anchored = true
	disc.CanCollide = false
	disc.CanQuery = false
	disc.CanTouch = false
	disc.CastShadow = false
	disc.Transparency = 0.25
	disc.Size = Vector3.new(0.3, 2, 2)
	disc.CFrame = CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, 0.4, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
	disc.Parent = Fx.Folder()
	local tween = TweenService:Create(disc, TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Size = Vector3.new(0.3, radius * 2, radius * 2), Transparency = 1 })
	tween:Play()
	tween.Completed:Once(function()
		disc:Destroy()
	end)
end

local function meteor(from, to, delay)
	local rock = Instance.new("Part")
	rock.Name = "Meteor"
	rock.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	rock.Size = Vector3.new(6, 6, 6)
	rock.Color = rgb(70, 40, 30)
	rock.Material = Enum.Material.CrackedLava
	rock.Anchored = true
	rock.CanCollide = false
	rock.CanQuery = false
	rock.CanTouch = false
	rock.Position = from
	rock.Parent = Fx.Folder()
	local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment.Parent = rock
	local flames = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	flames.Name = "Flames"
	flames.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/fire_main.dds"
	flames.LightEmission = 1
	flames.Color = ColorSequence.new(rgb(255, 140, 40), rgb(255, 60, 20))
	flames.Rate = 120
	flames.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.3, 0.6)
	flames.Speed = NumberRange.new(2, 6)
	flames.Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 5), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) })
	flames.Parent = attachment
	local tween = TweenService:Create(rock, TweenInfo.new(delay, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), { Position = to })
	tween:Play()
	tween.Completed:Once(function()
		rock:Destroy()
		Fx.Explosion({ Position = to, Size = Vector3.new(14, 10, 14), Explosion = "Fuel", Primary = rgb(70, 40, 30), Secondary = rgb(255, 90, 20), MaterialType = "Rock" })
		ring(to, rgb(255, 120, 40), 26, 0.6)
		local origin = rootPosition()
		if origin then
			Shake.Add(math.clamp(1 - (to - origin).Magnitude / 200, 0, 1) * 0.8)
		end
		controllers.SoundController:Play("WreckBig", { Position = to })
	end)
end

local function totalWreck(duration)
	controllers.SoundController:Play("ChaosAlarm")
	local origin = rootPosition() or Vector3.zero
	for wave = 1, 6 do
		task.delay(wave * 0.25, function()
			for _ = 1, 3 do
				local angle = math.random() * math.pi * 2
				local distance = 25 + math.random() * 70
				local spot = origin + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * distance, 6 + math.random() * 10, math.sin(angle) * distance)
				Fx.Explosion({ Position = spot, Size = Vector3.new(18, 18, 18), Explosion = "Huge", Primary = rgb(60, 58, 56), Secondary = rgb(255, 122, 26), MaterialType = "Concrete" })
			end
			Shake.Add(0.45)
		end)
	end
	task.delay(1.8, function()
		screenFlash(rgb(255, 255, 255), 0.9, 1.2)
		fovPunch(18, 1.4)
		Shake.Add(1.2)
		ring(origin, rgb(255, 122, 26), 160, 1.4)
		controllers.SoundController:Play("TotalWreck")
	end)
end

local function nuclear(data)
	local position = data.Position or Vector3.zero
	local countdown = data.Countdown or 5
	for second = 1, countdown do
		task.delay(second - 1, function()
			controllers.SoundController:Play("ChaosAlarm", { Volume = 0.6 })
			pulseTint(rgb(180, 255, 120), 0.6, 0.6)
		end)
	end
	task.delay(countdown, function()
		screenFlash(rgb(240, 255, 220), 1, 1.8)
		fovPunch(22, 2)
		Shake.Add(1.3)
		ring(position, rgb(160, 255, 80), 140, 1.8)
		column(position, rgb(255, 160, 60), 160, 30, 2.4)
		for _ = 1, 8 do
			local offset = Vector3.new(math.random(-40, 40), 10 + math.random() * 60, math.random(-40, 40))
			Fx.Explosion({ Position = position + offset, Size = Vector3.new(24, 24, 24), Explosion = "Fuel", Primary = rgb(80, 70, 60), Secondary = rgb(160, 255, 80), MaterialType = "Concrete" })
		end
		controllers.SoundController:Play("TotalWreck")
	end)
end

function WorldEvents.Setup(fx, shake, registry)
	Fx = fx
	Shake = shake
	controllers = registry

	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name = "FlashGui"
	gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	gui.DisplayOrder = 40
	gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
	flashFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
	flashFrame.Name = "Flash"
	flashFrame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	flashFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	flashFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	flashFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	flashFrame.Active = false
	flashFrame.Parent = gui

	tint = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
	tint.Name = "EventTint"
	tint.Enabled = false
	tint.Parent = Lighting
end

function WorldEvents.Handle(kind, data)
	if kind == "Respawn" then
		local origin = rootPosition()
		if origin and data.Position and (data.Position - origin).Magnitude < 180 then
			Fx.Respawn(data.Position, data.Size)
		end
	elseif kind == "ChaosStart" then
		controllers.SoundController:Play("ChaosAlarm")
		pulseTint(rgb(190, 120, 255), data.Mega and 1.4 or 1, 2.5)
		screenFlash(rgb(166, 77, 255), 0.45, 0.9)
		Shake.Add(0.5)
	elseif kind == "TotalWreck" then
		totalWreck(data.Duration or 7)
	elseif kind == "Meteor" then
		if typeof(data.From) == "Vector3" and typeof(data.To) == "Vector3" then
			meteor(data.From, data.To, data.Delay or 1.2)
		end
	elseif kind == "Nuclear" then
		nuclear(data)
	elseif kind == "Rebirth" then
		local root = characterOf(data.UserId)
		if root then
			column(root.Position - Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), rgb(166, 77, 255), 90, 7, 1.6)
			ring(root.Position - Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), rgb(200, 120, 255), 30, 1)
			Fx.Impact(root.Position, rgb(166, 77, 255), 2)
			if data.UserId == player.UserId then
				screenFlash(rgb(166, 77, 255), 0.6, 1.2)
				Shake.Add(0.6)
				controllers.SoundController:Play("Rebirth")
			end
		end
	elseif kind == "Shockwave" then
		local origin = rootPosition()
		if origin and typeof(data.Position) == "Vector3" and (data.Position - origin).Magnitude < 200 then
			local radius = math.clamp(tonumber(data.Radius) or 16, 6, 60)
			ring(data.Ground or data.Position, rgb(255, 196, 40), radius, 0.45)
			ring(data.Ground or data.Position, rgb(255, 59, 59), radius * 0.6, 0.35)
			Fx.Impact(data.Position, rgb(255, 196, 40), 1.6)
			if data.UserId == player.UserId then
				Shake.Add(0.22)
			end
		end
	elseif kind == "LevelUp" then
		local root = characterOf(data.UserId)
		if root then
			ring(root.Position - Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), rgb(255, 210, 31), 12, 0.7)
			Fx.Spark(root.Position, rgb(255, 210, 31), 2)
			if data.UserId == player.UserId then
				controllers.SoundController:Play("LevelUp")
			end
		end
	end
end

return WorldEvents

ServerScriptService.Services.UpgradeServ.source:
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local UpgradeConfig = require(Shared.Config.UpgradeConfig)
local Formulas = require(Shared.Modules.Formulas)
local Signal = require(Shared.Modules.Signal)
local Validate = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.Validate)
local Notifier = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.Notifier)

local MAX_BATCH = 50

local UpgradeService = { Priority = 40 }
UpgradeService.Upgraded = Signal.new()

function UpgradeService:Init(services)
	self.Services = services
	self.Data = services.DataService
end

function UpgradeService:Start()
	local economy = self.Services.EconomyService

	self.Services.AntiExploitService:Connect("BuyUpgrade", { Rate = 8, Burst = 8 }, function(player, upgradeId, mode)
		if not Validate.String(upgradeId, 32) then
			return
		end
		local upgrade = UpgradeConfig.ById[upgradeId]
		if not upgrade then
			return
		end
		local data = self.Data:GetData(player)
		local level = data.Upgrades[upgradeId] or 0
		if level >= upgrade.MaxLevel then
			Notifier.Error(player, "MAX LEVEL")
			return
		end

		local balance = upgrade.Currency == "Scrap" and data.Scrap or data.Cash
		local batch = mode == "Max" and MAX_BATCH or 1
		local total, levels = 0, 0
		while levels < batch and level + levels < upgrade.MaxLevel do
			local price = Formulas.UpgradePrice(upgradeId, level + levels)
			if total + price > balance then
				break
			end
			total += price
			levels += 1
		end
		if levels == 0 then
			local message = "NOT ENOUGH CASH"
			if upgrade.Currency == "Scrap" then
				local tooBig = Formulas.UpgradePrice(upgradeId, level) > economy:GetStats(player).Capacity
				message = tooBig and "BAG TOO SMALL - BUY SCRAP CAPACITY" or "NOT ENOUGH SCRAP"
			end
			Notifier.Error(player, message)
			return
		end

		local spent = if upgrade.Currency == "Scrap" then economy:SpendScrap(player, total) else economy:SpendCash(player, total)
		if not spent then
			return
		end
		data.Upgrades[upgradeId] = level + levels
		self.Data:Replicate(player, "Upgrades")
		economy:RefreshStats(player)
		self.Upgraded:Fire(player, upgradeId, level + levels)
	end)
end

return UpgradeService

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local DECAY = 1.8
local MAX_TRAUMA = 1.3
local ROTATION = 0.055
local FREQUENCY = 28

local Shake = {}

local trauma = 0
local enabled = true

function Shake.Setup()
	RunService:BindToRenderStep("WreckCameraShake", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function(deltaTime)
		if trauma <= 0 then
			return
		end
		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if enabled and camera then
			local amount = trauma * trauma
			local time = os.clock() * FREQUENCY
			camera.CFrame *= CFrame.Angles(
				math.noise(time, 0.3) * ROTATION * amount,
				math.noise(0.7, time) * ROTATION * amount,
				math.noise(time, time) * ROTATION * 0.6 * amount
			)
		end
		trauma = math.max(trauma - deltaTime * DECAY, 0)
	end)
end

function Shake.Add(amount)
	if not enabled then
		return
	end
	trauma = math.min(trauma + amount, MAX_TRAUMA)
end

function Shake.SetEnabled(value)
	enabled = value
	if not enabled then
		trauma = 0
	end
end

return Shake

local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local SoundConfig = require(Shared.Config.SoundConfig)
local UIKit = require(script.Parent.Parent:WaitForChild("Components"):WaitForChild("UIKit"))

local MIN_INTERVAL = 0.08
local MAX_VOICES=12
local activeVoices=0
local worldVoices=0
local MAX_WORLD_VOICES=9
local LIFETIME = 6

local SoundController = { Priority = 3 }

local effectsEnabled = true
local musicEnabled = true
local lastPlayed = {}
local music = nil
local effectsGroup = nil

local function pick(entry)
	return entry.Ids[math.random(1, #entry.Ids)]
end

function SoundController:Init(controllers)
	self.Controllers = controllers
	effectsGroup = Instance.new("SoundGroup")
	effectsGroup.Name = "Effects"
	effectsGroup.Volume = 1
	effectsGroup.Parent = SoundService
end

function SoundController:Start()
	UIKit.ClickHandler = function()
		self:Play("Click")
	end
	self.Controllers.DataController:Observe("Settings", function(settings)
		if type(settings) ~= "table" then
			return
		end
		effectsEnabled = settings.Sfx ~= false
  effectsGroup.Volume=effectsEnabled and 1 or 0
		musicEnabled = settings.Music ~= false
		self:UpdateMusic()
	end)
	self:UpdateMusic()
end

function SoundController:UpdateMusic()
	local entry = SoundConfig.Music
	if not entry or #entry.Ids == 0 then
		return
	end
	if not music then
		music = Instance.new("Sound")
		music.Name = "Soundtrack"
		music.SoundId = pick(entry)
		music.Looped = true
		music.Volume = entry.Volume
		music.Parent = SoundService
	end
	if musicEnabled and not music.IsPlaying then
		music:Play()
	elseif not musicEnabled and music.IsPlaying then
		music:Pause()
	end
end

function SoundController:PlayImpact(material,sizeClass,position,crit,volume)
 local stone=material=="Stone"or material=="Concrete"or material=="Rock"
 local heavy=material=="Metal"or stone or sizeClass=="Huge"or sizeClass=="Large"
 local pitch=material=="Glass"and 1.25 or material=="Wood"and 1.1 or stone and .85 or 1
 return self:Play(crit and "Crit"or heavy and "HitHeavy"or "Hit",{Position=position,Pitch=pitch,Volume=volume or .85})
end

function SoundController:Play(key, options)
	local spatial=options and options.Position~=nil
 if not effectsEnabled or activeVoices>=MAX_VOICES or (spatial and worldVoices>=MAX_WORLD_VOICES)then
		return nil
	end
	local entry = SoundConfig[key]
	if not entry or #entry.Ids == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	local interval=(key=="Wreck"or key=="WreckBig"or key=="Coin"or key=="Scrap")and .18 or MIN_INTERVAL
 if now - (lastPlayed[key] or 0) < interval then
		return nil
	end
	lastPlayed[key] = now
	options = options or {}

	local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
	sound.Name = key
	sound.SoundId = pick(entry)
	sound.Volume = entry.Volume * (options.Volume or 1)
	local pitch = entry.Pitch or { 1, 1 }
	sound.PlaybackSpeed = (options.Pitch or 1) * (pitch[1] + math.random() * (pitch[2] - pitch[1]))
	sound.SoundGroup = effectsGroup

	if options.Position then
		local holder = Instance.new("Attachment")
		holder.Name = "SoundAnchor"
		holder.WorldPosition = options.Position
		holder.Parent = workspace.Terrain
		sound.RollOffMinDistance = 14
		sound.RollOffMaxDistance = 240
		sound.Parent = holder
		Debris:AddItem(holder, LIFETIME)
	else
		sound.Parent = options.Parent or SoundService
		Debris:AddItem(sound, LIFETIME)
	end
	activeVoices+=1
 if spatial then worldVoices+=1 end
 local released=false
 local function release()if not released then released=true activeVoices-=1 if spatial then worldVoices-=1 end end end
 sound.Ended:Once(release)
 sound.Destroying:Once(release)
 sound:Play()
	return sound
end

return SoundController

ServerScriptService.Services.Leaderboard.source:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Format = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.Format)

local AVATAR_SCALE = 1.45

local Podium = {}

local current = {}

local function podiumModel()
	local hall = workspace:FindFirstChild("Leaderboards") and workspace.Leaderboards:FindFirstChild("HallOfWreckers")
	return hall and hall:FindFirstChild("Podium")
end

local function findBodyAttachment(avatar, name)
	for _, part in ipairs(avatar:GetChildren()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			local attachment = part:FindFirstChild(name)
			if attachment and attachment:IsA("Attachment") then
				return attachment
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function seatAccessory(avatar, handle)
	for _, joint in ipairs(handle:GetChildren()) do
		if joint:IsA("JointInstance") and joint.Part0 and joint.Part1 then
			if joint.Part1 == handle then
				handle.CFrame = joint.Part0.CFrame * joint.C0 * joint.C1:Inverse()
				return
			elseif joint.Part0 == handle then
				handle.CFrame = joint.Part1.CFrame * joint.C1 * joint.C0:Inverse()
				return
			end
		end
	end
	for _, attachment in ipairs(handle:GetChildren()) do
		if attachment:IsA("Attachment") then
			local target = findBodyAttachment(avatar, attachment.Name)
			if target then
				handle.CFrame = target.WorldCFrame * attachment.CFrame:Inverse()
				return
			end
		end
	end
end

local function seatAccessories(avatar)
	for _, accessory in ipairs(avatar:GetChildren()) do
		if accessory:IsA("Accoutrement") then
			local handle = accessory:FindFirstChild("Handle")
			if handle and handle:IsA("BasePart") then
				seatAccessory(avatar, handle)
			end
		end
	end
end

local function headTop(avatar)
	local head = avatar:FindFirstChild("Head")
	if not head or not head:IsA("BasePart") then
		local box, size = avatar:GetBoundingBox()
		return box.Position.Y + size.Y / 2
	end
	local top = head.Position.Y + head.Size.Y / 2
	local limit = top + 2.5
	for _, accessory in ipairs(avatar:GetChildren()) do
		local handle = accessory:IsA("Accoutrement") and accessory:FindFirstChild("Handle")
		if handle and handle:IsA("BasePart") and (handle.Position - head.Position).Magnitude < head.Size.Magnitude * 1.5 then
			top = math.max(top, math.min(limit, handle.Position.Y + handle.Size.Y / 2))
		end
	end
	return top
end

local function placePlate(pedestal, plate, avatar)
	local base = plate:GetAttribute("BaseOffset")
	if base == nil then
		base = plate.StudsOffsetWorldSpace.Y
		plate:SetAttribute("BaseOffset", base)
	end
	local offset = base
	if avatar then
		local height = plate.Size.Y.Scale
		offset = math.max(base, headTop(avatar) + 0.6 + height / 2 - pedestal.Position.Y)
	end
	plate.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, offset, 0)
end

local function feetOffset(avatar)
	local pivot = avatar:GetPivot()
	local lowest = math.huge
	for _, part in ipairs(avatar:GetDescendants()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" and not part:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Accoutrement") then
			local cf, size = part.CFrame, part.Size
			local halfY = math.abs(cf.RightVector.Y) * size.X / 2 + math.abs(cf.UpVector.Y) * size.Y / 2 + math.abs(cf.LookVector.Y) * size.Z / 2
			lowest = math.min(lowest, cf.Position.Y - halfY)
		end
	end
	if lowest == math.huge then
		local box, size = avatar:GetBoundingBox()
		lowest = box.Position.Y - size.Y / 2
	end
	return pivot.Position.Y - lowest
end

local function facingTarget(podium)
	local hall = podium.Parent
	local entrance = hall and hall:FindFirstChild("Entrance")
	if entrance then
		return entrance:GetPivot().Position
	end
	return podium:GetPivot().Position - Vector3.new(0, 0, 100)
end

local function buildAvatar(userId)
	local ok, avatar = pcall(Players.CreateHumanoidModelFromUserId, Players, userId)
	if not ok or not avatar then
		return nil
	end
	seatAccessories(avatar)
	for _, descendant in ipairs(avatar:GetDescendants()) do
		if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
			descendant.Anchored = true
			descendant.CanCollide = false
			descendant.CanQuery = false
		elseif descendant:IsA("BaseScript") then
			descendant:Destroy()
		end
	end
	local humanoid = avatar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if humanoid then
		humanoid.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
	end
	pcall(avatar.ScaleTo, avatar, AVATAR_SCALE)
	return avatar
end

function Podium.Update(rows)
	local podium = podiumModel()
	if not podium then
		return
	end
	for rank = 1, 3 do
		local pedestal = podium:FindFirstChild("Pedestal" .. rank)
		local row = rows[rank]
		if pedestal then
			local plate = pedestal:FindFirstChild("NamePlate", true)
			if plate then
				local nameLabel = plate:FindFirstChild("PlayerName", true)
				local valueLabel = plate:FindFirstChild("Value", true)
				if nameLabel then
					nameLabel.Text = row and row.Name or "---"
				end
				if valueLabel then
					valueLabel.Text = row and Format.Number(row.Value) or ""
				end
			end
			local userId = row and row.UserId
			local slot = current[rank]
			if not slot or slot.UserId ~= userId then
				if slot and slot.Avatar then
					slot.Avatar:Destroy()
				end
				current[rank] = { UserId = userId }
				if plate then
					placePlate(pedestal, plate, nil)
				end
				if userId then
					local avatar = buildAvatar(userId)
					if avatar and current[rank].UserId == userId then
						local top = pedestal.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, pedestal.Size.Y / 2, 0)
						local position = top.Position + Vector3.new(0, feetOffset(avatar), 0)
						local target = facingTarget(podium)
						local standing = CFrame.lookAt(position, Vector3.new(target.X, position.Y, target.Z))
						avatar.Name = "Champion" .. rank
						avatar:PivotTo(standing)
						avatar.Parent = podium
						current[rank].Avatar = avatar
						if plate then
							placePlate(pedestal, plate, avatar)
						end
					elseif avatar then
						avatar:Destroy()
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

return Podium

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local Signal = require(Shared.Modules.Signal)
local Net = require(Shared.Modules.Net)

local READY_RETRY = 5

local DataController = { Priority = 1 }
DataController.Changed = Signal.new()
DataController.SessionChanged = Signal.new()
DataController.Loaded = Signal.new()

local data = nil
local session = {}

function DataController:Start()
	local remote = Net.Remote("DataSync")
	remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(kind, key, value)
		if kind == "Full" then
			local first = data == nil
			data = key
			session = value or {}
			for dataKey, dataValue in pairs(data) do
				self.Changed:Fire(dataKey, dataValue)
			end
			for sessionKey, sessionValue in pairs(session) do
				self.SessionChanged:Fire(sessionKey, sessionValue)
			end
			if first then
				self.Loaded:Fire(data)
				Players.LocalPlayer:SetAttribute("DataReady", true)
			end
		elseif kind == "Set" then
			if data then
				data[key] = value
				self.Changed:Fire(key, value)
			end
		elseif kind == "Session" then
			session[key] = value
			self.SessionChanged:Fire(key, value)
		end
	end)
	remote:FireServer("Ready")
	task.spawn(function()
		while not data do
			task.wait(READY_RETRY)
			if not data then
				remote:FireServer("Ready")
			end
		end
	end)
end

function DataController:Get(key)
	return data and data[key]
end

function DataController:GetAll()
	return data
end

function DataController:GetSession(key)
	return session[key]
end

function DataController:IsLoaded()
	return data ~= nil
end

function DataController:WaitUntilLoaded()
	while not data do
		self.Loaded:Wait()
	end
	return data
end

function DataController:Observe(key, callback)
	if data then
		task.spawn(callback, data[key])
	end
	return self.Changed:Connect(function(changedKey, value)
		if changedKey == key then
			callback(value)
		end
	end)
end

function DataController:ObserveSession(key, callback)
	if session[key] ~= nil then
		task.spawn(callback, session[key])
	end
	return self.SessionChanged:Connect(function(changedKey, value)
		if changedKey == key then
			callback(value)
		end
	end)
end

function DataController:GetStats()
	return session.Stats or {}
end

return DataController
