local ReplicatedStorage=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Config=require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config.CacheConfig)
local Zones=require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config.ZoneConfig)
local Notifier=require(game.ServerScriptService.Modules.Notifier)
local CacheService={Priority=53}
local models={}
local function part(model,name,size,pos,color,material)
 local p=Instance.new("Part")
 p.Name=name p.Size=size p.Position=pos p.Color=color p.Material=material or Enum.Material.Metal
 p.Anchored=true p.CanCollide=false p.CanTouch=false p.CanQuery=false p.CastShadow=false p.Parent=model
 return p
end

local function safePosition(zone,offset)
 local center=Zones.Center(zone)
 local desired=Vector3.new(center.X+offset.X,1.6,center.Z+offset.Y)
 local params=OverlapParams.new()
 params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
 params.FilterDescendantsInstances={workspace.Map,workspace.Destructibles}
 for _,shift in ipairs({Vector3.zero,Vector3.new(12,0,0),Vector3.new(0,0,12),Vector3.new(-12,0,0),Vector3.new(0,0,-12),Vector3.new(20,0,20),Vector3.new(-20,0,-20),Vector3.new(20,0,-20),Vector3.new(-20,0,20)})do
  local pos=desired+shift local blocked=false
  for _,p in ipairs(workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(pos),Vector3.new(5,3,5),params))do
   if p.CanCollide and p.Position.Y+p.Size.Y/2>1 then blocked=true break end
  end
  if not blocked then return pos end
 end
 return nil
end

function CacheService:Init(services)
 self.Services=services self.Data=services.DataService
end

function CacheService:Collect(player,id)
 local cache=Config.ById[id]local model=models[id]
 local data=self.Data:GetData(player)
 if not cache or not model or not data then return false end
 local char=player.Character local root=char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 local human=char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 if not root or not human or human.Health<=0 or (root.Position-model.Body.Position).Magnitude>12 then return false end
 if not self.Services.ZoneService:IsUnlocked(player,cache.Zone)then return false end
 local progress=data.QuestProgress[cache.QuestId]
 if not progress or progress.Completed or progress.Used[id]then return false end
 self.Services.QuestService:Advance(player,"FindCache",0,id)
 self.Data:Replicate(player,"QuestProgress")
 Notifier.Send(player,{Kind="Info",Text="SALVAGE CACHE FOUND",Subtext=progress.Progress.." / "..progress.Target.." found. View Collections for your trail.",Icon="Scrap"})
 return true
end

function CacheService:Start()
 local root=workspace:FindFirstChild("SalvageCaches")or Instance.new("Folder")
 root.Name="SalvageCaches"root.Parent=workspace
 for _,cache in ipairs(Config.List)do
  local pos=safePosition(cache.Zone,cache.Offset)
  if not pos then warn("[CacheService] No clear placement for "..cache.Id)continue end
  local model=Instance.new("Model")model.Name=cache.Id model:SetAttribute("CacheId",cache.Id)model:SetAttribute("Zone",cache.Zone)model:SetAttribute("QuestId",cache.QuestId)
  local body=part(model,"Body",Vector3.new(3,2.6,3),pos,Color3.fromRGB(40,53,61))
  part(model,"Lid",Vector3.new(3.2,.25,3.2),pos+Vector3.new(0,1.4,0),Color3.fromRGB(184,143,54))
  part(model,"Band",Vector3.new(.4,2.7,3.1),pos,Zones.ById[cache.Zone].Accent:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(80,100,110),.4))
  local badge=Instance.new("BillboardGui")
  badge.Name="Marker"badge.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(105,24)badge.StudsOffset=Vector3.new(0,2.5,0)badge.MaxDistance=38 badge.AlwaysOnTop=false badge.Parent=body
  local label=Instance.new("TextLabel")label.BackgroundTransparency=.15 label.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(23,31,39)
  label.Text=cache.QuestId==Config.QuestId and "SALVAGE CACHE"or "DEEP SALVAGE"label.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold label.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(92,210,220)label.TextScaled=true label.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1)label.Parent=badge
  local attachment=Instance.new("Attachment")attachment.Name="Interaction"attachment.Position=Vector3.new(0,1.8,0)attachment.Parent=body
  local prompt=Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
  prompt.Name="Collect"prompt.ActionText="Collect"prompt.ObjectText="Hidden Salvage"
  prompt.Style=Enum.ProximityPromptStyle.Custom
  prompt.HoldDuration=.4 prompt.MaxActivationDistance=10 prompt.RequiresLineOfSight=true prompt.Parent=attachment
  prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)self:Collect(player,cache.Id)end)
  model.PrimaryPart=body model.Parent=root models[cache.Id]=model
 end
end
return CacheService

local DEFAULT_MAX_STRING = 200

local Validate = {}

local function isFinite(value)
	return type(value) == "number" and value == value and value ~= math.huge and value ~= -math.huge
end

function Validate.String(value, maxLength)
	if type(value) ~= "string" then
		return false
	end
	if #value > (maxLength or DEFAULT_MAX_STRING) then
		return false
	end
	return utf8.len(value) ~= nil
end

function Validate.Number(value, minimum, maximum)
	if not isFinite(value) then
		return false
	end
	if minimum ~= nil and value < minimum then
		return false
	end
	if maximum ~= nil and value > maximum then
		return false
	end
	return true
end

function Validate.Integer(value, minimum, maximum)
	return Validate.Number(value, minimum, maximum) and value % 1 == 0
end

function Validate.Vector3(value)
	return typeof(value) == "Vector3" and isFinite(value.X) and isFinite(value.Y) and isFinite(value.Z)
end

function Validate.OneOf(value, list)
	if value == nil or type(list) ~= "table" then
		return false
	end
	if table.find(list, value) ~= nil then
		return true
	end
	return type(value) == "string" and list[value] ~= nil
end

function Validate.Boolean(value)
	return type(value) == "boolean"
end

return Validate

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local ToolConfig = require(Shared.Config.ToolConfig)
local ThemeConfig = require(Shared.Config.ThemeConfig)
local Format = require(Shared.Modules.Format)
local Net = require(Shared.Modules.Net)
local Fx = require(script.Fx)
local Floaters = require(script.Floaters)
local Shake = require(script.Shake)
local Projectiles = require(script.Projectiles)
local Drops = require(script.Drops)
local HealthBars = require(script.HealthBars)
local WorldEvents = require(script.WorldEvents)

local Colors = ThemeConfig.Colors
local SHAKE_BY_CLASS = { Small = 0.25, Medium = 0.45, Large = 0.75, Huge = 1.1, Event = 1.2 }

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local EffectsController = { Priority = 15 }

local settings = { Shake = true, DamageNumbers = true, LowEffects = false }

local function rootPosition()
	local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	return root and root.Position
end

local function proximityScale(position, radius)
	local origin = rootPosition()
	if not origin then
		return 0
	end
	return math.clamp(1 - (position - origin).Magnitude / radius, 0, 1)
end

function EffectsController:Init(controllers)
	self.Controllers = controllers
	Fx.Setup()
	Floaters.Setup()
	Shake.Setup()
	Projectiles.Setup(Fx)
	Drops.Setup(controllers)
	HealthBars.Setup()
	WorldEvents.Setup(Fx, Shake, controllers)
end

function EffectsController:Start()
	local controllers = self.Controllers
	local sound = controllers.SoundController

	controllers.DataController:Observe("Settings", function(value)
		if type(value) == "table" then
			settings.Shake = value.Shake ~= false
			settings.DamageNumbers = value.DamageNumbers ~= false
			settings.LowEffects = value.LowEffects == true
   require(script.Parent.Parent.Components.UIKit).ReducedMotion=settings.LowEffects
			Shake.SetEnabled(settings.Shake and not settings.LowEffects)
   Drops.SetLowEffects(settings.LowEffects)
			Fx.SetLowEffects(settings.LowEffects)
			Projectiles.SetLowEffects(settings.LowEffects)
		end
	end)

	Net.Remote("HitFeedback").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(hits)
		for index, hit in ipairs(hits) do
			if index > 6 then
				break
			end
			Fx.Spark(hit.Position, hit.Crit and Colors.Crit or Colors.Yellow, hit.Crit and 1.6 or 1)
			if settings.DamageNumbers then
				Floaters.Damage(hit.Position, hit.Damage, hit.Crit)
			end
			HealthBars.Track(hit.Uid)
		end
		local first = hits[1]
		if first then
			sound:PlayImpact(first.MaterialType,first.SizeClass,first.Position,first.Crit)
			Shake.Add(first.Crit and 0.3 or 0.12)
		end
	end)

	Net.Remote("HitFx").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(payload)
		if payload.UserId ~= player.UserId and proximityScale(payload.Position, 160) > 0 then
			Fx.Spark(payload.Position, payload.Crit and Colors.Crit or Colors.Yellow, 0.7)
			sound:PlayImpact(payload.MaterialType,nil,payload.Position,payload.Crit,.6)
		end
	end)

	Net.Remote("AttackFx").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(payload)
		if payload.UserId ~= player.UserId and (proximityScale(payload.From, 220) > 0 or proximityScale(payload.To, 220) > 0) then
			Projectiles.Fire(payload.ToolId, payload.From, payload.To, false, payload.Confirmed == true)
		end
	end)

	controllers.CombatController.Attacked:Connect(function(toolId, model, aimPosition, from)
		local def = ToolConfig.ById[toolId]
		if def and def.Kind ~= "Melee" then
			local target = aimPosition or (model and model:GetPivot().Position)
			if target then
				Projectiles.Fire(toolId, from, target, true, false)
				sound:Play(def.Fx == "TNT" and "Launch" or def.Fx == "Rocket" and "Rocket" or def.Fx == "Plasma" and "Plasma" or def.Fx == "Void" and "Void" or "Beam", { Position = from })
			end
		end
	end)

	Net.Remote("AttackConfirmed").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(payload)
		if type(payload) == "table" and payload.ToolId and typeof(payload.From) == "Vector3" and typeof(payload.To) == "Vector3" then
			Projectiles.Impact(payload.ToolId, payload.From, payload.To)
		end
	end)

	Net.Remote("WreckFx").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(payload)
		local near = proximityScale(payload.Position, 220)
		if near <= 0 then
			return
		end
		Fx.Explosion(payload)
		local big = payload.SizeClass == "Huge" or payload.SizeClass == "Event" or payload.SizeClass == "Large"
		sound:Play(big and "WreckBig" or "Wreck", { Position = payload.Position })
		Shake.Add((SHAKE_BY_CLASS[payload.SizeClass] or 0.4) * near, 0.35)
		HealthBars.Release(payload.Uid)
	end)

	Net.Remote("RewardFx").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(payload)
		local position = payload.Position
		if not settings.LowEffects and payload.Wrecked and payload.Counted then
			Floaters.Text(position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), "WRECKED!", Colors.Orange, 1.35)
		end
		if (payload.Cash or 0) > 0 then
			task.delay(0.12, Floaters.Text, position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0), "+" .. Format.Number(payload.Cash) .. " CASH", Colors.Cash, 1)
			sound:Play("Coin")
		end
		if not settings.LowEffects and (payload.Xp or 0) > 0 then
			task.delay(0.24, Floaters.Text, position, "+" .. Format.Number(payload.Xp) .. " XP", Colors.Cyan, 0.75)
		end
		if (payload.Cash or 0) > 0 then
			Fx.CoinBurst(position, rootPosition())
		end
	end)

	Net.Remote("WorldFx").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(kind, data)
		WorldEvents.Handle(kind, data or {})
	end)

	Net.Remote("ScrapDrops").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(action, list)
		Drops.Handle(action, list)
	end)
end

return EffectsController

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local EventConfig = require(Shared.Config.EventConfig)
local ZoneConfig = require(Shared.Config.ZoneConfig)

local EDGE_MARGIN = 30
local ATTEMPTS = 24

local Spawning = {}

local overlap = OverlapParams.new()
overlap.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

function Spawning.PlayersByZone()
	local counts = {}
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local zoneId = root and ZoneConfig.ZoneAt(root.Position)
		local zone = zoneId and ZoneConfig.ById[zoneId]
		if zone and zone.Order then
			counts[zoneId] = (counts[zoneId] or 0) + 1
		end
	end
	return counts
end

function Spawning.BusiestZone()
	local best, bestCount = "ScrapYard", 0
	for zoneId, count in pairs(Spawning.PlayersByZone()) do
		if count > bestCount then
			best, bestCount = zoneId, count
		end
	end
	return best, math.max(bestCount, 1)
end

function Spawning.FindSpot(zoneId, size)
	local center = ZoneConfig.Center(zoneId)
	local half = ZoneConfig.CellSize / 2 - EDGE_MARGIN - math.max(size.X, size.Z) / 2
	overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances = { workspace.Destructibles, workspace.EventObjects }
	for _ = 1, ATTEMPTS do
		local x = center.X + (math.random() * 2 - 1) * half
		local z = center.Z + (math.random() * 2 - 1) * half
		local cframe = CFrame.new(x, 0, z) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(math.random(0, 7) * 45), 0)
		local probe = cframe * CFrame.new(0, size.Y / 2 + 0.5, 0)
		if #workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(probe, size + Vector3.new(6, 0, 6), overlap) == 0 then
			return cframe
		end
	end
	return CFrame.new(center.X + math.random(-20, 20), 0, center.Z + math.random(-20, 20))
end

function Spawning.Scaled(objectId, zoneId, crowd)
	local def = EventConfig.Objects[objectId]
	local zone = ZoneConfig.ById[zoneId]
	local scale = zone and zone.HealthScale or 1
	local crowdScale = 1 + (def.PlayerScaling or 0) * math.max((crowd or 1) - 1, 0)
	return {
		MaxHealth = def.BaseHealth * scale * crowdScale,
		Reward = def.BaseReward * scale * crowdScale,
		ScrapReward = def.BaseScrap * scale * crowdScale,
	}
end

function Spawning.SpawnObject(destruction, objectId, zoneId, crowd, eventId, lifetime, cframe)
	local def = EventConfig.Objects[objectId]
	if not def then
		return nil
	end
	local stats = Spawning.Scaled(objectId, zoneId, crowd)
	return destruction:Spawn(objectId, cframe or Spawning.FindSpot(zoneId, def.Size), {
		Zone = zoneId,
		MaxHealth = stats.MaxHealth,
		Reward = stats.Reward,
		ScrapReward = stats.ScrapReward,
		EventId = eventId,
		Lifetime = lifetime,
	})
end

return Spawning

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local ChaosShopConfig = require(Shared.Config.ChaosShopConfig)
local Formulas = require(Shared.Modules.Formulas)
local Signal = require(Shared.Modules.Signal)
local Validate = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.Validate)
local Notifier = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.Notifier)

local ChaosShopService = { Priority = 41 }
ChaosShopService.Purchased = Signal.new()

function ChaosShopService:Init(services)
	self.Services = services
	self.Data = services.DataService
end

function ChaosShopService:Start()
	local economy = self.Services.EconomyService

	self.Services.AntiExploitService:Connect("BuyChaosUpgrade", { Rate = 4, Burst = 6 }, function(player, itemId)
		if not Validate.String(itemId, 32) then
			return
		end
		local item = ChaosShopConfig.ById[itemId]
		if not item then
			return
		end
		local data = self.Data:GetData(player)
		local level = data.ChaosUpgrades[itemId] or 0
		if level >= item.MaxLevel then
			Notifier.Error(player, "MAX LEVEL")
			return
		end
		if not economy:SpendCores(player, Formulas.ChaosUpgradeCost(itemId, level)) then
			Notifier.Error(player, "NOT ENOUGH CHAOS CORES")
			return
		end
		data.ChaosUpgrades[itemId] = level + 1
		self.Data:Replicate(player, "ChaosUpgrades")
		economy:RefreshStats(player)
		self.Purchased:Fire(player, itemId, level + 1)
	end)
end

return ChaosShopService
